title: Product Research Analyst Intern
description:
About Us

Axension AI is a SaaS based B2B company rebuilding how enterprises operate. We build multi agent AI workflow automation systems for enterprises across multiple high stakes industries where operational inefficiency is costly and errors have consequences.We engineer autonomous systems that execute, coordinate, validate, and optimize workflows without constant human supervision. Every deployment is benchmarked. Every outcome is measurable. Every system is built for executive visibility.Our infrastructure aligns with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 compliance is foundational, not an afterthought. If efficiency is strategy infrastructure is power.

About the Role

As a Product Research Analyst Intern, you will be the person who helps Axension AI understand its markets, its buyers, and its competitors deeply. You will conduct structured research across multiple enterprise verticals, generate insights that directly inform product and go to market decisions, and work closely with the founding team. This is not a passive role your findings will be read, used, and acted on.

Responsibilities

Research enterprise AI, SaaS, and workflow automation markets across multiple high stakes industry verticals

Identify market size, growth trends, and whitespace opportunities within each target vertical

Monitor and track competitors products, pricing, messaging, positioning, and go to market moves

Build and maintain Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) and detailed buyer personas for each sector

Conduct primary research through outreach, interviews, and surveys with enterprise buyers and decision-makers

Analyze industry pain points and map how Axension AI's solutions address them

Assist in crafting product positioning statements and value proposition frameworks

Research enterprise SaaS pricing models and benchmark Axension AI's positioning in the market

Track key market signals and prepare clear, structured insights reports for leadership

Support go to market planning for new vertical entries and product feature launches

Translate complex technical capabilities into clear business value language for enterprise buyers

Collaborate with product, sales, and content teams to ensure research insights are applied effectively

What We Are Looking For

Strong analytical mindset you draw conclusions from data, not just describe it

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Self-driven with the ability to work independently in a fast moving startup environment

Commercially minded you think in terms of markets, buyers, and business outcomes

Genuinely curious about AI, enterprise technology, and how large industries operate

Prior exposure to market research, business analysis, or consulting is a plus not required

Key Skills

Market Research & Industry Analysis

Competitive Intelligence

Buyer Persona & ICP Development

Product Positioning & Value Proposition

WritingData Analysis & Interpretation

Business Writing & Structured

ReportingFamiliarity with tools like Google Trends, Statista, Crunchbase, G2, or Notion is a plus

What You Gain

Real research work that directly influences product and sales decisions at Axension AI Direct access to and mentorship from the founding team Portfolio ready deliverables market analyses, competitive reports, and research frameworks A strong reference based on the quality and impact of your contribution

NoteThis is a remote role with INR 3,000/- stipend each month for initial four months. Good performing candidates will be offered a paid full time position after successful completion of four months internship and the pay would be revised upwards.

title: Data & Insights Analyst
description:
Data & Insights Analyst

**Role:**
Data & Insights Analyst

**Experience:**
3–4 years

**Function:**
AI & Data Intelligence

**﻿Location:**
Hyderabad

**Work Mode:**
Work From Office

**About Zenwork**

Zenwork is a market-leading, award-winning provider of digital tax compliance software serving ~20% of US SMBs, mid-market companies, and large enterprises, including 30,000+ CPA firms across the United States. As businesses rely more on independent contractors, vendors, and suppliers, Zenwork helps customers manage increasing federal and state tax reporting requirements through modern, automated compliance technology.

Zenwork’s Tax1099 software enables companies of all sizes to compliantly e-file 1099 tax forms and other critical tax documents, with ~90M+ tax forms e-filed to date. Headquartered in Fayetteville, Arkansas, Zenwork announced a
**$163 million minority investment from Spectrum Equity**
to accelerate product innovation and capture the growing opportunity in automated tax compliance and regulatory reporting.

Learn more: Zenwork

**The Role**

We are looking for a highly analytical, logical, and business-minded Data & Insights Analyst to join our AI team. The person must understand business workflows, customer behaviour, product usage, and stakeholder needs, then translate that context into meaningful insights and action.

The ideal candidate can independently structure ambiguous problems, write advanced analytical queries, build trusted dashboards, use Python for analysis and automation, and leverage AI tools to work faster and smarter.

**What You Will Do**

·  Develop a strong understanding of business processes, product workflows, customer journeys, and stakeholder objectives.

·  Translate business questions into analytical frameworks, metrics, and clear recommendations.

·  Write, optimise, and validate complex SQL queries across large and varied datasets.

·  Use Python to automate data preparation, validation, analysis, monitoring, and recurring reporting.

·  Identify trends, anomalies, risks, opportunities, and leading indicators that stakeholders should act on.

·  Define meaningful KPIs and distinguish decision-useful signals from noise.

·  Build intuitive dashboards that explain what happened, why it happened, and what users should do next.

·  Use AI tools to accelerate analysis, query development, research, documentation, and workflow automation.

·  Partner with Product, Engineering, AI, Operations, Growth, and leadership teams to support data-driven decisions.

**What You Bring**

·  3–4 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, product analytics, or a related role.

·  Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, query optimisation, and data validation.

·  Strong Python skills, including Pandas, NumPy, APIs, automation, and data transformation.

·  Experience building dashboards using Power BI, Amazon QuickSight, Tableau, or a similar BI platform.

·  Excellent logical reasoning and the ability to understand and accurately represent complex business rules.

·  Ability to communicate insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

·  High ownership, intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, and comfort working through ambiguity.

**Nice to Have**

·  Exposure to AI/ML, LLMs, AI agents, or modern AI-enabled analytical workflows.

·  Experience with AWS data services such as Redshift, S3, or Glue.

·  Experience in SaaS, FinTech, payments, tax, compliance, or regulatory technology.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Stakeholders trust your numbers, use your dashboards, and act on your insights. You proactively identify meaningful signals, automate repetitive work, and help the team make faster, better-informed product and business decisions.

title: RC FS-BT INS-P And C-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Service line - Position Title:**

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Worked on multiple Business transformation, upgrade and modernization programs.
* Requirements Gathering, Elicitation –writing BRDs, FSDs. Conducting JAD sessions and Workshops to capture requirements and working close with Product Owner.
* Work with the client to define the most optimal future state operational process and related product configuration.
* Define scope by providing innovative solutions and challenging all new client requirements and change requests but simultaneously ensuring that client gets the required business value.
* Elaborate and deliver clearly defined requirement documents with relevant dataflow and process flow diagrams.
* Work closely with product design development team to analyse and extract functional enhancements.
* Provide product consultancy and assist the client with acceptance criteria gathering and support throughout the project life cycle.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Product Knowledge – Guidewire, Duckcreek, Exigent, Majesco. (Preferred Guidewire/Duckcreek)
* Strong skills in stakeholder management and communication.
* Should have end to end processes in P&C insurance domain.
* Data transformation, Business data modelling, Data mapping, transformation rules, data migration, data profiling, data visualisation, Tableau, Power-BI, Reporting, Basic understanding of SQL query
* AI and Gen AI use cases implementation, Understanding of AI architecture for AI Use cases
* Should be ready to work in flexible shifts (a good amount of overlap with US/UK hours).
* Good organizational and time management skills required.
* Should have good written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Industry certifications AINS 21 - Property and Liability Insurance Principles, AINS 22 - Personal Insurance, AINS 23 - Commercial Insurance and AINS 24 - General Insurance for IT and Support Professionals will be added advantage.
* Additional experience in Life or other insurance domain is added advantage.

We expect you to work effectively as a team member and build good relationships with the client. You will have the opportunity to expand your domain knowledge and skills and will be able to collaborate frequently with other EY professionals with a wide variety of expertise.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Manager, Product Design
description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
**What you get to do in this role:**

* Directly manage, mentor and develop 3–5 designers
* Drive the UX vision and execution of a platform that produces a product line to revolutionize workplace productivity and analytics solutions for some of the largest companies in the world
* Collaborate cross-functionally with product management, user research, engineering and content from strategic definition, planning, architecture, through tactical execution of the product roadmaps
* Distill complex problems into clear goals and requirements for the design and research team
* Understand the company's Design Systems, encourage their application, and contribute to their further development and maintenance.
* Drive the growth of user-centric, collaborative culture across the Business Unit
* Evangelize design strategy and product vision across the global, distributed design teams
* Assist in conducting user needs assessment, task analysis and develop user profiles; identify key tasks for user research, competitive analysis and user testing, develop usability plans.
* Develop high level task flow content and then use storyboards and other design documents to communicate concepts and vision to others.
* Lead your team through rapid iterations of theoretical task scenarios, navigation map, flow, and state-transition diagrams to document design decisions.
* Oversee your team's work: detailed mockups and prototypes and behavior specifications.
* Oversee UI layouts including controls, labels and graphical elements for software on both mobile and desktop platforms with an eye towards experience unification.
* Participate in documentation development process such as user experience specifications, testing and evaluation.
* Work closely with product management in UX ideation and innovation.
* Travel up to 20% of the year

**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* Minimum 3 years of experience managing people and/or leading design teams
* Minimum 10+ years of experience in UX Design and/or Interaction Design field
* Passion to grow and mentor people
* Strong skills in Information Architecture
* A portfolio of work samples representing your work and approach
* Expertise in one or more of the following enterprise product spaces: IT Security Management, IT Operations Management, Security Operations, HR Service Delivery, Customer Service Management (CSM), or Finance & Legal
* Expert with Sketch, Invision, Photoshop, or other design tools
* Ability to do rapid prototyping in Axure, Keynote, Framer, Principle or similar tools
* Ability to understand and distill complex problems into clean solutions
* Must have strong written and verbal English communication skills
* Must have excellent teamwork, communication, and technical problem-solving skills to contribute within a multi-functional and multi-disciplined team
* Obsessed with the relentless pursuit of UX perfection working inside an iterative and agile development environment
* Must be able to work with minimal supervision in a fluid, fast-paced and truly agile environment
* Expected to demonstrate a high level of initiative, good sense of humor, and a “make it work” ethos
* Experience in creating content and/or designing with compliance to WCAG 2.0/2.1 AA guidelines is a plus

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of web design technologies (HTML, CSS)
* Experience working in an agile or incremental manner
* Experience working with tools such as ServiceNow, Miro, or Abstract

title: IT Manager – Systems & Administration
description:
**About us**

At Gameopedia, our journey began in Norway with a simple mission: to be the geeky gamer friend who helps people discover great games and have better gaming experiences. From humble beginnings, we quickly made our mark, landing our first major customer just a year later, one of Norway’s largest news publications. That milestone led us to expand to India, where five passionate gamers began building Gameopedia around a dining table in a small apartment.

Today, with offices in Oslo and Hyderabad, we provide industry-leading video game data, metadata and insights to some of the world’s biggest companies, powering experiences and decisions for millions of gamers every day.

Over more than 15 years, we have built deep gaming expertise and one of the industry’s richest and most structured sources of video game data. As technology and AI transform how games are discovered, understood and experienced, we believe trusted, comprehensive and high-quality data will become more important than ever.

Our ambition is to make Gameopedia the
**data truth for gaming**
: the trusted foundation that companies, products and AI systems rely on to understand the world of games. Our vision is to empower businesses across the gaming ecosystem to create extraordinary experiences for a billion gamers every day.

If you want to help build the data foundation powering the future of gaming, we’d love to have you on the journey.

**The Role: IT Manager**

We’re looking for an IT Manager to lead and scale our IT operations globally. You’ll design, build, and manage a secure, robust, and efficient IT infrastructure, ensuring seamless support for a growing, multi-location organization. As both a strategist and a hands-on leader, you’ll help us achieve operational excellence and empower our teams to innovate.

**What We Are Looking For:**

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong practical experience in several of the following:
* Google Workspace administration
* Windows and macOS administration
* Identity and access management
* Endpoint/device management
* Networking, Wi-Fi, firewalls and VPNs
* SSO and MFA
* SaaS administration
* Backup and recovery
* Endpoint security
* IT asset management
* IT ticketing/service management tools
* Basic automation of IT administration
* Experience with cloud-first technology organizations is preferred.
* Working Style and Capabilities

**We are looking for someone who:**

* Takes ownership and follows issues through to resolution
* Can work independently without constant technical supervision
* Is hands-on and technically curious
* Can research unfamiliar technologies and form a recommendation
* Solves root causes rather than repeatedly fixing symptoms
* Creates clear, structured documentation
* Has strong written and spoken English
* Communicates effectively with vendors and internal stakeholders
* Is comfortable challenging vendors when necessary
* Can prioritize effectively
* Is proactive rather than reactive
* Understands when to solve something internally and when specialist help is required
* Uses data and evidence when making recommendations

**Qualifications**

* Relevant degree, diploma or equivalent professional experience
* 6-8 years of relevant IT / system administration experience
* Strong Google Workspace administration experience
* Experience managing junior IT resources and/or vendors
* Relevant Google, Microsoft, networking, security or cloud certifications are preferred but not mandatory
* Practical capability, independent problem-solving and demonstrated ownership of real-world IT environments will be valued more highly than certifications alone.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary.
* Health insurance.
* Casual dress code.
* Dynamic, collaboration-friendly office environment.

title: Architect I - Cloud Infrastructure Services
description:
**Role Description**
Cloud Architect, Codon Platform (AWS and Azure)
  
  
Location: UST Hyderabad
  
  
Type: Full time, in-house
  
  
**About The Role**
Codon is UST's governed developer platform: a web chat and a browser terminal that put Claude to work on ServiceNow and other enterprise platforms, with every write
  
  
audited, every secret brokered, and every destination controlled at the network edge. It runs today on AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS PostgreSQL, EFS, internal ALB with blue/green
  
  
deployments, a Squid egress tier) with Azure for identity (Entra) and Key Vault, reached over a transit gateway, SD-WAN and Zscaler.
  
  
We are hiring the person who owns this architecture end to end and takes it from a single-tenant dev and pilot footprint to a secure, multi-tenant, resilient product. You
  
  
will be the technical authority for infrastructure, the counterpart to our network, security, identity and AI gateway teams, and the hands that write the Terraform.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
Architecture and roadmap
  
  

* Own the target architecture for Codon across AWS and Azure: landing zone, account and subscription structure, network, identity, data, secrets, observability.
* Design and deliver multi-tenancy: tenant isolation at the account, network, data and identity layers; per-tenant cost attribution; tenant onboarding as code.
* Design and deliver disaster recovery and business continuity: RPO and RTO targets per tier, cross-region strategy, backup and restore drills, runbooks that are

rehearsed, not written once.
  
  

* Define the environment model (dev, test, pilot, production) and the promotion path between them, including the deployment gate that holds a release until its checks

Security
  
  

* Raise the platform to a documented security posture: least-privilege IAM, workload identity, secret rotation with zero downtime (we already rotate database and gateway

keys), private endpoints, egress allow-listing, encryption and key management (KMS and Key Vault).
  
  

* Run threat modelling for the platform's trust boundaries, including an AI agent with a shell inside a container, and close the findings.
* Prepare the platform for internal security review and for customer audits (SOC 2 style evidence, logging and retention, access reviews).

Build and operate
  
  

* Write and review the Terraform (modules, environment roots, policy as code). Everything is code; nothing is clicked in a console.
* Own the CI/CD and release tooling with the product team: image builds, SBOMs, the deployer, evidence capture.
* Set up observability that answers questions in minutes: central logging, metrics, tracing, ing, cost dashboards.
* Lead incident analysis across teams. Recent examples from our own log: a rotated database password that silently broke new connections, an egress path that drops for

hours on a shared security gateway, a load balancer whose private addresses changed under a fixed route.
  
  
Work with others
  
  

* Be the single technical contact for UST's Network, Cloud, Security, Identity and AI gateway teams; turn their constraints into designs and their requests into tickets

with evidence.
  
  

* Pair with the product engineers daily. Review their infrastructure changes, teach them the platform's rules, and keep the design records current.
* Guide one or two platform engineers as the team grows.

What you bring
  
  
**Experience**

* 12 to 14 years in software or infrastructure engineering, of which at least 10 years hands-on in public cloud, with production ownership on both AWS and Azure. Depth on

one, real delivery on the other.
  
  

* You have designed and operated at least one multi-tenant SaaS platform and at least one cross-region DR setup, and you can describe what broke in each.
* You have written Terraform for years, not months. You can read a plan and tell what will be replaced and why.

Technical
  
  

* AWS: VPC design, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, ECS or EKS, RDS, EFS, ALB and NLB, IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, Route 53, Organizations and SCPs.
* Azure: Entra ID (enterprise apps, SAML and OIDC, conditional access), Key Vault with private endpoints, VNets and Private Link, Azure Policy, hybrid connectivity.
* Networking: routing across cloud and on-premises, SD-WAN and security gateways such as Zscaler, TLS and certificate lifecycle, DNS split-horizon.
* Security: zero trust principles, workload identity, secret rotation, container hardening, audit logging, compliance evidence.
* Containers and delivery: Docker, Fargate or Kubernetes, blue/green and canary deployments, GitHub Actions or equivalent, SBOM and vulnerability management.
* Comfortable reading application code (TypeScript or Python) well enough to find where an infrastructure assumption lives.

Ways of working
  
  

* You write things down: decision records, runbooks, incident reports with evidence. You prefer a diagram and a table to a meeting.
* You test in production-like conditions and rehearse failures before they happen.
* You are direct with other teams about what is theirs and what is ours, with the logs to show it.

Certifications (any two, or equivalent demonstrated experience)
  
  

* AWS Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional
* Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
* A security credential such as AWS Security Specialty, AZ-500 or CCSP

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience hosting LLM or agent workloads: gateways, key brokering, cost metering per user, isolation of agent sandboxes.
* Enterprise platform background: ServiceNow, Salesforce or SAP integration patterns.
* FinOps practice: cost allocation by tenant, rightsizing, commitment planning.
* Exposure to regulated environments and customer audits.

First six months, what success looks like
  
  

* A written target architecture for multi-tenant Codon on AWS and Azure, reviewed with Security and Network, with a sequenced plan.
* Production environment stood up as code with the deployment gate, logging, ing and cost reporting in place.
* A DR design with targets agreed, and the first restore drill completed and documented.
* The current security findings closed, secret rotation proven without downtime, and an audit evidence pack that a reviewer can read.
* Standing working agreements with the Network, Identity and AI gateway teams, with named contacts and response expectations.

**Skills**
AWS, Azure Policy, AWS Transit Gateway, AWS Fargate

title: Oracle Technology Specialist - II
description:

**Role Purpose:**
The Oracle Technology Specialist – II supports the availability, reliability, performance, and secure operation of Oracle technology services across Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). The role provides hands-on administration and operational support for OCI infrastructure, Oracle Database, and Oracle Fusion Middleware, including provisioning, monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting, automation, and release support.
  
  
The role works closely with business users, project teams, system integrators, and service providers to maintain stable and effective Oracle services.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Infrastructure Administration and Operations**

* Administer and support Oracle Database 19c and 26ai, Oracle Fusion Middleware 12c and 14c, and associated OCI services. Provision and configure OCI infrastructure in accordance with approved architecture, security standards, and operational procedures.
* Perform routine maintenance, including patching, backup and recovery, configuration changes, and service health checks.

* Proactively monitor infrastructure health, performance, capacity, and resource utilization, investigating alerts and taking appropriate corrective action.
* Diagnose database, middleware, and cloud infrastructure issues and contribute to root cause analysis and problem resolution.
* Identify availability, capacity, performance, and operational risks and take appropriate remediation or escalation action.

**Service Management and Release Coordination**

* Manage incidents and service requests within agreed service expectations, ensuring effective investigation, communication, documentation, and resolution.
* Contribute to problem management, root cause analysis, and corrective actions for recurring service issues.
* Coordinate infrastructure maintenance and release activities with the Release Manager, application teams, business stakeholders, and service providers.
* Support Oracle quarterly updates, patching, change implementation, and post-change validation.
* Identify technical dependencies and scheduling conflicts and help minimize disruption to business services.
* Support application capacity and infrastructure requirements while maintaining security, privacy, and operational standards.

**Automation and Continuous Improvement**

* Collaborate with GSI and project teams to establish effective monitoring and operational support for new and changed services. Automate repeatable infrastructure provisioning, monitoring, health checks, and administrative activities using Terraform, OCI CLI, SQL, PL/SQL, and Unix/Linux shell scripting.
* Maintain and enhance Infrastructure as Code (IaC) configurations for OCI using Terraform, following established standards and change-control processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve platform reliability, monitoring, operational efficiency, and support processes.
* Support the transition of new and changed services from project delivery into operational support.

**Collaboration and Knowledge Management**

* Work with Key Business Users, system integration leads, infrastructure teams, application teams, project teams, and external service providers to maintain service availability and performance.
* Engage with stakeholders to understand service concerns, operational requirements, and opportunities for improvement.
* Provide clear technical updates during incidents, maintenance, releases, and service-impacting events.
* Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), runbooks, troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, and training materials.
* Document technical resolutions and lessons learned to improve knowledge sharing and reduce recurring operational issues.

**Required Experience:**

* Minimum 3 years of infrastructure, platform, or technology support experience, including at least 2 years of hands-on OCI experience.
* Experience administering or supporting Oracle Database, Oracle Fusion Middleware, and OCI services in production or business-critical environments.
* Experience provisioning, configuring, monitoring, maintaining, and troubleshooting cloud infrastructure.
* Experience working in a global, multinational, and multi-vendor environment.
* Experience working within structured incident, problem, change, and release management processes.
* Experience coordinating activities across internal technical teams, business stakeholders, and external service providers.Strong track record of service delivery, technical problem solving, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

**Technical Skills:**
**Core:**

* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) administration and support.
* Oracle Database 19c and 26ai administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, backup, recovery, and performance management.
* Oracle Fusion Middleware 12c and 14c administration and support.
* Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM). OCI Observability, monitoring, logging, alerting, and diagnostics.
* OCI compute, storage, networking, IAM, backup, and availability concepts.

**Automation and Infrastructure as Code**

* Terraform for OCI Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* OCI CLI scripting and automation.
* SQL and PL/SQL.
* Unix/Linux shell scripting.
* Automation of infrastructure provisioning, configuration, monitoring, reporting, and operational health checks.

**Supporting Knowledge:**

* Oracle database backup and recovery.
* Cloud networking and connectivity.
* Identity and access management and least-privilege principles.
* Infrastructure security and operational controls.
* Performance, capacity, and availability management.
* Incident, problem, change, and release management practices.

**Professional Skills:**

* Strong analytical, diagnostic, and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to prioritize operational activities and respond effectively to service incidents.
* Clear written and verbal communication across technical and business audiences.
* Ability to work effectively with geographically distributed and multi-vendor teams.
* Strong attention to security, operational quality, documentation, and compliance.
* Proactive approach to automation, service improvement, and operational risk reduction.Ability to work independently within established technical and governance standards.

Why Arcadis?

It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.
  
  
You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.

title: Senior AI Platform Engineer

This is a senior technical lead role that pairs deep platform engineering expertise with the thought leadership needed to bring AI into production operations. The person owns the build, hardening, patching, and lifecycle of the operating system and platform estate, and serves as the top escalation point for complex incidents — while simultaneously identifying where AI and automation can replace manual toil, reduce incident volume, and shorten recovery times. Success depends as much on change leadership as on engineering: shaping standards, winning stakeholder buy-in, and guiding 1st line operations through new AI-enabled ways of working without disrupting service levels.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Platform engineering depth — packaging and hardening approved OS builds, management agent stacks, patch currency, and configuration standards across the estate
* AI-driven operations innovation — identifying, piloting, and scaling AI/automation use cases for incident triage, root cause analysis, runbook execution, and predictive monitoring
* Thought leadership and evangelism — articulating an AI-for-operations vision, authoring white papers and R&D positions, staying ahead of emerging tooling
* Change management and adoption — driving organizational uptake of new practices, coaching 1st line teams, managing risk and resistance while protecting SLAs
* Incident, problem, and change discipline — major incident leadership, RCA, and rigorous change control in a regulated production environment
* Service improvement measurement — instrumenting and evidencing reductions in incident volume and MTTR from process redesign and automation
* Solution design and implementation planning — translating requirements into physical builds, costed designs, and multi-workstream delivery plans
* Automation and infrastructure-as-code fluency — scripting, configuration management, and pipeline-driven platform delivery
* Standards, compliance, and documentation — run books, technical policies, and AI governance/guardrails to document-control standards
* Cross-functional influence — partnering with architecture, security, development, vendors, and the business to land change.

**Required Qualifications**

* Provides a high level of technical and subject matter expertise in one or more technologies and serves as a point of escalation for technical issues related to specialty.
* Produces, delivers, and maintains appropriate documentation for systems in accordance document control standards and procedures.
* Provide input to records, quality systems and management reports as required
* Contributes to the definition and implementation of improved operability on new and current systems.
* Uses innovative methods including the redesign of process and providing technical solutions to reduce the volume and mean time to recover incidents in assigned business unit.
* Identifies risks & issues and takes ownership to deliver appropriate resolutions.
* Provides technical expertise for root cause analysis and problem management.
* Provides detailed implementation/project plans across multiple, complex work streams according to agreed standards and ensures project processes and timelines are understood and followed.

title: Senior Network Infrastructure Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Network Operations Engineer to support and maintain our cloud network infrastructure. This network serves the needs across the whole software stack for NVIDIA, from Graphics Drivers to Autonomous Vehicles and Artificial Intelligence. In this role, the Network Operations Engineer will remediate critical alerts within defined SLAs, triage production impacting network incidents, and interact with internal customers on network related issues. They will also be responsible for engaging with external vendors to remediate hardware and software issues, and participate in project related work such as network device upgrades and capacity augmentations. An ideal candidate will possess a wide range of skills, including alert monitoring & resolution in large-scale networks and CSP environments, outstanding troubleshooting skills, understanding of L3 underlay networks, and network protocol knowledge in large multi-vendor infrastructures.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Engage in 24/7 global shift rotations to provide remote support for network repairs and changes while collaborating across teams and updating customers on status and ticket information.
* Drive operational improvements in change management and daily operations by following procedures.
* Manage and operate large scale IP network technologies and infrastructures.
* Utilise your skills in Peering and Datacenter interconnect technologies: PNI, Transit, Exchange, Passive DWDM, Wave circuits.
* Monitor and support the network health of on-premises and cloud infrastructures.
* Collaborate and develop workflow enhancements while documenting best practices.

**What We Need To See**

* Deep knowledge and experience of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IS-IS, VxLAN, EVPN, QoS, GRE, IPsec, DNS, and MACsec.
* Over 4 years of experience in network operations.
* Skilled in network troubleshooting techniques and leveraging creative problem-solving abilities.
* Strong track record of alert response within defined SLAs and Incident management.
* Experience with one or more of the following CSP environments: AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI.
* Familiarity with Arista, Fortinet and Juniper.
* Hands-on experience with contributing to tooling and automation for provisioning, monitoring, and managing complex network infrastructures.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Strong background of Mellanox/Cumulus OS.
* Working knowledge of Infiniband technology.
* Skilled in Unix/Linux system administration, with the ability to write and understand Python/Shell scripts to enhance productivity in hyperscale environments.
* Familiarity with leveraging tools such as Netbox/Nautobot, Prometheus, Grafana, Panoptes to monitor and manage a global network.
* Passionate about innovating and investing in ground breaking technologies.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hard-working people in the world working for us. Are you creative and autonomous? Do you love a challenge? If so, we want to hear from you.

title: Senior Service Delivery Consultant
description:
Senior Service Delivery Consultant
  
  
**What Makes Us, Us**

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — Caring, Customer success-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
  
  
If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!
  
  
**WHY THIS IS IMPORTANT TO US**

* Senior Service Delivery Consultants are skilled professionals who form part of our SaaS Operations team delivering services to our clients. The main purpose of the role is to contribute to the effective support and maintenance of SimCorp Dimension and to all aspects of service delivery around SimCorp Dimension.
* Senior Service Delivery Consultants support our clients by providing solutions and deploying services related to the usage of SimCorp Dimension. They work closely with local and global teams within SimCorp.
* In this key role you will work in APAC/EMEA shift to provide support & solutions to overcome issues encountered by the customer and to optimise usage of the systems for them. This interesting job offers you a unique opportunity to increase your knowledge and get experience on a variety of disciplines. You will find yourself working in a diverse and fast-growing environment for an international company with a significant growth potential and career opportunities. If you want to contribute to our growth and develop in a professional environment - grow with us!

**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* You will be the key contact for our clients regarding production support and ensure and maintain the relationship.
* Analyze problems and issues which occur in the solutions and the system operations of SimCorp services at clients’ production environment on a wide range of topics on your own to provide convincing and timely solutions to our client within agreed SLAs
* Advise and service our client users with minimal supervision on configuration maintenance and enhancement by providing solutions related to the usage of SimCorp services and beyond to ensure that the client uses SimCorp services in an optimal, future-oriented way
* Co-operate closely with other professionals within SimCorp on a global level by way of specialist roles to share knowledge and ensure efficient solutions for the client
* You will be required to work on APAC/EMEA shift. Weekend/Public Holiday works are required on occasion. Working extended hours might also be required on occasion.

**What We Value**

* A degree in finance/economics/mathematics/computer science. Knowledge in financial issues - theoretical as well as practical
* Minimum 5 years’ experience within asset management, funds management or custodian.
* Familiar with Simcorp Dimension
* Experience in the operation and support of front-to back investment management solutions
* You are good at working on & prioritizing multiple tasks at the same time.
* Self-motivated, service-minded and a natural desire for problem solving, enthusiastic, committed, result-oriented, and able to thrive in a time-sensitive situation
* Other requirements
* APAC / EMEA shift hours (May change depending on business needs)
* Hybrid working arrangement (2x a week in office)

**Benefits**

* Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Culture – Inclusive and diverse company culture.
* Work-life balance – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace.
* Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes.
* Career & Growth – Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS**
Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
  
  
  
  
If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
  
  
We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
  
  
**WHO WE ARE?**
For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
  
  
SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.
  
  
SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

title: Senior Manager - Reliability Engineering
description:
ABOUT US:
  
  
LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.
  
  
LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 65 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.
  
  
OUR PEOPLE:
  
  
People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.
  
  
We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.
  
  
ROLE PROFILE:
  
  
The Senior Manager - Reliability Engineering is accountable for the reliability, resilience, and operational effectiveness of critical enterprise applications and platforms throughout the service lifecycle.
  
  
The role will drive the evolution of the L2/SRE function from reactive production support towards proactive reliability engineering, using automation, observability, operational learning, and strong engineering partnerships to reduce toil, incidents, and operational risk.
  
  
Working across engineering, product, infrastructure, security, and support, the role will promote shared ownership of production reliability and ensure services are continuously improved to meet agreed levels of availability, performance, resilience, and customer experience.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Lead the L2/SRE function and its continuous improvement, with accountability for improving service reliability, resilience, operational efficiency, and engineering maturity.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing L2/SRE team, fostering accountability, technical capability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Define and mature Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and error budgets to support clear, data-led reliability and engineering decisions.
* Reduce operational toil through automation, improved tooling, self-service capabilities, and simplification of repetitive support activities.
* Establish strong observability and alerting standards across logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, and telemetry to improve detection, diagnosis, and recovery.
* Define operational readiness standards, ensuring services are supportable, resilient, appropriately monitored, well documented, and have clear recovery and escalation procedures before entering production.
* Lead effective Incident Management within L2/SRE, including response, escalation, post-incident review, and identification of recurring issues. Partner with L3 on Problem Management and RCA, ensuring corrective actions and reliability improvements are tracked through to completion.
* Champion strong ITSM practices and operational hygiene across Incident, Problem, Change, service ownership, documentation, and continuous improvement.
* Oversee proportionate, risk-based Change Management and approval processes, ensuring changes are appropriately assessed, dependencies and conflicts are understood, implementation and rollback plans are robust, and higher-risk activity receives the right level of scrutiny while avoiding unnecessary overhead for well-understood, low-risk change.
* Partner with L3 engineering and other technology teams to ensure production learnings, recurring incidents, support trends, and reliability concerns are reflected in engineering priorities and addressed at source.
* Drive resilience improvements through disaster recovery and failover testing, capacity planning, dependency analysis, and clear ownership of reliability-related technical debt.
* Define, monitor, and report on service health and reliability measures, including availability, performance, SLO attainment, incident trends, recovery times, operational risk, and improvement outcomes.
* Apply strong technical judgement, risk assessment, prioritisation, and conflict-resolution skills when making decisions in high-pressure operational situations.

What you'll get in return:
  
  
At LSEG, we invest in excellence. You’ll be part of a high-performing team where your expertise is valued and your impact is visible. We offer:
  
  

* Competitive compensation with performance-based rewards.
* A flexible hybrid work model that supports work-life balance.
* Access to cutting-edge tools and infrastructure to do your best work.
* Opportunities for continuous learning, including certifications, conferences, and internal mobility.
* A collaborative culture that values technical mastery, ownership, and innovation.
* The chance to work on a globally critical system that powers secure financial transactions across markets.

title: Workforce Software consultant II
description:
**Company Description**
At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future
  
  
**Job Description**
A Senior Analyst focuses specifically on the configuration, maintenance, and optimization of the organization's Workforce Software (WFM) system. They bridge the gap between IT and Operations, ensuring the software accurately models business rules and delivers actionable data for scheduling, capturing, forecasting, and calculating time data for payroll processes..
  
  
The Workforce Software Senior Analyst is the subject matter expert responsible for the technical administration, configuration, and data integrity of the Workforce Software (WFM) system. This role ensures the WFM platform accurately reflects business logic, supports efficient staffing and scheduling, and provides reliable data for operational and financial analysis.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* WFM System Administration & Configuration: Maintain and update core WFM system settings, policy profiles, employee profiles, time-off policies, quota calculations and timesheet calculations.
* Data Integrity: Ensure the accuracy of data integrations between the WFM system and upstream HR/Payroll systems (e.g., SAP Employee Central Payroll). Troubleshoot and resolve data flow errors.
* User Management: Manage user access, roles, and permissions within the WFM application.
* System Upgrades & Testing: Participate in testing and validation for WFM system upgrades, patches, and feature rollouts to ensure seamless performance and compliance.
* Optimization & Analysis: Monitor jobs for review and correction of errors.
* Rule Engine Optimization: Analyze current scheduling models and configuration settings to identify opportunities for improved forecasting accuracy, adherence, and efficiency.
* Business Requirements: Translate complex business requirements (e.g., new labor agreements, regulatory changes) into functional specifications and configure them within the WFM platform.
* Reporting & Dashboards: Develop, modify, and manage custom reports and dashboards within the WFM system to provide operational leaders with visibility into key metrics (e.g., compliance, productivity, utilization).
* Support & Collaboration: Problem resolution with business partners, SAP/WFS, support contractors, and internal IT staff.
* Technical Support: Serve as the Tier 2 or Tier 3 technical contact for WFM system issues, diagnosing problems related to the mobile app and WorkforceHub, integration with SuccessFactors, quota calculations, and timesheet calculations.
* Training & Documentation: Create and deliver training materials and support documentation for end-users, WFM schedulers, and new administrators.
* Cross-Functional Liaison: Collaborate closely with IT, HRIS, Payroll, and Operations teams to ensure system alignment with organizational policies and technical infrastructure.

**Qualifications**

* Any Graduate
* 3-4 years of hands-on experience administering, configuring, or supporting a major Workforce Software platform.
* Workforce Time Level 1 - Configuration Specialist
* Workforce Time Level 2 - Configuration Specialist
* Strong technical aptitude for system logic, relational databases, and data interfaces.
* Experience with SAP Employee Central integration data points with WFM.
* Proficiency in Advanced Excel for data analysis and validation.
* Preferred Skills : Knowledge of time and attendance, payroll processing, and labor law compliance as it relates to system configuration.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Certifications from WorkForce Software permitting system modifications and report creation.

**Additional Information**
Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

Experience working on Strategy design and Operating model for data organizations with ability to design solutions around AI adoption; knowledge of AI/ML implementation use cases for players in FSI industry.

Certifications such as AWS, GCP, Azure will be a plus. Experience with workload assessment, business cases development, operational assessment, roadmap creation, vendor selection

**Position Summary**
The Associate, HRIS – Workday Absence & Payroll is responsible for supporting, enhancing, and continuously improving HR systems and operational processes across the organization. This role serves as a strategic thought partner to HR customer groups, translating business requirements into effective Workday solutions, advising on process and data needs, and supporting informed business decision-making.
  
  
The position will collaborate closely with the Human Resources Systems (HRS) team, senior global HR leadership, HR Service Operations, and senior business stakeholders across the Brookfield-supported footprint.
  
  
This position requires the employee to work onsite.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide functional and technical expertise in Workday Absence, Payroll, and HCM Core, with a focus on delivering scalable and efficient HR solutions.
* Design, configure, and maintain complex Workday Absence and Payroll functionality, including accruals, time-off plans, eligibility rules, payroll-related configuration, and related business processes.
* Translate business requirements into detailed and effective Workday system configurations, ensuring alignment with HR policies and business objectives.
* Develop and maintain Business Process Definitions, condition rules, approval workflows, notifications, and other Workday business process configurations.
* Configure and support Workday Payroll functionality, including payroll processes, earnings and deductions, payroll inputs, pay components and related business processes in accordance with business requirements.
* Partner with Payroll, HR, Finance, and other stakeholders to troubleshoot payroll issues, assess impacts, and support timely resolution of production issues and payroll-related requests.
* Configure leave types, absence eligibility, entitlement units, accruals, accrual defaulting, and time-off plans in accordance with business policies and requirements.
* Develop and maintain calculated fields and leverage Workday configuration capabilities to support complex business requirements.
* Manage areas such as leave type/segment security, time-off transfer balance units, alert messages, worklets, delegation, custom notifications, and Workday surveys.
* Prepare detailed test plans and test cases, conduct manual testing, and support regression and release testing for Workday updates and enhancements.
* Lead testing, data validation, defect identification, and resolution activities during system releases and process changes.
* Analyze large HR data loads and validate data accuracy, completeness, and integrity during data transfers and system updates.
* Collaborate with business users and HR stakeholders to identify opportunities for process improvements, system enhancements, and operational efficiencies.
* Provide guidance and training to the HR Service Operations team on Workday functionality, business processes, and best practices, leveraging Workday Community and other supported resources.
* Serve as a subject matter expert and provide consultative support on Workday Absence and Payroll issues and complex business requirements.
* Support and maintain integrations and data interfaces, including an understanding of Enterprise Interface Builder (EIBs) and related Workday integration concepts.
* Maintain system and data integrity and ensure Workday solutions and processes continue to support business objectives.
* Train, mentor, and coach team members, sharing Workday knowledge and best practices to build team capability.
* Work effectively in a global environment and collaborate across multiple teams, stakeholders, time zones, and competing priorities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree
* Hands-on experience supporting Workday Absence and Payroll configuration and payroll processes is required.
* Workday Time Tracking experience is nice to have for this role.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience with Workday Absence and Payroll, with strong experience in Workday HCM Core.
* Strong technical and functional expertise in Workday Absence and Payroll configuration.
* Strong understanding of HR policies and the ability to translate policy requirements into Workday configuration.
* Experience developing test plans, test cases, and conducting manual testing, including testing associated with Workday releases.
* Experience analyzing and validating large HR data loads to ensure accurate and complete data transfer.
* Working knowledge of EIBs, integrations, calculated fields, and Workday configuration tools.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.
* Demonstrated ability to train, mentor, and coach team members.

title: QA Engineering
description:
**The Opportunity: Build the future of Wealth**

In a fintech world obsessed with gamification and speculative betting, Endowus stands apart. We aren't here to build another trading app; we are building the financial infrastructure to help people achieve long-term life goals - retirement, education, and financial freedom.

**Headquartered in Singapore, we are the largest independent digital wealth platform in Asia**
. However, we are not a one-trick robo-advisor. We are a full-suite wealth platform spanning public equities, fixed income, private markets, and hedge funds. We provide clients with customized exposure—global, regional, or sectoral—across all their wealth (from liquid cash to pension savings) and for all their needs (from short-term cash management to long-term retirement planning).

Just six years after launch, we manage over US$10 Billion (~₹90,000 Crore) in assets for more than a quarter-million clients across Singapore and Hong Kong. We are a Series B company backed by global giants (Lightspeed, Illuminate, Prosus, EDBI, UBS), with ambitions to cover the entire region.

**This is not an 'offshore' support role.**
Our India team is a
**core product hub**
, operating on parity with our Singapore HQ. Engineers here drive end-to-end ownership of platform innovation. You won't just be testing code; you will be engineering the safety nets that allow us to move fast without breaking trust.

**The Role: Engineering Confidence**

Most companies treat QA as a final checkpoint. We treat it as an engineering discipline.

Our clients trust us with their life savings. "Move fast and break things" is not an option here. What we need is "Move fast and prove it's safe."

Here’s what you can look forward to in this role.

* **Engineer the Safety Net**
  : You will build and maintain scalable automation scripts that cover the entire stack - from Backend APIs (Scala/Akka) to Web (React) and Mobile (Flutter). You ensure our regression tests are reliable and fast.
* **Shift Quality Left**
  : You will collaborate with Product Managers and Developers before a line of code is written. You will review requirements for testability and ensure edge cases are caught during the design phase.
* **Pragmatic Quality**
  : While automation is our north star, we value thoughtful test planning and the human eye. You are willing to roll up your sleeves and perform manual exploratory testing because you know when to automate and when to test/investigate manually.
* **Drive CI/CD Velocity**
  : You will integrate your tests into our CI/CD pipelines. You ensure that our feedback loops are fast so developers can fix issues immediately.
* **Guardian of the Client Experience**
  : You will look beyond functional correctness. You will simulate real-world client behaviors to catch usability friction, performance lags, and data inconsistencies that automated checks might miss.

**Our Tech Stack**

* **Web Automation**
  : We use
  **Playwright**
  for high-speed, reliable end-to-end testing of our React applications.
* **Backend Automation**
  : We use
  **Cucumber-Scala**
  to test our distributed microservices (Scala/Akka) and ensure our domain logic holds up under pressure.
* **Mobile Automation**
  : We leverage
  **Maestro E2E**
  and flutter tests for our Dart/Flutter mobile apps.
* **Ops**
  : We are 100% cloud-native (AWS) and rely heavily on
  **CI/CD**
  to run your tests on every commit.

**Want to look under the hood?**
Read how we solve testing challenges on our Engineering Blog at
tech.endowus.com

**What Success Looks Like**

* **First 30 Days (Immersion)**
  : You understand our domain models and testing infrastructure. You have added a new regression test and performed manual testing for a new feature release.
* **First 90 Days (Ownership)**
  : You are actively writing automated tests for new features within the sprint. You have built a deep understanding of many domain flows and have plugged several gaps in our current test coverage.
* **First 6 Months (Impact)**
  : You now own the test planning & execution for major new initiatives and are actively elevating the quality of our platform with a “founder mentality”.

**What You Bring (Requirements)**

We care more about your engineering intuition than your ability to memorize APIs. However, this role requires a specific baseline:

**Must-Haves**
:

* **4+ Years of Test Engineering**
  : You have solid experience in automation. You are comfortable writing code to test code, but you also respect the value of manual validation.
* **Strong Coding Fundamentals**
  : You are proficient in at least one major language (
  **Java, Scala, TypeScript, or Python**
  ). You can read developer code to understand where a bug might be hiding.
* **Automation Framework Competence**
  : You have experience using and extending frameworks like
  **Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium**
  . You can write stable, maintainable scripts.
* **API Testing DNA**
  : You are comfortable testing microservices. You understand REST, JSON, and how to query a database (SQL) to verify test states.
* **Collaborative Mindset**
  : You don't wait for a "hand-off." You actively ask developers and PMs questions about implementation details to plan your tests better

**Nice-to-Haves**
:

* **Mobile Automation**
  : Experience testing Flutter or native apps using Appium or Maestro.
* **Performance Testing**
  : Experience with K6, Gatling, or JMeter.
* **FinTech Domain**
  : You understand financial concepts, ledgers, or high-security environments

**Why Endowus?**

* **Modern Stack, Serious Business**
  : You get to apply modern automation tools to mission-critical financial infrastructure. You get the intellectual depth of a top-tier private bank with the agility of a startup.
* **World-Class Engineering Talent**
  : You will work with colleagues from top product companies like Amazon, Google, Swiggy, Flipkart, Grab, and Meta. We bring together strong fintech DNA with the best of agile startup culture.
* **Career Growth with Upside**
  : We manage massive AUA ($10 billion and growing) with a lean, high-talent team (~85 in product engineering). This means high visibility, high impact, and significant ESOP upside in a company that is defining the category.
* **Leadership Pedigree**
  : Our leadership team brings experience from Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, UBS, McKinsey, Bloomberg, Amazon, Alibaba, Grab, Shopee, Salesforce, and more.

**Why NOT Endowus?**

We want you to thrive here, which means we must be honest about the environment.

* **You prefer 100% Automation**
  : If you thrive best when writing code all day and prefer to minimize manual exploration with the product or learning the domain inside-out, our hybrid approach might not suit you.
* **You prefer a Centralized QA Structure**
  : If you prefer working in a dedicated QA team with clear hand-offs from developers, you might find our cross-functional team structure (Backend + Frontend + QA + PM + Design) challenging.
* **You prefer executing over planning**
  : If you do your best work when given a pre-written test plan to execute step-by-step, this role might be too broad. We need engineers who can look at a feature spec and derive the test strategy themselves.
* **You want 100% Remote**
  : We work in the office at least 3 days a week because we believe in the serendipity of in-person collaboration

**The Interview Process**

We respect your time and aim to be thorough yet efficient.

* Recruiter Screen (30 min): Quick alignment on role, stack, and mission.
* Online Coding Assessment (90 min): A hands-on coding challenge to assess your coding and scripting fundamentals along with Test planning
* Technical Deep Dive (90 min): Live coding and discussion. We focus on automation logic, framework usage, and how you approach manual vs. automated scenarios.
* System Design (60 min): We talk about test strategies for distributed systems, API testing, and data management.
* Culture & Values (60 min): Meeting with Leadership to ensure we are a match.

title: Sr. Security Operations Analyst

We are seeking an experienced Identity and Access Management (IAM) Operations Analyst to support day-to-day IAM operations across enterprise applications and identity platforms. **Key Responsibilities**
**Application Access Management**

* Process application access requests, modifications, and removals in accordance with approved procedures.
* Perform user provisioning and deprovisioning across enterprise applications.
* Validate approvals and ensure appropriate authorization before granting access.
* Support role-based access control (RBAC) and entitlement management activities.
* Investigate and resolve access-related incidents and service requests.
* Maintain accurate records of user access and access changes.

**Identity Lifecycle Management**

* Execute Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) processes.
* Ensure timely onboarding and offboarding of workforce members.
* Support automated and manual provisioning workflows.
* Monitor provisioning failures and perform corrective actions.
* Coordinate with application owners and HR teams to maintain access accuracy.

**Active Directory Administration**

* Manage user, group, and service accounts within Active Directory.
* Create, modify, and remove security groups and distribution groups.

title: Senior Engineer Nondestructive Testing And Retrofitting
description:
**Company Description**
Retrofit Structural Strengthening Associates is a specialized agency focused on structural retrofitting, nondestructive testing (NDT), and structural stability certification for reinforced concrete structures. Led by Dr. Naresh Kalaskar, Ph.D. (Structures), the organization offers structural assessments, strengthening, repairs, retrofitting, and waterproofing solutions. With over 23 years of industry experience, the team supports residential, commercial, industrial, and heritage buildings across India. The company is committed to creating stronger structures and lasting protection through technically robust, quality-driven services. More information is available at www.retrofitssa.com.

**Role Description**
The Senior Engineer Nondestructive Testing and Retrofitting will lead and execute structural assessments, NDT investigations, and retrofitting solutions for a variety of building types. This full-time, on-site role is based in Hyderabad and involves planning and conducting field inspections, supervising NDT testing, interpreting test data, and preparing technical reports and recommendations. The position includes designing and reviewing strengthening and retrofitting schemes, coordinating with design teams, contractors, and clients, and ensuring compliance with relevant codes and standards. The Senior Engineer will also oversee quality control procedures, mentor junior engineers and technicians, and support the issuance of structural stability certifications. Routine responsibilities include site visits, documentation, client communication, and participation in project review meetings.

**Qualifications**

* Strong technical expertise in structural engineering, including RCC behavior, structural analysis, and design of strengthening and retrofitting solutions.
* Hands-on experience with nondestructive testing methods (e.g., rebound hammer, ultrasonic pulse velocity, core testing coordination, rebar locator) and interpretation of test results.
* Proficiency in using structural engineering software and tools (e.g., STAAD, ETABS, or similar) for analysis of existing structures and retrofit design.
* Knowledge of relevant national and international codes and standards for concrete structures, retrofitting, durability, and structural safety.
* Ability to manage site activities, coordinate with multidisciplinary teams, and supervise technicians and junior engineers during inspections and repair works.
* Strong report-writing and documentation skills, including preparation of assessment reports, test summaries, retrofit proposals, and stability certification documents.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for interacting with clients, consultants, and contractors, and for explaining technical findings clearly.
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil/Structural Engineering; a Master’s degree in Structural Engineering is preferred.
* Several years of relevant experience in structural assessment, NDT, and retrofitting projects; experience with heritage or complex structures is an advantage.
* Commitment to safety, quality, and ethical
