title: CAD Design Engineer, Mechanical & Code-First Reverse Engineering
description:
**Job Title:**
CAD Design Engineer, Mechanical & Code-First Reverse Engineering

**Location:**
Hyderabad | Pune| Gurugram |
Bengaluru (On-site)

**Type:**
Full-Time

**Experience:**
4+ years

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced CAD professional with strong expertise in 3D modelling, part and assembly design, and technical drafting. In this role, you will create and refine high-quality CAD models and engineering drawings, develop robust design workflows, and collaborate with engineering teams to deliver accurate, manufacturable, and production-ready designs.

**What You'll Do**

* Create and review data grounded in real CAD and mechanical design practice, parts, assemblies, drawings, and the reasoning behind them.
* Reverse-engineer geometry: take an STL/mesh with no feature history and reconstruct the design intent as parametric, code-first CAD (build123d), inferring sketches, features, datums, patterns, and key dimensional relationships.
* Evaluate AI-generated design solutions, 3D models, feature trees, mating strategies, drawings, and pin down failure cases, edge cases, and quality gaps.
* Decompose complex modelling and verification tasks into structured, step-by-step workflows the model can learn from and be measured against.

**Domain Responsibilities**

* Build and assess parametric models, assemblies, and detailed2D drawings across machined, sheet-metal, cast/moulded, and weldment parts.
* Judge design intent, constraints, and robustness, modelling approach.
* Apply and check GD&T, tolerancing, and design-for-manufacturing across the full product design lifecycle (concept → detailing → design review → handoff).
* Validate code-first reconstructions against source geometry via deviation and dimensional-accuracy checks.

**Requirements**

***Must Have***

* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech/Ph.D in Mechanical Engineering (or closely related) from a Tier 1/Tier2 institute (IIT, NIT, BITS, IIIT, DTU/NSUT, or equivalent).
* 4+ years of hands-on CAD/mechanical design with breadth across multiple platforms (Autodesk Fusion, SolidWorks, Creo, NX, CATIA, or Inventor), multiple part types, and the full design workflow.
* Strong command of parametric modelling, assembly design, engineering drawings, GD&T, and DFM.
* Working Python ability and genuine comfort with code-first CAD (build123d / Cad Query), or a clear track record of picking up scripting fast.

***Good to Have***

* Mesh processing (trimesh, Open3D, numpy-stl) and familiarity with OpenCascade/OCCT.

Here, your knack for numbers and insight will directly influence our evolving HR landscape. You'll uncover the patterns that drive strategic changes and bring forth ideas that resonate across global teams. Are you ready to be at the forefront of transformation, delivering insights that matter? Dive into a role that blends analytics with action and be part of our success story.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* A Workforce Planning Analyst will support strategic and operational workforce decisions through data analysis, forecasting, reporting, and workforce modelling. The role helps ensure the organisation has the right people, skills, and capacity to meet current and future business needs.
* Prior to each Workforce Planning Cycle/ review period, you will carry the necessary checks and audits within the system. Considering continuous improvement as the technology develops.

* Develop workforce forecasts and staffing models based on forecast.
* Create dashboards, reports, and KPI tracking for leadership.
* Identify workforce trends, risks, and gaps.
* Support budgeting and annual workforce planning cycles.
* Improve workforce planning processes and reporting automation.
* Ensure data accuracy across HR systems and planning tools.
* Present insights and recommendations to stakeholders.

* Headcount
* Rate Cards
* Attrition rate
* Time to hire
* Workforce utilization
* Capacity vs demand
* Productivity metrics
* Overtime trends
* Hiring forecast accuracy

* Extensive experience working in an Analyst role
* Proven track record of expertise of suite of Finance solutions e.g. SAP (essential), Service Now (preferred), Azure Dev Ops(desirable).
* Experience of working with senior stakeholders to balance business needs with workforce planning standards and processes
* Enthusiastic about the use of technology, with a proven ability to provide a communication ‘bridge’

* Good understanding of workforce / financial data and organisational structures
* Ability to interpret and aggregate data into meaningful outputs (e.g. averages)
* Stakeholder communication / management, providing clear guidance and managing inputs from multiple markets
* Structured approach to end-to-end data processes with strong attention to detail and deadlines
* Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud

Technical Skills
  
  

* Advanced Microsoft Excel
* Data visualization tools:
* Power BI
* Tableau
* HRIS and workforce systems knowledge - SAP SuccessFactors

Soft Skills
  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Attention to detail
* Communication and presentation skills
* Stakeholder management
* Business acumen
* Ability to work with large datasets

* HR analytics certification

The skills for success
  
  
Data and Analytics, HR Process Improvement; Process management; HR Process improvement, Storytelling; Data led storytelling, Digital literacy, HR Data Analsyis; Data management; Employee data management, Operational Excellence, Solutioning.

title: Senior Healthcare Data Integration Analyst
description:
**Aliases:**
Senior EHR Data Implementation Analyst (Epic/Cerner), Lead, Healthcare Data Exchange and Interoperability, Senior Clinical Data Mapping and Integration Analyst, Healthcare Data Ingestion and Interoperability Engineer, Senior Clinical Informatics Analyst - Data Integration, Healthcare Implementation Consultant - Data.
  
  
**About Truveta**
Truveta is the world's first health provider led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta's ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values.
  
  
Truveta was born in the Pacific Northwest in the USA and has employees who live across the country. As we expand our global footprint with a new presence in Hyderabad, India, we're building a world-class team to help us scale this mission, and high-quality, well-integrated health data is at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
*This job requires daily onsite work at our headquarters in Hyderabad, India.*
**Who We Need**
Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse team to tackle complex health and technical challenges. Beyond core capabilities, we are seeking problem solvers, passionate and collaborative teammates, and those willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. If you are interested in the opportunity to pursue purposeful work, join a mission-driven team, and build a rewarding career while having fun, Truveta may be the perfect fit for you.
  
  
**This Opportunity**
We are seeking a Senior Healthcare Data Integration Analyst to lead and support the onboarding of member data into the Truveta platform. This role is central to ensuring high-quality, well-integrated data that meets clinical, research, and operational needs.
  
  
The ideal candidate is passionate about working with complex healthcare datasets, uncovering patterns in disparate source systems, and building scalable processes that make downstream analytics efficient and reliable. You will work closely with external member teams and internal engineering stakeholders to profile, map, validate, and automate data ingestion workflows, bringing hands-on experience with clinical applications such as Epic, Cerner, MEDITECH, or Allscripts and with healthcare data standards including HL7, FHIR, and CCDA.
  
  
Working from the Truveta India Development Center, you will partner every day with engineering, product, and member teams in the United States, so regular overlap with US Pacific (West Coast) business hours is part of the role.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead onboarding of data from member source systems and third-party sources into the Truveta platform.
* Partner with external technical and clinical teams to understand source data structures, workflows, and business context.
* Perform comprehensive data profiling to assess completeness, quality, conformance, and integrity.
* Develop and maintain source-to-target mappings aligned to platform data models and standards.
* Define, implement, and validate business and data transformation rules.
* Design and support test automation strategies for onboarding workflows, including validation and regression testing.
* Document onboarding methodologies, transformation logic, data quality findings, and validation processes to ensure reproducibility and knowledge sharing.
* Provide clear, timely communication to stakeholders, from customer-facing discussions to deep technical design sessions.
* Continuously improve onboarding processes to increase scalability, efficiency, and reliability.

**Experience**

* Subject matter expertise in clinical applications and an understanding of how healthcare data supports clinicians, researchers, and patients.
* Strong knowledge of healthcare industry terminology and concepts.
* Hands-on experience with data profiling tools, data quality analysis, and visualization technologies.
* Deep understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT processes, and data lifecycle management.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex datasets and translate business workflows into technical specifications.
* Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, and external partners.
* A track record of producing comprehensive documentation of methodologies, processes, and findings that supports reproducibility and knowledge sharing.
* Self-starter with a strong ownership mindset and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

**Key Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or graduate degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Engineering, Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or related analytical field.
* 6+ years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, or healthcare data implementation roles.
* 3+ years of implementation experience with clinical applications such as Epic, Cerner, MEDITECH, or Allscripts.
* 3+ years of experience analyzing large datasets, with strong proficiency in SQL and Python or R.
* Demonstrated experience with data profiling, source-to-target mapping, and validation testing.

title: Mechanical Engineer – CNC Manufacturing & CAD/CAM Automation
description:
**GCC Mechanical Engineer – CNC Manufacturing & CAD/CAM Automation**
**Join the team as our new GCC Mechanical Engineer – CNC Manufacturing & CAD/CAM Automation**
As a GCC Mechanical Engineer, you will play a key role in transforming manufacturing expertise into scalable digital solutions. Working at the intersection of mechanical engineering, CNC manufacturing, CAD/CAM technologies, and automation, you will collaborate with software engineers, product managers, and manufacturing partners to build intelligent systems that improve manufacturability analysis, process planning, quoting accuracy, and production efficiency across global manufacturing operations.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Drive CNC Manufacturing Automation**
  
  

* Develop and enhance manufacturing standards, automation logic, and workflows for CNC machining across milling, turning, and secondary operations.
* Translate real-world machining expertise into scalable software requirements, engineering rules, algorithms, and product capabilities.
* Design automated solutions for:

+ Manufacturability analysis
+ Feature recognition
+ Machining strategy selection
+ Fixture planning
+ Tolerance and risk detection
+ Cycle time estimation
+ Cost estimation and quoting logic

* Build scalable process planning frameworks for a wide range of materials, geometries, and production volumes.

**Improve Digital Manufacturing Processes**

* Review CAD models, engineering drawings, and technical specifications to identify manufacturability risks and automation opportunities.
* Standardize CNC machining best practices and convert engineering knowledge into reusable digital workflows.
* Support development and validation of CAD/CAM workflows, post-process logic, machine capability mapping, and automated process recommendations.
* Collaborate with manufacturing partners to benchmark capabilities, define process limits, and improve consistency across production sites.
* Analyse manufacturing data to identify bottlenecks, process variation, and improvement opportunities.

**Partner with Cross-functional Teams**

* Work closely with software engineers and product managers to develop manufacturing intelligence solutions.
* Participate in testing and validation of software features related to CAM automation and CNC process planning.
* Document engineering standards, technical decisions, and process assumptions for technical and business stakeholders.
* Contribute to the long-term strategy for digital manufacturing and manufacturing automation.

**What It Takes**
**Technical Expertise**
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of experience in CNC manufacturing, machining process engineering, or manufacturing automation.
* Strong expertise in:

+ 3-axis and 5-axis CNC milling
+ Turning and Mill-Turn machining
+ Workholding and fixturing
+ Tool selection and process parameter optimisation
+ GD&T and tolerance analysis
+ Material behaviour and machining trade-offs

* Hands-on experience with CAD/CAM platforms such as Fusion 360, Mastercam, Siemens NX, SolidCAM, hyperMILL, ESPRIT, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA).
* Experience translating engineering knowledge into structured workflows, decision logic, automation rules, or software requirements.

title: AI Test Architect
description:
**Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WS Audiology continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.**
We’re looking for an
**AI Test Architect**
to define, implement, and scale the next generation of quality engineering powered by AI. You will own the
**test architecture strategy**
end-to-end—combining
**LLM-driven automation**
,
**computer vision**
, and
**hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) systems**
—to deliver robust, scalable, and privacy-first testing for
**mobile applications and hardware-integrated products**
.
  
  
This is a senior, hands-on architecture role: you’ll set the strategy, establish standards, lead technical decision-making, and build reusable platforms and frameworks while mentoring teams across QA, Dev, and DevOps.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* AI Test Strategy & Architecture
* Define and maintain the enterprise test architecture, roadmap, and standards spanning functional, non-functional, integration, mobile, and HIL layers.
* Drive a shift-left and automation-first culture; architect frameworks that are modular, resilient, and easy to evolve.
* Establish test design principles, risk-based testing approaches, and coverage models aligned with business goals and compliance requirements.
* Lead architecture reviews and decision forums; evaluate build vs. buy for AI tooling and frameworks.
* AI-Driven Test Innovation (LLMs, RAG, CV/OCR)
* Architect and implement RAG-based test generation using local LLMs (e.g., Ollama, llama.cpp) and frameworks like LangChain/LlamaIndex to reason over requirements, app states, and logs.
* Build AI agents that can: interpret acceptance criteria, propose and prioritize test scenarios, and auto-generate test cases/scripts.
* Develop computer-vision and OCR pipelines (OpenCV, Tesseract, or equivalent) for precise UI validation, visual diffing, and visual regression analysis.
* Design models for UI anomaly detection, flakiness prediction, and self-healing locators beyond traditional Appium-style selectors.
* Automate localization testing for text, layout, and formatting across languages and screen sizes using AI.
* Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) & Mobile Systems
* Define and evolve a Python-based HIL framework for end-to-end validation of Mobile/Desktop/WebApp interacting with hardware (e.g., medical devices, sensors, wearables).
* Architect communication interfaces (USB, Bluetooth, Serial) and test harnesses to control/observe device interactions reliably at scale.
* Incorporate AI-driven adapters that learn device behaviors, detect drift, and improve robustness of HIL scenarios over time.
* Partner with mobile teams (Android/iOS) to integrate Appium/Espresso/XCUITest/FlaUI where appropriate and augment with AI components.
* On-Prem Infrastructure & MLOps for Test at Scale
* Design on-prem/private-cloud inference infrastructure for low-latency, high-throughput model execution with strong data privacy guarantees.
* Containerize models and agents (Docker) and integrate into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI) for parallel execution and test-on-commit workflows.
* Implement continuous learning loops to leverage test failures, telemetry, and labels to retrain and improve models.
* Establish model lifecycle practices (versioning, evaluation, rollback, governance) using tools like MLflow/Langchain, self-hosted vector stores, and caching.
* Automation Platforms & Tooling
* Extend or replace traditional frameworks (e.g., Appium) with AI-assisted components that enhance stability and coverage.
* Build Python-based toolchains for model training/inference and integrations into test workflows; standardize reusable libraries and templates.
* Define reference architectures for UI, API, performance, security, and resilience testing; ensure seamless observability, logging, and triage workflows.
* Quality Governance, Metrics & Risk
* Define quality gates, entry/exit criteria, and release readiness bars; ensure compliance and privacy-by-design.
* Track and publish leading indicators and outcome metrics—defect escape rate, test yield, visual regression detection rate, flakiness, mean-time-to-detect/triage, inference latency, infra utilization.
* Conduct root cause analyses and drive systemic fixes across tooling, test design, and pipelines.
* Audit processes for adherence to standards; champion continuous improvement.
* Technical Leadership & Enablement
* Mentor QA engineers and SDETs on AI/ML testing, HIL, and architectural best practices.
* Facilitate collaboration across QA, Development, Data/ML, Security, and DevOps.
* Curate internal playbooks, patterns, sample repos, and training content to scale adoption.

What You Bring
  
  
Must-Have
  
  

* 10+ years in Quality Engineering / Software Development, with 5+ years in test architecture / QA leadership.
* Strong Python expertise and hands-on experience with AI/ML in testing contexts.
* Proven experience training or fine-tuning models using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face.
* Solid background in Computer Vision (OpenCV) and OCR for UI/visual validation.
* Track record building automation frameworks for mobile and/or device-integrated systems, and clear understanding of limitations of traditional tools (e.g., Appium).
* Experience with CI/CD, Docker, and deploying AI models into test or production environments.
* Demonstrated ability to define strategy, set standards, and lead cross-functional technical initiatives.

Highly Desirable
  
  

* Hands-on with local LLMs (Ollama, llama.cpp) and RAG using LangChain/LlamaIndex.
* Prior experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) or Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) testing.
* Familiarity with Android/iOS ecosystems and tooling (ADB, Xcode, Fastlane, Espresso, XCUITest, Detox).
* Observability and analytics (e.g., Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry) for test health and triage.
* Experience in regulated environments (e.g., medical devices) and familiarity with risk management and compliance (e.g., ISO 13485, IEC 62304, IEC 62366, ISO 14971, HIPAA/GDPR) is a plus.

Soft Skills
  
  

* Strategic thinker with a builder’s mindset and strong systems design instincts.
* Excellent communicator who simplifies complex concepts and aligns stakeholders.
* Strong ownership, bias for action, and comfort navigating ambiguity.
* Passion for mentoring and uplifting engineering excellence across teams.

Success Metrics (Examples)
  
  

* >40% reduction in flaky test failures and >30% faster triage through AI triage/visual diffing.
* >25% increase in critical defect detection pre-release (vs. prior baseline).
* P95 AI inference latency within target SLA for CI pipelines.
* Adoption of standardized AI-assisted frameworks across X product teams within Y quarters.

**Jira Specialist Job Description**

**Project**

ServiceNow and Jira integration for customer support

Offshore (India), with at least 3 hours a day of overlap with Pacific Time

Full time, 40 hours a week. Shared between the integration project and other Jira support work

October 19, 2026 to January 22, 2027 (weeks 2 to 15), including go-live and hypercare

Buxton Delivery Manager and Solution Lead

Buxton Technical Lead and developers, client’s Jira Workstream Lead and Jira Administrator

**Role Summary**

Owns the Jira side of the ServiceNow and Jira integration. Support agents link Jira issues to ServiceNow cases, Jira comments copy to case work notes, and Jira status, assignee, priority and resolution update the case. The integration must work across all of client’s Jira projects with no project-specific setup. This role makes that possible on the Jira side, tests it with the Jira teams and handles other Jira support tasks that client assigns.

**Responsibilities**

* Join the Jira requirements sessions and help agree a base set of required fields for all Jira projects.

* Set up the integration service account, API tokens or OAuth access and permissions with the Jira Administrator.
* Configure webhooks or automation rules that send comment and field changes to ServiceNow.
* Build test Jira projects and test data that cover the different project setups.
* Test the integration with the Buxton developers: issue linking, comment copy, field sync, error handling and retries.
* Support the Jira group during user acceptance testing (UAT), log defects and confirm fixes.
* Write Jira-side runbook notes for the managed services team and support go-live checks and hypercare.
* Handle other Jira support tasks client assigns within the weekly hours, such as project setup, scheme changes, user access and automation fixes.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Four or more years as a Jira administrator in a multi-project company environment.
* Hands-on administration of projects, issue types, workflows, screens, field configurations, permission schemes and notification schemes.
* Working experience with the Jira REST API, webhooks and Jira Query Language (JQL).
* Experience with Automation for Jira rules.
* At least one integration between Jira and another system, such as ServiceNow, Salesforce or a support tool.
* Comfortable testing APIs with Postman or similar tools.
* Clear written and spoken English and experience working with United States clients across time zones.

**Nice to Have**

* Jira Service Management (JSM) administration.
* Experience with both Jira Cloud and Jira Data Center.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow Integration Hub or the ServiceNow Jira spoke.
* ScriptRunner or similar scripting add-ons.
* Experience standardizing fields and workflows across many Jira projects.

**Certifications**

* Atlassian Certified Jira Administrator
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) is a plus

description:
****Company Description****
Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.
  
  
****Job Description****
**Job description**
**Job Description**
**Job Title:**
Data Migration Engineer
  
  
**Summary**
The Data Migration Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting data replication, migration, and integration solutions across cloud and on-prem environments. This role ensures secure, reliable, and high-performance data movement between heterogeneous systems, leveraging modern ETL tools, lakehouse technologies, and DevOps practices. The role carries platform and administration responsibilities for the Snowflake environment and the AWS data platform services that support it, and requires 24x7 operational support for mission-critical data pipelines.
  
  
Key Responsibilities Data replication and migration
  
  

* Design and implement data replication and migration solutions across multiple platforms (AWS DocumentDB, PostgreSQL, DB2, Snowflake).
* Develop and maintain ETL workflows using AWS services (DMS, Glue) and other integration tools.
* Ensure data integrity, latency, and SLA compliance for replication and migration processes.
* Plan and execute migrations off legacy on-prem estates into AWS, including validation, reconciliation, cutover, and rollback planning.
* Provide 24x7 support for data replication platforms, including incident management and root cause analysis.
* Monitor and optimize replication performance, ensuring scalability and cost efficiency.

Platform and DevOps engineering
  
  

* Build and operate data platform services on AWS, including AWS Glue (ETL jobs, crawlers, Data Catalog), AWS Lambda, S3, Step Functions, and EventBridge.
* Develop and maintain lakehouse ingestion patterns using Apache Hudi (upserts, incremental processing, compaction, clustering, schema evolution), with awareness of comparable open table formats (Iceberg, Delta Lake).
* Implement DevOps practices for automation, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation), including automated testing and promotion between environments.
* Deploy and support Windows and Linux compute in AWS (EC2, clustering, networking, IAM) in support of replication and migration workloads.
* Implement observability across the platform: logging, metrics, alerting, and dashboarding (CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana).

Snowflake administration
  
  

* Administer the Snowflake platform as day-to-day operational owner: account, database, schema, and warehouse management.
* Design and manage role-based access control (RBAC), including role hierarchies and integration with enterprise identity (SSO/SCIM).
* Manage warehouse sizing, auto-suspend/auto-resume, resource monitors, and query optimization to control cost and performance.
* Operate ingestion into Snowflake via bulk loading (COPY INTO), Snowpipe, tasks, streams, and S3-based staging, alongside third-party replication tooling.
* Implement platform governance: data masking, row access policies, tagging, time travel/retention configuration, and usage monitoring.
* Establish and maintain runbooks, standards, and documentation for Snowflake administration, and support knowledge transfer across the team.

Security, governance, and collaboration
  
  

* Maintain compliance with security standards, including encryption in transit and at rest, IAM roles and policies, and vulnerability management.
* Collaborate with architecture and security teams to validate designs and ensure adherence to governance policies.
* Partner with business units and vendors (including vendor engineering/professional services teams) to deliver strategic data integration solutions.

**Skills & Qualifications Core Expertise**

* Minimum 3 years in data replication, migration, and integration engineering.
* Hands-on experience with AWS Data Migration Service (DMS), AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, and S3-based staging for Snowflake.
* Practical experience with Apache Hudi or a comparable open table format (Iceberg, Delta Lake) in a production environment.
* Strong knowledge of Snowflake architecture and administration: RBAC, warehouse and cost management, bulk loading (COPY INTO), and Snowpipe.
* Proficiency in PostgreSQL, DB2, and other relational databases.
* Experience migrating or re-platforming legacy Windows Server workloads into cloud environments.

Programming & Automation
  
  

* Scripting skills in Python and Shell; PySpark experience advantageous.
* Hands-on experience with Terraform or similar IaC tools.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tools (Jenkins, Git, Docker).

Security & Compliance
  
  

* Understanding of TLS/SSL, encryption standards, IAM policies, and vulnerability management.

**Additional Skills**

* Experience with ETL/replication tools (Qlik Replicate, Matillion, Fivetran) is a plus.
* Knowledge of monitoring and alerting tools (CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana).
* Experience supporting the handover or transition of platform services between teams.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Data Engineer Associate, or Data Analytics Specialty.
* Snowflake SnowPro Core or Administrator Certification.
* DevOps-related certifications.

**Other Requirements**

* Ability to work in a 24x7 operational support model.
* Strong problem-solving and communication skills.
* Experience in Agile environments and ITSM tools (ServiceNow).

**Qualifications**

* Appropriate degree level or equivalent qualification.
* AWS experience.
* Snowflake administration.
* Database technology experience.

**Qualifications**

* Develops and designs tool sets that simplify provisioning and support on premises and on Azure.

* Plans and executes major platform software and operating system upgrades and maintenance across a highly virtualized environment.

* Provides in-depth experience in troubleshooting SAP IT systems.

* Excellent knowledge of Linux methods.

* Experience with a diverse range of orchestration suites and tools, including, but not limited to: Puppet Enterprise, HP Operations Orchestration, GitLab, GitHub, Terraform, Ansible.

* Experienced in working closely with development teams to define and optimize CI/CD pipeline processes.
* Proven ability to perform custom RPM builds.
* Strong Cloud experience in Azure.
* Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) or SUSE certification or higher certification or equivalent engineering experience.

* Experience developing and documenting standard operating procedures and best practices in a technical repository.

* Strong scripting language expertise.
* Strong focus on design, build, deployment, security, system hardening, and securing services.
* Controls consistency and integrity monitoring and health checks of the operating system structure.
* Proven expertise in Performance Tuning and Capacity Planning.
* Understanding of Configuration Management and Change Management Best Practices.
* Excellent troubleshooting skills and the ability to logically think through problem situations.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proven ability to partner with others in the area or company to deliver quality solutions.
* Able to work effectively and produce consistent results with minimum supervision. Self-motivated, responsible, conscientious, and detail-oriented.
* Able to work well under pressure and handle crisis situations professionally.
* Strong experience with services in Enterprise – Active Directory, DNS, Apache, Tomcat.
* Strong understanding of Kerberos, cross-realm authentication, and Kerberized services.
* Proven experience reviewing and comparing multiple platform options for a given application and collaborating with appropriate teams to choose the right platform.
* Available for periodic off-hours work, including weekends and holidays and be able to provide 24x7 on-call support as necessary.

**Recommended:**

* BS degree in Computer Science or equivalent formal training and experience.
* 8+ years’ IT experience and 6+ years’ Red Hat Linux experience in an enterprise environment.
* Experience with VMWare and virtualized environments.
* Working knowledge of Python, Puppet, and Ansible scripting language.
* Successful internal candidates will have spent one year or more on their current team.

* Management will review the Job Analysis for this position prior to a job offer.

**Job Description**
Summary -
  
  
We are hiring a Search Engineer to support and develop our UK search platforms. You will work across Apache Solr and Amazon OpenSearch (including Serverless), covering production support, search development, and a live Solr to OpenSearch migration.
  
  
This role suits someone who has worked L1, L2, and L3 search issues on a large distributed estate - Solr or Elasticsearch on EC2 or on-prem RHEL and can debug from logs, cluster state, and AWS CloudWatch or Splunk. Day-to-day work is hands-on: Bash, operational scripts, search changes, and using AI effectively to investigate and deliver faster.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own L1/L2/L3 search support: triage latency, indexing failures, cluster instability, auth/TLS, and query regressions, then drive RCA and lasting fixes.
* Debug distributed Solr and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch clusters on AWS EC2 and, where relevant, on-prem RHEL, using CloudWatch, Splunk, host logs, and cluster APIs.
* Develop and improve search: schemas, analyzers, indexing, queries, relevance, and search APIs.
* Contribute to the Solr to OpenSearch migration, including schema and query translation and relevancy and performance checks.
* Write and maintain Bash and operational automation for deploy, day-2 support, and incident response.
* Use AI and prompt engineering as part of daily engineering work - investigation, scripting, and delivery.
* Partner with product and platform teams on indexing pipelines, APIs, and AWS infrastructure.

**What You'll Bring**

* Strong production experience with Solr and/or Elasticsearch on EC2 or on-prem RHEL, including a large distributed, multi-node estate.
* A track record of resolving L1/L2/L3 search incidents, not only feature work.
* Solid Lucene fundamentals: schema, analyzers, relevancy, shards, replicas, and cluster operations.
* Hands-on Bash and comfort with AWS day-2 operations, especially CloudWatch, Splunk, or direct log analysis on RHEL hosts.
* Ability to develop search changes in Java and/or Python; SQL and RDBMS-backed indexing are useful.
* Practical use of AI tools and prompt engineering to speed up debugging, scripting, and implementation.
* Clear communication under incident pressure.

**Nice to have**

* OpenSearch, including Serverless, or a Solr to OpenSearch / Elasticsearch migration.
* A Solr major-version upgrade.
* Gatling, Locust, or similar performance testing.
* Custom search plugins or matching and relevance APIs.
* Ansible, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Harness, or Jenkins.
* C++, Okta/JWT, LDAP, SigV4, or TLS operational experience.
* AWS certification.

title: Associate Director - HPC Infrastructure Architect
description:
**Summary**
Scientific computing sits at the centre of how Novartis discovers and develops medicines. Cloud & Hosting Services has established AI & HPC Engineering as the single engineering and delivery channel for high-performance computing, and Architecture & Integration owns the target architecture behind it. The HPC Infrastructure Architect is accountable for that architecture: the compute, storage, interconnect, scheduling and data-locality design that scientific workloads run on, on premises and in the cloud.
  
  
The role translates scientific demand - molecular modelling, imaging and cryo-electron microscopy, genomics, simulation and increasingly AI-adjacent workloads - into capacity models, workload placement principles and platform patterns. It carries the physical dependencies with it: power, rack and cooling envelopes, high-performance storage tiers, network fabric, and the data centre and colocation footprint that a large campus and site transformation programme is reshaping.
  
  
This is an individual contributor architecture role in which credibility with scientists matters as much as credibility with infrastructure engineers.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the HPC reference architecture: cluster topologies, CPU and GPU node designs, high-performance and tiered storage, interconnect fabric, schedulers and the software stack that supports scientific workflows.
* Define the scientific workload placement model - which workloads run on dedicated clusters, which burst to cloud, and which belong on AI platforms - based on performance, data gravity, cost and compliance.
* Produce and maintain capacity plans for compute, accelerators, storage and network, including the power, rack and cooling requirements that data centre and colocation planning depends on.
* Establish data-locality and data-movement principles across instruments, laboratories, storage tiers, archive and cloud, including replication and recovery approaches for irreplaceable scientific data.
* Translate scientific requirements into sizing, benchmarking and procurement input, and validate feasibility before engineering build.
* Maintain architecture decision records for HPC platform choices, connecting each to scientific outcome, cost and lifecycle consequence.
* Define the interface with AI infrastructure so that shared accelerators, storage and data pipelines are used coherently rather than duplicated.
* Ensure HPC designs meet security, quality and regulatory expectations and are operable by Infrastructure Operations after handover.
* Engage scientific communities and research IT partners as the trusted architecture contact for high-performance computing.
* Coach engineers and analysts, and act as a role model for the Novartis Values and Behaviours.

**Essential Requirements**

* 8+ years of experience designing, building, or operating large-scale High-Performance Computing (HPC) environments.
* Proven expertise in HPC platform architecture, capacity planning, and multi-cluster infrastructure design.
* Strong experience supporting Linux-based compute clusters in enterprise or scientific computing environments.
* Hands-on knowledge of workload schedulers such as Slurm, LSF, or comparable HPC scheduling technologies.
* Solid understanding of CPU and GPU infrastructure design, performance optimization, and benchmarking methodologies.
* Experience with high-performance storage solutions, parallel file systems, and high-speed networking technologies, including InfiniBand and Ethernet fabrics.
* Knowledge of containerized, reproducible scientific workflows and hybrid or cloud-based HPC environments.
* Familiarity with large-scale data management practices, including data replication, archiving, and infrastructure planning (power, cooling, and rack design); experience supporting research or scientific computing communities is highly desirable.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Able to work fluently with scientists and translate research needs into infrastructure terms; rigorous, evidence-based approach to sizing and benchmarking; long-horizon planning discipline; strong collaboration across engineering, facilities and research organizations.
* Fluent English, written and spoken. Additional languages are an asset.

**About The Role**
Qonfido is building an AI companion for money, helping people organise, understand, and grow their wealth with clarity and confidence.
  
  
As a Founder's Office Intern, you will sit at the centre of the company: close to strategy, product, data, and day-to-day execution. This is not a shadowing internship. You will own real workstreams, present recommendations to founders, and help turn ambiguity into decisions and decisions into shipped outcomes.
  
  
You will move across strategy setting, data analysis, product management support, AI optimisation, and operational follow-through, learning how a modern fintech startup actually runs.
  
  
If you are curious, structured, comfortable with AI tools, and energised by solving messy problems end to end, this role is for you.
  
  
What you'll own
  
  
Strategy & Problem Framing
  
  

* Help founders frame weekly and monthly priorities: what matters, why now, and what success looks like.
* Turn open-ended questions into crisp problem statements, options, and recommendation memos.
* Support competitive, market, and customer research that informs product and growth bets.
* Track strategic initiatives from idea → decision → owner → next milestone.

Data Analysis & Insights
  
  

* Pull, clean, and analyse product, growth, and operational data to answer founder questions quickly.
* Build lightweight dashboards, scorecards, and recurring insight notes (what changed, why it matters, what to do).
* Validate hypotheses with evidence (not vibes) and flag risks, anomalies, and opportunities early.
* Translate analysis into clear visuals and one-page briefs founders can act on.

Product Management Support
  
  

* Support discovery: user interviews, feedback synthesis, journey mapping, and opportunity sizing.

* Coordinate across design, engineering, and go-to-market to keep scope, timelines, and dependencies visible.
* Run QA / dogfooding passes, document bugs/edge cases, and close the loop after launches.

AI Optimisation & Workflow Design
  
  

* Identify repetitive Founder Office and team workflows that AI can compress or improve.

* Experiment with tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Notion AI, spreadsheet copilots) and measure time saved / quality lift.
* Help the team adopt better AI habits: templates, evaluation checklists, and versioned workflows.

Operational Support
  
  

* Own follow-ups, meeting notes, action trackers, and decision logs so nothing important falls through.
* Coordinate cross-functional projects: timelines, owners, blockers, and weekly status updates.
* Support special projects spanning hiring ops, partner outreach, content briefs, or launch readiness as needed.
* Create durable systems (docs, trackers, checklists) that make the company faster after you leave each workstream.

What success looks like
  
  
Within the first 6 months, you should be able to:
  
  

* Deliver founder-ready memos and analyses that lead to clear decisions.
* Own at least one end-to-end workstream from problem framing to measurable outcome.
* Ship useful AI workflows that reduce cycle time for recurring Founder Office tasks.
* Keep priorities, owners, and next actions visible across the initiatives you support.
* Demonstrate strong judgment: escalate early, communicate crisply, and improve with feedback.

Who you are
  
  

* Final-year undergraduate / postgraduate student or recent graduate (any rigorous major; preference for business, economics, CS, design, or quantitative fields).
* Strong analytical and written communication skills. You can turn complexity into clarity.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets and basic data analysis; SQL / Python / BI tools are a plus.
* Hands-on with modern AI tools and eager to invent better ways of working.
* Structured operator: you track details, close loops, and hate dropped balls.
* High ownership and bias to action in ambiguous environments.

Bonus points
  
  

* Prior internship in startups, consulting, product, analytics, or strategy.

* Experience writing specs, running user interviews, or shipping a small product/feature.

title: Senior Investigation Specialist, Last Mile - Flex VoD
description:
**Description**
The Rabbit App Bug Triage (RABT) team is part of the Voice of Driver (VoD) organization within Worldwide Flex Driver Partner Insights & Experience (WW DPIX). VoD is responsible for identifying, interpreting, and acting on signals that indicate friction in the Delivery Partner (DP) experience across the Amazon Flex journey.
  
  
RABT owns the operational mechanism for identifying, validating, and triaging potential defects in the Rabbit application. The team consolidates feedback from multiple sources, including Driver Support contacts, station escalations, country teams, social media, and app reviews, and converts those signals into structured, evidence-based technical investigations.
  
  
The team’s role is not limited to defect intake. RABT determines whether a reported issue is actionable, reconstructs the affected DP journey using available operational and technical signals, assesses recurrence and potential blast radius, removes duplicate noise, and provides engineering teams with sufficiently complete evidence to accelerate root-cause analysis and resolution. The team also identifies systemic gaps in product behavior, operational mechanisms, and diagnostic coverage, and works with partner teams to improve both defect detection and the quality of upstream signals.
  
  
RABT is looking for a Senior Investigation Specialist who can independently manage complex investigations, work through incomplete or ambiguous information, and translate large volumes of DP feedback and operational data into clear technical findings.
  
  
The ideal candidate will combine strong investigative judgment with analytical capability and operational rigor. The role requires regular use of SQL, dashboards, logs, case history, system signals, and internal diagnostic tools to validate hypotheses and quantify impact. The successful candidate will also work closely with Program Managers, Product Managers, Software Development Managers, Engineers, Operations teams, and other stakeholders across geographies.
  
  
In addition to managing individual investigations, the role will contribute to improving RABT’s broader operating mechanisms, including SOPs, quality controls, taxonomy, automation, AI-assisted triage, and defect-intake processes.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Independently investigate and triage complex Rabbit app issues using DP feedback, operational data, logs, system signals, and internal diagnostic tools.
* Determine issue actionability, identify failure patterns, distinguish product defects from operational or expected behavior, and assess potential blast radius.
* Create clear, evidence-backed technical tickets that enable Product and Engineering teams to investigate and resolve issues efficiently.
* Analyze trends and recurring defects using SQL, Excel, dashboards, and other analytical tools to identify emerging risks and systemic problems.

Partner with Program, Product, Engineering, Operations, and country teams to drive high-impact issues through investigation, escalation, and closure.
  
  

* Improve RABT operating mechanisms, including SOPs, quality controls, taxonomies, investigation frameworks, and knowledge repositories.

Support automation and AI-driven triage by defining investigation logic, validating outputs, identifying failure modes, and reducing repetitive manual work.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Rabbit App Bug Triage (RABT) team is part of Voice of Driver (VoD) within Worldwide Flex Driver Partner Insights & Experience (WW DPIX). RABT Team identifies, validates, and triages potential Rabbit app defects using feedback from Driver Support, stations, country teams, social media, and app reviews. The team partners closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Program teams to improve issue actionability, reduce defect-resolution time, and strengthen the DP experience. RABT also develops scalable mechanisms across quality, automation, AI-assisted triage, and defect detection to improve how app issues are identified and resolved globally.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* high school diploma or bachelor's degree

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience pulling data from databases using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems
* Experience using SQL

title: Lead Generation Specialist – US Tax | F-1, OPT, H-1B & H-4 EAD Leads
description:
Lead Generation Specialist – US Tax | F1 OPT, H-1B & H-4 EAD Leads

**Company:**
Taxquity Advisors

**Work Mode:**
Full-time | Hybrid

**Experience:**
2–4 years preferred

Company Description

Taxquity Advisors is a US-focused tax, immigration, and advisory firm providing US tax preparation, immigration support, and compliance services to individuals, NRIs, expatriates, businesses, and international clients. Our services include US individual tax returns (Form 1040), business tax returns, ITIN applications, FBAR/FATCA compliance, cross-border tax planning, and immigration support for F-1, OPT, STEM OPT, H-1B, Green Card, and H-4 EAD clients.

Role Description

We are seeking a proactive
**Lead Generation Specialist**
responsible for identifying potential clients, sourcing relevant prospect data, building targeted lead databases, and generating qualified business opportunities for Taxquity Advisors' US taxation and immigration services.

The primary responsibility is to identify prospective clients within the
**F-1 student, OPT, STEM OPT, H-1B visa holder, H-4 EAD, and NRI segments**
. The specialist will research relevant markets, build prospect lists containing names and available business contact details, conduct outreach, and convert interested prospects into consultation opportunities.

The role requires a strong focus on data research, database development, cold calling, digital prospecting, referral partnerships, and lead conversion.

Key Responsibilities

* **Lead Data Sourcing:**
  Identify and compile prospective-client data for F-1 international students, OPT and STEM OPT students, H-1B visa holders, H-4 EAD holders, NRIs, and other individuals who may require US tax services.
* **Database Development:**
  Build and maintain structured lead databases containing prospect names, mobile numbers where lawfully available, email addresses where available, location, prospect category, lead source, and outreach status.
* **Targeted Prospect Research:**
  Research relevant universities, international student communities, professional networks, recruitment firms, immigration consultancies, and other appropriate channels to identify potential clients.
* **Contact Information Verification:**
  Verify the accuracy and relevance of contact information using legitimate sources and authorized databases. Obtain and document consent where required before contacting prospects.
* **Cold Calling and Outreach:**
  Contact eligible prospects through permitted calling, email, messaging, and digital outreach channels to introduce Taxquity Advisors' services.
* **Lead Qualification:**
  Identify prospects who may need Form 1040 preparation, federal and state tax filing, tax planning, ITIN applications, FBAR/FATCA compliance, or related services.
* **Referral Partnerships:**
  Develop relationships with education consultants, immigration service providers, recruitment agencies, universities, and other relevant referral partners.
* **Lead Conversion:**
  Schedule consultations and coordinate with the sales and tax advisory teams to convert qualified leads into clients.
* **CRM Management:**
  Maintain accurate prospect records, contact history, follow-up schedules, campaign results, and conversion metrics.
* **Reporting:**
  Submit regular reports covering new leads sourced, verified contact records, calls completed, interested prospects, consultations scheduled, and conversions.

Target Lead Segments

1. **F-1 Visa Students**
   – International students studying at US universities.
2. **OPT Students**
   – Students working in the United States under Optional Practical Training.
3. **STEM OPT Students**
   – Eligible graduates working under STEM OPT extensions.
4. **H-1B Visa Holders**
   – Professionals employed in the United States under H-1B status.
5. **H-4 EAD Holders**
   – Eligible H-4 dependents authorized to work in the United States.
6. **NRIs and Expatriates**
   – Individuals with potential US tax filing or cross-border tax compliance needs.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Finance, Marketing, or a related field.
* MBA/PGDM preferred.
* 2–4 years of experience in lead generation, sales, business development, telecalling, client acquisition, or financial services.
* Demonstrated ability to source leads and build organized databases containing names and available contact details.
* Strong research skills and familiarity with online prospecting tools, CRM systems, Excel, and lead management platforms.
* Excellent communication, cold-calling, follow-up, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment and achieve measurable targets.
* Knowledge of US taxation, Form 1040, F-1/OPT/STEM OPT, H-1B, and H-4 EAD is an advantage.

Performance Expectations

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Number of relevant leads sourced from legitimate channels.
* Number of accurate and verified contact records added to the database.
* Number of qualified prospects contacted.
* Number of interested prospects and consultations generated.
* Referral partnerships established and leads converted into paying clients.

**Important:**
Contact data must be sourced through lawful, authorized channels and handled in accordance with applicable privacy, data-protection, and telemarketing requirements. Personal mobile numbers must not be obtained through unauthorized databases, scraping, or disclosure of private information without an appropriate legal basis

title: Founding Growth Lead - B2B SaaS
description:
**Role: Founding Growth Lead - B2B SaaS**

**Company:**

StepsAI

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**Work Mode:**
Work from Office

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
3 to 8 years (relevant experience matters more than years)

**Reports to:**
Founders

**About StepsAI**

StepsAI builds AI agents that help businesses sell more, generate leads, and handle customer support automatically.

Our AI agents work across websites, Shopify, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, and voice calls. They help businesses answer customer questions, recommend products, recover abandoned carts, qualify leads, book appointments, and automate everyday customer interactions.

We're building for businesses in India and global markets.

We have a growing product, real customers, and a team that's constantly shipping new features.

**Now we're looking for someone who can help us build a repeatable inbound growth engine.**

**About the Role**

We're looking for a
**Founding Growth Lead**
who can take ownership of growing StepsAI's inbound acquisition from the ground up.

This is not a traditional marketing management role.

We want someone who understands how SaaS companies attract customers, convert website visitors into users, and turn product trials into paying customers.

You'll work directly with the founders to identify growth opportunities, experiment with acquisition channels, improve conversions, and build a scalable growth engine.

**Your goal is simple: Help more businesses discover StepsAI, try our product, and become paying customers.**

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Own Inbound Growth & Demand Generation

* Develop and execute our inbound growth strategy across India and international markets.
* Drive qualified traffic, product signups, demo requests, and paying customers.
* Identify the best acquisition channels and build repeatable growth processes.
* Run experiments, measure results, and scale what works.

2. SEO, AI Search & Organic Acquisition

* Build an SEO strategy targeting high-intent, business-focused searches.
* Identify keywords, competitor comparisons, and use cases that attract potential buyers.
* Improve StepsAI's visibility across Google and AI-powered search platforms.
* Work with the content team to create landing pages, comparison pages, guides, and customer stories that generate leads.

3. Product-Led Growth & Conversion Optimization

* Improve the journey from website visitor to signup, product activation, and paid subscription.
* Optimize landing pages, signup flows, onboarding, and conversion funnels.
* Work closely with product and engineering teams to identify and remove friction.
* Run A/B tests and other experiments to improve acquisition and activation.

4. Shopify & Marketplace Growth

* Drive installations and adoption of our Shopify app.
* Improve App Store visibility, listing conversion, activation, and customer feedback.
* Explore other relevant marketplaces, directories, and integration ecosystems.
* Identify opportunities to acquire customers through the platforms they already use.

5. Performance Marketing & Growth Experiments

* Plan and execute targeted campaigns across Google Ads, Shopify App Store Ads, and other relevant channels.
* Test messaging, landing pages, keywords, and offers.
* Optimize acquisition costs and lead quality.
* Make data-backed decisions about which channels deserve more investment.

6. Partnerships & Distribution

* Explore partnerships with Shopify agencies, digital marketing agencies, consultants, and SaaS ecosystems.
* Develop repeatable referral and partner-led acquisition programs.
* Experiment with co-marketing, communities, and industry-specific distribution strategies.

7. Analytics & Growth Ownership

* Own the end-to-end acquisition and conversion funnel.
* Track qualified inbound leads, signups, activation, paid conversions, customer acquisition cost, and revenue.
* Set up and use tools such as GA4, Google Search Console, PostHog, Mixpanel, and CRM reporting.
* Share weekly growth insights, experiments, results, and next steps with the founders.

What We're Looking For

**Must Have**

* 4+ years of hands-on experience in SaaS growth, demand generation, or growth marketing.
* Proven experience generating inbound leads, signups, or revenue for a B2B SaaS product.
* Strong understanding of SEO, performance marketing, landing-page optimization, and conversion funnels.
* Experience executing growth campaigns yourself, not just managing external agencies.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to connect marketing activities to business outcomes.
* Ability to independently plan, execute, measure, and iterate on growth experiments.
* Comfortable working in a fast-moving startup with limited resources and high ownership.

**Good to Have**

* Experience growing a SaaS company from an early stage.
* Experience with product-led growth or self-serve SaaS products.
* Familiarity with Shopify, e-commerce SaaS, AI agents, or customer support platforms.
* Experience with international markets such as the US, UK, or Middle East.
* Experience building agency partnerships, referral programs, or marketplace acquisition channels.
* Familiarity with marketing automation and AI tools.

What Success Looks Like

**First 30 Days**

* Understand our customers, product, competitors, and acquisition funnel.
* Identify our most promising customer segments and inbound channels.
* Build a measurable growth plan and launch initial experiments.

**First 60 Days**

* Launch and optimize targeted acquisition campaigns.
* Improve website and signup conversion.
* Build a consistent process for generating qualified inbound opportunities.
* Identify early signals of repeatable acquisition.

**First 90 Days**

* Establish measurable inbound acquisition channels.
* Increase qualified signups, product activations, and inbound opportunities.
* Demonstrate which growth activities contribute to paying customers.
* Build a clear roadmap for scaling the most effective channels.

Why Join StepsAI?

* **Build from zero to one:**
  You'll create our growth engine rather than inherit an established process.
* **Real ownership:**
  Your work will directly influence customer acquisition and company revenue.
* **Work with founders:**
  Make decisions quickly and see your ideas implemented.
* **A product you can demonstrate:**
  Work with AI agents solving real sales and support problems.
* **Room to grow:**
  Opportunity to build and eventually lead the growth function as StepsAI scales.

We're looking for someone who enjoys building, experimenting, learning, and taking responsibility for outcomes.

How to Apply

Send your resume or LinkedIn profile along with brief answers to these questions:

1. **What's one SaaS product you've helped grow?**
   What was your specific contribution, and what measurable results did you achieve?
2. **Have you built an inbound acquisition channel from scratch?**
   Tell us what you did and what worked.
3. **If you joined StepsAI, what would you prioritize in your first 30 days?**

We care much more about what you've actually built and grown than impressive job titles.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
**About Us**
Darwinbox is Asia’s fastest growing SaaS based HR Technology platform. A brainchild of alumni from the country’s most distinguished institutions (IIT/IIM/XLRI) and organizations (McKinsey, EY, Google), Darwinbox is the preferred technology partner of 1000+ global enterprises with more than 4 million+ employees using the platform.
  
  
Our end-to-end HCM technology suite competes with the best in the business and has won against giants such as SAP, Oracle and Workday several times to acquire iconic enterprise customers ranging from the largest conglomerates to unicorns, such as, Adani, Mahindra, Kotak, TVS, Arvind, Nivea, Puma, Swiggy, Paytm, Bigbasket and Delhivery.
  
  
Backed by Sequoia, Microsoft, KKR and Partners Group, and recognized by global analysts such as Gartner and Forrester, we are scaling rapidly across markets. This is a rocketship, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a GTM Engineer, you will embed across Marketing, SDRs, Sales, and Pre-Sales — mapping how work actually gets done, then engineering better versions of those workflows using AI. You will lead AI and technology implementation across all marketing functions, enabling the team to move faster, produce more, and make smarter decisions.
  
  
This is an AI-first role in the truest sense. You will not just use AI tools — you will build them. You will design systems, automate workflows, prototype internal tooling, and deploy solutions that generate compounding returns for the entire GTM engine.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* AI-Native Workflow Engineering
* Identify high-friction workflows across the GTM org and rebuild them with AI at the core.
* Build and deploy automation pipelines using n8n, Make, Clay, and LLM APIs — replacing manual effort with intelligent, signal-driven systems.
* Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to build internal tools, scripts, and dashboards without engineering dependencies. If the tool you need does not exist, build it yourself.
* AI-Powered Content & Demand Generation
* Build a content automation pipeline for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) — so Darwinbox surfaces in every relevant AI-driven buyer conversation, at scale.
* Design and deploy AI-powered outbound systems that personalize messaging at the account and persona level, replacing manual sequencing with intelligent, signal-driven outreach.
* Experiment with warm-up sequences, inbox health, deliverability, and multi-channel orchestration across email and LinkedIn.
* MarTech Stack & AI Tool Ownership
* Own the evaluation, onboarding, and integration of AI and MarTech tools: HubSpot, Clay, Apollo.io, Cognism, HeyReach, Instantly, and whatever emerges next.
* Audit tech spend, eliminate redundancy, and optimize for leverage. If a new AI tool could make the team 2x more effective, you are testing it that week — not that quarter.
* Reporting, Analytics & Data Intelligence
* Build real-time dashboards for campaign performance, pipeline contribution, and GTM efficiency.
* Analyze funnel metrics and surface actionable insights using SQL, automation, or whatever tool fits the question.
* Automate CRM hygiene, data enrichment, and reporting workflows, so the team always works with clean, reliable data.
* Process Design & Governance
* Map existing GTM processes, identify inefficiencies, and implement automation for speed and accuracy.
* Document all workflows and maintain a system of record for automation. Ensure compliance with data governance standards.

**Who Should Apply**

* AI builder: You build with AI, not just prompt it.
* You have used Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot to ship real things: tools, automations, dashboards, scripts. Going from a problem statement to a working prototype without filing an engineering ticket is table stakes.
* Hands-on experience with automation and integration tools: n8n, Clay, Make, Zapier, or similar.
* Comfort with SQL and APIs — enough to pull, transform, and load data independently.
* Engineering rigor: you break ambiguous problems into first-principles components and own them end-to-end.
* Obsession with outcomes. You are not done when it is built — you are done when it is measurably working.
* Graduated from a top-tier institution (think IIT, NIT, BITS, or equivalent).

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 2-6 years in content marketing for B2B / SaaS (HR tech experience is a plus).
* Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling abilities.
* Experience with content calendars, editorial planning, and project workflows.
* Familiarity with SEO fundamentals and performance analytics.
* Strong understanding of buyer personas, content funnels, and GTM alignment.

The specialist will contribute to accurate campaign billing insights and operational reports that help business teams optimize communication and value delivery to customers while ensuring data quality and compliance.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support daily payment related data preparation activities for email marketing campaigns by maintaining accurate spreadsheets in MS Excel and ensuring that data inputs are properly validated for business use.
* Execute routine data updates in MS Excel for marketing and payments teams by organizing customer and transaction information into structured formats that allow reliable reporting and analysis.
* Perform basic data quality checks on email marketing and payment datasets using MS Excel functions so that incorrect values and formatting issues are identified and addressed in a timely manner.
* Collaborate with marketing and operations team members to understand their data needs and translate those requirements into clear and well organized Excel based templates for ongoing use.
* Generate scheduled operational reports in MS Excel that summarize email marketing activity and payment related indicators so that stakeholders can take informed decisions about campaign actions.
* Apply standard formulas and pivot based analysis in MS Excel to highlight campaign performance trends and simple payment related metrics that support business monitoring.
* Maintain clear documentation for recurring Excel processes and file structures so that tasks can be executed consistently during rotational shifts and handovers remain smooth.
* Respond to email based queries from internal partners regarding data corrections or report clarification by using English language communication that is precise and respectful.
* Support testing steps for email marketing technical changes by preparing relevant datasets in MS Excel and recording observed results clearly for review.
* Coordinate closely with office based colleagues during rotational shifts to ensure that all assigned data tasks and reports are completed within agreed timelines.
* Adhere to company policies on data privacy and information security by handling customer and payment related information in Excel with appropriate access and storage practices.
* Contribute ideas to improve efficiency of Excel workflows and reporting formats so that the payments specialist function can deliver faster and more reliable insights to business teams.
* Participate in team discussions and training sessions to build stronger understanding of email marketing technology concepts and basic payment processes while continuously enhancing Excel proficiency.

**Qualifications**

* Possess foundational proficiency in MS Excel including ability to use common formulas sorting filtering pivot tables and basic charting to support structured reporting work.
* Demonstrate clear communication skills in English including reading writing and speaking so that requirements and findings can be shared accurately with diverse stakeholders.
* Bring exposure to email marketing technology concepts such as campaign configuration audience lists and performance indicators that support effective collaboration with technical teams.
* Show a strong orientation to detail and accuracy in data handling activities by carefully checking spreadsheet entries and ensuring consistent formats for smooth downstream use.
* Exhibit willingness to work from office in a rotational shift environment while managing time and tasks responsibly to maintain continuity of operations.
* Display curiosity and commitment to learning new tools and practices in payments and marketing technology so that skills remain relevant in a rapidly evolving business landscape.
* Apply analytical thinking and problem solving mindset when working on Excel based data sets by identifying anomalies and raising them proactively for resolution.

title: Associate Business Consultant - CRM
description:
Associate Business Consultant – CRM & Marketing Automation
  
  
Location: Hyderabad, India (Work from Office)
  
  
Company: DigiDelight
  
  
Experience: 1–3 Years
  
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
About DigiDelight
  
  
DigiDelight is an enterprise technology company developing innovative solutions that help organizations transform their business operations, customer engagement, and digital processes.
  
  
Our flagship CRM and marketing automation platform, DigiCRM, enables organizations to manage customer relationships, sales pipelines, marketing campaigns, customer journeys, and business workflows through an integrated digital platform.
  
  
We are looking for an enthusiastic, business-oriented professional who wants to build a career at the intersection of marketing, business consulting, and enterprise technology.
  
  
About the Role
  
  
We are hiring an Associate Business Consultant – CRM & Marketing Automation to join our Hyderabad team.
  
  
This is a client-facing business consulting and solution implementation role, not a conventional IT Business Analyst or documentation-focused position.
  
  
You will work directly with customers to understand their sales, marketing, and customer engagement challenges and help translate their business needs into practical CRM and marketing automation solutions.
  
  
The ideal candidate should be comfortable interacting with clients, asking insightful questions, presenting ideas confidently, and collaborating with technology teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Business Consulting & Client Engagement
  
  
- Engage directly with clients to understand their sales, marketing, and customer engagement processes.
  
- Conduct discovery sessions, requirement workshops, and business process discussions.
  
- Identify opportunities to improve lead generation, sales conversion, customer retention, and campaign effectiveness.
  
- Translate business challenges into functional requirements and practical solution recommendations.
  
  
CRM & Marketing Automation
  
  
- Understand and help configure sales pipelines, lead management, customer journeys, and CRM workflows.
  
- Work with marketing automation capabilities including email, WhatsApp, social media, and multichannel campaigns.
  
- Help customers define marketing goals, campaign KPIs, lead qualification criteria, and conversion metrics.
  
- Assist with customer segmentation, campaign planning, and workflow automation.
  
- Support the implementation and adoption of DigiCRM across customer organizations.
  
  
Product Demonstrations & Solution Delivery
  
  
- Conduct product demonstrations and presentations for prospective and existing customers.
  
- Collaborate with product, development, and implementation teams to translate business requirements into working solutions.
  
- Support user acceptance testing, customer training, and implementation activities.
  
- Gather customer feedback and contribute to continuous product improvement.
  
  
Required Qualifications & Experience
  
  
- 1–3 years of professional experience in digital marketing, B2C marketing, CRM, sales operations, marketing automation, or customer engagement.
  
- At least 1 year of practical exposure to B2C sales or marketing processes.
  
- Good understanding of digital marketing concepts, sales funnels, lead generation, campaign management, and customer journeys.
  
- Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  
- Strong presentation skills and confidence in client-facing discussions.
  
- Ability to understand business problems, ask relevant questions, and propose logical solutions.
  
- Willingness to learn new enterprise software platforms and business processes.
  
- Comfortable working from our Hyderabad office.
  
  
Good to Have
  
  
- Experience with CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Zoho CRM, Salesforce, or similar applications.
  
- Exposure to marketing automation tools, email marketing, WhatsApp campaigns, or customer engagement platforms.
  
- Familiarity with Google Analytics, website conversion tracking, lead attribution, or campaign performance reporting.
  
- Understanding of AI-driven marketing, workflow automation, and customer analytics.
  
- Educational background in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or related disciplines.
  
  
What We Value
  
  
We value attitude, communication, business understanding, and curiosity more than technical qualifications or job titles.
  
  
You do not need to be a programmer.
  
  
We are particularly interested in candidates who:
  
  
- Enjoy interacting with people and understanding business challenges.
  
- Can confidently communicate ideas to business stakeholders.
  
- Have strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  
- Are proactive, adaptable, and eager to learn.
  
- Aspire to build a career in business consulting and enterprise technology.
  
  
Why Join DigiDelight?
  
  
- Work directly with business customers and understand real-world challenges.
  
- Gain hands-on experience in CRM, marketing automation, and enterprise software.
  
- Develop client consulting, presentation, and solution design skills.
  
- Work closely with product and business leadership teams.
  
- Build a career in a growing enterprise technology company with opportunities for greater responsibility.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Interested candidates can email their updated CV to:
  
  
rajani.chiluka@digidelight.com
  
  
Email Subject: Associate Business Consultant – DigiCRM
  
  
Please include a brief introduction describing your experience in marketing, CRM, or customer engagement and why this opportunity interests you.
  
  
We are actively reviewing applications and looking to fill this position at the earliest.

description:

who can make people smile, think, feel; and most importantly,
