title: Manager – Founder's Office (Growth) (5+ Yrs to 10 Yrs)
description:
**Job Description: Manager – Founder's Office (Growth) (5+ Yrs to 10 Yrs)**
**About Bilvantis**
Bilvantis is a Data & AI engineering services company with teams in the US, India, the UK and the UAE. We don't work as a vendor. We work as an extension of our clients' own teams. We put our solutions and accelerators into every piece of repeatable work, and we choose to grow deep within a small set of accounts rather than spread thin across many.
  
  
**Why This Role Exists**
Much of Bilvantis growth runs through the CEO's relationships, with clients, prospects, partners and the wider network. The ideas are there: who to reach, how to engage, what to send and when. What's missing is someone who makes sure every one of those threads is researched, followed up and moved forward, every time.
  
  
This role is the CEO's growth shadow. You'll own the rhythm behind every contact, lead, opportunity and meeting, so that nothing slips, the right content reaches the right person at the right time, and every meeting, trip and event turns into real progress.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
**Pipeline and relationship nurturing:**

* Keep every contact, lead and opportunity the CEO is working on in one place (CRM), each with a clear status, next step and date.
* Run a planned nurture calendar for each relationship, with the right touchpoint at the right time: case studies, articles, newsletters, event invites and updates.
* Draft follow-ups in the CEO’s voice within 24 hours of every interaction, ready to review and send.
* Hold a Daily connect and weekly pipeline review with the CEO: what moved, what’s stuck, and what needs the CEO personally.

**Research And Prospect Building**

* Turn the CEO’s ideas on industries, accounts and people into researched target lists and account maps.
* Prepare a short brief before every meeting or outreach: the person, the company, their priorities, recent news, the Bilvantis angle and talking points.
* Track buying signals such as leadership changes, funding, migration plans and partner activity, and flag the right moments to engage.

**Meetings And Action Closure**

* Join all external meetings and growth-related internal meetings (pipeline, account reviews, leadership reviews), virtually by default.
* Capture notes, decisions and actions, and send a clear summary with owners and dates soon after each meeting.
* Follow every action through to completion with internal and external stakeholders, and escalate early when something is at risk.

**Content And Internal Coordination**

* Work with Delivery, Practice, Pre-Sales, Solutions and Marketing to get the right decks, proposals, case studies and updates ready on time.
* Check quality and fit before anything goes to an external contact, so every piece we send is relevant, accurate and on-brand.
* Keep a ready library of content for each industry, solution and partner.

**Travel And Event Planning**

* Plan the CEO’s travel and events around people, clients, partners and growth priorities: which city, which week and who to meet.
* Secure meetings before each trip, build the itinerary, and prepare a brief for every person the CEO will meet.
* Close every trip and event with follow-ups within 48 hours and a short summary of outcomes and next steps.
* Work with the admin or travel desk on logistics; your focus is the purpose and outcomes of each trip.

**Partner And Network Follow-through**

* Support follow-ups with Databricks and Google Cloud partner teams, event contacts, referral partners and advisors.

**Working Hours And Travel**

* Based in Hyderabad, working fixed overlap hours with the US (Central Time), for example 6 pm to 1 am IST or a split shift.
* Travel with the CEO on key US trips and on all India trips; a valid US B1/B2 visa, or willingness to obtain one, is required.

**What You Bring**

* Prior Experience: 5+ years to 10 years in business development, client engagement, consulting or a founder’s / CEO’s office.
* Highly organized and dependable: you keep many threads moving at once and never drop one.
* Strong writing: clear, crisp emails, LinkedIn messages, briefs and meeting summaries, and the ability to write in the CEO’s voice.
* Business sense: enough understanding of Data, AI, cloud and our solutions to choose the right content and message for each person.
* Getting things done without authority: you get busy internal teams to deliver on time, politely and persistently.
* Research skills: quick, sharp research on companies and people using LinkedIn Sales Navigator and the web.
* Communication and presence: confident with senior leaders, both internal and external, in the US and India.
* Discretion and judgement: you work closely with the CEO and senior contacts, and handle confidential information with care.
* Comfortable with tools: CRM (HubSpot or Salesforce), Microsoft 365, Sales Navigator, and AI tools for research, notes and drafting.
* Ownership: you act as if the pipeline is yours, not like an assistant waiting for instructions.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience in a founder’s office, CEO’s office or chief of staff role.
* Background in IT services, consulting or Data & AI.
* Experience working with US clients and time zones.
* An MBA or equivalent business qualification.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Every active contact and opportunity has a current status and next step; nothing goes stale.
* Follow-ups sent within 24 hours of meetings and within 48 hours of trips and events.
* Meeting actions closed on time, across internal and external stakeholders.
* Growth in qualified meetings and opportunities from the CEO’s network and nurture programmes.
* Measurable outcomes from each trip and event, such as meetings held, opportunities opened and relationships advanced.
* CEO time saved and redirected to high-value conversations.

**Why Join**

* Work directly alongside the CEO and see how a fast-growing company is built from the inside.
* Real exposure to senior clients, partners and leadership in the US, India, the UK and the UAE.
* A role that can grow into chief of staff, strategy or BD leadership.

title: Technical Content Manager
description:
**About WPP Production**
We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.
  
  
**About WPP**
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
  
  
**A hybrid working model**
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around three days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
  
  
**What does a Technical Content Manager do at WPP Production?**
The Content Management organization at WPP Productions is responsible for publishing creative assets, experiences, and critical digital content to our client websites and other platforms across the globe. A
**Technical Content Manager**
reports to the Head of Content Management and works closely with both the Content Management organization and external teams to examine processes and systems in order to encourage standardization and identify potential for improvement, and ensure client interactive deliverables are completed accurately and on time. This includes ownership of the content management and publishing operations in support of our client’s product launches and other digital marketing programs, including setting up and managing page structure and content in a CMS (content management system).
  
  
Core responsibilities of a Technical Program Manager include monitoring and analyzing current processes and system features/bugs from the point of view of the Interactive Content Management team. This role produces recommendations for process and system improvements where possible; disseminates information to internal and external teams when applicable; performs some day-to-day content management tasks; facilitates cross-functional collaboration across the Marcom organization; and maintains full knowledge of an ever-changing set of tools and processes.The Technical Program Manager also actively elevates the efficiency, accuracy, and consistency of the Interactive Content Management team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the content management approach to workflow and toolsets
* Work with the CM and producer teams to identify gaps in workflow and toolsets
* Make recommendations for improvements to workflow and toolsets
* Work across functional stakeholder groups to define use cases, functional requirements, and enhancements for content management platforms.
* Represent content management in platform/workflow strategic initiatives, e.g. user acceptance testing, side projects to explore new workflows or tools.
* Manage builds of content management platforms, including testing and training other team members
* Act as a source of truth for the content management team with regards to process, workflow, systems, and tools
* Create documentation and training materials for assigned CMS and publishing platforms
* Work with the content management and developer teams to standardize page structures and agree upon project approaches
* Maintain complete understanding of complexities of CMS and other internal tools
* Troubleshoot system issues as a part of the first line of defense
* Contribute to the evolution of internal platforms and processes by providing feedback on toolsets, UI, best practices, and workflow optimization
* Own documentation initiatives for applicable projects, including creating new documentation, updating old documentation, organizing the team wiki, and disseminating that information to the team for both day-to-day and training needs
* Collaborate cross-functionally with internal and external teams
* Actively balance the work of monitoring and analyzing system issues, organizing and prioritizing feedback, documenting issues and solutions, making contributions to project work, and standardizing approach and best practices for the content management team in a fast-paced, ever-evolving work environment

**Requirements:**

* A Bachelor’s degree or higher; preferably with a focus on marketing, design, or communication
* 5+ years experience working on web production teams
* Mastery of Adobe Experience Manager or other CMS
* Knowledge of HTML, XML, JSON, and enterprise CMS a plus
* Experience with localization and managing content for a global audience, using a CMS
* Deep knowledge of how content management and other related system processes work
* Record of troubleshooting and diagnosing CMS issues, and communicating those issues to both technical and non-technical personnel
* Experience in building out new or proprietary CMS
* Demonstrated success in business process improvement and re-engineering
* Proven ability to manage ambiguity effectively
* Experience creating and managing internal tools a plus

title: Outbound Lead Generation Specialist
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an
**Outbound Lead Generation Specialist**
to build and fill the new-business pipeline for 8 Views.

**This is a pure outbound role.**
Your job is to start conversations with the right prospects and hand over qualified, meeting-ready leads. You will not handle proposals, negotiation or closing. The Business Development team picks up from your handover.

You will source leads from LinkedIn and other channels, build relationships with consultants and potential partners, and run a consistent weekly outreach cadence. If you enjoy research, outreach and the discipline of hitting activity and meeting targets, this role is for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Source leads**
  from LinkedIn, referrals, events, directories, industry databases and other channels, with a focus on our core sectors: Real Estate, Education, Healthcare and other lead-generation businesses.
* Run structured
  **LinkedIn outreach**
  : build prospect lists, send connection requests, follow up and start conversations that lead to meetings.
* Build and nurture relationships with
  **consultants, agencies and other potential partners**
  to create referral and collaboration channels.
* Research each prospect's business, competitors and current digital presence so every outreach message is relevant and personalised.
* Qualify leads on budget, need, timeline and decision-maker access before handing them over.
* Book discovery calls and meetings for the BD team, with clear notes on the prospect's context and needs.
* Maintain a steady weekly outreach cadence and hit defined targets for connections, conversations and meetings booked.
* Keep the CRM updated daily with lead status, outreach activity and follow-ups.
* Track outreach performance (reply rates, meeting conversion, source-wise quality) and refine messaging and targeting based on the numbers.
* Use outreach and lead-generation tools, including LinkedIn automation, enrichment and email tools, to scale outreach without losing quality.
* Share weekly reports on pipeline activity and lead quality with the BD lead.

**What We're Looking For**

* **2-4 years of experience**
  in outbound lead generation, business development, inside sales or SDR roles, ideally in a digital marketing agency or similar service business.
* Strong command of
  **LinkedIn as a prospecting tool**
  , including Sales Navigator, search filters and connection-led conversations.
* Proven ability to source leads from multiple channels and book qualified meetings consistently.
* Excellent written communication: you can write short, personalised messages that get replies.
* Basic understanding of digital marketing and performance marketing, enough to hold a credible first conversation with a prospect.
* Comfort with numbers: reply rates, conversion rates and lead-to-meeting ratios.
* Hands-on experience with a CRM and outreach or lead-generation tools.
* Strong research skills and attention to detail.
* Self-driven and comfortable working to weekly activity and meeting targets.
* Comfortable using AI tools to improve research, outreach and productivity.

**What Will Make You Successful**

* You enjoy outreach and are not discouraged by silence or rejection.
* You research before you reach out, and your messages reflect it.
* You build genuine relationships with consultants and partners, not just send cold messages.
* You track your own numbers and keep improving what works.
* You stay disciplined with your daily and weekly cadence.
* You are curious about how performance marketing works and how it drives leads for clients.

**Bonus Points If You Have**

* Experience selling digital marketing or performance marketing services.
* An existing network of consultants, agencies or channel partners.
* Experience with Real Estate, Education or Healthcare clients.
* Experience with LinkedIn automation tools, Clay, Apollo, Lusha or similar platforms.

**Prior experience in outbound lead generation is mandatory. Candidates with agency experience will be preferred.**

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Associate Senior Assistant, Product Strategy & Management, Audit and Assurance**
**Position Overview**
The Customer Success Product Analyst helps customers and stakeholders realize greater value from business products by resolving complex issues, analyzing product and support data, and identifying opportunities to improve customer outcomes. Working across several product teams and service providers, this experienced individual contributor translates customer insights into practical product, process, and support improvements while contributing to product strategy and prioritization.
  
  
This role is designed for someone who can operate with limited supervision, exercise sound judgment, and demonstrate critical thinking skills and agility.
  
  
**Work you will do**
Product & Process Analysis and Resolution -
  
  

* Take ownership of product support issues throughout their lifecycle, ensuring that issues are coordinated, monitored, documented, tracked, and resolved appropriately.
* Investigate tickets that cannot be resolved by first-level support resources.
* Demonstrate an ability to look beyond published guidance, when needed, to resolve issues.
* Analyze ticket trends, recurring issues, root causes, and resolution patterns to identify opportunities for short-term resolution workarounds and long-term improvement.
* Identify trends, patterns, trouble areas, forecasts, and opportunities for product, process, and customer-experience improvement.

Customer Success and Stakeholder Engagement-
  
  

* Collaborate with Customer Success and product team members to understand and communicate customer needs, pain points, and satisfaction drivers.
* Serve as a bridge between technical and non-technical audiences, ensuring that customer requirements and business needs are clearly understood.
* Support customer and stakeholder conversations through evidence-based insights, clear issue framing, and practical recommendations.

Process Improvement, Knowledge Management, and Training -
  
  

* Research and propose process-improvement initiatives.
* Support implementation of relevant support policies, standards, procedures, and best practices.
* Assist in maintaining a knowledge repository, primarily in ServiceNow.
* Collaborate with training and Customer Success teams to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of first-level support staff.

Decision-Making and Scope-
  
  
The role involves moderately complex, varied work often requiring independent judgment to select and apply the most appropriate resources. The analyst is expected to make recommendations, subject to appropriate approval, on matters that may affect multiple groups within a functional area.
  
  
Decisions generally have moderate impact on a team or group within the function. Because issues may not be subject to direct verification, the role requires careful analysis, documentation, stakeholder communication, and timely escalation of key risks or unresolved problems.

This team helps customers and stakeholders realize greater value from business products by resolving complex issues, analyzing product and support data, and identifying opportunities to improve customer outcomes.

11:00 A.M. to 8:00 P.M.

Hyderabad

* Experience working with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

* Experience with ServiceNow and the Microsoft suite of applications.

Core Skills and Competencies
  
  

* Analytical thinking: Ability to analyze data, identify meaningful patterns, and derive actionable insights.

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

Support cloud networking execution, VPC provisioning, security group standards, and related connectivity work. Manage storage across cloud and legacy on-prem storage as workloads migrate; contribute to on-prem retirement and datacenter decommissioning efforts. Own cloud execution: load balancers, DNS (), VPC provisioning, and security group standards. Manage compute resources at scale with an eye toward right-sizing and long-term maintainability. Administer cloud storage and database services with attention to cost, performance, and resilience. Administer and harden Linux and Windows Server environments across cloud and on-prem, including patching, performance tuning, troubleshooting, Active Directory integration, Group Policy, DNS, and certificate services. Manage hybrid identity and authentication across on-prem and cloud workloads, and maintain OS-level security baselines and hardening standards across the estate. Use AI tooling to draft first-pass runbooks, DR documentation, and incident retrospectives to validate and refine before publishing. Collaboration & Documentation Document architecture, DR runbooks, and standard operating procedures others can actually follow under pressure. Provide technical guidance to product teams on infrastructure resilience, migration sequencing, and recovery design. Required Qualifications5+ years of hands-on cloud infrastructure engineering experience, with deep expertise in AWS and in other cloud environments. Direct experience with disaster recovery design and execution. Strong Infrastructure as Code experience (CDK, Terraform, or CloudFormation). Experience with containerized environments and Kubernetes/EKS, including version upgrade and lifecycle management. Linux and Windows Server administration experience, including patching and OS lifecycle management at scale. Solid IAM design experience, including cross-account access and least-privilege enforcement. Strong scripting ability (Python, Bash, or PowerShell). Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines. Comfortable being the primary on-call and L2 escalation point for infrastructure incidents. Familiarity with DISA STIG or CIS benchmark hardening, and vulnerability management/triage workflows. FinOps or cost governance experience, including tagging standards enforcement. title: Technology Support Lead - Business Resiliency Incident & Crisis Management
description:
**Job Description**
Join our dynamic team to innovate and refine technology operations, impacting the core of our business services.
  
  
As a Technology Support Lead in Infrastructure Platforms team, you will play a leadership role in ensuring the operational stability, availability, and performance of our production services. Critical thinking while overseeing day-to-day maintenance of the firm's systems will be key and set you up for success as you navigate tasks related to identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving issues to ensure a seamless user experience.
  
  
Given the critical role JPMC plays in the world economy, Business Resiliency remains a key area of focus for the Firm. Enterprise Technology (ET) Crisis Management (CM) is responsible for providing dedicated Incident and Crisis Business Resiliency support within ET, including assets such as staff, sites, processes and functions. This enables ET to swiftly adapt and respond to disruptive events—whether local, regional or global—in order to maintain owned Essential Services while safeguarding people, assets and the reputation of JPMC.
  
  
You'll be responsible for stakeholder communication and client relationship management. You'll use critical thinking to establish the team's functional goals and set priorities and objectives that align with our overall strategy. You'll coach, manage and mentor people, both in-house and in collaboration with our talented and dedicated problem-solving technologists across the JPMorgan Chase & Co. global network.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Lead teams of technologists that provide end-to-end application or infrastructure service delivery for the successful business operations of the firm
* Execute and support Firmwide published policies and standards, partnering with Enterprise Technology stakeholders and the Firmwide Resiliency Office to ensure consistent governance and adherence.
* Monitor and triage disruption events for impact to Enterprise Technology staff, sites, processes and functions; manage timely stakeholder communications, escalation and coordination; invoke recovery strategies and the crisis management process where required; and support return to Business As Usual (BAU) once impacts are stabilized and recovery actions are complete.
* Participate in Firmwide Simulation Utility (FSU)-led annual events to validate end-to-end resilience of recovery plans supporting Essential Services, including alignment to defined impact tolerances.
* Actively support simulated technology crisis exercises requiring recovery of all in-scope applications in a data center, using established Incident Management and Crisis Management processes.
* Execute policies and procedures that ensure operational stability and availability and lead incident, problem, and change management in support of full stack technology systems, applications, or infrastructure
* Monitor production environments for anomalies, address issues, drive evolution of utilization of standard observability tools, and escalate and communicate issues and solutions to business and technology stakeholders through incident resolution and service restoration

include, but are not exclusively:

* Process Optimization: Identify opportunities for automation and process optimization across CCM and pricing frameworks.

* Issue Resolution: Diagnose and resolve complex incidents related to rebate processing, settlement runs, accrual postings, and pricing inconsistencies.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Perform in-depth RCA on recurring issues and implement preventive, sustainable fixes.
* ITSM Ticket Management: Manage incidents, service requests, and problem tickets efficiently within enterprise ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Period-End Operations: Monitor, validate, and troubleshoot period-end settlement runs and financial postings.

* SD/FI Alignment: Collaborate effectively with SD and FI/CO teams to resolve cross-functional issues and ensure accurate O2C financial integration.
* Pricing Accuracy: Leverage deep SD and Pricing expertise to maintain calculation schema integrity and pricing determination rules.

Technical & Functional Expertise
  
  

* SAP CCM: 4+ years of focused experience configuring and supporting S/4HANA Condition Contract Management (Customer/Vendor Rebates, Chargebacks, Accruals, and Settlements).

* SAP FI Integration: Working knowledge of G/L accounting, account determination, split settlements, and revenue recognition impacts.
* RICEF Development: Proven track record in creating detailed functional designs for custom reports, interfaces, enhancements, and forms.
* ITSM & Tools: Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, Solution Manager, ChaRM, or similar change control frameworks.

Experience & Education
  
  

* Experience: 8–10 years of SAP consulting experience across both Application Maintenance (Support) and Enhancement/Implementation projects.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline.

* Problem-Solving: Analytical mindset with strong root cause analysis and troubleshooting abilities.

**Business Development Manager – Bid Management**

The role will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, monitoring government and private tenders, evaluating tender opportunities, managing the complete bid lifecycle, coordinating with technical and commercial teams, preparing proposals, and developing strong relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have strong experience in civil engineering/construction tendering and bid management, excellent commercial understanding, strong coordination skills, and the ability to manage multiple bids simultaneously while ensuring timely and high-quality submissions. Prior hands-on experience with U.S. government contracts at the federal and state/local levels is mandatory.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Business Development & Opportunity Identification
* Identify and develop new business opportunities in the civil engineering, infrastructure, construction, and related sectors.
* Monitor government, PSU, private-sector, EPC, infrastructure, and institutional tender opportunities.
* Track upcoming projects and maintain a pipeline of potential business opportunities.
* Develop and maintain relationships with clients, consultants, architects, contractors, project management consultants, and other industry stakeholders.
* Conduct market research to identify upcoming projects, competitors, market trends, and business opportunities.
* Identify and pursue business opportunities with U.S. federal, state, county, and municipal government agencies in the civil engineering, infrastructure, construction, and related sectors.
* Explore opportunities through direct client engagement, industry networks, referrals, and strategic partnerships.

* Manage the complete bid/tender lifecycle from opportunity identification through submission and award.
* Review tender documents, RFPs, RFQs, EOIs, and prequalification documents.
* Apply knowledge of U.S. federal and state/local government procurement requirements, solicitation procedures, and contract bidding processes.
* Analyze tender requirements, eligibility criteria, scope of work, technical requirements, commercial terms, and submission conditions.
* Coordinate with management to conduct Bid / No-Bid evaluations.
* Prepare tender submission schedules and ensure compliance with submission deadlines.
* Maintain a comprehensive tender tracker covering all ongoing and upcoming bids.
* Ensure all required forms, declarations, certificates, registrations, and supporting documents are available and valid.
* Review bid documents for completeness, accuracy, and compliance before submission.
* Prequalification & EOI Management
* Identify and manage EOI, RFQ, RFP, and prequalification opportunities.
* Prepare and submit company capability statements, credentials, technical profiles, and prequalification documents.
* Maintain and regularly update company credentials, project experience, client references, certifications, and key personnel profiles.
* Coordinate with internal teams to collect relevant project experience and technical information.
* Ensure timely submission of prequalification and vendor registration documents.
* Proposal Preparation & Coordination
* Lead preparation of technical and commercial proposals in coordination with relevant teams.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Estimation, Projects, Procurement, Finance, Legal, and Management teams for bid preparation.
* Develop bid submission checklists and responsibility matrices.
* Coordinate collection of BOQs, drawings, specifications, methodology, project schedules, resource plans, and other technical inputs.
* Ensure proposals clearly address client requirements and evaluation criteria.
* Review final submissions before management approval and submission.
* Commercial & Pricing Coordination
* Coordinate with estimation and finance teams for preparation of project cost estimates and commercial proposals.
* Analyze BOQs, rates, quantities, margins, project costs, and commercial conditions.
* Support preparation of competitive and commercially viable bid prices.
* Review payment terms, retention, advance payment, liquidated damages, performance guarantees, penalties, escalation clauses, and other commercial conditions.
* Highlight commercial risks and deviations to management.
* Support negotiations with clients and consultants on commercial matters.
* Client & Stakeholder Management
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
* Arrange client meetings, pre-bid meetings, site visits, clarification meetings, and presentations.
* Maintain regular communication with clients regarding tender status, clarifications, and submissions.
* Coordinate responses to client queries and requests for clarification.
* Develop a strong understanding of client requirements and upcoming project plans.
* Represent the company professionally during business development meetings and industry interactions.
* Tender Clarifications & Negotiations
* Coordinate preparation and submission of technical and commercial clarifications.
* Attend pre-bid meetings and record key requirements and clarifications.
* Coordinate with internal teams to respond to tender queries.
* Participate in commercial negotiations and post-bid discussions.
* Track tender amendments, corrigenda, addenda, and revised submission requirements.
* Tender Tracking & Reporting
* Maintain an updated database of current, upcoming, submitted, awarded, and lost tenders.
* Prepare weekly/monthly business development and tender MIS reports.
* Track bid values, submission dates, tender status, competitors, outcomes, and expected revenues.
* Analyze bid success rates and identify reasons for won/lost opportunities.
* Provide regular pipeline and revenue forecasts to management.
* Maintain accurate records of all tender-related communications and documents.
* Contract & Award Coordination
* Coordinate with management and relevant departments following successful bids.
* Review Letter of Award, Work Order, LOI, and contract documentation.
* Coordinate handover of awarded projects from Business Development/Bid Management to the Projects/Operations team.
* Highlight key contractual and commercial obligations identified during the bidding process.
* Support negotiations and finalization of contractual terms where required.
* Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis
* Monitor competitors, market pricing, project trends, and major industry developments.
* Track major infrastructure and civil engineering projects in the target market.
* Identify potential clients and strategic accounts.
* Analyze competitor participation and success in major tenders.
* Provide management with market intelligence and recommendations for business development strategy.

Key Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Strong knowledge of civil engineering and construction tendering.
* Proven experience in end-to-end bid and proposal management.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with U.S. government contracts at both federal and state/local levels.
* Strong understanding of BOQs, estimates, pricing, specifications, and tender conditions.
* Excellent commercial and negotiation skills.
* Strong analytical and numerical ability.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong client relationship and stakeholder-management skills.
* Excellent coordination and follow-up skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tenders simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail and deadline orientation.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of business development activities.
* Strong presentation and proposal-writing skills.
* High level of integrity and professionalism.

Technical / Software Skills
  
  

* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Experience working with tender portals and e-procurement platforms.
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD / BOQ / estimation-related documentation will be an advantage.
* Familiarity with CRM and bid/tender management systems will be preferred.
* Working knowledge of U.S. federal procurement platforms such as SAM.gov and state, county, and municipal government procurement portals.

Educational Qualification
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering is preferred.
* MBA / PGDM in Marketing, Business Development, or Management will be an added advantage.
* Candidates from Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or related backgrounds will be preferred.

**Experience**

* 8–12 years of relevant experience in Business Development, Tendering, Bid Management, Proposal Management, or Pre-Sales, preferably within the civil engineering, construction, infrastructure, EPC, or engineering consultancy sector.

* Experience limited to Indian government tenders or private-sector bidding outside the U.S. will not meet this requirement.

title: Specialist, Financial Planning and Analysis-Hyderabad
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Specialist, Financial Planning and Analysis- Deloitte Support Services India Pvt Ltd
  
  
Ready to elevate your finance career? As a Senior Analyst on our Global Finance team, you’ll expand your expertise in financial reporting and analysis while taking on greater responsibilities in project execution and stakeholder collaboration. In this dynamic, international role, you’ll work across regions and member firms, mentor junior team members, and use your analytical skills to drive process improvements and deliver meaningful insights that support strategic decision-making.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
**Service delivery**

* Act as a subject matter expert (SME) by gaining a thorough understanding of finance and business processes and systems. Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of financial statement interpretation (e.g., profit and loss, balance sheet) by performing detailed analysis and delivering actionable insights. Manage monthly and quarterly closing, budgeting, and forecasting cycles for assigned business units, including data collection, journal entry posting, variance analysis, and timely report delivery with minimal support.
* Exhibit leadership potential by taking on additional responsibilities, reviewing the quality of work, managing and monitoring deliverables to completion, and serving as a backup for the Assistant Manager or Team Lead. Establish yourself as a key point of contact for the business, ensuring smooth communication and operational efficiency.
* Design, automate, and maintain advanced financial models, databases, and dashboards to analyze expenses, headcount, travel, and other key cost drivers.
* Act as the primary finance liaison for assigned Profit Centers, resolving stakeholder queries, coordinating deliverables, and fostering transparent communication and trust.
* Develop subject-matter expertise in SAP, Anaplan, Analysis for Office, and advanced Excel, troubleshooting issues, standardizing workflows, and driving system or process enhancements.
* Identify data or process gaps, quantify their impact, and formulate practical recommendations, ensuring remediation is escalated or driven to closure. Support process automation and digital initiatives to drive efficiency and innovation in reporting and analysis.
* Review tasks and activities performed by junior team members, ensuring high-quality deliverables and tracking their performance.
* Mentor and support the onboarding of new analysts, contributing to their professional development and successful integration into the team.
* Partner with Global Finance colleagues and leadership on key initiatives, maintain project documentation, share best practices, and foster a collaborative, high-performance team culture.

**Leadership competencies**

* Clear and concise written and verbal communication.
* Collaborate seamlessly within teams and cross-functional teams, actively contribute to knowledge and best practice sharing; contribute towards execution of defined goals for business / projects / Global Finace wide initiatives.
* Develop and maintain effective relationships with team members, cross-functional teams at all levels and stakeholders to enhance visibility.
* Demonstrate a proactive approach by contributing ideas and solutions for projects / initiatives (business / non-business) to drive business / organization priorities.
* Efficient time and resource management skills to handle multiple tasks and meet deadlines; flexible navigating changing priorities and evolving business requirements.
* Accept feedback positively, seek opportunities to progress with an intent to apply and demonstrate consistent improvement; gain exposure towards recruitment, training and coaching.
* Demonstrate a high level of professionalism in all interactions, display a strong work ethic, embracing a collaborative mindset and establish as a go-to person.
* Build relationships within the Global Finance organization to establish meaningful connections across for professional growth.

**The Team**
The DTTL Global Finance Group supports DTTL and member firms globally with financial reporting, analysis, and related strategic projects. Our team culture is collaborative and encourages team members to take initiative and seek on-the-job learning opportunities. Our Finance professionals are committed to excellence and to enhancing the trust of DTTL and member firms. Quality is our top priority, and by focusing on innovation, we continue to raise the bar on quality and deliver greater value to our internal clients.
  
  
**Qualifications Required**

* Master’s degree in finance, accounting, or a related discipline (MBA, CMA, or equivalent) from an accredited institution.
* 4–6 years of FP&A and accounting experience—ideally in a multinational / global organization.
* Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial-statement analysis, KPIs/metrics, and the full budgeting and forecasting cycle.
* Good to have: Experience with SAP ECC, Anaplan, ServiceNow, Analysis for Office, SWIFT, or similar ERP and reporting platforms, including the ability to troubleshoot and improve workflows.
* Expert-level Excel skills (complex formulas, pivot tables, automation); strong PowerPoint abilities; working knowledge of data-visualization tools such as Power BI and Tableau.
* Proven analytical and problem-solving capability with the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations.
* Clear and concise communicator, comfortable engaging with finance teams, internal clients, and senior leadership.
* High standards for quality and timeliness; performance-driven, proactive in raising issues, and effective at self-management in dynamic environments.
* Demonstrated involvement in process improvement or automation initiatives is an advantage.
* Ability to work cross-functionally and contribute to a collaborative team culture.

**Work location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**Timings:**
12:00 PM – 9:00 PM; 02:00 PM – 11:00 PM
  
  
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: SB 1522
description:
Role Summary
  
  
Softobiz builds and runs Global Capability Centres for enterprise clients globally. Our two co-founders lead commercial, delivery and technology across multiple accounts and time zones, and too much of their week goes on scheduling, follow ups and pulling information together. As Founder's Office Associate, you will take that load off and become the operating backbone of the Founder's Office. You start with executive support and grow into owning projects end to end as you earn trust.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Executive Support (primary mandate, about 60%)
  
  

* Manage both founders' calendars across India, Australia and US time zones; protect focus time and resolve conflicts without escalating
* Triage inboxes: flag what needs a founder, draft replies, and close out the rest
* Prepare briefs before client, partner and leadership meetings covering context, open items and desired outcomes
* Capture decisions and actions after meetings and drive them to closure
* Plan business travel end to end, including itineraries, visas and on ground logistics
* Coordinate leadership reviews, offsites and client visits to our offices

Founder's Office Projects (secondary mandate, about 40%, growing over time)
  
  

* Track priority initiatives across accounts and functions, and run a weekly founder review of status, risks and blockers
* Build decks, proposals, board style updates and client review packs
* Pull data from finance, delivery and hiring teams into clear summaries the founders can act on
* Run short research tasks such as vendor comparisons, office options and market scans
* Own selected internal projects end to end, from brief to completion
* Act as the first point of contact for the founders and handle sensitive information with complete discretion

**Required Skills**
Domain Skills & Tools
  
  
**Must**
Executive Support Calendar and inbox management across time zones, travel planning, meeting briefs and minutes
  
  
Business Writing Professional emails, one page briefs, meeting notes, status updates
  
  
Microsoft 365 Outlook, Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint
  
  
Coordination Action tracking, follow ups, status reporting
  
  
AI Productivity Using AI tools to draft, summarise and research faster
  
  
**Preferred**
Presentations Board, client review and proposal decks
  
  
Business Acumen Basic financials, contracts and hiring data
  
  
**Qualifications & Certifications**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; an MBA is a plus but not required
* 3 to 6 years as an Executive Assistant to a CXO or founder, or in a Founder's Office, consulting or project coordination role
* Experience in IT services, GCCs, or with Australian or US clients is preferred
* No certifications required

Soft Skills & Cultural Fit
  
  

* Proven discretion with confidential commercial and people information
* Writes a crisp email or brief without help, and speaks confidently with senior client stakeholders
* Comfortable with early morning calls for Australia and evening calls for the US, as needed
* High ownership: drives actions to closure without needing to be followed up
* Stays calm and organised when priorities shift between two founders

What We Offer
  
  

* Work directly with both co-founders and see first hand how a GCC business is run
* Exposure to enterprise clients across Australia, the US and India
* A clear growth path from executive support into Founder's Office and strategy work
* Flexibility to work from our Hyderabad HQ or remotely
* Competitive compensation with performance linked growth

First 6 Months: Priority Focus
  
  

* Take over both founders' calendars, inboxes and travel within the first 30 days
* Set up a weekly founder review of priorities, actions and risks
* Standardize meeting briefs and post meeting action tracking

title: Staff Detection & Response Engineer
description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.
  
  
At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.
  
  
**Role Overview**
Fanatics is seeking an experienced Staff Security Engineer to join our Detection and Response team, bringing hands-on expertise in incident response, detection engineering, and SOAR development to help scale our security operations. The ideal candidate combines a defensive practitioner's mindset with deep knowledge of adversarial TTPs, driving continuous improvement across detections, automated workflows, and cross-team security partnerships. The Staff Security Engineer, Detection & Response delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.
  
  
**How Will You Drive Impact**
Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)
  
  
Provide technical input and direction on detection and response projects, including tasking, reviewing peer engineers' work, and mentoring team members to elevate the team's overall capability.
  
  
Partner with leadership and peers to gather requirements, priorities, and enhancement requests, translating them into data, tooling, and integration requirements that align with organizational goals.
  
  
Collaborate closely with engineering teams across the organization to continuously define use cases and requirements for enabling technologies including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, Intrusion Detection Systems, Secure Web Gateway, DNS security, System Hardening, Identity Management, and PKI.
  
  
Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)
  
  
Respond to security incidents and conduct thorough investigations, clearly articulating potential risks and remediation strategies to stakeholders at all levels to protect the platform and the fan experience.
  
  
Apply a usable security philosophy — ensuring that security controls and processes protect Fanatics' fans and data without disrupting the pace of innovation that drives the business.
  
  
Participate in an on-call rotation, monitoring the real-world performance of detections and automated workflows to ensure continuous coverage and rapid response.
  
  
Communicate findings, risks, and recommendations with exceptional clarity to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across internal and external audiences.
  
  
Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)
  
  
Design, develop, test, and continuously optimize detection rules and SOAR workflows using engineering best practices, enabling faster anomaly identification and more consistent incident response at scale.
  
  
Conduct proactive threat hunts and threat modeling exercises, drawing on attacker TTP insights to identify potential indicators of compromise and translate findings into actionable security controls.
  
  
Evaluate and operationalize AI-assisted security tooling to expand detection coverage, increase response speed, and scale the team's capabilities as Fanatics continues to grow.
  
  
Leverage detection-as-code methodologies and CI/CD tools (e.g. GitLab, GitHub) to manage and evolve the detection library in a disciplined, repeatable, and auditable manner.
  
  
Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)
  
  
Own the full lifecycle of detections, automated response workflows, playbooks, integrations, and scripts — including authoring and maintaining thorough documentation for each.
  
  
Contribute to process and technology improvement after each incident, ensuring the team learns, adapts, and raises its baseline after every event.
  
  
Analyze endpoint, network, and application logs for anomalous activity at enterprise scale, applying strong data analysis and correlation skills to surface meaningful signals from noise.
  
  
Operate effectively as an independent contributor within a highly distributed, multi-region SOC environment, demonstrating strong organizational skills, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize work in a fast-paced, rapidly changing setting.
  
  
AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY
  
  
We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:
  
  
Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
  
  
Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
  
  
Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
  
  
Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
**CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING**
8+ years of experience in technical information security roles with a focus on security monitoring, threat detection, and incident response, including hands-on incident response experience managing complex investigations with multiple stakeholders.
  
  
Advanced experience with enterprise SIEM platforms, including the design and development of detections, reports, and dashboards, combined with strong SOAR development skills and proven experience automating security response workflows at enterprise scale.
  
  
Deep working knowledge of adversary TTPs and demonstrated experience applying MITRE ATT&CK principles to detect and respond to security incidents, including use of penetration testing and ATT&CK framework tools to simulate adversarial behaviors.
  
  
Strong conceptual knowledge of OS internals and malware functionality — including persistence mechanisms — sufficient to author endpoint detections directly from raw telemetry.
  
  
Proficiency with scripting, REST APIs, query languages, and CI/CD tools (e.g. GitLab, GitHub) for automation, alert enrichment, detection development, and detection-as-code workflows.
  
  
Experience evaluating and operating AI-assisted security tooling, and familiarity with working in hybrid environments that include both on-premise and cloud-based systems.
  
  
Exceptional communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to objectively evaluate security risk and operate with a high degree of autonomy within a distributed, multi-region team.
  
  
*At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.*
**About Us**
*Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.*
**About The Team**

title: Senior Product Specialist - Deep Sector-7
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.
  
  
At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.
  
  
**Your Team's Impact**
Content & Technology Solutions (CTS) is the industry leading content delivery platform. Clients seamlessly access organized and connected content that is easily discoverable, explorable, and procured via the Open:FactSet Marketplace. Data is delivered via a variety of technologies and formats that meet the needs of our client's workflows. By enabling our clients to utilize their preferred choice of industry standard databases, programming languages, and data visualization tools, we empower them to focus on the core competencies needed to drive their business. The Strategic Business Unit has experienced a double-digit year-over-year growth rate. Our solutions portfolio includes Standard DataFeeds, Data Exploration, OnDemand (API), Views, Cornerstone, Benchmark Feeds, and the Open: FactSet Marketplace.
  
  
The CTS Product Management team is looking for a dynamic Senior Product Specialist to join our Deep Sector Team to contribute to the expansion of Deep Sector Feeds in FactSet Fundamentals. Deep Sector is an initiative where FactSet collects new content, improves existing collection efforts in fundamentals, as well as develops new reports and functionality across 9 sectors: Banks, Insurance, Real Estate, Power & Utilities, TMT, Metals & Mining, Oil & Gas, Specialty Finance and Healthcare.
  
  
In this role, you will be expected to gain a comprehensive understanding of CTS products and delivery technologies, to be a key contributor to defining and expanding the product packages available, and to enhance and add features that provide connectivity, scalability, and enhanced usability. You will work closely with a broadly distributed group of Content, Product, Strategy, Sales & Support, Engineering, and Quality Assurance.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Insights**
– Derives insights to support product bets
  
  

* Regularly gathers, Analyzes, and interprets feedback directly from clients and prospects to understand their problems and the gaps in our solutions and in the marketplace.
* Participates in product discovery. Proactively identifies the market and validates the opportunity to prove whether a solution is valuable, viable, feasible and usable before developing it.
* Contributes to defining the metrics that will measure product outcomes.

**Strategy**
– Identifies and articulates a path to achieve results
  
  

* Performs research and analysis that contributes to the product vision, strategic framework and roadmap.

**Execution**
– Delivers on product outcomes
  
  

* Serves as SME on the quality and nuances of the product. Knows the top issues and how to troubleshoot them. Serves as an internal resource to educate junior team members and support help desk on troubleshooting and best practices.
* Supports Product Managers by prioritizing issues that are critical to fix in order to improve the customer experience. Defines the problem space correctly and experiment with potential solutions before suggesting a specific fix.
* Adept at separating bugs from user error and stability issues. Escalates issues to Engineering appropriately.
* Assists to clearly define user needs and acceptance criteria with development teams. Helps to prioritize needs and provides clarity for iterating on solutions.
* Prioritizes the instrumentation and reporting of key product metrics.
* Is exposed to Agile principles and best practices.

**Leadership**
– Inspires cross-functional teams to achieve great outcomes
  
  

* Gives prompt and candid feedback to cross-functional team members.
* Coaches and mentors junior team members.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in B.Tech/MCA or BBA/MBA. A combination of tech and finance would be ideal, although not mandatory.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in product development, product strategy and roadmap
* Ability to troubleshoot client issues and solve them with a combination of creativity, analytical skills, and subject matter expertise.
* Understands how to leverage tools and frameworks for product management such as user personas, empathy mapping, and prioritization frameworks.
* Is product-oriented. Can take a stand to say “No” to stakeholders/engineering and starts by defining the problems, goals and needs, and does experimentation to uncover the best solution.
* Familiarity with query languages (e.g., SQL) and programming languages commonly utilized in the financial industry (e.g., Python, R).
* Knowledge of data sets and technology solutions commonly utilized in the financial industry is a plus.

Knowledge of data and technology workflows and end users common in the financial industry is a plus.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:
  
  

* The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
* Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.

**Learn More About Our Benefits Here.**
Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.
  
  
**Company Overview**
FactSet (NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn.
  
  
At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

title: Senior Product Specialist
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Applied AI Senior Product Specialist
  
  
An Applied AI Senior Product Specialist is a mid-level individual contributor responsible for ensuring a product’s value and viability within a product line. This role involves leading empowered, cross-function al product teams to solve customer problems that align with business needs. Being a mid-level product management role, you will have the opportunity to own products of lesser complexity that drive business value. The Applied AI Senior Product Specialist, like any of our product managers, is accountable for the product’s success, from vision to execution, and collaborates closely with various functions and stakeholders to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. This role harnesses AI and agentic tools to compress the concept-to-cas h learning loop—automatin g analysis, prototyping, and compliance detail-work so the team can focus on the human judgment AI cannot replace: product sense-making.
  
  
The Applied AI Senior Product Specialist plays a crucial role in ensuring the success of our less complex yet valuable products by balancing customer needs with business objectives. This role requires a blend of strategic vision, analytical skills, and collaborative teamwork to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. It demands some experience in the modern product management craft and a drive for continuous improvement—am plified by the fluent, responsible use of AI to learn faster and earn faster.
  
  
Work you’ll do
  
  

* Product Accountability
* Responsible and accountable for the product's value and viability showcasing a measurable Return on Investments (ROI)
* Drive strategy-align ed solutions to achieve product value objectives.
* Formulate and achieve Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for identified problems to solve.
* Measure KPIs and analyze outcomes to inform future strategies.
* Leverage AI to harvest outcome evidence early and often, lowering total cost of ownership (TCO).
* Vision and Strategy
* Co-create, own, and evangelize the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, using AI to deepen domain knowledge and simulate future scenarios to chart pathways others have not yet seen.
* Align product objectives with the product line and business goals.
* Co-create in collaboration with business stakeholders, engineering, experience, and delivery.
* Market and User Engagement
* Conduct user research and competitive analysis, using AI agents to synthesize research at speed—accelera ting the data crunching, ensuring the human connection.

title: Manager - Strategy
description:
**The Role :**

At Recykal, strategy is not a support function. It is a growth engine. As part of the Strategy team, you will work alongside business leaders to shape high impact decisions that influence growth, profitability and long term market positioning. You will be embedded within a business unit cluster, working as a strategic partner who turns ambiguity into action.

**CORE MANDATE:**

* Own annual strategic planning for the assigned business unit cluster — market sizing, competitive landscaping, and opportunity assessment.
* Translate strategic plans into actionable roadmaps with clear milestones, resource requirements, and success metrics.
* Lead strategic projects spanning product launches, pricing strategy, and market expansion.
* Act as the strategic bridge between business units and central leadership, aligning priorities across teams.
* Define leading and lagging indicators for strategic health and build dashboards that surface the right signals.
* Prepare executive presentations and board-level materials that drive decision-making at the top.

**EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:**

* 4–8 years in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, or business development
* Strong analytical and financial modelling capabilities; comfortable building models from scratch
* Experience solving complex, end-to-end strategic business problems with measurable impact
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint for modelling, analysis, and executive storytelling
* Familiarity with data visualization and BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a strong plus
* MBA / equivalent postgraduate degree preferred; strong academic foundation in business or economics

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**A. BU STRATEGY & ANNUAL PLANNING**

* Own annual strategic planning; conduct market sizing, competitive landscaping and opportunity assessments
* Translate strategic plans into actionable roadmaps with milestones and success metrics
* Work with BU heads to define strategic priorities for the year ahead
* Monitor strategy execution, track KPIs, and flag early-warning signals

**B. COMMERCIAL & GROWTH INITIATIVES**

* Lead strategic projects — product launches, pricing strategy, market expansion
* Build robust financial models and business cases for new opportunities
* Identify white spaces and adjacencies for growth
* Partner with Sales, Product and Operations to convert strategy into measurable outcomes

**C. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP**

* Act as the strategic bridge between business units and central leadership
* Collaborate with Finance, Product and Operations on cross-functional initiatives
* Influence decision-making without direct authority
* Build trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels

**D. PERFORMANCE & INSIGHTS**

* Define leading and lagging indicators for strategic health; build dashboards for leadership
* Develop competitive intelligence frameworks to track market dynamics and benchmark Recykal's position

**E. EXECUTIVE COMMUNICATION & STORYTELLING**

* Prepare crisp, well-structured executive presentations and board-level materials
* Synthesize complex data into clear, decision-ready recommendations
* Communicate decisions and strategic context in a way that builds confidence and clarity

**WHY THIS ROLE?**

* Embedded strategic partner shaping high-impact decisions for a business unit cluster
* Direct exposure to BU heads, central leadership, and investors
* Own strategy end to end — from market sizing to boardroom storytelling
* Equal parts analyst and communicator — build the models and deliver the narrative

title: Fixed Income Testing Analyst
description:
**Job Description: Fixed Income Testing Analyst**

Relevant Experience: 3 - 7 years

Location: Hyderabad, India

Shift: UK Shift

NP – Immediate/ Not more than 30/ Buy outs

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a Fixed Income Testing Analyst with strong knowledge of fixed income

products, investment analytics, and data validation. The role will support testing, analysis,

and validation of fixed income data, risk measures, performance calculations, and portfolio

analytics within investment management platforms. The ideal candidate will possess strong

analytical skills, experience with investigating data discrepancies, and an understanding of

fixed income instruments, performance attribution, performance and risk analytics.

**Key Responsibilities**

 Design, execute, and maintain functional, integration, regression, and data-validation test

scenarios for fixed income investment management platforms.

 Validate fixed income data, portfolio attributes, returns, benchmarks, attribution outputs,

risk metrics, and reporting results.

 Test and validate bonds, structured products, swaps, and fixed income derivatives,

including pricing, cash flows, accrued interest, duration, convexity, yield, spread, and

sensitivity measures.

 Analyze fixed income risk, attribution, and analytics outputs to ensure accuracy and

completeness.

 Investigate data discrepancies, calculation issues, and testing exceptions through root

cause analysis and defect resolution.

 Perform data quality reviews and collaborate with Performance Management, Fund

Operations, Technology, and Data teams to resolve issues.

 Support user acceptance testing (UAT), release validation, production checks, and issue

triage activities.

 Prepare test plans, test cases, defect reports, execution summaries, and supporting

documentation.

 Communicate testing progress, risks, findings, and recommendations to business and

technology stakeholders.

**Required Skills and Experience**

 3–5 years of relevant hands-on experience in fixed income analytics, performance

measurement, testing, and reporting.

 Business analysis and platform-testing experience within investment management.

Experience validating calculation engines, market and reference data, security-level and

portfolio-level results, and upstream/downstream interfaces is highly desirable.

Proficiency in SQL, Excel, Agile delivery, requirements traceability, UAT, regression

testing, reconciliation and defect management is preferred.

 Strong understanding of return calculations, performance attribution, benchmarks, risk

measures, and portfolio reporting.

 Strong understanding of fixed income products including government bonds, corporate

bonds, agency securities, structured products, swaps, futures, options, and other fixed

income derivatives.

 Experience testing investment-performance or fund-operations applications, data flows,

calculations, and reports.

 Expertise in one or more leading performance measurement platforms.

 Strong analytical, reconciliation, problem-solving, documentation, and stakeholder-

management skills.

 Ability to interpret business requirements and translate them into comprehensive test

scenarios and expected results.

**Preferred Experience**

 Fixed Income Attribution

 Fixed Income Risk Analytics

 Performance Measurement

 Investment Analytics

 Portfolio Analytics

 Data Quality Validation

 Reconciliation & Exception Analysis

 Investment Management Platforms (Aladdin, FactSet, Eagle, SimCorp, etc.)

**Preferred Qualifications**

 Experience with Aladdin is preferred but not required. Candidates with strong fixed

income analytics, attribution, risk, or performance measurement experience on other

investment platforms will also be considered.

 Familiarity with SQL, data-query tools, test-management tools, and defect-tracking

platforms.

 Knowledge of fund accounting, portfolio accounting, market data, and investment

operations.

 Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science,

or a related discipline; relevant investment or testing certifications are advantageous.
