title: Senior Specialist, Data Platform Engineering
description:
Your opportunity
  
  
At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
  
  
Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region .
  
  
What you have
  
  
The SAM Data Technology team builds and enhances cloud native data pipelines and data platform capabilities that support Schwab Asset Management’s analytical, operational, and regulatory data needs. As a Sr. Specialist (Level 56), you will take on expanded ownership of data pipeline design, cloud data engineering patterns, and the development of scalable data solutions across Snowflake and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  
  
Engineers at this level operate with greater independence, take lead roles in technical problem solving, and contribute to shaping best practices for data engineering within SAMDA.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design & Build Investment Data Pipelines
* Design, develop, and optimize investment data pipelines using ETL/ELT patterns.
* Integrate data from custodians, vendors, and internal platforms into curated datasets.
* Build reliable workflows using GCS, Dataproc, Cloud Dataflow, Composer (Airflow), and Pub/Sub.
* Implement scalable transformations in Snowflake and other cloud data warehouses.
* Investment Data Modeling
* Contribute to portfolio, transaction, pricing, and performance data models aligned to investment use cases.
* Apply Kimball/star schema patterns and domain driven modeling for analytics and reporting.
* Optimize schemas for API consumption, dashboards, and quantitative analysis.
* Data APIs for Investment Use Cases (Full Stack)
* Design and implement Investment Data APIs using Python
* Expose curated investment datasets (holdings, performance, risk metrics) via secure REST endpoints.
* Enable programmatic access for portfolio managers, analysts, and downstream applications.
* Apply authentication, authorization, and data entitlement controls consistent with regulated investment data.
* Python Dashboards & Investment Analytics UI
* Build Python based dashboards and UI applications (Streamlit, Dash, Panel).
* Create interactive visualizations for portfolio views, performance trends, and risk insights using Plotly, Matplotlib, and Seaborn.
* Translate complex investment datasets into intuitive, self service analytical experiences.
* Optimize dashboard performance for large portfolios and time series data.
* Advanced Cloud & Application Engineering
* Build data and application services using Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, and Cloud SQL.
* Apply distributed processing frameworks (Apache Spark, Beam, Flink) for large scale investment datasets.
* Package and deploy APIs and dashboards using Docker.
* DevOps, CI/CD & Automation
* Own CI/CD pipelines for data pipelines, investment data APIs, and Python UI applications.
* Use Git/Bitbucket/Bamboo, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Maven, Nexus for build and release automation.
* Data Quality, Controls & Reliability (Investments)
* Implement data quality checks specific to investment data (reconciliation, completeness, timeliness).
* Monitor pipelines, APIs, and dashboards to ensure reliable delivery of investment insights. Troubleshoot complex data issues impacting portfolio, performance, or risk reporting.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
* 3–5 years of experience building cloud based investment or financial data platforms.
* Hands on experience with Snowflake and GCP services (GCS, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Composer, Cloud SQL).
* Strong Python skills for data engineering, API development, and visualization.
* Experience building REST APIs using FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks.
* Experience building Python dashboards/UI (Streamlit, Dash, Panel).
* Experience with distributed processing frameworks (Spark, Beam, or Flink).
* Proficiency with CI/CD, Docker, and IaC (Terraform or GCP Deployment Manager).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with investment management data (portfolios, performance, risk, pricing).
* Familiarity with custodians, portfolio accounting, or market data vendors.
* Knowledge of data governance, entitlements, and controls in regulated investment environments.
* Ability to lead cross functional investment data initiatives.
* Strong documentation and communication skills.

What’s in it for you
  
  
At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security.
  
  
**Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include**

* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more
* Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage
* Annual reimbursement for health check-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
* Transportation and meal benefits that support your day-to-day work
* Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance

title: Financial Reporting Specialist
description:
**Hiring: Manager – Financial Consolidation**

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Function:**
Finance & Accounts | Record-to-Report (R2R)

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced finance professional to manage financial consolidation, consolidated financial statement preparation, financial reporting, and statutory compliance for a large, diversified organization with multiple subsidiaries and joint ventures.

The role involves coordinating with finance teams, auditors, and internal stakeholders to ensure accurate and timely financial reporting, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement of consolidation processes.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Financial Consolidation & Reporting**

* Coordinate the preparation and review of Consolidated Financial Statements (CFS) for group entities and intermediate holding companies.
* Review standalone financial statements and ensure the accuracy and consistency of consolidated financial data.
* Perform intercompany reconciliations, related-party transaction (RPT) verification, and elimination entries.
* Account for the share of profit or loss from joint ventures and associates.
* Monitor general ledger (GL) groupings, entity relationships, and financial data within consolidation systems.
* Prepare monthly MIS, quarterly consolidated forecasts, and Annual Operating Plan (AOP) reports.
* Review financial dashboards, management presentations, and published financial information.

**2. Financial Closing & Compliance**

* Develop and monitor monthly and quarterly financial closing schedules to ensure timely completion.
* Identify consolidation discrepancies, investigate variances, and coordinate corrective actions with respective entities.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Ind AS, Companies Act requirements, SEBI LODR regulations, and relevant financial reporting standards.
* Support statutory and internal audits, including the preparation of audit schedules, documentation, and responses to auditor queries.
* Coordinate the preparation of financial analysis, variance reports, and Audit Committee presentations.

**3. Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate with subsidiary finance teams, business finance, statutory auditors, and other internal stakeholders.
* Resolve consolidation-related queries and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Monitor reporting timelines and escalate delays or significant discrepancies to management.

**4. Process Improvement & Team Management**

* Identify opportunities to automate and improve financial consolidation processes, accuracy, and turnaround time.
* Drive standardization of reporting processes and implementation of regulatory changes.
* Allocate responsibilities, coordinate daily activities, and guide team members in preparing consolidated financial statements and supporting schedules.

**Candidate Profile**

* **Qualification:**
  Chartered Accountant (CA).
* **Experience:**
  8–11 years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts, financial consolidation, and reporting within a large organization.
* Strong understanding of Ind AS, consolidated financial statements, accounting standards, and financial closing processes.
* Hands-on exposure to SAP and BPC or equivalent financial consolidation tools.
* Experience in managing intercompany transactions, eliminations, joint ventures, associates, and statutory audits.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate teams, manage reporting deadlines, and drive process improvements.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

**Preferred Industry Exposure:**
Infrastructure or other large, diversified organizations with multiple subsidiaries and joint ventures.

**Interested candidates**
with relevant experience in financial consolidation and group reporting are encouraged to apply.

Regards,

Deepak - 98676 96869

description:

Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
  
  
The User Access Manager is a senior individual contributor and people leader responsible for the day-to-day operation, health, and continuous improvement of alterDomus' Identity and Access Management capabilities. This role sits at the intersection of operational excellence and strategic enablement, ensuring that the right people have the right access to the right resources — nothing more, nothing less.
  
  
Leading a team of 10 professionals — 1 Team Lead, 3 Shift Leads and 6 Access Management Analysts — the User Access Manager will own BAU delivery across the three IAM pillars: Identity Governance (SailPoint IdentityNow), Customer Identity (Okta / Auth0), and Privileged Access (CyberArk PAM, EPM & WPM). The role operates within alterDomus' broader Cyber Resiliency Programme and reports directly to the CISO or Deputy CISO.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
Team Leadership & BAU Delivery
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 10 professionals — comprising 1 Team Lead, 3 Shift Leads and 6 Access Management Analysts — across the three platform domains.
* Own the BAU service model: incident triage, access request fulfilment, certification campaigns, and recertification reviews; maintaining 24×5 operational coverage.
* Define team SLAs, OKRs, and operational KPIs; produce regular MI for CISO and governance forums.
* Manage on-call rotation and escalation paths to ensure 24/7 operational cover where required.

Identity Governance & Administration — SailPoint IdentityNow / Identity Security Cloud
  
  

* Serve as the functional owner of the SailPoint IDN/ISC platform across all production, UAT, and sandbox environments.
* Drive lifecycle management processes: joiner/mover/leaver, access request, approval workflows, and role-based access control (RBAC).
* Maintain and extend source/target connectors (Salesforce, Active Directory, ServiceNow, cloud SaaS).
* Lead Separation of Duties (SoD) policy enforcement, access certification design, and audit evidence generation.

Customer Identity & Access Management — Okta / Auth0
  
  

* Own the CIAM platform landscape, covering both Okta Workforce Identity and Auth0 Customer Identity tenants.
* Govern MFA policies, adaptive authentication, SSO federation (SAML/OIDC), and B2B/B2C user journeys.
* Partner with application teams to onboard new integrations, enforce secure token flows, and maintain API security standards.
* Monitor and respond to anomalous authentication events; drive threat model reviews of identity attack surfaces.

Privileged Access Management — CyberArk PAM, EPM & WPM
  
  

* Manage the operational lifecycle of privileged accounts across the enterprise, including service accounts, admin credentials, and secrets.
* Maintain CyberArk vault health, session recording policy, and just-in-time (JIT) provisioning workflows in PAM and WPM.
* Administer CyberArk Endpoint Privilege Manager (EPM): manage application control policies, least-privilege enforcement on endpoints, and threat protection coverage.
* Enforce least-privilege principles through regular privilege entitlement reviews and attestation cycles.
* Support red-team and penetration-testing activities by providing PAM architecture context and remediation ownership.

Risk, Compliance & Audit
  
  

* Act as the primary IAM subject matter expert (SME) for internal audits, external assessments, and regulatory reviews (DORA, GDPR, SOX, ISO 27001).
* Maintain an IAM risk register; track and remediate control deficiencies to agreed timelines.

title: Analyst or Senior Analyst – Detailed Design (Civil) Engineering
description:
**About DESRI**
DESRI (formerly D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments) is a market-leading owner and operator of renewable energy projects throughout the United States. We have acquired or developed approximately 13 gigawatts of contracted capacity across a portfolio of over 85 renewable energy projects in 24 states.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a resourceful candidate to join the India office of DESRI, i.e., DESRI India Private Limited, based in Hyderabad, India. The candidate will be a part of Design and Engineering team and will regularly interact with the U.S. and Hyderabad-based teams, as well as external parties. The candidate will be a part of a small, inclusive, highly skilled team responsible for supporting DESRI’s portfolio of wind, solar, and storage projects within a dynamic environment that values collaboration, thoughtful problem solving, and attention to detail.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Lead or support civil detailed design for utility-scale PV projects from concept to Issue for Construction (IFC), ensuring designs are accurate, constructible, and cost-effective. Develop and refine site layouts, grading, and drainage using AutoCAD Civil 3D; evaluate tracker slope tolerances, spacing, shading/obstructions, and constructability. Perform mass-grading/cut-fill analyses and optimize earthwork balance; plan access roads, internal circulation, laydown areas, and substation/collector pads. Execute hydrologic and stormwater analyses (flood, erosion, inundation), and propose mitigation (e.g., channels, culverts, energy dissipation, erosion control). Consolidate topographic, geotechnical, environmental, and civil datasets to drive layout iterations; run multiple optimizations passes and clearly summarize trade-offs. Coordinate closely with Geotech, Electrical, Structural, GIS, and Project Management teams to ensure integrated designs and smooth handoffs to EPC partners.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* A Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Civil Engineering with 2-6 years or a Master of Technology (M.Tech) in Civil or related specialization with 1-3 years of relevant experience in large-scale solar, renewable, or land-development projects.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD Civil 3D and GIS (ArcGIS/QGIS); comfortable working with large site datasets (DEM/LiDAR, surfaces, survey, environmental constraints).
* Working knowledge of grading, drainage, erosion control, access road design, and tracker-driven layout constraints for utility-scale PV.
* Ability to run iterative design optimizations and communicate conclusions via well-organized drawings and design summaries. Preferred experience with hydrology/stormwater tools (e.g., HEC-RAS, HydroCAD, Civil Storm) and layout production tools (PVcase/PV Farm).
* Familiarity with U.S. codes/standards and permitting practices (e.g., OSHA/EPA guidance; knowledge of ASTM/NEC interfaces during civil-electrical coordination). Familiarity with study/data retrieval from public data sources and preparing constraint analysis plans, buildable area analysis, and area summations. Familiarity or experience with utilizing artificial intelligence to create efficient workflows or applications. Exposure to construction means/methods, field commissioning, and value-engineering for cost and schedule optimization.

* Confident, approachable leader with strong client‑facing presence.
* Demonstrates leadership through coordination, clarity, and proactive communication.
* Encourages teams to develop integrated, constructible, and high‑quality mechanical design solutions.
* Organised, disciplined, and able to resolve complex mechanical issues in a timely manner.
* Champions a strong culture of safety, quality, and innovation.
* Flexible, dependable, and capable of performing in fast‑paced, contractor‑integrated environments.

**Work Experience**

* 15+ years of experience in mechanical engineering design and design management within water/wastewater infrastructure projects.

* Proven leadership of multidisciplinary teams delivering mechanical design for

+ Water/wastewater pump stations
+ WTPs/WWTPs and associated process units
+ Chemical dosing systems
+ Sludge handling systems
+ High‑lift/low‑lift pumping systems
+ Treatment mechanical equipment (screens, clarifiers, blowers, compressors, valves, etc.)

* Strong understanding of pumping systems NPSH, system curves, pump selection, surge analysis interface, pipework design, and hydraulic analysis.
* Demonstrated capability in Design for Design‑Build constructability reviews, contractor interface, installation sequencing, technical risk mitigation.
* Experience coordinating mechanical design within a BIM‑enabled environment.

* Experience with vendor coordination, MTO/BoQ preparation, equipment procurement support, and technical bid evaluations.
* Experience with change management, design risk management, and impacts assessment.
* Ability to support bids, proposals, LOE estimates, and multidisciplinary design execution plans.
* Experience with alternate delivery models (DB, EPC, CMAR, PPP) is an asset.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical (or related discipline)
* Master’s degree in relevant field is advantageous

**Preferred Attributes**

* Exposure to brownfield upgrades, shutdown/staging, and commissioning planning.

About the Team

We are an early-stage engineering team building high-bandwidth, low-power interconnect for next-

generation compute and datacenter systems, spanning die-to-die links and 224G-class electrical SerDes.

We are looking for an experienced analog/mixed-signal designer to take ownership of key circuits in our

PHYs and help carry them from architecture through silicon. This is a small, hands-on team: you will own

your blocks end to end, from specification and design through layout, tapeout, and lab bring-up, and

have a direct say in architecture and product decisions.

What You'll Be Doing

• Own the design of one or more high-speed analog/mixed-signal blocks for our SerDes PHYs,

from specification and architecture through schematic design, simulation, and post-layout sign-

off.

• Contribute across the PHY, including transmitter (serializer, driver, DAC-based TX, FFE), receiver

(CTLE, DFE, samplers, ADC-based front end), clocking (PLL/DLL, phase interpolator, duty-cycle

correction, CDR or forwarded clock), and supporting circuits (termination, deskew, bias,

references).

• Derive block-level specifications and budgets for jitter, noise, linearity, power, and area from

link-level requirements, working closely with the architecture team.

• Verify designs across PVT corners, Monte Carlo, and extracted parasitics, including EM/IR and

reliability checks.

• Guide layout engineers on floorplanning, matching, and critical routing.

• Partner with SI/package, DSP, digital, and verification teams on calibration, link training, and

adaptation, and provide behavioral models for system-level simulation.

• Support silicon bring-up, lab characterization, and debug.

• Lead design reviews and mentor junior engineers.

What We Need to See

• MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering (or equivalent) and 8+ years in analog/mixed-signal IC

design.

• High-speed SerDes or I/O circuits taken to production silicon in advanced FinFET nodes.

• Strong fundamentals in noise, jitter, equalization, and clocking.

• Hands-on with Synopsys or Cadence custom IC design and simulation flows, including post-

layout simulation.

• Clear communicator across architecture, digital, and package teams.

• Comfortable owning your blocks end to end in a small team, lab work included.Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd

• Experience with 112G/224G PAM4 SerDes, including ADC/DSP-based receivers or DAC-based

transmitters.

• Experience with die-to-die interconnect standards such as UCIe.

• Familiarity with advanced packaging and package/interposer signal integrity.

• Experience with calibration and adaptation loops and mixed-signal co-design.

• Python, SKILL, or similar scripting to automate simulation, regression, and data analysis,

including AI/LLM-based agents applied to design workflows.

• Hands-on silicon bring-up and lab characterization experience.

**Job Title:**
Senior Process Executive - Clinical Specialist
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India
  
  
**Business Unit:**
Revenue Cycle Management
  
  
****Role Summary:****
The Clinical Specialist serves as a bridge between clinical documentation and revenue cycle operations, ensuring accurate medical record review, coding support, charge capture validation, payer compliance, and denial prevention. This role collaborates with healthcare providers, coders, billing teams, and payers to optimize reimbursement while maintaining compliance with US healthcare regulations and payer guidelines.
  
  
The position requires strong communication skills, analytical abilities, and knowledge of revenue cycle management (RCM) to resolve claim issues, reduce outstanding AR, and improve cash flow. Additionally, the Senior Process Executive will mentor junior associates and contribute to process improvements.

**Clinical Documentation Review**

* Review medical records to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with payer requirements.
* Identify documentation gaps that may impact coding accuracy and reimbursement.
* Support Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI) initiatives.
* Educate providers on documentation best practices.

**Revenue Cycle Support**

* Analyze claims for documentation-related denials and underpayments.
* Assist in resolving clinical denials, medical necessity denials, and authorization-related denials.
* Review appeals and prepare supporting clinical documentation.
* Ensure accurate charge capture and reimbursement optimization.

**Coding & Compliance Collaboration**

* Work closely with medical coders to ensure accurate ICD-10-CM, CPT, and HCPCS coding.
* Validate medical necessity requirements based on payer policies.
* Monitor compliance with CMS, Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payer regulations.
* Support internal and external audits.

**Denial Management**

* Investigate denied claims and identify root causes.
* Prepare clinical appeal letters and supporting documentation.
* Track denial trends and recommend corrective actions.
* Collaborate with AR and billing teams to reduce denial rates.

****Required Skills:****
**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Nursing, Life Sciences, Healthcare Administration, Pharmacy, or related healthcare field.
* RN (Registered Nurse), BPT, B.Pharm, M.Pharm, or equivalent clinical qualification preferred.

****Experience****

* 2–5+ years of experience in US Healthcare RCM, Clinical Documentation Review, CDI, Utilization Management, or Denial Management.
* Experience working with Medicare, Medicaid, and Commercial Insurance payers.
* Knowledge of medical necessity guidelines and payer policies.

**Technical Knowledge**
**Candidate Should Have An Understanding Of:**

* ICD-10-CM
* CPT/HCPCS coding fundamentals
* Medical terminology
* Anatomy and physiology
* CMS guidelines
* Revenue Cycle Management processes
* EMR/EHR systems

****Preferred Certifications****

* Certified Clinical Documentation Specialist (CCDS)
* Certified Documentation Improvement Practitioner (CDIP)
* CPC, CCS, or CRC certification

description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Job Summary
  
  
This role is for an "Outcome Architect" rather than a traditional coder. This role sits at the intersection of robust Software Architecture and high-velocity, AI-augmented development ("Vibe Coding"). Instead of writing manual line-by-line code, you will leverage LLMs and AI tools (like Cursor and Copilot) to rapidly architect, prototype, and deploy the internal tools, automated labs, and environments used by our Global Sales Engineering (SE) teams to demonstrate the CyberArk Identity Security platform.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Outcome-Driven Architecture: Design structurally sound, modular, and scalable internal products, POC toolkits, and field utilities.
* Rapid AI Delivery: Use AI agents and LLMs to move from concept to field-ready tools at record speed, focusing heavily on logic, security, and system flow.
* Full-Stack Ownership: Build and maintain global field operations tools, APIs, and interfaces using whichever language or technical approach best fits the problem.
* Cloud & Identity Automation: Architect automated, friction-free "lab-on-demand" solutions allowing SEs to deploy complex Identity Security scenarios (PAM, Secrets Management).
* Technical Bridge: Act as the technical expert for the Sales Engineering team, translating vague field requirements into functional technical assets.

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* Strong foundation in software engineering with 5+ years of experience , system design, data flow, and building resilient, secure systems.
* Expert at utilizing AI interfaces (Cursor, Copilot, LLMs) as a primary development environment to write, debug, and refactor.
* Problem solver who can easily pick up or generate the required code (Python, JS, C#, etc.) to hit the architectural goal.
* Hands-on experience designing and deploying within AWS or Azure ecosystems.
* Skilled at automating infrastructure and workflows to create seamless internal experiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Sales Engineering, DevSecOps, or Infrastructure/Tools roles.
* Deep understanding of Identity Security, Zero Trust, or Secrets Management.
* A strong curiosity about the future of autonomous AI development agents.

**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
  
  
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Artist & Content Creator
description:
Fellow Yellow Design Studio | Hyderabad | Full-time, in-studio

Fellow Yellow is an architecture and interior design studio in Hyderabad. We build culturally rooted storytelling spaces: restaurants, bars, cafés, showrooms, homes and public places that carry something of where they are and who they’re for. Grounded Imagination is how we describe it. Ideas that come from somewhere real, built with care.

This year the work has travelled a little further than the sites it sits on. We were part of TAD 50 and selected for GoodHomes Design Discoveries 2026. We’re now looking for someone to help us tell these stories properly, from the first sketch to the last photograph.

**The role**

We’re looking for an artist first. Someone who draws, composes, sees. Then a content creator who can take that eye onto site and into a reel. Then a brand designer who keeps everything we put out looking like us.

You’d live inside the projects and bring the story out. Not a marketing seat at the far end of the office, but part of the project room, working alongside the founders and the architects as spaces take shape.

**What you’d be doing**

* Joining site visits and capturing the process as it unfolds: materials arriving, craftspeople at work, the quiet moments between drawings and reality
* Planning final shoots with photographers and vendors, and shaping how each project is presented to the world
* Creating reels, photo sets, illustrations and posts, and looking after our Instagram and LinkedIn from planning through to publishing and conversation
* Designing the decks, case studies and presentation boards we share with clients
* Keeping the brand system consistent and improving our templates as we grow

**Who we hope you are**

* An artist at heart. You sketch, illustrate, photograph or make things, and it shows in how you compose a frame or lay out a page
* Fluent in social media. You know what works on Instagram right now, what a good reel looks like, and why some accounts grow and others don’t
* An eye for detail. Alignment, spacing, colour, a caption with one word too many. You notice, and you fix it
* Quick. Site content needs to go out while it’s fresh, and client decks don’t wait
* Fresher or a few years in, it doesn’t matter much. What you can make matters more than how long you’ve been making it
* At home in Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign and Canva, with Premiere or CapCut for reels
* Drawn to architecture, interiors and craft. You notice how a space feels, not just how it looks
* Easy to work with. You’ll be coordinating with architects, site teams, vendors and photographers, sometimes all in a day
* A writer with a voice of your own, warm and unhurried

**Nice to have**

* Your own photography or video skills
* Some motion graphics
* An architecture, fine arts, design or visual communication background

**Life at the studio**

* You’re in the room where the projects happen, from concept to handover
* The founders are directly reachable. We’re a small team and we like it that way
* Every post you make is a real place you watched come to life

**Hiring process**

1. Portfolio review
2. A short phone interview
3. A one-hour online test
4. Offer

**How to apply**

Apply here on LinkedIn with your portfolio link and any page you’ve run. Portfolio first, CV second. Sketchbooks, personal work and student projects all count. No cover letter needed. We’ll reply to everyone we shortlist.

title: Robotics Educator
description:
**Who We Are:**

An Ed-Tech startup based in Hyderabad and operational in multiple states providing learning outcomes focused curriculum and software solutions to private schools.

At EkaLavya, we believe Robotics is not about assembling kits. It is about nurturing problem-solvers, creators, innovators, and future entrepreneurs. As we expand across 30–40 partner schools this academic year, we are looking for passionate educators who can inspire students from Grade I to Grade IX through Robotics, Coding, and hands-on project-based learning.

**POSITION: ROBOTICS EDUCATOR / STEM INNOVATION MENTOR**

**Location:**
Multiple schools across assigned regions in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Compensation:**
Mentioned at the end of the Job description

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**
You will not be a traditional teacher. You will act as a mentor who helps students:

1. Build and program robots

2. Solve real-world problems through projects

3. Think like engineers and innovators

4. Develop creativity, teamwork, and presentation skills

5. Participate in inter-school Robotics Innovation Challenges

You will be responsible for delivering Robotics curriculum, conducting lab sessions, mentoring projects, assessing learning outcomes, and continuously improving the program through school-level feedback to leadership and content team

**SELECTION AND CERTIFICATION JOURNEY**

At EkaLavya, student learning outcomes are our highest priority. Since Robotics education requires a combination of technical understanding, classroom delivery skills, activity management, and student engagement, we follow a structured selection process.

The selection journey includes:

**1. Interview and Practical Assessment**

Candidates who successfully clear the interview and practical teaching assessment will receive a
**conditional offer for the Robotics Educator role.**

**2. Robotics Faculty Induction and Certification**

Before independent classroom deployment, selected candidates must successfully complete a
**structured induction and certification program**
(typically 3-7 days in hybrid mode).

The
**certification process**
will include:

* EkaLavya teaching philosophy and pedagogy
* Robotics curriculum orientation
* Grade-wise learning journey
* Robotics kit handling
* Project execution
* Lab activities
* Classroom management
* Student engagement techniques
* Practice teaching sessions

**3. Classroom Readiness and Final Appointment**

After successful completion of training and certification, appointment confirmation will be made based on:

* Technical capability
* Teaching demonstration
* Student-centric classroom approach
* Feedback from internal mentors
* Feedback from school stakeholders
* Performance during live classroom sessions

As Robotics is not a regular school subject and requires a different learning curve, we do not permanently deploy faculty members without observing their classroom readiness.

Every educator will receive continuous support, mentoring, and need-based training interventions.

**Performance will be reviewed**
during the
**initial 1-6 month period**
through multiple feedback loops to ensure success for both the educator and students

**DESIRED CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* **Preferred**
  - Diploma in Robotics, Electronics, Computer Science, AI, IoT, Automation or related fields
* Fresh graduates
  **passionate about STEM education**
  and willing to undergo intensive training
* Experienced Robotics Trainers, STEM Educators, Makerspace Facilitators
* **FRESHERS ARE WELCOME**
  - We strongly encourage applications from: Final-year students, Recent graduates, Robotics enthusiasts, Makers, Tinkerers, DIY innovators. If you are willing to learn, build, experiment, and inspire young minds, we will help you grow into an exceptional STEM educator.
* Professionals exploring a
  **career transition**
  into education
* Individuals looking to
  **restart their professional journey**
  after a career break
* Experienced professionals who have a passion for mentoring and shaping young minds

At EkaLavya, we believe great educators are created through a combination of knowledge, curiosity, patience, empathy, and the willingness to learn continuously. You do not need to come with a traditional teaching background. If you are passionate about learning, building, experimenting, and inspiring young minds, we will support your journey to become an exceptional STEM educator.

We especially value professionals who bring maturity, life experience, and the ability to create a positive classroom culture while helping students develop technical skills, confidence, creativity, and a problem-solving mindset.

Whether you are beginning your career, restarting after a gap, or bringing decades of experience if you have the passion to contribute to education and the curiosity to learn Robotics and new-age technologies, we welcome you to apply.

**GROWTH AND CROSS-FUNCTIONAL OPPORTUNITIES**

At EkaLavya, we believe professionals grow by continuously learning and contributing. Based on business requirements, individual aspirations, and skill development opportunities, team members may receive exposure beyond their core role.

Faculty members may also contribute to
**cross-functional initiatives**
based on their inclination, such as:

* Sales support
* Social media
* Content/design support
* Operations
* Marketing initiatives
* Other strategic projects

title: Lead Systems Operations Engineer
description:
**About This Role**
Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Systems Operations Engineer.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Lead complex, broad impact initiatives including provision of high level systems consultation for the technology teams
* Work as key participant in large scale planning of computer systems and network infrastructure for Systems Operations functional area
* Review and analyze complex technical challenges, as well as escalated support issues related to core business solutions that require in depth evaluation of multiple factors, such as alternatives, enhancements, periodic systems reviews, or improvements to existing systems
* Make decisions on technical changes and enhancements
* Consult with engineering team on change design requiring solid understanding of technical process controls or standards that influence and drive new initiatives
* Collaborate and consult with technical peers, colleagues, and mid to more experienced level managers to resolve systems support issues and achieve goals

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of Systems Engineering, Technology Architecture experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experienced in monitoring, automation, and cloud platforms, with a proven track record of designing and supporting highly scalable, reliable, and secure API ecosystems.

**Job Expectations**

* Platform Operations & Daily Support: Lead daily support operations for Apigee OPDK, Apigee Hybrid,to ensure platform uptime, stability, and performance.
* Manage and maintain core Apigee components such as Routers, Message Processors, MART, Synchronizer, UDCA, Postgres, Zookeeper, Cassandra, and runtime infrastructure.
* Lead operational activities for IBM DataPower, including domain management, cryptographic objects, firmware upgrades, service configuration, and cluster maintenance.
* Incident Management & RCA: Own and resolve P1/P2 high-severity incidents with quick response and deep technical troubleshooting.
* Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA), document post-incident reports, and drive permanent corrective actions.
* Lead communication handling during major incidents and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
* Support Process Management: Oversee ticket lifecycle management, SLA adherence, and escalation handling across support tiers.
* Act as the primary technical liaison between Support, Engineering, Cloud, Network, Security, and Architecture teams.
* Deployment & Release Support: Support API proxy deployments, shared flows, developer portal configurations, and runtime troubleshooting.
* Debug policy-level issues (JavaCallout, JS, Python, OAuth, JWT, KVM, Target Server configs, mTLS, etc.).
* Collaborate with engineering to validate release changes, certify upgrades, and improve CI/CD pipelines.
* Upgrades, Patching & Performance: Plan and execute version upgrades, patching cycles, infrastructure migrations, and configuration refactoring.
* Conduct capacity planning, performance profiling, load testing support, and platform tuning.
* Oversee TLS certificate renewals, key management, rotation, and platform security posture.
* DataPower Operations: Operate and support IBM DataPower Gateways, including configuration of Multi-Protocol Gateways (MPGW), WS-Proxies, Cryptographic profiles, XSLT, GatewayScript services.
* Troubleshoot runtime, policy, routing, and security issues on DataPower appliances.
* Automation, IaC & Reliability Engineering: Expertise knowledge in Ansible, python, Unix scripting and contribute automating tasks like Monitoring & alerting, Deployment workflows, Health checks, Incident response, Config validation.
* Implement reliability improvements through Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Terraform, Ansible, and GitOps.
* Develop automated recovery scripts and tools to reduce manual operational overhead.
* Observability, Monitoring & Alerting: Establish and maintain observability using: Splunk, ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace / AppDynamics
* Build dashboards for SLIs/SLOs, latency, error analysis, backend performance, and capacity metrics.
* Improve proactive alerting to reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to recover (MTTR).
* Governance, Change & Architectural Engagement: Participate in design discussions, architectural reviews, API governance activities, and platform modernization initiatives.
* Work with CAB (Change Advisory Board) for change planning, approvals, and execution tracking.
* Contribute to runbooks, SOPs, architectural diagrams, and platform knowledge base assets.

title: State Business Head
description:
**Job Description: State Business Head**

* **Location:**
  Hyderabad
* **Markets:**
  Kerala, Gujarat, Odisha (3 positions available)
* **Experience:**
  7–12 years
* **Compensation:**
  35–40 Lakhs per annum
* **Reporting To:**
  Founder's Office

**About the Role**

This role is for entrepreneurial
**State Business Heads**
who will build the business in their respective states almost like a
**Mini CEO**
. This is not a traditional marketing, operations, or business-development role. You will own the entire state business end-to-end: understanding the customer, identifying the right offerings, building partner networks, creating the occasion calendar, launching campaigns, acquiring customers, delivering the service successfully, and bringing customers back again.

The ideal candidate possesses strong commercial thinking, cultural understanding, marketing instinct, and exceptional execution capabilities.

**What You Will Own**

1. **State Business & Revenue**

* Own the growth of the business in the assigned state.
* Build annual and quarterly business plans covering: Revenue, Transactions, New customers, Repeat customers, Average Order Value (AOV), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), Retention, Product portfolio, and Partner network.
* Treat the state as your own business and continuously identify new opportunities for growth.

1. **Understand the State's Consumer Ecosystem**

* Develop a deep understanding of the state's key markets, regional traditions, festivals, seasonal and occasion-led demand, local customs, consumer preferences, life-event needs, influential local voices, and customer behaviour.
* Translate this understanding into products and campaigns relevant to customers in that state.

1. **Build Partner Network**

* Identify and develop relationships with high-potential partners and institutions.
* Responsibilities include: Partner discovery, meeting partner management and key stakeholders, partnership negotiation, offering selection, commercial arrangements, operational readiness, content collection, quality standards, and long-term relationship management.
* Build a strong pipeline of partners rather than depending on only a few.

1. **Build the State Occasion Calendar**

* Create a 365-day calendar for the state identifying opportunities around major festivals, monthly occasions, seasonal peaks, and other high-demand days.
* For every major occasion, decide the offering, partner, pricing, target customers, and marketing timelines.

1. **Product Creation**

* Work with partners, product, content, and operations teams to create compelling offerings.
* Own the product proposition, partner selection, packages, pricing, add-ons, fulfilment, personalisation options, customer communication, photos/videos, storytelling, and landing-page proposition. Convert regional occasions into compelling and authentic consumer propositions.

1. **Campaign Planning & Growth**

* Own the commercial success of every major campaign spanning Meta Ads, Google Ads, performance marketing, CAC, ROAS, CTR, conversion, creative testing, audience segmentation, landing-page conversion, remarketing, and WhatsApp marketing.
* Analyse campaign metrics to optimize propositions, partners, pricing, and creatives.

1. **Influencer & Creator Partnerships**

* Build a state-level network of regional influencers, YouTubers, Instagram creators, regional celebrities, niche content creators, and community voices.
* Develop performance-linked partnerships that drive transactions rather than mere brand awareness.

1. **End-to-End Service Execution**

* Oversee the complete customer journey from booking, order detail collection, partner coordination, and service execution, to proof/video delivery, fulfilment, customer communication, and feedback.

1. **Retention & Repeat Business**

* Build repeat behaviour by working with CRM and retention teams across WhatsApp, push notifications, email, personalization, festival reminders, past-purchase recommendations, partner recommendations, cross-sells, family occasions, birthdays, anniversaries, and recurring purchases.

1. **Consumer Insights**

* Constantly analyse customer feedback, search behaviour, customer support conversations, campaign comments, social media, competitor actions, and market trends to launch new products and improve existing offerings.

**Candidate Profile**

This role calls for builders rather than administrators. The ideal candidate:

* Has
  **7-12 years**
  of experience.
* Has built or scaled a consumer business, category, city, region, or marketplace.
* Understands digital consumer acquisition and Meta/Google performance marketing.
* Has strong commercial, analytical ability, and experience working with vendors, partners, or distributed supply.
* Can manage complex operations, understand retention/repeat purchase behaviour, and work with ambiguity to build things from zero.
* Possesses very high ownership and operates without waiting for instructions.
* Is comfortable traveling across the assigned state.
* *Preferred Background:*
  Experience in D2C, e-commerce, marketplaces, food delivery, travel, matrimony, consumer internet, regional content, or other high-frequency consumer businesses.

**Cultural Requirement**

Deep cultural understanding of the respective state is mandatory. The candidate must:

* Speak the state's language fluently and read it comfortably.
* Understand regional traditions, festivals, consumer behaviour, and cultural nuances across different districts/regions within the state.

Note: All positions will be based in Hyderabad.

Job Title – Identity Platform Engineer (IPE)

Location – Hyderabad

Experience: 5+ Years

Shift Timing: 4.00pm to 1.00am (Monday to Thursday - Work from Office & Friday- Work From Home)

You'll own the build, automation, and integration of identity systems across our Identity Control Plane. This isn't a helpdesk role — you're treating identity as a scalable platform product, not a queue of tickets.

Core stack: SailPoint + Entra ID + Active Directory + HR systems + downstream apps. You ship reliable, repeatable, production-grade identity solutions.

Engineer Identity Lifecycle End-to-End

• Provision and deprovision access across AD, Entra ID, and enterprise apps.

Kill Manual Processes

• Build reusable platform components that scale across apps and user types.

• Push standard paths; push back on exceptions.

Own Application Onboarding

• Be the technical lead for integrating apps into the identity governance model.

• Implement birthright access, RBAC, and request-driven access per platform standards.

• Build integrations that are observable and maintainable — not just functional.

Keep It Stable at Scale

• Fix recurring issues through engineering, not workarounds.

• Support root cause analysis with IAM leads.

• Ensure your implementations generate audit evidence without you babysitting compliance.

Document and Track Your Work

• Keep your work planned, tracked, and traceable.

• Write documentation that actually helps the next person — configs, workflows, integrations.

• Contribute to shared knowledge bases and improve standards over time.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

What You Need

• Degree in CS/IT/Engineering or equivalent real-world experience.

• Solid grip on SAML, OAuth2, OIDC, directory sync.

• Strong troubleshooting skills across provisioning flows and integrations.

• You build things that are supportable, not just shippable.

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
  
  
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**

and

Communication management

The coordinator will also know where to find expert advice through being in close touch with the people operations team in our global offices and the talent acquisition operation team.
* Is comfortable solving queries via emails, calls, zoom meetings as well as face-to-face interactions.
* Ability to show integrity and maintain confidentiality at all times, especially when dealing with sensitive data or PII

Recruitment process coordination
  
  

* Understanding our tools such as the ATS system and Cronofy (scheduling tool)

* Facilitate in-person assessments days for candidates, coordinating logistics, and ensuring the smooth running of assessment activities

Process improvement
  
  

* Works closely with the Programmes and Experience Specialist in identifying areas of improvement within existing HR processes to improve overall candidate experience

Event Coordination
  
  

* Work closely with the WiseStart Employer Brand Specialist to coordinate early career events, including managing catering arrangements, venue logistics, and ensuring compliance with non-disclosure agreements (NDAs).

**Visa And Compliance**

* Develop a comprehensive understanding of visa requirements and compliance regulations relevant to international candidates.
* Keeps up to date with business changes and HR legal/policy/process changes
* Manage the process for necessary documentation for eligible candidates.

Invoice Processing and Budget management
  
  

* Manage invoice processing and budgeting activities related to recruitment expenses. Maintain accurate records of expenditure and assist in budget forecasting for recruitment initiatives

**Qualifications**
**Education:**
Bachelor’s/Masters degree (recently graduated) in a relevant subject area such as Human Resources, Humanities, Business/Management, Marketing, Psychology, or Social Sciences (or equivalent practical experience).
  
  
Additional Information
  
  

* Office Address: Table Space Suites, Raheja Mindspace, Building 4, HITEC City, Hyderabad, India

**Benefits**

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
  
  
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

title: Design Manager - Water/Wastewater Treatment
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
As a Design Manager – Treatment, you will lead the multidisciplinary design delivery of complex water treatment, wastewater treatment, and desalination projects. You will be responsible for driving design integration, technical excellence, programme certainty, and quality compliance across all stages of project delivery. This includes overseeing process, civil, mechanical, chemical, electrical, and I&C interfaces, ensuring alignment across all design disciplines.
  
  
You will work closely with Project Managers, Discipline Leads, and Sector/Regional leadership to plan, coordinate, and assure the technical execution of treatment projects while also mentoring and strengthening the capability of the broader design team.
  
  
Key duties include
  
  

* Development and implementation of multidisciplinary design strategies for water/wastewater treatment and desalination projects, ensuring design integration and coherent execution.
* Lead and manage the preparation, coordination, and delivery of design packages for water treatment plants, wastewater treatment plants, desalination facilities, and associated process systems.
* Evaluate, compare, and select appropriate treatment technologies and processes for project-specific needs.
* Provide leadership in Design for Design‑Build (D for DB) models—ensuring constructability, staging, risk mitigation, and alignment with contractor expectations.
* Lead or support HAZOP/HAZID studies, interpret findings, and implement appropriate mitigation measures across treatment process designs.
* Own and manage core design management documents Project Responsibility Matrix, Project Organisation Chart, Design Programme, Basis of Design, and Schedule of Deliverables.
* Identify and manage inputs from external specialists, JV partners, and sub‑consultants, ensuring their deliverables are fully integrated.
* Lead client engagement activities, including workshops, presentations, design reviews, and technical discussions.
* Facilitate multidisciplinary coordination meetings and proactively manage resolution of design issues to maintain schedule and quality commitments.
* Ensure all design outputs comply with quality standards, codes, legislation, and HSE principles, promoting safe design practices.

**We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in
**delivering Design Build water infrastructure projects**
.**
Here's what you'll need
  
  
**Key software tools**

* Planning & Coordination Primavera P6 / MS Project
* Collaboration ACC, ProjectWise, SharePoint, MS Teams
* GIS ArcGIS Pro / QGIS
* Treatment Modelling (exposure advantageous) RO/ion balance tools, process simulators
* BIM (exposure advantageous) Revit, Civil 3D, Navisworks, Revizto

**Key Behaviours**

* Builds positive, collaborative relationships across diverse teams.
* Strong client‑facing presence; personable, approachable, and confident.
* Leads through coordination, communication, and engagement.
* Drives integrated, high‑quality design solutions across disciplines.
* Organised, proactive, and able to resolve complex issues promptly.
* Creative, flexible, dependable; champions safety and quality culture.

**Work Experience**

* 20+ years of experience in design management within an engineering consultancy or EPC/Design‑Build environment.
* Proven experience managing multidisciplinary design teams delivering complex treatment facilities.
* Demonstrated capability in delivering Water Treatment/ Wastewater Treatment/ Desalination across preliminary, detailed, and construction design stages.
* Strong understanding of PFDs, mass balance development, hydraulic profiles, P&IDs, and preparation of process input documents.
* Strong experience in Design for Design‑Build (D for DB), including early contractor engagement, constructability review, and technical risk mitigation.
* Experience leading design delivery in BIM‑enabled environments.
* Demonstrated interest in digital delivery and innovation, including automation, data‑driven workflows, and continuous improvement.
* Strong communication, coordination, leadership, and organisational skills.
* Experience in client presentations, tender submissions, and stakeholder management.
* Experience in change management, including assessment of design changes, impact analysis, and stakeholder communication.
* Working understanding of MTO/BoQ development and coordination with discipline teams for quantity validation.
* Ability to develop Level‑of‑Effort (LOE) estimates and support bids, proposals, and design execution plans.
* Understanding of project financials, including forecasting, progress tracking, milestone monitoring, and invoicing.
* Experience with alternate delivery methods such as Design–Build, EPC, CMAR, or PPP/P3 is an asset.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Civil, Chemical, Environmental Engineering (or related discipline)
* Master’s degree in relevant field
* Professional Engineer (PE) / Chartered Engineer (CEng) is highly desirable

**Preferred Attributes**

* Experience delivering large multidisciplinary treatment programmes (water, wastewater, or desalination).
* Exposure to complex staging, commissioning planning, or brownfield facility expansions.
* Experience or understanding of PFAS treatment technologies (e.g., GAC, IX, RO) is an added advantage.
* Awareness of sustainability, circularity, and low‑carbon treatment solutions.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast‑paced, contractor‑integrated environments.

**Hybrid Work Expectation**
Average office presence of 3 days per week or as per Company Policy, with travel for client/site meetings and occasional team meetings.
  
  
At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Forward deployed Engineer
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer**

**Company:**
Trida Labs

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
3–5 Years

**About Trida Labs**

Trida Labs builds AI-native products that help organizations work with enterprise data, analytics, and intelligent applications.

Our products include TridaPad, an AI-native data collaboration platform for querying, analyzing, visualizing, and managing enterprise data; AgentSQL, an agentic AI analytics solution for natural-language interaction with enterprise data; and TridaPad MCP Server, which enables AI assistants and MCP-compatible clients to interact with TridaPad capabilities.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to work directly with customers and turn business and technical requirements into working solutions using Trida Labs products.

You will work across customer discovery, data integration, configuration, testing, deployment, and production troubleshooting. You will understand customer workflows, data environments, security requirements, and business needs, then configure and integrate our products to solve real-world problems.

You will also support customer pilots, technical demonstrations, and pre-sales engagements, validating solutions against customer-specific use cases and collaborating with engineering teams when product-level changes are required.

This is a customer-facing engineering role focused on configuring and extending existing capabilities rather than building customer-specific forks.

**What You'll Do**

**1. Customer Discovery & Solution Design**

* Understand customer workflows, technical requirements, data environments, and operational constraints.
* Translate business requirements into practical Trida Labs solutions.
* Identify required data sources, integrations, permissions, configurations, and deployment requirements.
* Assess technical feasibility, explain trade-offs, and define reusable implementation approaches.

**2. Pre-Sales, Pilots & Proofs of Concept**

* Support technical discussions, product demonstrations, pilots, and proofs of concept.
* Demonstrate how TridaPad and AgentSQL address customer use cases.
* Configure representative customer environments and validate technical requirements.
* Identify integration, security, and deployment constraints and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders.

**3. Product Implementation & Data Integration**

* Deploy and configure TridaPad and AgentSQL for customer requirements.
* Configure data sources, database connections, permissions, schemas, and analytics workflows.
* Integrate enterprise databases and platforms such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, and Databricks.
* Understand customer data models, relationships, and business metrics.
* Validate data accessibility and troubleshoot connectivity, permission, schema, query, and integration issues.

**4. AI & Analytics Implementation**

* Configure existing AI and analytics capabilities for customer use cases.
* Adapt prompts, context, tools, and application workflows where appropriate.
* Validate natural-language analytics, SQL generation, analytical results, visualizations, dashboards, and summaries.
* Diagnose unreliable AI outputs and distinguish data, configuration, context, model, and product issues.
* Collaborate with specialist engineering teams when core product changes are needed.

**5. Security, Access & MCP Integrations**

* Support customer security questionnaires, technical reviews, and access requirements.
* Coordinate VPN, IP allowlisting, private connectivity, restricted network, and other environment-specific requirements.
* Support self-hosted deployments in customer cloud or on-premises environments where applicable.
* Apply least-privilege principles and follow requirements for handling production data, PII, credentials, logs, and debugging information.
* Configure and validate MCP integrations with AI assistants, internal applications, and customer workflows, including authentication, permissions, and tool access.

**6. Customer Evaluation & Validation**

* Build customer-specific golden question sets containing representative business questions, expected SQL, and verified analytical results.
* Test customer configurations against schemas, terminology, metrics, permissions, and real-world questions.
* Rerun relevant tests after product, model, prompt, or configuration changes.
* Validate SQL, analytics, visualizations, dashboards, and summaries against expected outcomes.
* Track regressions, communicate actionable findings, and maintain versioned customer-specific configuration artifacts.

**7. Deployment & Production Troubleshooting**

* Prepare implementation plans and technical validation checklists.
* Support deployments across development, staging, and production environments.
* Troubleshoot application, API, database, AI, integration, and deployment issues using logs, traces, errors, and reproduction steps.
* Validate fixes against customer-relevant scenarios and support releases, upgrades, and post-deployment checks.
* Coordinate infrastructure and platform-level issues with the appropriate engineering teams.

**8. Customer Feedback & Engineering Collaboration**

* Identify recurring customer problems and distinguish implementation needs from core product requirements.
* Provide structured feedback with technical details, reproduction steps, expected behavior, and customer impact.
* Identify opportunities to convert repeated implementation work into reusable product capabilities, tools, or documentation.
* Collaborate with AI, AI Agent, Data & AI, Backend, Platform, NLP/ML, and Product teams.
* Reduce customer-specific workarounds and avoid unnecessary product forks.

**Role Ownership**

* **Forward Deployed Engineer:**
  Owns customer discovery, solution design, implementation, integration, configuration, validation, deployment, troubleshooting, and customer-facing technical delivery.
* **AI Engineer:**
  Owns reusable user-facing AI features and AI-powered application experiences.
* **AI Agent Engineer:**
  Owns agent orchestration, behavior, tool workflows, and core agent capabilities.
* **Data & AI Engineer:**
  Owns data connectivity, schema and metadata systems, semantic representations, and cross-database data correctness.
* **NLP/ML Engineer:**
  Owns model-level NLP and generation quality, including SQL-generation capabilities.
* **Platform Engineer:**
  Owns infrastructure, model access, deployment systems, observability, security, and platform-level connectivity.
* **Backend Engineer:**
  Owns core backend services, APIs, business logic, and shared application services.

The Forward Deployed Engineer configures and extends existing capabilities, validates customer deployments, and escalates core product changes to the appropriate teams rather than maintaining customer-specific forks.

**Customer Engagement Expectations**

* Work directly with customers across different technical and business environments.
* Support customer meetings and deployments across relevant time zones when required.
* Be willing to travel for customer meetings, workshops, deployments, and go-live activities when necessary.
* Manage multiple implementation activities while maintaining clear priorities and communication.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3–5 years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, data engineering, AI engineering, technical consulting, or a related technical role.
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
* Experience with APIs, databases, backend services, enterprise applications, and data integrations.
* Strong understanding of data workflows, SQL, and technical troubleshooting.
* Experience working with customers, stakeholders, or cross-functional technical teams.
* Familiarity with LLMs, Generative AI, and AI-powered applications.
* Ability to translate customer requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to investigate issues using logs, errors, configurations, and reproduction steps.
* Strong communication skills and comfort supporting customer environments and production deployments.
* Ability to manage multiple requirements and competing priorities effectively.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Technical Consulting, or Technical Implementation.
* Experience supporting product demonstrations, pilots, or proofs of concept.
* Experience with AI analytics, natural-language-to-SQL, or enterprise data applications.
* Experience with AI agents, tool calling, or agentic workflows.
* Familiarity with LangGraph, LangChain, or LlamaIndex.
* Experience with MCP and AI assistant integrations.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks.
* Experience with Docker and cloud or deployment platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Render, or Vercel.
* Experience with production deployments, AI evaluation, regression testing, observability, or production AI troubleshooting.

**Key Skills**

Python | SQL | APIs | Databases | Enterprise Data | System Integration | Generative AI | LLMs | AI Applications | Natural-Language-to-SQL | Data Analytics | AI Agents | MCP | Docker | Cloud | Customer Deployment | Production Troubleshooting | Technical Implementation | Technical Communication

**Why Join Trida Labs?**

At Trida Labs, you will work directly on real AI systems solving enterprise data and analytics problems.

You will collaborate with customers and engineering teams across solution design, AI implementation, enterprise data integration, evaluation, production troubleshooting, and product improvement—helping turn real customer requirements into reliable, reusable product capabilities.

**Equal Opportunity**

Trida Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone has the opportunity to contribute and grow.

description:

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Application Support Engineer to support internet banking applications, middleware platforms, and containerized applications running on OpenShift. The candidate will be responsible for production monitoring, incident management, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, application availability, and ensuring smooth banking operations.

The ideal candidate should have experience supporting critical banking applications in a 24/7 production environment, with strong troubleshooting skills across application, middleware, database, and infrastructure layers.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Internet Banking Application Support

* Provide L1/L2/L3 production support for internet banking and digital banking applications.
* Monitor application availability, transaction processing, and banking services.
* Troubleshoot login issues, fund transfer failures, payment errors, session timeouts, and transaction discrepancies.
* Analyze application logs and coordinate with development, database, network, and infrastructure teams.
* Support banking interfaces, API integrations, payment gateways, and third-party systems.
* Ensure adherence to banking security standards, audit requirements, and change management procedures.

2. Middleware Support

* Support middleware platforms such as IBM WebSphere, JBoss/WildFly, Apache Tomcat, or Oracle WebLogic.
* Monitor application servers, JVM health, thread pools, connection pools, and server resources.
* Troubleshoot deployment failures, application connectivity issues, performance bottlenecks, and server errors.
* Analyze logs and troubleshoot HTTP errors, including 500, 502, 503, and 504.
* Support application deployments, configuration changes, certificate renewals, and service restarts.
* Work with infrastructure teams to resolve load balancer, network, database connectivity, and integration issues.

3. OpenShift / Container Platform Support

* Monitor and support applications deployed on Red Hat OpenShift.
* Troubleshoot pod failures, CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff, deployment issues, and service connectivity.
* Work with pods, deployments, services, routes, ConfigMaps, secrets, and namespaces.
* Use oc commands to investigate application and container issues.
* Analyze pod logs, events, resource utilization, and readiness/liveness probe failures.
* Support application releases, rolling deployments, scaling, and rollback activities.
* Coordinate with DevOps and platform teams for cluster-level and infrastructure-related issues.

4. Incident, Problem & Change Management

* Handle production incidents and service requests within defined SLAs.
* Perform initial investigation, impact assessment, escalation, and incident resolution.
* Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and prepare incident reports.
* Participate in problem management, change management, release activities, and disaster recovery drills.
* Maintain support documentation, runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles.
* Participate in rotational shifts, on-call support, and planned maintenance activities.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong experience in application or production support.
* Knowledge of internet banking, digital banking, payment systems, or financial services applications.
* Hands-on experience with middleware and application servers.
* Working knowledge of Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes fundamentals.
* Strong Linux/Unix commands and shell scripting basics.
* Experience analyzing application logs using tools such as Splunk, ELK, or similar monitoring platforms.
* Knowledge of SQL and basic database troubleshooting.
* Understanding of REST APIs, HTTP/HTTPS, JSON/XML, SSL/TLS certificates, and network connectivity.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes, incident management, and SLA-based support.
* Experience with monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, App Dynamics, or similar tools is an advantage.

title: Principal Engineer Software
description:
**Our Mission**
