**Job Summary**
Job Summary
  
  
As a Principal Engineer in our Identity Security division, you will be the ultimate technical authority and go-to expert for our core Single Sign-On (SSO) and Federation capabilities. You will own the architectural integrity, security posture, and scalability of our SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect (OIDC) implementations. In this role, you will balance deep technical execution with organizational leadership—driving best practices across microservices, mentoring engineering teams, representing our identity expertise externally, and pioneering the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to advance our identity security capabilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Write clean, highly secure, and performance-optimized code for critical authentication paths and build Proof of Concepts (PoCs) to evaluate new architectures.
* Architect resilient, low-latency microservices capable of handling millions of token validations, federation requests, and authentication flows globally.
* Drive engineering modernizations, including upgrading backend frameworks, implementing secure CI/CD pipelines, and integrating advanced security analysis tools.
* Lead root-cause analysis and resolution of critical bugs involving multi-tenant SSO setups, token encryption/signing, and token lifecycles.
* Partner with data science teams to integrate AI/ML models into authentication flows for real-time risk scoring and anomalous token behavior detection.
* Advocate for and embed generative AI development tools into the team's daily workflows to safely accelerate delivery and improve code quality.
* Lead large-scale features, protocol refactors, and microservice optimizations, ensuring alignment with the company’s Tech Radar and security baselines.
* Identify architectural gaps in SSO services, advocate for improvements, and implement robust solutions.
* Conduct rigorous reviews of complex protocol implementations and cryptographic designs to ensure strict adherence to RFC standards.
* Proactively identify and resolve cross-team technical dependencies for seamless integration.
* Teach, guide, and upskill developers, fostering a culture of deep identity security awareness.
* Represent the company in the cybersecurity industry by speaking at tech conferences, writing technical blogs, or contributing to open-source identity standards.

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record in a Tech Lead or Principal Engineer role.
* The candidate should have experience in at least one of the following programming languages: C#/.NET OR Java OR Python .The candidate should be willing to work with the C#/.NET technology stack.
* Exposure or strong interest in applying AI/ML technologies within cybersecurity contexts.
* Strong background in modern cloud-native architectures, distributed microservices, and secure-by-design engineering principles.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proven experience in public speaking, technical writing (blogs/whitepapers), or mentoring engineering communities.
* Broad understanding of the business context, connecting technical decisions to customer value.
* Ability to translate highly complex technical concepts for both engineering and business stakeholders.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with Identity and Access Management (IAM) architectures, specifically building and securing SAML 2.0 Identity/Service Providers and OAuth 2.0/OIDC Authorization Servers.

**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
  
  
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. **About Insightsoftware**
insightsoftware is a global provider of connected solutions for the Office of the CFO. We empower business leaders with accessible insights and connected solutions to drive actionable business strategy. With operations spanning 40+ countries, we help finance and IT teams work smarter, faster, and with greater confidence.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Command Centre Associate is a hands-on entry-level operations role supporting the new Hyderabad Command Centre. Reporting to a Specialist or Senior Manager, you will assist with 24×7 monitoring, incident triage, and operational support for our multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, on-premises).
  
  
This is a supervised, guided-learning role designed to build your foundation in cloud operations, incident management, and IT service delivery. You will work alongside Specialists, executing runbooks, documenting actions, and escalating issues per established procedures. The first 6-12 months are on-site for training and team integration; after that, you transition to hybrid work.
  
  
Key Competencies for Success (Fresher-Focused)
  
  
**Learning Aptitude & Problem-Solving**
Ability to learn new tools, systems, and processes quickly—comfortable admitting knowledge gaps and asking clarifying questions.
  
  
Logical thinking and curiosity; desire to understand "why" systems behave the way they do, not just follow steps.
  
  
Ability to break down ambiguous problems into smaller, manageable steps.
  
  
Comfort with ambiguity and change; ability to adapt when procedures evolve or new scenarios emerge.
  
  
**Behavioral & Team Skills**
Team player mentality—willing to support colleagues during high-pressure incidents and contribute to collective success.
  
  
Collaborative and open to feedback; able to receive coaching from Specialists without defensiveness.
  
  
Proactive attitude—identify issues before being told, flag ambiguities, suggest improvements based on observations.
  
  
Reliability and accountability—follow through on commitments, own your errors, and take corrective action.
  
  
Resilience under pressure; calm demeanor during incident response and ability to stay focused during high-stress situations.
  
  
**Communication & Documentation**
Clear written communication—shift logs, incident notes, and handoffs must be precise, concise, and actionable for the next shift.
  
  
Ability to explain technical issues in plain language to stakeholders with varying technical backgrounds.
  
  
Active listening—understand escalation context and ask clarifying questions before escalating to Specialists.
  
  
Comfort with asynchronous communication and remote collaboration tools (Slack, Confluence, Teams).
  
  
**Work Ethic & Growth Mindset**
Genuine interest in IT operations and cloud infrastructure; willingness to invest time in structured learning.
  
  
Self-motivated—can work independently during quieter shift periods, using time to study runbooks, documentation, or suggested learning resources.
  
  
Detail-oriented—meticulously follow runbooks, document every step taken, and flag deviations or unexpected findings.
  
  
Role requires to work 24×7 shifts including nights, weekends, and holidays.
  
  
Long-term commitment—seeking a role for sustained career growth, not short-term exposure.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Incident Monitoring & Triage (Guided)**
Monitor alerts and incoming incidents under supervision; classify and document in Jira Service Management with guidance from Specialists.
  
  
Execute standard troubleshooting steps and runbooks for routine issues (e.g., log file analysis, service restarts, basic connectivity checks).
  
  
Escalate unresolved, unusual, or high-severity incidents with clear context to Specialists.
  
  
**24×7 Shift Operations**
Participate in 24×7 rotational shifts; maintain detailed shift logs and handoff notes for continuity.
  
  
Follow shift procedures, escalation matrices, and communication protocols.
  
  
Alert Specialists to threshold breaches, anomalies, or potential security events.
  
  
**Documentation & Knowledge Building**
Document all incident actions, resolutions, and learnings for audit trails and knowledge base updates.
  
  
Contribute observations on recurring issues and alert patterns to help refine runbooks.
  
  
Create or update Confluence articles for common troubleshooting procedures with Specialist review.
  
  
**Learning & Skill Development**
Shadow Specialists and senior peers to understand multi-cloud architecture, ITIL incident processes, and command centre workflows.
  
  
Work through structured onboarding—cloud fundamentals, tooling, runbooks, and escalation procedures.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
1–2 years in IT operations, helpdesk, NOC, or field support (or fresh graduate with technical foundation).
  
  
Basic familiarity with cloud concepts (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS); no hands-on AWS/Azure required but willingness to learn is essential.
  
  
Comfortable with networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, basic routing) and willingness to deepen knowledge.
  
  
Strong attention to detail—ability to follow runbooks precisely and document actions accurately.
  
  
Clear written and verbal communication for shift logs, handoffs, and escalations.
  
  
Ability to work 24×7 rotational shifts including nights, weekends, and Indian holidays.
  
  
Basic Windows/Linux command-line familiarity (e.g., navigating directories, viewing files, basic troubleshooting).
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Awareness of ITIL Incident and Problem Management concepts.
  
  
Exposure to at least one monitoring/alerting tool (Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, PagerDuty).
  
  
Familiarity with Jira or similar ticketing systems.
  
  
Basic scripting knowledge (Bash, Python, or PowerShell) for log parsing or simple automation tasks.
  
  
Prior IT or infrastructure support experience (even in a smaller organisation).
  
  
What We Offer
  
  
Structured onboarding and mentorship from experienced Specialists—accelerated learning path in cloud operations and ITIL incident management.
  
  
Hands-on exposure to a modern multi-cloud tech stack (AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, SaaS, enterprise platforms).
  
  
Clear progression: proven performers can grow into Specialist roles within 18–24 months.
  
  
Collaborative, results-oriented culture underpinned by core values of Winning Attitude, One Team, and Disciplined Execution.
  
  
Competitive compensation, shift allowance, benefits, and professional development support (certifications, training).
  
  
Exposure to global IT operations in a PE-backed, high-growth software company.
  
  
**Additional Information**
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Learn more about our high-energy, high-performance global team: Work With Us

title: Cloud Operations Analyst
description:
**Are you ready to shape the future of data?**

  

Matillion is the company behind Maia, the AI Data Automation platform.

  

In the AI economy, demand for data is exploding. Manual data engineering can’t keep up. Maia fixes that by combining 15 years of data expertise with agentic AI to eliminate the manual work that slows data teams down. Organisations like Cisco, DocuSign, and Slack are already using it to deliver real business impact, faster.

  

We started in Manchester and now we’re global - with teams across the UK, US and India.

  

We are driven, curious, energetic people who move fast, think big and hold ourselves to a high standard. We’re here to make a dent in the universe bigger than ourselves. And we’re looking for people who want to be part of it.

**About the role**

  

We're Matillion - and we're building the first AI Data Automation platform. Our cloud infrastructure isn't a back-office function; it's the engine that powers everything our customers rely on. As a Cloud Operations Analyst, you'll be a key architect of that engine, owning the reliability, scalability and security of our cloud-native platforms across AWS, GCP and Azure. This is a high-impact individual contributor role that sits at the intersection of Cloud Infrastructure, FinOps and SRE, and you'll be working in a small, focused engineering team where your decisions have real, visible consequence.
  
  
This isn't a reactive ops role. You'll be proactively identifying bottlenecks, driving automated remediation, applying AI tooling to accelerate workflows and partnering with Finance to make sure we scale efficiently. If you thrive with autonomy, think in systems and believe cloud infrastructure should be engineered with clinical precision, this is for you.

**What you will be doing**

  
* Designing, implementing and continuously improving Matillion's cloud infrastructure estate and Infrastructure as Code across AWS (primary), GCP and Azure, and conducting deep-dive performance analysis and driving automated remediation of bottlenecks
  
* Leading FinOps initiatives; analysing cloud spend, managing Reserved Instances and Savings Plans, and partnering with Finance to ensure we scale efficiently and responsibly
  
* Applying AI-powered developer tools (including Claude Code) to research, automate and accelerate operational workloads without compromising on safety or quality
  
* Managing Kubernetes (EKS) and Docker deployments at scale, scripting automation in Python, Go or Bash, and owning the consistency and reliability of our cloud-native platforms
  
* Mentoring junior analysts, leading technical knowledge shares, and driving continuous improvement in the team's ways of working by building a culture of documentation and operational excellence
  
  

**What we are looking for**

  
* Demonstrable experience in a Cloud Operations, DevOps or SRE role supporting high-availability SaaS environments with advanced, hands-on AWS expertise (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, EKS) and proven Terraform mastery including complex state files and code modularisation
  
* A sharp eye for cost optimisation; you can analyse cloud usage data, identify inefficiencies and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations that guide real infrastructure decisions and keep spend aligned to growth
  
* Strong Kubernetes (EKS) and containerisation experience at scale, paired with solid scripting ability in Python, Go or Bash for automating operational tasks
  
* A genuine willingness to master AI-powered developer tooling; you see AI as a force multiplier for productivity, not a threat to quality
  
* Autonomy and a bias for action; you dig into problems independently, think in systems, supervise AI outputs with rigour, and don't wait to be told what needs fixing

Cannot find a suitable role right now? We still want to hear from you. Drop us a line at 
talent@matillion.com.

title: Senior IGA Engineer
description:
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an
**IGA Engineer**
to design, build, operate, and sustain the enterprise Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) platform that serves as the control plane for how identity and access are governed across the organization. This role is responsible for developing and enhancing IGA capabilities—connectors, workflows, roles, and integrations—while keeping the platform healthy, reliable, and audit-ready, and executing the SOX ITGC controls that make it a trusted, compliant system of record for access.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role spanning both build and run: configuring and developing new capabilities, integrating target systems, and enhancing governance workflows on one side, and sustaining platform health, change management, vendor-coordinated migrations, incident resolution, and control execution on the other. The engineer turns requirements into working configuration and code, keeps the platform available, and ensures every SOX-relevant activity is performed on schedule with complete, clean evidence. The ideal candidate brings solid hands-on experience with an enterprise IGA platform (SailPoint, Saviynt, or equivalent) combined with strong ITGC/SOX discipline and an operations-and-audit mindset.
  
  
The IGA platform is a business-critical, SOX-scoped security capability. Operational lapses translate directly into two kinds of failure: disruptions that block provisioning, deprovisioning, and access reviews, and control failures that produce audit findings and compliance exposure. This position is critical to ensuring the platform is stable, well-instrumented, and rarely surprises the business.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**IGA Development & Engineering**

* Design, develop, and enhance IGA capabilities—connectors, integrations, joiner/mover/leaver (JML) and access-request workflows, roles, entitlements, certifications, and SoD rules—to meet evolving governance and business requirements.
* Build and maintain integrations between the IGA platform and target systems (HR, directories, cloud, and enterprise/SaaS applications) via APIs and connectors.
* Translate governance and access-model requirements into working configuration and code, following engineering standards and design patterns.
* Test, document, and promote changes through the appropriate environments with quality and maintainability in mind.

**Platform Operations**

* Operate, administer, and sustain the IGA platform so it runs reliably day to day, resolving sync, provisioning, and workflow failures as they arise.
* Execute platform upgrades, patches, and configuration changes through disciplined change control, with validated cutover and rollback plans.
* Maintain and enforce environment segregation between non-production and production.

**Observability, Monitoring & Reliability**

* Configure and continuously tune monitoring, logging, alerting, and dashboards for the platform, its connectors, and its governance workflows.
* Establish leading-indicator alerting (connector health, provisioning failures, job/queue depth, workflow errors) so degradations are caught before they disrupt users.
* Ensure failures generate alerts and that recurring errors are escalated into incidents per defined procedures.
* Define and track availability and health metrics for the platform and its critical workflows.

**Incident & Problem Management**

* Investigate and resolve incidents affecting the IGA platform and its governance workflows, restoring service and following the incident management process.
* Perform root-cause analysis on recurring platform issues and implement durable preventive fixes.
* Maintain runbooks and operational documentation to support consistent incident handling.

**Change & Release Management**

* Execute changes through the standard change management process—documented change requests, testing, and appropriate business/IT approvals before production migration.
* Enforce segregation of duties between developers and operations on production migrations; ensure any developer activity in production is monitored, logged, and reviewed.
* Support periodic change reviews and emergency-change post-implementation reviews.

**Vendor & Migration Coordination**

* Serve as a technical point of contact for platform and managed-service vendors during upgrades, migrations, and platform changes.
* Plan and execute migration/upgrade cutovers—scheduling, pre-checks, validation testing, rollback plans, and go/no-go decisions—and hold vendors accountable to SLAs.
* Coordinate with infrastructure and cloud teams on environment or backup dependencies.

**SOX & ITGC Compliance Execution**

* Own timely, accurate execution and evidence collection for the IGA platform's SOX control set, working within the broader IAM SOX program's governance and cadence.
* Execute access-administration controls: provisioning and account changes, terminations/deactivations, administrative and user-account revalidations, SoD/role matrix maintenance, and privileged account activity reviews.
* Execute change-management controls in line with the segregation-of-duties requirements above, and support SOC 1/SOC 2 report review and periodic governance and risk reviews.
* Investigate exceptions, assess impact, document results, and drive deficiencies to remediation; ensure no self-review on any revalidation control.
* Operate in a continuous audit-ready posture and support internal and external audit requests with complete, on-time evidence.

**Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* Use scripting to make configuration and control execution repeatable, reviewable, and auditable, reducing operational toil and tightening the loop between operations and evidence collection.
* Maintain knowledge continuity through documentation and runbooks so no single control or activity depends on one individual.

**Experience**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* 5–7 years in IAM/IGA engineering and operations, with hands-on experience configuring and developing on an enterprise IGA platform.
* Proven experience building and operating an enterprise IGA platform in production (SailPoint, Saviynt, or comparable).

**Technical Skills**

* Hands-on IGA development and administration: connectors/integrations, JML and access-request workflows, roles/entitlements, certifications, and SoD rules.
* Solid grounding in IAM fundamentals: authentication, SSO (SAML/OIDC), provisioning/SCIM, RBAC, JML, and SoD concepts.
* Experience building and integrating with target systems (HR, directories, cloud, and enterprise/SaaS applications) via APIs and connectors.
* Experience with observability and monitoring for application platforms—building meaningful alerts and dashboards, not just consuming them.
* Experience with incident and change management via ITSM tooling.
* Scripting ability (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for automation of platform tasks and evidence collection.

**Compliance Skills And Experience**

* SOX compliance and ITGC control testing experience.
* Ability to think, review, document, and challenge evidence from an auditor's perspective.
* Experience managing internal and external audit engagements.
* Strong understanding of IAM processes, access controls, and evidence validation.
* Ability to assess compliance risks and identify control gaps.
* Strong documentation and communication skills for auditor interactions and compliance reporting.
* Hands-on experience executing and evidencing core ITGC control types—access provisioning/deprovisioning, periodic user and privileged access reviews/recertification, and Segregation of Duties (SoD).
* Change-management control experience—change request tracking, testing, approvals, and dev-to-prod segregation of duties.
* Experience with deficiency and exception management—investigating exceptions, assessing impact, and tracking remediation to closure.
* Discipline to execute recurring controls on cadence and sustain audit-ready evidence.
* Experience reviewing SOC 1/SOC 2 reports, including complementary user entity controls (CUECs).
* Familiarity with GRC/compliance tooling for evidence and control management.
* Experience working with enterprise IAM platforms such as AD, SailPoint/Saviynt, etc. is preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant IGA platform certification or equivalent platform-specific training.
* Deeper experience developing and troubleshooting IGA connectors and integrations.
* Experience leading IGA platform migrations or major version upgrades.
* Prior experience partnering with GRC, Internal Audit, and External Audit in a regulated enterprise.
* General awareness of the cloud environment the platform runs in—enough to coordinate effectively with infrastructure and vendor teams (deep cloud engineering not required).

Why This Role Is Critical
  
  
The IGA platform is where access is governed and where a significant set of SOX ITGC controls are executed. Without dedicated engineering, operational, and compliance ownership, the platform is exposed on two fronts at once: reliability and audit.
  
  
**This Role Directly Protects The Organization From**

* Platform and workflow disruptions that block onboarding, delay deprovisioning, and stall access reviews.
* SOX control failures and audit findings—missed revalidations, broken change/SoD discipline, incomplete evidence.
* Failed or delayed platform migrations and upgrades due to a lack of internal accountability.
* Incident-handling and control-coverage gaps that threaten compliance and continuity.
* Over-dependence on premium-priced vendor and contractor support.

This position is for an engineer who builds, runs, and keeps a business-critical, SOX-scoped platform effective—someone who understands that in a regulated identity platform, engineering, reliability, and compliance are the same job.

The ideal candidate brings both deep administrative experience with ORMB/OUAF environments and strong Java development skills in large-volume financial systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* System Administration & Environment Management

+ Plan, execute, and document fresh installations of ORMB/OUAF across Development, QA, UAT, and Production environments on Linux/Unix servers

- Configure WebLogic application server, Oracle database connections, batch frameworks, and OUAF environment properties (ENVIRON.INI, SPLEBASE).
- Manage multi-environment topology including environment cloning, refresh, and rollback procedures.

+ Apply Oracle-released CPU patches, SPU patches, and product fix packs to ORMB/OUAF environments following change management procedures.

- Coordinate patch testing in lower environments before promoting to Production; maintain patch inventory and compliance registers.
- Use Oracle OPatch / OUAF patch utilities (e.g., FW patch scripts) and validate post-patch environment integrity.

+ Execute and oversee application deployments and release promotions across all environments using OUAF deployment utilities.

- Manage Configuration Migration (CM) packages, migration plans, and controlled rollouts via the OUAF Migration Assistant.
- Coordinate with DBAs for schema scripts, data migrations, and post-deployment validation.

+ Monitor application health, JVM performance, batch throughput, and WebLogic thread pools; tune configurations to meet SLA targets.
+ Maintain and update installation guides, runbooks, patch procedures, and environment-specific configuration documentation.

* Development & Enhancements

+ Design and develop custom ORMB components — algorithms, service scripts, BPA scripts, business objects, business services, and portal zones — using Java and the OUAF framework.
+ Build and maintain third-party integrations (e.g., tax engines, payment gateways, e-invoicing, ticketing systems) using REST/SOAP APIs and batch file-based patterns.
+ Develop and optimize batch programs for high-volume billing and financial transaction processing, including performance profiling and JVM-level tuning.
+ Collaborate with functional analysts and business stakeholders to gather requirements, propose solutions, and deliver enhancements aligned with business capabilities.

* Production Support & Operations

+ Provide Tier 2/3 production support for ORMB including incident triage, root cause analysis, and resolution of batch failures, data anomalies, and integration errors.
+ Run and schedule production batch jobs; maintain and modify interfaces, reports (BI Publisher), and scheduled tasks.
+ Perform year-end processing support, system upgrades, and general technical modifications with minimal business disruption.
+ Liaise with Oracle Support (SR management), infrastructure, and DBA teams to resolve platform-level issues.

* Collaboration & Governance

+ Work with external vendors and internal teams to evaluate system changes; participate in design reviews, propose solutions, and document outcomes.
+ Ensure all deployments and patches comply with change management, security, and audit policies.
+ Support the ORMB V8 upgrade and other strategic migration initiatives, contributing to parallel-run testing and validation activities.

**Knowledge And Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or Information Systems required.
* 4+ years of experience with Oracle ORMB or CC&B, including hands-on administration of OUAF-based environments (installations, patching, deployments).
* 4+ years of strong Java development skills with demonstrated ability to build and extend OUAF/ORMB framework components.
* Experience installing and patching ORMB/OUAF on Linux/Unix servers; familiarity with WebLogic administration and JVM tuning.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Database / SQL; ability to write and optimize queries against ORMB billing schema.
* Experience managing OUAF Configuration Migration (CM) packages and multi-environment promotion workflows.
* Ability to work independently and thrive in a high-profile environment while maintaining high attention to detail and quality.
* Strong communication skills to collaborate effectively with technical peers, business stakeholders, and third-party vendors.

**Preferred Knowledge And Experience**

* Familiarity with Oracle patch delivery mechanisms (My Oracle Support, OPatch) and WebLogic patching procedures.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines or scripted deployment automation for Java/OUAF applications.
* BI Publisher and/or Tableau experience is a plus.
* Financial industry experience with finance and/or accounting knowledge is beneficial.
* Experience with ORMB V8 (v8.x) and knowledge of differences from legacy CC&B / ORMB v2.x.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow or Jira integrations in enterprise environments.
* Ability to liaise with and build effective relationships with global teams across time zones.

title: NCX Senior Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is hiring an NCX Senior Engineer who is passionate about NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP) infrastructure operations to join our DSX team. This role involves working closely with strategic NVIDIA Cloud Partners to build and improve the operational capabilities essential for running large-scale NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure reliably in production.
  
  
Your role involves guiding partners beyond the initial cluster deployment and validation phase into advanced Day 2 operations. These operations cover ongoing infrastructure health, observability, lifecycle management, quick remediation, performance validation, and operational readiness. You will engage directly with partner engineering and operations teams to develop consistent approaches that support NVIDIA workloads and the broader external customer environments of the partners. This is a highly technical, hands-on role at the intersection of NVIDIA accelerated computing, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and production operations.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead NCP Day 2 operational readiness efforts. Collaborate directly with NVIDIA Cloud Partners to set up the systems, procedures, automation, and operational methods necessary to consistently manage NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure following initial deployment and activation.
* Build continuous infrastructure validation. Develop and implement methods to continuously validate GPU, CPU, storage, and network health. Do this across large-scale AI clusters to identify degraded infrastructure before it impacts critical training or inference workloads.
* Establish observability and operational telemetry. Help NCPs implement comprehensive telemetry, monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and operational signals across compute, GPU, InfiniBand/RoCE networking, storage, Kubernetes, and AI workloads.
* Develop automated detection and remediation. Build workflows to detect, isolate, drain, repair, validate, and return unhealthy infrastructure to service while minimizing disruption to customer workloads.
* Refine fleet lifecycle administration. Implement scalable strategies for managing sizable GPU fleets, including NVIDIA driver and firmware lifecycle administration, Kubernetes node maintenance, OS patching, configuration management, upgrades, and configuration drift identification.
* Operationalize NVIDIA reference architectures. Translate NVIDIA NCP requirements and reference architectures into production operating practices, validation criteria, runbooks, automation, and measurable operational standards.
* Define operational health and readiness. Develop health signals, SLOs, important metrics, acceptance criteria, and ongoing validation mechanisms that provide NVIDIA and NCPs with clear insight into infrastructure reliability and service readiness.
* Build reusable operational frameworks. Develop tooling, automation, implementation guides, runbooks, operational playbooks, and reference implementations that can be applied consistently across multiple NCP environments.

**What We Need To See**

* BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, cloud platform engineering, systems engineering, or similar roles supporting large-scale production environments.
* Strong experience operating Linux-based distributed systems and cloud infrastructure in production.
* Deep understanding of Kubernetes, containers, cluster scheduling, and the operational lifecycle of large multi-node environments.
* Strong understanding of production observability, including metrics, logging, alerting, dashboards, health checks, and operations guided by service level agreements.
* Experience crafting automation for infrastructure lifecycle management, failure detection, remediation, upgrades, and configuration management.
* Strong networking fundamentals and experience troubleshooting complex distributed systems across compute, network, and storage layers.
* Programming and automation experience using Python, Go, shell scripting, or similar languages.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience managing extensive GPU or accelerated computing infrastructure that supports AI training and inference workloads.
* Experience with NVIDIA technologies including DGX/HGX systems, CUDA, NVLink/NVSwitch, NVIDIA networking, InfiniBand, RoCE, GPU Operator, Network Operator, or related NVIDIA infrastructure software.
* Proven experience collaborating with NVIDIA Cloud Partners, hyperscale cloud providers, managed AI clouds, or extensive service-provider infrastructure and operating SLOs for large-scale compute infrastructure and using operational data to improve availability, performance, and fleet efficiency.
* Extensive knowledge of infrastructure observability tools including Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Alertmanager, and scalable telemetry pipelines and translating reference architectures or infrastructure requirements into repeatable production operating models across multiple customer or partner environments.

title: Senior Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
The Senior Cloud Platform Engineer designs, builds, and operates automated, secure, and scalable cloud platforms across AWS and Azure for enterprise clients. This is a hands-on engineering role — owning landing zone architecture, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, container platforms, and observability — with the technical depth to troubleshoot production issues and the maturity to mentor junior engineers and influence platform standards across client engagements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Platform & Landing Zone Engineering
* Design and build secure, multi-account/multi-subscription landing zones on AWS (Control Tower, Organizations) and Azure (Landing Zones, Management Groups).
* Implement network architecture — VPCs/VNets, transit gateways, hybrid connectivity, DNS, and security group / NSG design.
* Define and enforce account/subscription governance guardrails, tagging standards, and cost controls.
* Infrastructure as Code & Automation
* Author and maintain infrastructure using Terraform (primary) and/or CloudFormation / ARM / Bicep, structured as reusable modules.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, or Jenkins) for both infrastructure and application deployments.
* Drive GitOps practices for environment provisioning and change management.
* Containers & Orchestration
* Deploy, operate, and troubleshoot Kubernetes clusters (EKS, AKS) including networking (CNI), ingress, autoscaling, and RBAC.
* Support containerization of legacy and modernized workloads in partnership with application and modernization teams.
* Implement service mesh, secrets management, and workload identity patterns where applicable.
* Observability & Reliability
* Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting using CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Prometheus/Grafana, or equivalent.
* Define and track SLIs/SLOs for platform services; participate in on-call rotation and incident response.
* Conduct root-cause analysis for production issues and drive permanent fixes, not just workarounds.
* Security & Compliance
* Implement identity and access management (IAM roles/policies, Azure AD/Entra ID RBAC), least-privilege access, and secrets management (Secrets Manager, Key Vault, HashiCorp Vault).
* Embed security controls into pipelines (SAST/DAST, image scanning, policy-as-code with tools such as OPA/Sentinel).
* Support compliance requirements relevant to client engagements, including DPDP Act 2023, ISO 27001, and client-specific regulatory frameworks under Minfy's Kavach360 programme.
* Cost & Operational Efficiency
* Monitor and optimize cloud spend using native cost tools (Cost Explorer, Azure Cost Management) and rightsizing recommendations.
* Identify automation opportunities to reduce manual operational toil across managed environments.
* Client & Cross-Functional Engagement
* Work directly with client engineering and infrastructure teams as a trusted technical resource on managed services and migration engagements.
* Partner with the MiMo and Cloud Advisory teams to implement platforms that support migration and modernization roadmaps.
* Produce clear runbooks, architecture diagrams, and platform documentation.
* Mentorship & Technical Contribution
* Mentor junior and mid-level platform engineers; review their IaC and pipeline contributions.
* Contribute reusable modules, scripts, and accelerators to Minfy's internal platform engineering toolkit.
* Participate in architecture reviews and champion platform engineering best practices across the BU.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience
* 5–8 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering roles.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience operating production workloads on both AWS and Azure (multi-cloud experience required).
* Core Technical Skills
* Strong hands-on expertise with Terraform for multi-cloud Infrastructure as Code.
* Production experience with Kubernetes (EKS and/or AKS) — deployment, troubleshooting, and day-2 operations.
* Strong CI/CD skills — designing and building end-to-end pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, or Jenkins) with automated testing, security gates, and deployment strategies (blue-green, canary, rolling).
* Strong containerisation skills — Docker image build and optimization, multi-stage builds, container registries (ECR, ACR), and container security scanning.
* Scripting proficiency in Python, Bash, or Go for automation and tooling.
* Solid networking fundamentals — VPC/VNet design, routing, DNS, load balancing, and hybrid connectivity.
* Security & Governance
* Working knowledge of IAM/RBAC design, secrets management, and policy-as-code.
* Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks relevant to enterprise cloud environments (Well-Architected Framework, ISO 27001, DPDP Act 2023 or equivalent).
* Collaboration & Communication
* Comfortable working directly with client technical stakeholders and cross-functional Minfy teams (advisory, MiMo, security).
* Able to produce clear technical documentation and communicate incident/root-cause findings effectively.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator / DevOps Engineer Expert, or CKA/CKAD.
* Experience with GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Flux).
* Exposure to service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd).
* Prior experience in a partner/SI or managed services environment (AWS Premier/Advanced Partner or Microsoft Solutions Partner).
* Familiarity with FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization.

**KEY COMPETENCIES**

* Ownership — treats production platforms as their own; drives issues to permanent resolution.
* Automation-first mindset — defaults to codifying repeatable work rather than manual intervention.
* Technical depth with pragmatism — balances best practice with delivery timelines and client constraints.
* Collaboration — works effectively across client teams, internal BUs, and junior engineers.
* Continuous learning — stays current across a fast-moving, multi-cloud technology landscape.

* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.

As a Cloud Engineer, you will play a crucial role in moving an organization's data, applications, and infrastructure from on-premises environments to cloud platforms. This role involves a combination of technical expertise, strategic planning, and project management.

title: Tech Lead – Cloud Content Delivery (CDN Migration)
description:
Job Description: Tech Lead – Cloud Content Delivery (CDN Migration)
  
  
**Level:**
L4 / Tech Lead
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad (or as applicable)
  
  
**Function:**
Cloud Advisory / Managed Services – Content Delivery & Edge Infrastructure
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are looking for a
**Tech Lead – Systems Engineering**
to own and drive the migration of content delivery workloads from Akamai to Amazon CloudFront. Beyond hands-on architecture and delivery, this role carries technical leadership of the migration workstream — setting technical direction, reviewing designs, mentoring engineers, and acting as the primary technical point of contact for stakeholders through planning, execution, and cutover.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Technical Delivery**

* Lead end-to-end migration of content delivery workloads from Akamai to Amazon CloudFront — origin configurations, cache behaviors, and edge locations
* Architect and deploy CloudFront distributions with appropriate cache policies, origin request policies, and response header configurations
* Design and implement AWS WAF rules, web ACLs, and managed rule groups to secure migrated workloads
* Own the design and quality of Terraform modules for CloudFront, WAF, and supporting AWS resources, establishing reusable patterns for the team
* Drive cache validation, latency testing, and traffic cutover verification across all migration phases
* Define and enforce standards for runbooks, architecture diagrams, and operational handover documentation

**Technical Leadership**

* Set the technical approach and migration strategy in collaboration with architecture and delivery leadership
* Review peer designs, Terraform code, and cutover plans; ensure adherence to security, performance, and IaC best practices
* Mentor and upskill junior and mid-level engineers on CDN architecture, WAF configuration, and IaC practices
* Act as primary technical escalation point during cutover windows, coordinating with cross-functional teams (network, security, application owners)
* Communicate technical status, risks, and trade-offs to internal stakeholders and, where required, client stakeholders

**Requirements**
**Experience**

* 5–12 years of professional experience as a Systems Engineer, with demonstrated technical leadership on at least one significant infrastructure migration or modernization initiative

**Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in Amazon CloudFront — distribution configuration, cache behaviors, and origin setup
* Proficiency in AWS WAF — web ACLs, managed rules, and custom rule authoring
* Working familiarity with Akamai CDN, sufficient for accurate migration mapping (origin, caching, and security control equivalence)
* Strong Terraform skills for Infrastructure as Code across AWS resources; able to define reusable, production-grade modules
* Proficient in Java and Python for scripting, automation, and tooling
* Comfortable owning technical decisions independently and defending them in design reviews

**Leadership & Communication**

* Prior experience guiding or mentoring engineers, or informally leading technical workstreams
* Upper-Intermediate (B2) or higher proficiency in English, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both engineering and business stakeholders

Good to Have
  
  

* AWS Certification (Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional, or Advanced Networking Specialty)
* Experience with observability tooling for CDN performance (CloudWatch, Real User Monitoring)
* Exposure to client-facing delivery in a consulting/systems integrator environment

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
  
  
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Engage and contribute to the Identity & Access Management projects
* Work effectively as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication, and updating senior team members on progress
* Administer and support enterprise Okta environments across production, non-production, and disaster recovery tenants.
* Design, review, test, and implement Okta policies (Global Session Policies, Application Sign-in policies, authenticator enrollment policies etc.,)
* Engineer secure authentication experience using SSO, MFA, passwordless and phishing-resistant authenticators, while balancing security, user experience, and business continuity,
* Configure and troubleshoot application integrations using SAML 2.0, OIDC/Oauth 2.0, SWA, WS-Federation, and SCIM, including claims, assignments, provisioning, and deprovisioning.
* Develop and maintain Okta workflows and API-based automations for identity operations, policy administration, notifications, reporting, and bulk changes.
* Monitor authentication health and security events using Okta system lo and Splunk dashboards/alerts. Analyse trends, investigate anomalies, and recommend threshold or control improvements.
* Provide operational support for authentication incidents and service requests, preform root cause analysis, coordinate vendor support, and document resolution and closure evidence.
* Plan and execute controlled IAM changes, including impact analysis, implementation steps, risk assessment, test cases, success criteria, communications, rollback plans, and post change validations.
* Maintain technical documentation, knowledge articles, runbooks, implementation plans, architecture notes, and support procedures in approved enterprise repositories.
* Create and manage Jira stories and sprint deliverables, estimate work, track dependencies, communicate progress, and support Agile ceremonies.
* Collaborate with IAM engineering, IAM operations, application owners, directory services, service desk, security operations, infrastructure teams, change management, and product vendors.
* Contribute to knowledge transfer, onboarding, peer reviews, mentoring, and continuous improvement of team standards and operating procedures.
* Execute the engagement requirements, along with review of work by junior team members
* Help prepare reports and schedules that will be delivered to clients and other interested parties
* Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel
* Build strong internal relationships within EY Consulting Services and with other services across the organization
* Help senior team members in performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff/junior level team members
* Contribute to people related initiatives including recruiting and retaining IAM professionals
* Understand and follow workplace policies and procedures
* Manage the performance management for the direct reportees, as per the organization policies
* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Participating in the organization-wide people initiatives

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong hands-on experience in okta administration, with the ability to translate business and security requirements into supportable technical configurations.
* Deep understanding of authentication and authorization concepts, including SSO, MFA, passwordless authentication, phishing resistance, session management, and adaptive or risk-based access.
* Practical experience with Okta policies, rules, groups, profile mappings, authenticators, application assignments, directory integrations, user lifecycle management, and role-based administration.
* Working knowledge of SAML 2.0, Oauth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SWA, WS-Federation, SCIM, REST APIs, JSON, XML, and HTTP concepts.
* Experience in designing, testing, and troubleshooting provisioning and deprovisioning flows, group-based access, profile sourcing, attribute mappings, and downstream application behavior.
* Ability to use Splunk and Okta system log for operational monitoring, alert analysis, incident investigation, change validation, and audit evidence.
* Understanding of access-control models such as RBAC and ABAC, least privilege, privileged access, break-glass access, identity governance, and security control design.
* Good understanding of Access Management, Workforce and CIAM solutions.
* Strong Understanding of Okta API’s and good understanding of XML, HTML, CSS.
* Should be capable of dissecting large problems and designing modular, scalable solutions.
* Knowledge on FIDO, OAuth, Open ID connect and REST Concepts.
* Hands-on experience in setting up the Identity and Access Management environment in standalone and cluster environment.
* Hands-on experience on configuring the tool as per the requirements.
* Hands-on experience on Directory level integration with Okta for AD, LDAP, Azure AD, Oracle AD.
* Good Understanding on IWA and Okta Workflows.
* Hands-on experience on Okta APIs.
* Should be knowledge on Okta Access Gateway, Okta Advance Server Access and SCIM.
* Define and set up approach for risk-based MFA and applications access control.
* Hands-on experience on security related assessments and configuration for AM platforms, adaptive risk configurations and Multi-factor authentications.
* Capability of understanding the business requirements and converting that into design.
* Ability to perform risk assessment and threat modelling exercises with technology engineering teams.
* Should be flexible to work on new technologies in IAM domain.
* Worked in client facing role.
* Experience with ServiceNow, JIRA, Confluence, Bruno or Postman, Git-based version control, and enterprise change management processes.
* Need to be thorough in their respective tool with hands-on experience involving configuration, implementation & customization.
* Hands-on Java/Python development and debugging experience.
* Use case design, Solution Requirements Specification and mapping business requirements to technical requirements (Traceability Matrix).
* Involvement in a successful pursuit of a potential client by being part of the RFP response team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* 5-9 Years’ Work Experience in Identity and Access Management
* Experience implementing or supporting SSO, MFA, directory integrations, federation, lifecycle management, and application onboarding.
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Experience Access Management tools such as Okta, PingFed
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* Ability to participate in client-facing discussions and work effectively across on-site and offshore delivery models.

**Certification:**

* Okta certifications such as Okta Certified Professional, Administrator, Consultant, Developer, Workflows speciality.
* Security certifications such as CISSP, CISA, or an equivalent IAM/security certification.

**What We Look For**

* Who has hands on experience in setting up the Identity and Access Management environment in standalone and cluster environment.
* Who has hands-on Development experience on Application and Directory Integration, User Provisioning, Okta Workflows, triggers, Rules and customizing the tool as per the requirements.
* A structured problem solver who can break down complex authentication issues, validate assumptions with evidence, and drive issues to closure.
* A dependable team member who takes ownership, communicates early, documents clearly, and collaborates effectively across technical and business teams.
* A continuous learner who keeps pace with IAM threats, product changes, modern authentication standards, and automation opportunities.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**

With ambitious growth plans for the future and the global and local scale to achieve them, we continue to serve our customers and care for our

.
  
  
**Overview Of The Role**
Reporting to the Core HR & Systems Support Owner, this role supports the day-to-day administration, troubleshooting and resolve complex functional and technical issues of the HR Technology systems dealing primarily with Workday HCM solution integrating into the broader Global Operating Model. The position serves as the first point of contact for employee enquiries escalated by the Global Virtual Hub to HR Technology team, administers complex Workday transactional activities, Mass operation management, and supports the continual improvement of Workday HCM processes across a global, multi-country environment.
  
  
**TO EXCEL IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL NEED TO HAVE**
**Core Product**

* Workday Administration – Serve as primary Workday HCM administrator across modules including Core HCM, Compensation, Absence, Time Tracking, Recruiting, Talent & Performance, and Business Process Configuration
* Configuration Support – Assist with configuration of technical changes within Workday as directed by the Core HR & Systems Support Owner
* Bulk Administration – Administer bulk upload activities via EIB inbound integrations and Org Studio, as escalated by the Global Virtual Hub
* Continuous Improvement – Support initiatives surrounding continual improvement within Workday HCM and its interaction with associated core modules

**Leadership & Support**

* Client Service Delivery & Enablement – Serve as escalation point for HR Operations Teams and Provide Workday transactional support and training to the Global Virtual Hub to further build their technical support capability
* Cross-functional Collaboration - Assist People Systems Lead and Product team with system initiatives, cross-functional projects, and coordination across teams, and Ad-Hoc business requirements.
* Knowledge Transfer - Support training and knowledge transfer to team members and stakeholders

**Technical Operations**

* Issue Resolution – Troubleshoot and resolve Workday ERP functional issues, technical issues, configuration defects, and system-related challenges
* Stakeholder Liaison – Act as liaison between Global HR Operations and HR Tech Product Teams to meet business needs and support service delivery
* Quality Assurance - Support comprehensive unit testing completion before partnering with Tech Assurance team for system test and UAT
* Cross-functional Collaboration – Collaborate with HR, business stakeholders, and IT teams to resolve queries and support Workday HCM solutions and associated People Systems ERPs
* Escalation Handling – Act as first point of contact for system-related queries escalated by the Global Virtual Hub, through to resolution
* Technical Support - Provide first-line technical support, liaising with HR Operations Teams, End-Users, Business Stakeholders, Customer Experience and Centre of Excellence teams

**Strategic Alignment**

* Technology Administration - Assist with administration of new HR technologies (Workday, Docusign, Beamery, Glantus, etc) globally
* Global Process Support – Support global HR processes and enterprise-scale Workday HCM environments and assist with implementation of new HR technologies globally
* Communication – Communicate technical and functional concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Meeting Participation - Participate in Team meetings, issue log calls, product and project meetings to support business delivery and knowledge sharing

**Skills And Capabilities**

* Workday Knowledge: Good experience in Workday HCM configuration, maintenance, production support, and enhancements; familiarity with business processes (joiner, mover, leaver), organizational structures, and integrations (EIB inbound, Org Studio) is desirable. And knowledge of SDLC is a plus.
* Technical Tooling : Exposure to ticketing and case management tools such as HR Help, Salesforce, JIRA etc. is required.
* HR Process Knowledge: Fair understanding of Workday HCM business processes and global HR operations within enterprise-scale environments
* Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills : Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex functional and technical issues, with developing problem-solving abilities to assess needs and investigate solutions
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical audiences
* Team Collaboration: To work cohesively as a strong team player & Ability to work effectively within a range of stakeholders and People Technology teams.
* Self-Management: Willingness to upskill in technology and learn new skills and systems; ability to operate and partner within a People Technology team and demonstrate collaborative work style with developing experience in self-managing and monitoring workload effectively

***Preferred Experience Level:***
3 to 5 years of Workday Techno-Functional expertise.
  
  
**Benefits We Offer**

* Access to Learnerbly, Udemy, and a Self-Development Fund for upskilling.
* Career growth through Internal Mobility Programs .
* Comprehensive Health Insurance for you and dependents.
* Coverage of OPD Consultations and Full Body health checkup every year.

* Hybrid Model: 2 office days/week with flexible leave policies, including maternity, paternity, and sabbaticals.

* Employer PF Contribution , gratuity, Personal Accident & Life Insurance.
* Sharesave Plan to purchase discounted company shares.

B.E/MTech/B.Tech/ME

ITIL Foundation Qualified (Certified Preferred)

8-10+ Years

* ACC/SRS
* CA1
* DFHSM
* DFSMS
* IBM Utilities/Exits
* ICF Catalogs
* DB2 and IMS
* Storage Admin perspective
* REXX

* Experience working closely with z/OS systems programmers.

**Desired Skills**

* FICON protocols and multi‑pathing concepts
* I/O performance diagnostics (RMF, SMF, DCOLLECT)

**Work Timings\***
Monday - Friday

Rotational Shifts (Shift1/Shift2)
  
  
24/7 Oncall on rotational basis

We are currently seeking a Software Development Senior Analyst to join our team in Hyderabad, Telangana (IN-TG), India (IN).
  
  
**Job Title: PLM Teamcenter & CAD/CAE Support Consultant**
**Role Overview**
The PLM Teamcenter & CAD/CAE Support consultant is responsible for the administration, support, enhancement, and continuous improvement of Siemens Teamcenter PLM environments while providing leadership across CAD/CAE support functions. This role ensures the stability, performance, and reliability of PLM systems, drives process optimization, manages upgrades and integrations, and collaborates with cross-functional engineering, manufacturing, and IT teams to support product development initiatives.

* System Administration & Support

+ Deliver technical support for Teamcenter users and resolve issues promptly.
+ Manage user access, permissions, and data integrity within Teamcenter.
+ Monitor system performance and implement improvements.

* Maintenance & Upgrades

+ Plan and execute Teamcenter maintenance patches and major version upgrades.
+ Maintain and modify Teamcenter Business Modeler IDE (BMIDE) configurations.
+ Administer Active Workspace deployments and configurations.

* Enhancements & Integration

+ Deploy new Teamcenter features and solutions, including Supplier Collaboration Framework.
+ Support integration with CAD, ERP, and manufacturing systems.

* Documentation & Training

+ Develop and maintain technical documentation for configurations and processes.
+ Provide training and guidance to end-users and junior support staff.

* Collaboration

+ Work closely with engineering, manufacturing, and IT teams to improve PLM workflows.
+ Participate in global PLM enhancement projects and rollouts.
+ Knowledge and awareness on CAD/CAE best practices.
+ Lead cross-functional meetings to align simulation outputs with design goals.
+ Communicate technical findings to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.
+ Contribute to project planning, risk assessment, and design validation strategies.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* Experience:

+ 5+ years in Teamcenter administration, customization, and support.
+ Strong knowledge of PLM principles and Siemens Teamcenter architecture.

* Technical Skills:

+ Teamcenter BMIDE, ITK development, Active Workspace configuration.
+ Familiarity with integrations (CAD, ERP systems).

* Soft Skills:

+ Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
+ Ability to lead and mentor support teams.

* Experience with Teamcenter visualization and NX integration.
* Knowledge of Agile or Scrum methodologies.
* Exposure to automotive, aerospace, or discrete manufacturing domains.

title: Sr Engineer, Applications
description:
**When you join Accurate Background, you’re an integral part of making every hire the start of a success story. Your contributions will help us fulfill our mission of advancing the background screening experience through visibility and insights, empowering our clients to make smarter, unbiased decisions.**
**Job Description**
The Software Engineer (Production Support) ensures the stability and performance of our world-class background check platform. This role is dedicated to real-time monitoring, troubleshooting, and code-level defect resolution during critical business hours. You will work cross-functionally with infrastructure and security teams to maintain high system availability.
  
  
**Shift Timings**
This role requires flexibility to work in a rotational shift environment to provide extended coverage:
  
  

* Afternoon Shift: 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM
* Night Shift: 5:00 PM – 2:00 AM

**Responsibilities (Duties)**

* Application Support: Provide high-priority troubleshooting and issue resolution across all environments.
* Incident Management: Monitor system health and respond to application alerts during night-shift operations to ensure zero downtime.
* Defect Resolution: Debug, analyze, and implement code fixes for production issues using C#, .NET Core, and ASP.NET. .
* Root Cause Analysis: Perform investigations into system failures and implement permanent fixes.
* Deployment Support: Manage and support build and deployment processes (CI/CD) during off-peak hours.
* Communication: Provide clear handovers between shifts and updates to stakeholders on critical production incidents.

**Qualifications**

* Qualifications
* Education: BE/BTech/MS in Computer Science or equivalent.
* Experience: 4+ years of experience in .NET development or production support.
* Backend Tech: C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, ADO.NET, Entity Framework, LINQ, Web API, Microservices Architecture.
* Web Services: RESTful APIs, JSON, XML, SOAP, API integrations.
* Database/Servers: SQL Server, MongoDB, MySQL, IIS, Windows Server.
* Messaging & Caching: RabbitMQ, SQS, Redis, Memcached.
* Frontend: Ability to debug UI issues in Angular, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
* DevOps & Tools: Experience with Azure DevOps, Jenkins, AWS Code Build, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Cloud Exposure: Working knowledge of AWS and/or Azure environments.
* Mindset: Self-starter who can work independently during extended support hours with minimal supervision and strong ownership of production incidents.
* Key Skills

C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, Web API, SQL Server, IIS, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Redis, RabbitMQ, MongoDB, Microservices, Production Support, Incident Management, RCA, CI/CD, Troubleshooting.
  
  
**The Accurate Way**
We offer a fun, fast-paced environment, with lots of room for growth. We have an unwavering commitment to diversity, ensuring everyone has a complete sense of belonging here. To do this, we follow four guiding principles – Take Ownership, Be Open, Stay Curious, Work as One – core values that dictate what we stand for, and how we behave.
  
  
**Take ownership.**
Be accountable for your actions, your team, and the company. Accept responsibility willingly, especially when it’s what’s best for our customers. Give others every reason to trust you, believe in you, and count on you. Rise to every occasion with your personal best.
  
  
**Be open.**
Be open to new ideas. Be inclusive of people and ways of doing things. Make yourself accessible and approachable, and communicate with genuineness, transparency, honesty, and respect. Embrace differences.
  
  
**Stay curious.**
Stay curious even as you move forward. Tirelessly ask questions and challenge the status quo in your pursuit of new ideas, ways to solve problems, and to continually grow and improve.
  
  
**Work as one.**
Work together to create the best customer and workplace experience. Put our customers and employees first—before individual or departmental agendas. Make sure they get the help they need to succeed.
  
  
**Equal opportunities**
Accurate is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to hiring talented and qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Accurate will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws.
  
  
You must have a right to work in Australia indefinitely that does not involve sponsorship by the Company.

title: Consumer & Shop Insights Assoc Analyst
description:
**Overview**

* Deliver Social Intelligence and Consumer Insights projects across brands, markets and business questions, including innovation, communications, brand strategy, consumer trends and foresight.
* Translate business challenges into structured social-listening and research studies, supported by clear analytical plans.
* Combine qualitative and Quantitative data, which helps explain consumer motivations and the reasons behind behavior.
* Independently manage projects from initial scoping and brief alignment through analysis, storytelling, recommendations and final presentation.
* Convert complex findings into concise, compelling and actionable narratives for business and Insights stakeholders.
* Contribute to the continued development of PepsiCo’s Social Intelligence capability through knowledge sharing, best-practice development and stakeholder education.
* Work closely with Global Insights and business teams across cultures and markets.

**Responsibilities**

* Act as a Social Intelligence expert, with a strong focus on delivering insights
* Understanding the PepsiCo/Pepsi Lipton trends framework, leverage available technology stack and provide insights
* Understand business requirements and convert them into structured research approaches and deliverables.
* Lead projects end to end, including brief alignment, analysis, report development and presentation of results.
* Analyse digital conversations, consumer trends and market signals using tools such as Talkwalker, Trendscope, Tastewise and ConvoTrack.
* Integrate multiple quantitative and qualitative data sources to explain both what is happening and why it is happening.
* Conduct in-depth analyses with limited or no external support.
* Ensure high standards of data quality, validation and analytical rigour.
* Present findings and recommendations to Pepsi Lipton and regional business teams.
* Manage multiple projects, stakeholders and priorities while meeting agreed timelines and quality standards.
* Build strong stakeholder relationships, understand the business context and provide regular project updates.
* Partner with Global Insights and business teams to adopt and scale internal best practices.
* Help strengthen the Social Intelligence capability by improving ways of working and enabling others to use insight tools and analytics effectively.

**Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in market research, marketing, business, social sciences, analytics or a related discipline.
* 5–7 years of relevant experience in Social Listening, consumer insights, market research, analytics, marketing, competitive intelligence or a related function.
* Experience in an FMCG, food and beverage or consumer-focused organization is preferred.
* Hands-on experience using Social Listening or digital analytics platforms
* Experience analysing multiple data sources and translating findings into consumer and business insights.
* Experience conducting in-depth consumer research and presenting findings to business teams.
* Exposure to both qualitative and quantitative research, with qualitative research experience preferred.
* Understanding of brand and innovation strategy processes and the contribution of Insights at different stages.
* Preferable to have experience on trends, foresight, consumer behaviour, innovation, flavours, ingredients, health benefits or related strategic topics.
* Proven experience planning and delivering projects in a complex, multi-stakeholder environment.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English. Strong PowerPoint, report-writing and presentation capabilities.

title: Performance Marketer
description:
**About The Opportunity**

* Freedom With AI is an AI education and technology company based in Hyderabad, running one of India's most-enrolled AI learning communities with 4.8 lakh+ learners across 80+ countries. The company helps working professionals use AI tools to grow their careers and income, with a flagship free AI masterclass that converts into paid upskilling programs.

Role & Responsibilities
  
  

* Own paid campaigns across Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube TrueView, and WhatsApp — strategy, execution, and optimisation.
* Drive the full webinar funnel: registration volume, show-up rate, and masterclass-to-paid conversion — not just the top of the funnel.
* Build and maintain the performance dashboard tracking CAC, CPL, webinar show-up rate, and cost per paid enrollment — shared weekly with the founder.
* Run structured A/B tests on creatives, copy, audiences, and landing pages — document every learning, scale what works, kill what doesn't.
* Manage the paid budget tightly — we're bootstrapped and every rupee needs to justify itself.
* Feed audience intelligence back into product, content, and community decisions.

**Skills & Qualifications**
Must-Have
  
  

* 3–6 years running paid campaigns independently — not assisting. You own the numbers and can name them.
* Hands-on Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads at real monthly spend — tell us your number when you apply.
* YouTube TrueView and WhatsApp click-to-chat campaigns — built and optimised independently.
* Experience running A/B tests with structured documentation of learnings.
* Webinar or event registration funnel experience specifically — you know the difference between optimising for registrations vs show-up rate vs downstream paid conversion.
* GA4, Meta Ads Manager, and spreadsheet modelling are daily tools — not things you occasionally open.
* Ability to read attribution data, identify funnel drop-offs, and act on them without being told.
* Comfortable building performance dashboards from scratch — not just reading ones someone else built.
* Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, YouTube Ads — must-have.
* GA4, Meta Pixel, Google Tag Manager — must-have.
* Daily usage of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) in your own workflow — non-negotiable at an AI company.

**Preferred**

* WhatsApp Business API or click-to-chat campaigns — strong plus.
* CRM or marketing automation (GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or similar) — a plus.
* Experience in edtech, D2C, or any high-consideration funnel where the lead-to-paid journey is 3–7 days.
* Worked at a bootstrapped or early-stage company — budget discipline as a skill, not a complaint.
* Campaigns in Hindi or targeting Tier 2/3 India — strong plus.
* Strong independent execution — takes context and runs without repeated follow-ups.

Benefits & Culture Highlights
  
  

* Own the entire paid acquisition function — your decisions drive every rupee of marketing spend.
* Direct access to the founder — no layers, no approvals loop, fast decisions.
* Build from scratch — there is no existing performance marketing engine. You build it.
* Direct impact on 4.8 lakh+ learners across 80+ countries.
* Base + quarterly performance bonus tied to ROAS and enrollment targets — your ceiling is your results.
* Clear progression path to Head of Marketing as the team scales.
* Free access to all Freedom With AI programs — learn what you're selling.
