title: Search Engine Optimization Specialist
description:
**About HighRadius**

HighRadius provides a single Agentic AI platform for the Office of the CFO. It integrates 180+ agents that orchestrate end-to-end processes across Order-to-Cash, Close & Reconciliation, Consolidation & Reporting, Accounts Payable, B2B Payments, and Treasury. HighRadius guarantees operational KPI improvements by mapping them to specific agents on the platform. With a 3-6 month go-live period, HighRadius drives value creation at 1300+ enterprises such as 3M, Unilever, Bristol-Myers Squibb Company, Red Bull, Lufthansa, and more. HighRadius has been consistently recognized as a market leader by Gartner, IDC, and Forrester.

**Job Summary**

Responsible for driving the overarching organic search strategy to increase high-intent traffic, enhance search visibility, and directly contribute to the company's revenue pipeline. By balancing technical site health, intent-driven content creation, and international localization, this role ensures our global web presence captures and converts prospective buyers. The ideal candidate is a strategic, data-driven person who seamlessly translates complex search algorithms into actionable business growth while partnering effectively across marketing, web, and regional teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and execute the global SEO strategy across corporate, product, solution, industry, resource, and regional websites to increase qualified organic traffic, search visibility, and pipeline contribution.
* Lead technical SEO audits and partner with the Web Manager, developers, and external agencies to resolve issues related to crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, schema markup, redirects, canonicalization, internal linking, and site performance.
* Develop and execute backlink and authority-building strategies, including competitor backlink analysis, digital PR opportunities, outreach campaigns, and link acquisition initiatives.
* Conduct keyword research and build SEO content strategies for product pages, solution pages, blogs, comparison pages, glossary pages, and topic clusters in partnership with Product Marketing and Content teams.
* Support international SEO initiatives by optimizing localized websites through regional keyword research, hreflang implementation, metadata optimization, and localization best practices.
* Monitor SEO performance using Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, and other SEO platforms; translate insights into actionable recommendations and business impact.
* Collaborate closely with Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Web Development, Analytics, Regional Marketing, and external agencies to align SEO initiatives with campaign goals and revenue objectives.
* Own SEO reporting across rankings, organic traffic, conversions, MQLs, pipeline influence, and competitive performance while providing regular updates and strategic recommendations to leadership

**Skills & Experience Needed**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field.
* 4–5 years of progressive SEO experience in a B2B SaaS company, with demonstrated ownership of technical SEO and organic growth initiatives.
* Strong expertise in Technical SEO, including website audits, Core Web Vitals, schema markup, international SEO, and website migrations.
* Hands-on experience with SEO tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, and Looker Studio.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills with the ability to translate SEO insights into measurable business outcomes.

* Contribute to capability-building initiatives, knowledge-sharing forums, and process improvement projects.
* Foster a collaborative and high-performing team culture focused on accountability, innovation, and continuous learning.

****Skills And Experience****

* Media Planning teams are experts on the digital media landscape and how consumers interact with it. We architect and steward holistic media plans throughout their lifecycle, owning the creation of overall plans, cross-channel budget allocation, in-flight cross-channel optimization & reporting and post-campaign analysis. We are our clients’ key contacts for a unified view across all aspects of their campaigns, narrating the story of the campaign from planning recommendation through to PCA.
* 6–8 years of experience in media planning, integrated communications planning, or digital strategy roles, preferably within a global agency environment.
* Strong understanding of integrated media channels including digital, social, search, commerce, video, programmatic, impact buys and other non biddable emerging media.
* Proven experience managing teams in a fast-paced offshore/onshore delivery setup.
* Experience handling multi-market campaigns and collaborating with global stakeholders.

* Excellent analytical and strategic thinking capabilities with a data-driven approach to planning and optimization.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively.
* Experience with media planning tools, reporting dashboards, and planning frameworks.
* Strong presentation and storytelling capabilities.
* Ability to identify process improvement opportunities and drive operational efficiencies.
* Strong coaching and people management skills with experience developing high-performing teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a dynamic environment.

****Life At WPP Media & Benefits****
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. title: Demand Generation Marketer (B2B SaaS)
description:
**About the role**

 

We're hiring a hands-on demand generation marketer to build pipeline for our sales team. You'll plan and run campaigns across email, webinars, SEO and paid ads on LinkedIn and Google. You'll write the messaging and landing pages that turn interest into sales conversations, and use data to decide where the next dollar of budget should go.
 

**What you'll do**

 

* Plan and run multi-channel demand generation campaigns across email, webinars, content distribution, SEO, LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads, from brief through launch and optimisation.
* Write campaign copy yourself: ads, emails, landing pages and webinar invites. You'll turn CloudNuro's value proposition into messaging that lands with IT and finance buyers.
* Build and update landing pages in Webflow, and run A/B tests on pages, emails and creative to improve conversion.
* Run webinars and virtual events end to end, covering topic selection, promotion, registration and follow-up nurture.
* Build nurture flows and maintain lead scoring with the sales team, so MQLs reach our BDRs quickly and with the right context.
* Own SEO basics, including keyword research, on-page optimisation and content briefs.
* Report on traffic, conversions, MQLs, cost-per-lead and pipeline influenced, and turn those numbers into clear recommendations.
* Work closely with sales, product and design on ICP, messaging and campaign priorities.

**What you'll bring**

 

*Must have*

 

* 4+ years in demand generation, growth or performance marketing, ideally at a B2B SaaS or technology company.
* Campaigns you personally owned, with results you can talk through: MQLs generated, cost-per-lead and conversion rates.
* Strong writing skills. You'll write most of your own campaign copy.
* Working knowledge of HubSpot or Marketo and GA4, including UTMs and conversion tracking.
* Comfort working with data and building simple performance reports.

*Nice to have*

 

* Basic HTML and CSS for editing landing pages.
* Experience marketing to IT, finance or other technical buyers.

**How success is measured**

 

* MQL volume and quality, including MQL-to-SQL conversion.
* Cost-per-lead and campaign conversion rates.
* Landing page conversion improvements.
* Pipeline influenced by marketing.
* Organic traffic and keyword ranking growth.

title: B2B Lead Generation Specialist – US Market
description:
**Job Title:**

B2B Lead Generation Specialist – International Business Development

**Target Market:**

United States (US)

**Department:**

Sales & Business Development

**Experience:**

0–3 Years (preferred)

**Job Location:**

Hyderabad, India

**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive and results-driven
**B2B Lead Generation Specialist**

to support our international business development initiatives, primarily targeting the US market. The candidate will be responsible for building and maintaining high-quality B2B prospect databases, scraping and validating business contact information, executing email marketing campaigns, and generating qualified leads through LinkedIn outreach and cold calling.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with lead research, data extraction, email marketing, database management, and multichannel outbound prospecting to help build a consistent pipeline of potential business clients.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. B2B Lead Research & Database Building**

* Research and identify potential B2B clients in the US market based on target industries, company size, geography, and ideal customer profiles (ICPs).
* Build targeted prospect databases containing company names, websites, industry details, contact names, job titles, business email addresses, phone numbers, and LinkedIn profiles.
* Identify key decision-makers, including founders, CEOs, directors, department heads, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Use tools such as Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and other B2B data platforms to source relevant prospects.

**2. Database Scraping & Data Extraction**

* Extract business and contact information from relevant online sources, business directories, company websites, LinkedIn, and approved prospecting platforms.
* Use database scraping and data extraction tools to build targeted prospect lists efficiently.
* Segment prospect databases based on industry, company size, location, job title, and other campaign-specific criteria.
* Maintain organized, structured, and reusable lead databases for ongoing sales and marketing campaigns.
* Follow applicable platform terms, data protection requirements, and responsible data collection practices.

**3. Database Validation & Enrichment**

* Validate business email addresses to reduce bounce rates and improve email deliverability.
* Verify contact details, company information, job titles, website URLs, and LinkedIn profiles for accuracy.
* Identify and remove duplicate, outdated, irrelevant, and invalid records.
* Enrich existing databases with missing business information and relevant decision-maker details.
* Maintain database hygiene through regular cleaning, validation, segmentation, and updates.

**4. LinkedIn Prospecting & Outreach**

* Use LinkedIn and Sales Navigator to identify relevant decision-makers and target accounts.
* Execute targeted LinkedIn connection campaigns and personalized outreach sequences.
* Follow up with prospects to initiate conversations, assess interest, and identify potential business opportunities.
* Track connection acceptance, engagement, replies, and qualified leads generated.

**5. Email Marketing & Outbound Campaigns**

* Plan, execute, and manage targeted B2B email marketing and cold email campaigns for the US market.
* Create personalized email sequences, including introductory emails, follow-ups, and re-engagement messages.
* Segment email lists based on industry, company profile, job title, and campaign objectives.
* Manage campaign scheduling, contact uploads, audience segmentation, and follow-up sequences using email marketing and outreach platforms.
* Monitor email delivery, bounce rates, replies, positive responses, unsubscribes, and other campaign performance metrics.
* Optimize email subject lines, messaging, personalization, and campaign sequences to improve engagement and lead generation.
* Follow applicable email marketing regulations, maintain suppression lists, and respect opt-out requests.

**6. Cold Calling & Lead Qualification**

* Conduct outbound calls to US-based businesses to introduce company services and identify potential opportunities.
* Engage with decision-makers, understand business requirements, and qualify prospects based on relevance and potential interest.
* Schedule sales meetings and appointments for the business development team.
* Maintain accurate call notes, follow-up schedules, and prospect status updates.

**7. CRM & Database Management**

* Maintain accurate lead records, contact information, outreach history, and lead status in the CRM.
* Upload, organize, segment, and update prospect databases for sales and marketing activities.
* Track prospect interactions across LinkedIn, email, and phone.
* Ensure consistent follow-ups and maintain a structured pipeline of potential business opportunities.

**8. Reporting & Performance Tracking**

* Prepare daily and weekly reports covering database building, contacts validated, emails sent, calls completed, LinkedIn outreach, responses received, and qualified leads generated.
* Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve prospecting efficiency and conversion rates.
* Work with the business development team to refine target audiences, lead qualification criteria, and outreach strategies.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* 0–3 years of experience in B2B lead generation, database management, sales development, or international business development.
* Hands-on experience with B2B database scraping, contact extraction, and lead list building.
* Experience validating business email addresses and maintaining high-quality prospect databases.
* Practical knowledge of email marketing, cold email campaigns, and multichannel outreach.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, or similar prospecting platforms.
* Experience with CRM systems such as GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Understanding of lead segmentation, email deliverability, campaign analytics, and lead qualification.
* Strong research, data management, attention to detail, and follow-up skills.
* Ability to work toward measurable lead generation and appointment-setting targets.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience targeting US-based B2B companies and engaging with US decision-makers.
* Familiarity with email verification and enrichment tools such as NeverBounce, ZeroBounce, or similar platforms.
* Experience with email campaign and outreach tools such as GoHighLevel, Instantly, Smartlead, or equivalent platforms.
* Understanding of email authentication protocols, including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.
* Knowledge of data privacy requirements and applicable commercial email regulations.
* Experience managing high-volume prospect databases and multichannel outbound campaigns.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

* Performance will be evaluated based on:
* Number of relevant companies and contacts added to the database.
* Number and percentage of contact records successfully validated.
* Database accuracy, completeness, and duplicate rate.
* Email bounce rate and positive reply rate.
* LinkedIn connection acceptance and response rates.
* Number of outbound calls and meaningful conversations.
* Number of qualified leads generated.
* Number of sales meetings or appointments booked.
* CRM accuracy, follow-up consistency, and campaign reporting quality.

**Working Hours:**

The candidate should be flexible to align with US business hours when required for cold calling, live prospect engagement, and campaign coordination.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate combines strong research and data management skills with practical experience in outbound marketing. They should be comfortable sourcing and scraping business data, validating contact information, executing email marketing campaigns, and engaging prospects through LinkedIn and phone outreach.

The candidate should be detail-oriented, target-driven, and capable of building a reliable prospect pipeline that supports the company's international business development and revenue growth objectives.

title: Content Manager
description:
**About WPP Production**
We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.
  
  
**About WPP**
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
  
  
**A hybrid working model**
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
  
  
**What does a Content Manager do at WPP Production?**
The Content Management organization at WPP Production is responsible for publishing creative assets, experiences, and critical digital content to our client websites and other platforms across the globe. The Content Manager role reports to a Senior Content Manager and works closely with both the Content Management organization and external teams to ensure all client interactive deliverables are completed accurately and on time. This includes ownership of the content management and publishing operations in support of our client’s product launches and other digital marketing programs, including setting up and managing page structure and content in a CMS (content management system).
  
  
Core responsibilities of a Content Manager include day-to-day content management tasks, cross-functional collaboration across the Marcom organization, leading projects or initiatives from the content management perspective, and maintaining full knowledge of an ever-changing set of tools and processes.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**

* Own day-to-day content management operations and tasks in support of product launches, other marketing initiatives, and regular page maintenance
* Ensure the quality of deliverables to client
* Collaborate cross-functionally and proactively with internal and external teams, with high attention to communication standards
* Work with developer teams to plan page structures and agree upon project approaches
* Lead small projects with the support of the team
* Actively balance the work of multiple projects, assignments, and launches in a fast-paced, ever-evolving work environment
* Work within the content management org to contribute to documentation and training
* Maintain complete understanding of the complexities of CMS and other internal tools
* Troubleshoot system issues as a part of the first line of defense
* Contribute to the evolution of internal platforms and processes by providing feedback on toolsets, UI, best practices, and workflow optimization

**Requirements:**

* Minimum of 3 - 5 years experience working on web production teams
* Experience with localization and managing content for a global audience, using a CMS
* Deep knowledge of how content management and other related system processes work
* Experience working with a git client application (Tower, SourceTree, etc.) a plus
* Knowledge of HTML, XML, JSON, and enterprise CMS
* Record of troubleshooting and diagnosing CMS issues, and communicating those issues to both technical and non-technical personnel
* Demonstrated success in business process improvement and re-engineering
* Proven ability to manage ambiguity effectively
* Experience creating/managing internal tools a plus
* Excellent communication skills, and a demonstrated ability to work with others in an unpredictable environment
* Flexible personality to deal with rapidly-changing, time-constrained launch schedules
* High degree of ownership and accountability
* Ability to balance multiple project or assignments
* Highly detail-oriented, organized, and patient.

**Why work here:**
At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.
  
  
**Inclusion and Impact**
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
**Data**
We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.
  
  
**Please contact careers@wppproduction.com if you need the job advert or form in another format.**

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around three days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
  
  
**What does Senior Content Manager do at WPP Production?**
The Content Management organization at WPP Production is responsible for publishing creative assets, experiences, and critical digital content to our client websites and other platforms across the globe. A Senior Content Manager reports to the Manager, Content Management and manages a team that works closely with both the Content Management organization and external teams to ensure all client interactive deliverables are completed accurately and on time. This includes ownership of the content management and publishing operations in support of our client’s product launches and other digital marketing programs, including setting up and managing page structure and content in a CMS (content management system).
  
  
Core responsibilities of a Senior Content Manager include managing team resources and performance, day-to-day content management tasks, cross-functional collaboration across the Marcom organization, leading projects or initiatives from the content management perspective, and maintaining full knowledge of an ever-changing set of tools and processes.
  
  
(Note: This is a role focused on top-quality content production and publishing, with strong experience in managing a team and optimizing processes and productivity. It is not a content creation, design, or marketing job.)
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own day-to-day content management operations and tasks in support of product launches, other marketing initiatives, and regular page maintenance
* Ensure the quality of deliverables to client
* Collaborate cross-functionally and proactively with internal and external teams
* High attention to communication standards
* Work with developer teams to plan page structures and agree upon project approaches
* Lead multiple projects with the support of the team
* Manage a team of Content Managers and other individual contributors across multiple projects, taking responsibility for meeting deadlines, driving quality and accuracy, estimating project resourcing, and overall performance of the team
* Actively balance the work of multiple projects, assignments, and launches in a fast-paced, ever-evolving work environment
* Build strong partnerships and increase satisfaction with our client by providing support, intelligent recommendations, and operational efficiencies.
* Work within the content management org to improve documentation and training
* Maintain complete understanding of the complexities of CMS and other internal tools
* Troubleshoot system issues as a part of the first line of defense
* Contribute to the evolution of internal platforms and processes by providing feedback on toolsets, UI, best practices, and workflow optimization

**Requirements:**

* A Bachelor’s degree or higher; preferably with a focus on marketing, design, or communication
* 5+ years experience working on web production teams
* 2+ years team and people management experience
* Experience with localization and managing content for a global audience, using a CMS
* Deep knowledge of how content management and other related system processes work
* Experience working with a git client application (Tower, SourceTree, etc.) a plus
* Knowledge of HTML, XML, JSON, and enterprise CMS
* Record of troubleshooting and diagnosing CMS issues, and communicating those issues to both technical and non-technical personnel
* Demonstrated success in business process improvement and re-engineering
* Demonstrated experience in assessing and optimizing team resources and time commitments, with an eye to increasing productivity and reducing costs
* Proven ability to manage ambiguity effectively
* Experience creating/managing internal tools a plus
* Excellent communication skills, and a demonstrated ability to work with others in an unpredictable environment
* Flexible personality and schedule to deal with rapidly-changing, time-constrained launch schedules
* High degree of ownership and accountability
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and diplomacy skills
* Must be a self starter and have a positive, energetic approach
* Ability to balance multiple projects or assignments
* Highly detail-oriented, organized, and patient
* Experience working with offshore teams

**Why work here:**
At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

description:

* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
The Development family is responsible for creating, designing, deploying, and supporting applications, programs, and software solutions. May include research, new development, prototyping, modification, reuse, re-engineering, maintenance, or any other activities related to software products used internally or externally on product platforms supported by the firm. The software development process requires in-depth subject matter expertise in existing and emerging development methodologies, tools, and programming languages. Software Developers work closely with business partners and / or external clients in defining requirements and implementing solutions. The Application Support Engineering role specializes in maintaining and providing technical support for all applications that are beyond the development stage and are running in the daily operations of the firm. Works closely with development teams, infrastructure partners, and internal / external clients to escalate and resolve technical support incidents.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities**

* Demonstrated experience with ITIL Change, Incident, and Problem Management processes.
* Lead the resolution of critical production issues by coordinating Major Incident calls, engaging appropriate teams, and driving root cause analysis to closure.
* Troubleshoot and debug application and system components within complex, highly regulated environments spanning on‑premise, cloud, and hybrid platforms.
* Review and analyze proposed application designs, identifying operational gaps and providing recommendations to improve performance, resiliency, and supportability.
* Hands‑on experience with monitoring and alerting across distributed, cloud, and mainframe environments.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity best practices, including access controls, password management, and malware detection.
* Participate in Monthly Service Reviews (MSR) with development partners to review KPIs, operational metrics, and service performance.
* Execute responsibilities during planned and unplanned Disaster Recovery and Loss‑of‑Region events, ensuring required tasks are completed and evidence is collected.
* Collaborate effectively within the team and across functional groups to resolve application issues and escalate when necessary.
* Support internal and external audit requests by providing accurate documentation and evidence in a timely manner.
* Plan and execute certificate creation and renewals as required to support secure application operations.
* Create, enhance, and monitor dashboards to improve observability and proactively identify potential issues.
* Demonstrated ability to gather, analyze, and translate project and operational requirements into technical specifications.
* Deep understanding of the full application lifecycle, including development, testing, deployment, and support.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively with technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
* Promote a culture of transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Review and validate analysis performed by team members and implement corrective actions to prevent incident recurrence.
* Resolve critical application alerts promptly, including production defects, providing clear business impact assessments and root‑cause analysis; support minor enhancements as needed.
* Review, update, and maintain knowledge articles and runbooks in partnership with application development teams to ensure accuracy and relevance.
* Validate and submit responses for audit‑related requests for information (RFI).
* Review and execute Disaster Recovery procedures and scripts during outages, ensuring Business Continuity Management (BCM) evidence is properly documented.
* Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve efficiency in application monitoring and support processes.
* Partner with development teams throughout the design and development lifecycle to ensure applications are operationally ready and supportable.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 4 years of related experience
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience
* Talents Needed for Success
* Mainframe troubleshooting and support skills (COBOL, JCL, DB2, DB2 Stored Procedures, CICS, SPUFI, File aid)
* Mainframe scheduling (Job abends, Predecessor/Successor)
* Hands on experience in Mainframe, Unix, Linux, Windows, SQL/PLSQL
* Familiarity working with relational databases (DB2, Oracle, Snowflake)

ORBCOMM is seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to help design, build, and operate scalable, secure, and resilient cloud infrastructure that powers our global business and customer-facing platforms. In this role, you will play a key part in advancing cloud modernization, automation, platform reliability, and operational excellence across our multi-cloud environments.

Based in Hyderabad, India, you will contribute to the evolution of ORBCOMM’s cloud platforms across Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), helping drive scalability, resiliency, and innovation across the organization.

This position is based in our Hyderabad office and will be working an onsite work schedule.

* Drive continuous improvements in infrastructure resiliency, recoverability, and operational maturity.

title: Software Engineering- Mulesoft, MTS/SMTS
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Software Engineering
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a forward-thinking
**Software Engineer**
to own, administer, and scale our MuleSoft integrations across our Finance systems landscape, supporting mission-critical business processes. In this role, you will serve as the primary process expert for your service area, keeping enterprise APIs running smoothly while working closely with developers, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to support end-to-end Salesforce business processes.
  
  
Beyond core administration, you will drive operational efficiency by analyzing support trends, identifying enhancements, and actively redesigning workflows by integrating AI agents alongside human support engineers. If you are agile, adaptable, and bridge the gap between enterprise integrations, platform reliability, and modern AI automation, this is your play.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**MuleSoft Platform & Finance Systems Administration**

* Core Administration: Lead day-to-day administration, configuration, scaling, and proactive monitoring of MuleSoft integrations supporting core Finance and enterprise systems across CloudHub 2.0 and Runtime Fabric.
* Environment & Security Governance: Manage runtime configurations, secrets, environment variables, TLS certificates, and OAuth security while maintaining strict segregation of duties.
* Lifecycle Operations: Execute application restarts, runtime upgrades, capacity scaling, and configuration updates with minimal system downtime.

**Application Support, Maintenance & Trend Analysis**

* Production & Incident Support: Resolve technical and functional system issues across enterprise applications, analyzing logs, alerts, metrics, and transaction traces to intercept failures early.
* Proactive Improvement: Perform trend analysis on recurring support tickets to identify root causes and implement system enhancements that reduce overall support volume.
* Salesforce & Ecosystem Alignment: Serve as a primary process expert collaborating with developers, QA, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to support end-to-end Salesforce workflows and deploy new functionality.

**AI-Driven Workflow & Process Automation**

* Agentic Workflows: Design and implement intelligent support systems where AI agents collaborate alongside human support engineers to resolve incidents faster.
* Process Transformation: Identify manual, repetitive IT and business processes across the organization and transform them into streamlined, automated workflows.
* Automation Health: Continuously monitor existing automations, troubleshoot pipeline failures, and optimize system performance.

**Release, Change Management & Governance**

* Deployment Pipelines: Oversee sandbox environments, UAT testing, and production releases using established CI/CD best practices.
* Cross-Functional Coordination: Align major releases, enhancements, and platform upgrades across business stakeholders and development teams.
* Documentation: Maintain comprehensive, audit-ready technical documentation for system configurations, integrations, and business processes.

**What You Bring**

* MuleSoft Mastery: 4+ years of hands-on administration and implementation experience using the Anypoint Platform (Runtime Manager, CloudHub/CloudHub 2.0, API Manager, Exchange, and Mule Runtime).
* Enterprise & Finance Ecosystem Connectivity: Proven experience supporting integrations connecting Salesforce, Workday, SAP Concur, Coupa, relational databases, SFTP, REST/SOAP APIs, and messaging queues.
* Technical Depth: Solid grasp of SOA patterns, API security standards, TLS/certificates, CI/CD toolchains, and log analysis tools.
* Agility & Innovation Mindset: A proactive problem-solver comfortable managing multiple competing priorities, experimenting with new tools, and embracing AI-driven workflows.
* Communication & Collaboration: Strong verbal and written communication skills with a track record of collaborating effectively with developers, QA, and business partners.

**Required Skills**

* A demonstrated, genuine AI-first approach to engineering — using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty.
* Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in development workflows.
* Advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production-ready.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: IT Operations Analyst [T500-30162]
description:
**Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients.**

**Who are we:**

Core Insurance Platforms (CIP) is Zurich’s global capability responsible for building, running, and evolving core insurance technology. We set a unified, scalable operating model—covering governance, standards, architecture, service delivery, and reuse—so our business units can deliver at speed and scale.

CIP is the strategic steward of Zurich’s Guidewire ecosystem, aligning platform roadmaps to business strategy while driving stability, modernization, reduced supplier dependency, and long term cost efficiency.

India delivery center is one of our global delivery and capability hub. We bring together experts in AI, engineering, analysis, quality, and architecture to deliver product & process solutions, application run services, change and transformation initiatives, and centralized platform services across both on prem and Guidewire Cloud environments. Our teams operate from multiple global delivery centers, supporting Zurich’s business units worldwide.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**New Employee Onboarding:**

* Coordinate end-to-end technology onboarding activities for new employees and contingent workers.
* Review onboarding requests to ensure required information has been provided and identify missing or incomplete requirements.
* Coordinate activities with hiring managers and supporting IT teams to promote Day 1 technology readiness.
* Track onboarding requests from initiation through completion and follow up on outstanding dependencies.
* Maintain accurate onboarding records and provide status visibility to stakeholders.
* Identify potential onboarding delays and coordinate resolution before the employee's scheduled start date.
* Support standardized onboarding profiles based on employee role and technology requirements.

**System Access Provisioning:**

* Coordinate the provisioning of required system and application access.
* Manage or validate appropriate Active Directory security groups, shared resources, and access requirements.
* Work with identity management and application support teams when provisioning requires specialized fulfillment.
* Verify that required access has been completed and identify outstanding access dependencies.
* Troubleshoot and escalate provisioning issues that could affect employee readiness.

**Hardware and Software Provisioning:**

* Coordinate the ordering and preparation of laptops, monitors, docking stations, peripherals, and other approved equipment.
* Use
  **COUPA**
  and applicable procurement processes to facilitate hardware purchasing and monitor fulfillment.
* Coordinate required software installation based on employee role and business requirements.
* Track equipment orders and resolve or escalate fulfillment issues.
* Coordinate delivery or availability of equipment based on an employee's work location.

**ServiceNow Request Management:**

* Use
  **ServiceNow**
  as a primary platform for managing onboarding requests and associated IT work.
* Monitor assigned onboarding requests and related fulfillment activities.
* Maintain accurate ticket status, notes, assignments, and completion information.
* Coordinate dependencies across technical teams and escalate issues when necessary.
* Ensure requests are appropriately completed and documented.

**Scheduling and Coordination:**

* Schedule and coordinate onboarding-related activities with new employees, hiring managers, technicians, and supporting teams.
* Coordinate technology setup or installation appointments when required.
* Communicate upcoming onboarding schedules and outstanding requirements.
* Adjust schedules when equipment, access, employee availability, or other dependencies change.
* Provide clear status communication throughout the onboarding process.

**Reporting, Data Management and Automation:**

* Maintain onboarding data using
  **Excel, SharePoint, and ServiceNow**
  .
* Use Excel to analyze onboarding data, identify exceptions, reconcile information, and support operational reporting.
* Maintain accurate SharePoint lists and other onboarding data repositories where applicable.
* Use
  **Power Automate**
  to support workflow automation, notifications, reminders, data updates, and process improvements.
* Identify repetitive manual activities that may be candidates for automation.
* Support reporting that measures onboarding completion and operational effectiveness.

**Qualifications:**

**Must have Skills:**

Candidates should have working knowledge or experience with:

* **ServiceNow**
  : Request, incident, task, workflow, and onboarding ticket management
* **Active Directory**
  : User accounts, security groups, and access administration
* **Microsoft Intune**
  : Endpoint management, device configuration, and application deployment
* **Microsoft Excel**
  : Data tracking, filtering, reconciliation, formulas, and reporting
* **Microsoft SharePoint**
  : Lists, documentation, collaboration, and operational data management
* **Microsoft Power Automate**
  : Workflow automation, notifications, approvals, and data integration
* **COUPA**
  : Hardware purchasing, procurement, and order management
* Microsoft 365 applications and Windows endpoint environments.

**Core Competencies:**

**Organization and Attention to Detail:**

* Ability to manage multiple employees, start dates, orders, access requests, and technical dependencies simultaneously while maintaining accurate records.

**Customer Focus:**

* Strong commitment to providing new employees and hiring managers with a professional, responsive, and positive onboarding experience.

**Communication:**

* Ability to communicate clearly with new employees, hiring managers, technical teams, procurement teams, and other stakeholders.

**Ownership and Follow-Through:**

* Ability to take ownership of onboarding requests and proactively follow outstanding activities through resolution rather than simply handing work between teams.

**Problem Solving:**

* Ability to identify onboarding roadblocks, investigate their cause, engage the appropriate technical teams, and coordinate resolution.

**Process Improvement:**

* Ability to identify inefficient or repetitive processes and recommend opportunities for standardization or automation.

**Collaboration:**

* Ability to work effectively across End User Computing, Access Management, Procurement, application support, hiring managers, and other teams involved in onboarding.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting IT new-hire onboarding or employee lifecycle processes.
* Experience in an enterprise IT support or End User Computing environment.
* Experience coordinating hardware, software, and system-access provisioning.
* Experience with ServiceNow request or workflow management.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 technologies and endpoint management.
* Experience with purchasing or procurement processes.
* Experience developing or supporting workflow automation using Power Automate.
* Strong Excel data-management and reporting skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

title: Sr. Specialist DDIT IES CHS AI Infra. Engineering
description:
**Summary**
Sr Spec DDIT IES cloud Engineer will be responsible for designing, engineering, implementing, and operating enterprise AI infrastructure and platform capabilities that enable secure, scalable, and governed adoption of AI technologies across the enterprise.
  
  
The role will focus on engineering enterprise AI platforms, developer environments, infrastructure, automation, and enterprise integrations across SaaS AI platforms, cloud AI services, hybrid, and on-premises environments. The role will collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Hybrid Infrastructure, Security, Identity & Access Management, Networking, End User Computing, Operations, AI Enablement, and Business Technology teams.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, engineer, deploy, and support enterprise AI infrastructure and platform capabilities.
* Onboard and integrate enterprise AI platforms with enterprise identity, networking, security, monitoring, and operational services.
* Engineer AI developer environments, AI workspaces, API connectivity, model access, and platform integrations.
* Develop reusable platform components, reference implementations, and engineering patterns to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.
* Develop Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform, CFT, Bicep, ARM, Ansible, or equivalent technologies.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for provisioning, configuration, deployment, and lifecycle management of AI platforms.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning, platform operations, configuration management, and operational workflows using scripting and DevOps practices.
* Implement platform monitoring, logging, observability, backup, disaster recovery, high availability, and performance optimization solutions.
* Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, networking, platform, and integration issues across enterprise AI environments.
* Support operational excellence through proactive monitoring, incident resolution, and continuous service improvement.

**Essential Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in AI Infrastructure Engineering, Cloud Engineering and DevOps toolsets
* Relevant Cloud, Kubernetes, DevOps, Security, or AI certifications.
* Experience engineering enterprise AI platforms supporting Generative AI and AI-enabled workloads.
* Understanding of LLMs, AI APIs, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP), vector databases, model access patterns, and enterprise AI platform architecture.
* Enterprise AI ecosystems such as ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude, Gemini, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, AgentCore, Vertex AI, Strands Agents SDK, LangGraph, CrewAI, Run.AI or SLURM or open-source AI platforms.
* Kubernetes & Container Platforms
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevSecOps & CI/CD

**Desirable Requirements**

* AWS & Azure Monitor, Prometheus, Grafana, Log Analytics, Kusto Query Language (KQL), or equivalent monitoring platforms
* AI Developer Platforms (JupyterLab, VS Code, AI Workstations, Claude Cowork).

Please include the job requisition number in your message.
  
  
**Why Novartis:**
Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture

Learn about all the ways we’ll help you thrive personally and professionally.

title: Yoga Pilates Instructor
description:
**Company Description**
CORELINE is a premium fitness and wellness lounge that blends intelligent movement, intentional living, and timeless wellness experiences in a modern, minimalist setting. Based in Hyderabad, India, the studio integrates Pilates, advanced strength training, EMS, yoga/therapy , and curated recovery therapies such as sauna and cold plunge. It offers bespoke movement programs, private sessions, and community-led experiences that emphasize balance, resilience, and everyday vitality. With an integrated wellness café and workshops, CORELINE creates a sanctuary for meaningful connection, learning, and long-term transformation. The vision is to set a new benchmark in luxury wellness by refining foundations and building alignment, strength, and longevity with precision and care.

**Role Description**
The Yoga & Pilates Instructor at CORELINE is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad. This role involves leading group and private yoga and Pilates sessions, designing intelligent, safe, and effective class formats aligned with CORELINE’s philosophy of intentional movement and long-term wellness. The instructor will guide clients through mindful practice, support correct form and alignment, and collaborate with the team to integrate recovery modalities and cross-training when appropriate. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting sessions, preparing class plans, tracking client progress, providing personalized feedback, and contributing to community events, workshops, and wellness programs. The role also includes fostering an inclusive, calm studio environment, supporting member onboarding, and ensuring a high standard of customer experience.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Pilates Instruction, including mat and/or equipment-based methods, with an emphasis on safe alignment and progressive training.
* Candidates should possess experience in leading Group Exercise sessions, with the ability to manage class energy, adapt to varied fitness levels, and maintain a welcoming environment.
* Candidates should possess knowledge in Physical Therapy or functional movement principles, enabling them to design sessions that support mobility, stability, and injury prevention.
* Candidates should possess solid Customer Service and client care skills, including active listening, empathy, and professional communication in a luxury wellness setting.
* Candidates should possess Teaching and coaching abilities, including clear cueing, demonstration, and the capacity to educate clients on movement, breath, and body awareness.
* Relevant certifications in Yoga and Pilates from recognized institutions are required; additional qualifications in fitness, rehabilitation, or wellness coaching are an advantage.
* Prior experience working in premium fitness or wellness studios is beneficial, along with the ability to collaborate within a multidisciplinary team.
* Comfort working flexible hours, including early mornings, evenings, and weekends, and a commitment to maintaining a clean, safe, and inclusive studio space.

title: Cyber-DT&P -IAM-SailPoint ISC- Senior Consultant (CMF)
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Join Deloitte’s Cyber & Strategic Risk practice and help clients strengthen identity security across complex enterprise environments. As a Senior Consultant - Sailpoint Developer, you will support the design, development, and implementation of identity and access management solutions that help organizations protect systems, data, and user access. This role offers the opportunity to work across large-scale IAM engagements while deepening your experience in a growing, technology-enabled risk practice.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant - Sailpoint Developer on the Cyber & Strategic Risk team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Designing and implementing identity and access management solutions for client environments
* Configuring, customizing, and developing IAM integrations based on business and technical requirements
* Supporting requirements gathering, design documentation, testing, deployment, and application support across multiple engagements
* Troubleshooting IAM issues, performing post-design configuration activities, and coordinating with technology vendors as needed
* Contributing to proposals, practice development activities, process compliance initiatives, and security best practices

**The team**
Cyber & Strategic Risk
  
  
The cyber risk services—IAM practice helps organizations in designing, developing, and implementing industry-leading IAM solutions to protect their information and confidential data, as well as help them build their businesses and supporting technologies to be more secure, vigilant, and resilient. The cyber risk services—IAM team delivers service to clients through following key areas of
  
  
IAM:
  
  

* Application Onboarding
* Lifecycle Manager
* Compliance Manager
* Password Management
* Automated Provisioning
* Roles Management
* ITSM tools Integration
* Advanced Authentication Methods
* Strategy and Road Map

**Location: BLR/HYD/CHN/PUN**
**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree such as B.Tech, M.Tech, MS, or MBA
* 5-8 years of experience in IAM - Sailpoint ISC/IDN
* Experience delivering at least 2 IAM implementations across requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and application support using SailPoint, Oracle Identity Manager, or CyberArk
* Experience developing or configuring standard and custom IAM integrations using Java, .NET, or scripting languages
* Experience onboarding applications such as Active Directory, Lightweight Directory Access Protocol, and Exchange using out-of-the-box connectors
* Experience with advanced provisioning workflows, single sign-on, public key infrastructure concepts, and technologies such as Java, LDAP, SSL, relational database management systems, and Linux
* Experience working with web or application servers such as IIS, WebSphere, WebLogic, JBoss, or Apache

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with OAuth, JSON, REST, SOAP, and network protocols such as SSL, SSH, FTP, SMTP, HTTP, and HTTPS
* Experience creating technical documentation and proofs of concept for IAM technologies
* Experience with process frameworks and delivery methodologies
* IAM technology certifications
* PMP, CISSP, or other security certifications

title: SAP PM CS
description:
Job Description: SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven
**SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant**
with
**5 to 12 years**
of expertise across SAP Customer Service (CS), Service Management (SM), and S/4HANA Service.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for designing, configuring, and implementing end-to-end Service Management processes in an
**SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition (PCE) / RISE with SAP**
environment. You will bridge business requirements and functional architecture, manage cloud service governance, enable AI-driven service insights, and drive continuous optimization across the full service lifecycle.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Implementation
* Design, configure, and deploy S/4HANA Service Management processes across the entire service lifecycle: Engage, Sell, Contract, Plan, Schedule, Execute, Invoice, and Analyze.
* Map end-to-end business requirements to standard S/4HANA Service capabilities, including service quotations, service orders, service contracts, spare parts logistics, resource planning, billing, and analytics.
* Drive adoption of the latest S/4HANA PCE release innovations (e.g., service team determination, advanced execution processes, Fiori applications, and AI-powered service intelligence).
* S/4HANA Private Edition (PCE) Governance
* Operate effectively within the SAP S/4HANA PCE Shared Responsibility Model between the client and SAP Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS).
* Liaise with SAP for system-level operational tasks (e.g., infrastructure management, backups, maintenance, and upgrade administration).
* Lead client-side functional responsibilities, including business process configuration, functional validation, regression testing, and process governance based on SAP’s PCE Roles and Responsibilities framework.
* Service Order & Contract Management
* Configure and maintain service contract structures, recurring service billing plans, and auto-renewal mechanisms.
* Enable flexible billing scenarios, including Resource-Related Billing (RRB), Time & Material (T&M), and Fixed-Price billing models.
* Leverage modern platform features such as service contract template cloning and mass contract change capabilities.
* Service Planning, Execution & Logistics Integration
* Set up and optimize workforce planning, resource allocation, dispatching, and field service workflows.
* Configure plant and storage location parameters within service transactions to support multi-plant and multi-location service execution.
* Direct cross-module functional integration between service transactions and procurement (MM), inventory management, shipping, plant maintenance (PM), and follow-on financial postings.
* Data Migration, Testing & Integration
* Oversee data preparation, cleansing, transformation, and validation for service master data, active service contracts, and open service orders.
* Utilize the SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit and standard transition tools tailored for service artifacts.
* Coordinate functional and technical integrations across CRM, SAP Field Service Management (FSM), SAP CS, core logistics, and Finance (FI/CO).
* AI, Analytics & Continuous Process Improvement
* Implement embedded AI capabilities (e.g., Joule-assisted summaries, intelligent confirmations, and predictive service insights).
* Design custom Fiori dashboards, operational reports, and KPIs to monitor service performance and profitability.
* Guide business stakeholders through continuous improvement initiatives and the adoption of periodic SAP release features.
* Stakeholder Management & Documentation
* Facilitate requirements-gathering workshops, author detailed functional specifications (FS), and map target-state business process flows.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams spanning Logistics, Procurement, Finance, and Sales.
* Create training collateral, deliver end-user training, and lead hypercare support during deployment phases.

**Required Skills & Technical Expertise**

* Experience: 5–12 years of hands-on experience in SAP CS / SM / S/4HANA Service functional consulting.
* Core Module Competency: Comprehensive knowledge of S/4HANA Service (PCE) core functionality (Service Orders, Service Contracts, Resource-Related Billing, Invoicing, and Execution Logistics).
* Cloud Architecture: Clear operational understanding of the SAP PCE operating model, RISE with SAP frameworks, and cloud service boundary matrices.
* User Experience & Extensibility: Proficiency with modern SAP Fiori apps, standard OData APIs, and functional extensibility options.
* Integration Touchpoints: Strong cross-functional integration experience with PM, SD, MM, FI/CO, and SAP FSM.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Practical project experience with RISE with SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition implementations or migrations.
* Hands-on knowledge of SAP upgrade governance and release management protocols in PCE environments.
* Official SAP Certification in S/4HANA Service or related SAP functional modules.

**Soft Skills**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong consulting mindset with a proven ability to translate business strategy into technical solution designs.
* Proactive problem-solving capabilities and experience leading cross-functional delivery teams.

title: Medical Devices Design Engineer
description:
**Role and Responsibilities:**

1.

Design and develop electromechanical medical devices, including mechanical subsystems, precision components, assemblies, and associated accessories from concept through production.

2.

Develop innovative product concepts, detailed 3D CAD models, assemblies, engineering drawings, tolerance analyses, bills of materials, material specifications, and technical documentation.

3.

Build, source, and evaluate prototypes through rapid prototyping, prototype tooling, and representative manufacturing processes; analyse prototype performance and use results to improve product design, reliability, usability, and manufacturability.

4.

Apply Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) principles to optimize component design, assembly processes, product quality, reliability, and cost.

5.

Perform engineering analyses, including design calculations, tolerance stack-up analysis, FEA and CFD, where applicable, to evaluate strength, fatigue, thermal performance, fluid flow, and durability.

6.

Lead design reviews, DFMEA, risk assessments, root-cause analysis, failure analysis, and corrective actions to identify and mitigate product, subsystem, component, interface, and manufacturing risks.

7.

Develop engineering test strategies, test fixtures, and reports to support prototype evaluation, design verification, reliability testing, usability activities, and product validation.

8.

Maintain design-control and product-lifecycle documentation, including requirements, design inputs and outputs, change-control records, Engineering Change Orders, and technical reports.

9.

Collaborate with Quality, Regulatory, Systems Engineering, Manufacturing, Supplier Quality, Clinical, Human Factors, Sourcing, and Project Management teams.

  

**Education & Experience:**

1.

The role will own financial planning, profitability analysis, management MIS, forecasting and performance evaluation, while providing insights through peer benchmarking, financial ratio analysis and capital-markets / IPO-related analytics.

**Key Responsibilities**

* FP&A & Financial Planning – Own the Company’s financial model, annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, long-range planning and scenario analysis.
* Profitability Analysis – Conduct detailed profitability analysis at product, branch, geography and business-unit levels; identify opportunities for pricing, cost optimisation and revenue enhancement.
* Performance Management – Track actual performance against budget, prior period and business plan; analyse key drivers and recommend corrective actions.
* **Business & Financial Analytics – Analyse P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow performance and interpret key lending/NBFC ratios including NIM, yield, spread, ROA, ROE, cost-to-income, leverage, capital adequacy, liquidity and asset-quality metrics.**
* **Peer Benchmarking – Benchmark business, financial and operating metrics against relevant NBFC/HFC peers; identify performance gaps, trends and best practices.**
* Management MIS & Decision Support – Develop concise management dashboards and performance packs, with clear commentary on business drivers, risks and opportunities.
* Capital Markets / IPO Exposure – Support IPO readiness and capital-market initiatives through financial and operating metric analysis, peer benchmarking, valuation-related analysis, investor presentations and management/investor information requirements.
* Strategic Analytics – Evaluate product economics, pricing, branch expansion, cost structures, capital allocation and other strategic business decisions.
* ALM & Balance Sheet Analytics – Support forecasting of funding, liquidity, AUM, disbursements and Dynamic ALM, and assess their impact on profitability and capital.
* Cost Control & Efficiency – Monitor operating costs against budgets, identify efficiency opportunities and support business teams in delivering financial targets.
* **BI & Automation – Leverage Excel, BI and data-analysis tools to automate recurring MIS, improve reporting quality and enable drill-down analysis.**

**Educational Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or related field.
* CA / CFA / CMA / MBA or equivalent professional qualification preferred.

**Experience**

* **4–8 years of experience in FP&A, business finance, financial planning, financial analysis or related roles, preferably in NBFC / HFC / banking / financial services.**
* **Strong experience in financial modelling, budgeting, forecasting, profitability analysis and management reporting.**
* Exposure to peer benchmarking, financial ratio analysis and interpretation of lending / financial-services metrics.
* Exposure to IPO, capital markets, investor reporting or transaction-related financial analysis will be an advantage.
* **Familiarity with NBFC regulations, lending products, ALM and industry-specific financial metrics preferred.**

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong analytical and financial modelling skills with advanced Excel proficiency.
* Ability to interpret financial statements, business metrics and key financial ratios and translate them into actionable insights.
* **Strong understanding of NBFC / lending business economics and profitability drivers.**
* Ability to benchmark peers and understand business performance in the context of industry trends.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to present insights clearly to senior management.
* **Working knowledge of BI / data visualisation tools and ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle or equivalent.**

title: Security Operations Centre Specialist II
description:
**Our Global Structure**
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
  
  
**About The Team**
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drive everything we do. Our Information Security team enables innovation at speed—securely. As digital guardians of DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt, we safeguard our systems and the data of our employees, customers, riders, and partners. We defend against emerging cyber threats and embed security into every facet of the business. From building resilient defenses and responding to incidents to empowering teams with security knowledge, we are trusted partners protecting these global brands from the inside out.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Security Operations Centre Specialist offers a unique opportunity to shape our global Security Operations strategy across a global footprint of DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt. This role provides the platform to optimize our technology and AI investments while pioneering new methods to protect our data, people, and partners. As we expand, your specialist capabilities will be essential to our continued success.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Work in a 24/7 Global Security Operations Center, including scheduled night, weekend, and on-call shifts to support high and critical issues.
* Act as the first line of defense by triaging and investigating real-time alerts involving phishing, malware, network attacks, and privacy incidents within defined SLAs.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for medium-to-high severity alerts, providing tactical direction and escalating as required.
* Contribute to security playbooks and assist in developing AI-driven runbooks for automated alert triage.
* Support wider security incident investigations involving Threat Intelligence and Incident Response & Digital Forensics stakeholders.
* Assist in developing SOAR (Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response) workflows to streamline incident handling.
* Collaborate with the team to develop and help deliver cybersecurity awareness programs for employees, emphasising incident reporting and best practices.

**Requirements**

* 4–6 years of experience in a SOC environment, successfully resolving high-priority security alerts by identifying the root cause.
* Supporting the optimization of detection logic as a technical lead.
* Demonstrable hands-on experience as part of a Security Operations Centre, using monitoring platforms and triaging real-time alerts.
* Hands-on experience with AWS security config, SOAR, GSO, EDR/XDR, Splunk and SQL queries.
* Proven knowledge of optimal cloud security configurations, particularly across AWS
* Exceptional collaborative team player and a knowledge-sharing mindset.
* Familiarity of security compliance standards, e.g. ISO27001, NIS2, GDPR and PCI-DSS
* Lead low and medium security Incidents.
* Support incidents and initiatives led by Sr. Specialists and also help mentor and train more Security Analysts

Coordinate with the US, UK and EU central security teams as required.
  
  
**Why Deliveroo**
Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.
  
  
We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.
  
  
**Workplace & Benefits**
At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.
  
  
**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
  
  
We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.
  
  
If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
  
  
If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

**win together**
and

in our work.

* 3 or more years of experience supporting enterprise Windows Server and Microsoft infrastructure environments.

* Experience supporting patching, operational maintenance, incident response, and service request fulfillment.
* Experience working in a ticket-driven environment using tools such as ServiceNow and Jira.
* Ability to execute approved changes, document results, and communicate status clearly.
* Basic PowerShell scripting or automation experience for administration, reporting, or repeatable operational tasks.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across Windows, identity, network dependencies, and infrastructure services.
* Ability to work with distributed teams and follow established runbooks and escalation procedures.

**Core Competencies**
**Incident & Service Management**

* Effectively resolves Tier 2 incidents and service requests with a focus on accuracy, prioritization, and service quality

**Operational Excellence & Process Compliance**

* Demonstrates strong adherence to change management, incident management, ITIL practices, and documentation standards.

**Windows Platform Administration**

* Executes patching, system maintenance, monitoring, and operational support activities across Microsoft technologies and Windows environments.

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Communicates clearly and professionally with leadership, cross-functional teams, and global engineering stakeholders.

**Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* Identifies opportunities to improve runbooks, automate manual processes, and enhance operational efficiency and consistency.

**Preference**

* Experience supporting large enterprise Active Directory environments.
* Experience with domain controller health, replication, DNS troubleshooting, and Group Policy management.
* Exposure to Azure, Entra ID, hybrid identity, or cloud-connected Microsoft infrastructure.
* Experience with monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, Azure Monitor, VMware Aria, or similar platforms.
* Experience with ITIL-based incident, problem, request, and change management practices.
