Company: A leading global IT services and consulting MNC

Locations: Pune / Hyderabad / Bangalore / Chennai / Mumbai / Kolkata

Overall Experience: 7–14 Years

Core PKI Experience: Minimum 8–9 years of hands-on PKI experience, as specified in the requirement

Open Positions: 1

Notice Period: Immediate to 15 Days preferred

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced MS PKI / Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) Architect to lead the design, implementation, and management of enterprise Public Key Infrastructure and certificate lifecycle solutions.

The candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Microsoft PKI, Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), certificate lifecycle management platforms, and enterprise certificate automation.

Mandatory Skills

* Strong hands-on experience in PKI and certificate lifecycle management.
* Mandatory experience implementing Microsoft PKI / Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS).
* Experience with at least one CLM or certificate management platform:
* AppViewX CERT+
* CyberArk Certificate Manager
* Venafi Trust Protection Platform
* DigiCert
* Keyfactor
* Experience managing certificate discovery, issuance, renewal, revocation, deployment, and monitoring.
* Strong understanding of PKI architecture, certificate governance, cryptographic standards, trust models, and private key protection.
* Experience integrating CLM platforms with enterprise systems and public Certificate Authorities.
* Experience in certificate automation, scripting, and workflow development.

Preferred Skills

* Microsoft PKI / AD CS administration and implementation.
* Knowledge of DigiCert, Sectigo, Entrust, and GlobalSign.
* Familiarity with ACME, EST, and SCEP protocols.
* Cloud certificate management using Azure Key Vault, AWS Certificate Manager, or Google CAS.
* PowerShell, REST APIs, and automation.
* ServiceNow integration.
* PKI architecture, certificate governance, and security compliance.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead enterprise certificate lifecycle operations, including discovery, issuance, renewal, revocation, deployment, and monitoring.
* Design, implement, and manage CLM solutions using AppViewX, CyberArk Certificate Manager, Venafi, Keyfactor, and Microsoft PKI.
* Integrate certificate management platforms with AD CS, public CAs, cloud platforms, ITSM solutions, load balancers, web servers, and DevOps ecosystems.
* Develop automated certificate management workflows using platform-native tools, PowerShell, REST APIs, and scripting.
* Maintain certificate inventories, monitor expiration risks, and establish certificate governance and compliance controls.
* Define security policies for certificate issuance, cryptographic standards, key management, and private key protection.
* Establish dashboards, reporting, monitoring, and audit processes for certificate health and operational performance.
* Support certificate onboarding and automation across servers, applications, cloud services, and container platforms.
* Collaborate with Security, Infrastructure, Cloud, DevOps, and Application teams.
* Mentor team members on PKI, CLM platforms, automation, and best practices.
* Drive continuous improvement in certificate visibility, automation, and operational efficiency.

Ideal Candidate

A hands-on PKI professional with proven AD CS implementation experience, strong enterprise certificate lifecycle management expertise, and the ability to design and automate secure certificate management solutions.

title: Service Delivery Manager
description:
**Company Overview**
Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
The
**Service Improvement Analyst – Digital Workplace Services**
is responsible for identifying, analyzing, prioritizing, and driving service improvement opportunities across the Digital Workplace Services portfolio. This role focuses on enhancing the end-user experience, improving service performance, optimizing operational processes, and increasing adoption of modern workplace technologies.
  
  
Leveraging
**ITIL, Lean Six Sigma (LSS), Continual Service Improvement (CSI), and Digital Employee Experience (DEX)**
principles, the analyst partners with service owners, engineering teams, operations teams, vendors, and clients to identify opportunities, implement improvements, and measure outcomes. The role requires a strong combination of analytical skills, customer focus, business acumen, and technical understanding of modern workplace services such as Microsoft 365, endpoint management, collaboration platforms, service desk operations, and end-user computing services.
  
  
The Service Improvement Analyst will lead improvement initiatives across multiple clients and business functions while ensuring service delivery aligns with business objectives, user expectations, and operational excellence standards.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Service Improvement & Digital Workplace Optimization
  
  

* Lead the development and execution of service improvement initiatives across Digital Workplace Services in partnership with Service Excellence Leads, Service Owners, Engineering, and Operations teams.
* Analyze service performance, user experience data, operational metrics, and customer feedback to identify improvement opportunities.
* Drive continual improvement programs focused on enhancing employee productivity, service quality, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
* Establish improvement roadmaps aligned with Digital Workplace Services strategy and business objectives.
* Support the adoption and optimization of workplace technologies including Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, endpoint services, mobility solutions, and digital employee experience tools.
* Utilize Digital Employee Experience (DEX) insights, service analytics, and user sentiment data to prioritize and implement service improvements.

Process Excellence & Operational Effectiveness
  
  

* Develop a thorough understanding of existing Digital Workplace processes, workflows, and service delivery models to identify optimization opportunities.
* Create and maintain operational process documentation including: Process maps and flowcharts Standard operating procedures (SOPs) Capacity and utilization studies Time and motion studies Standard work documentation Cycle-time and workflow analysis
* Lead process redesign initiatives to improve efficiency, scalability, standardization, and service quality.
* Coordinate and track improvement activities resulting from Kaizen workshops, problem-solving sessions, and operational reviews.
* Implement Lean Six Sigma, ITIL, and Continuous Improvement methodologies to drive measurable outcomes.

Analytics, Reporting & Insights
  
  

* Define, monitor, and report on key Digital Workplace Services KPIs and SLAs, including: Service Desk performance End-user experience metrics Incident and request trends Availability and reliability metrics Adoption and utilization metrics Customer satisfaction (CSAT) Employee experience measures
* Develop dashboards and reporting frameworks that provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
* Conduct root cause analysis and trend analysis to proactively address recurring service issues.
* Utilize data-driven decision-making to recommend service enhancements and operational improvements.

Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership
  
  

* Lead cross-functional service improvement initiatives involving Operations, Engineering, Service Management, Product Teams, Vendors, and Client stakeholders.
* Serve as a trusted advisor and point of contact for service improvement programs and transformation efforts.
* Facilitate workshops, process reviews, and continuous improvement sessions with business and technical teams.
* Deliver Lean Six Sigma, ITIL, Continual Improvement, and service management training and awareness sessions.
* Mentor Yellow and Green Belt practitioners and support the organization's continuous improvement culture.
* Partner with leadership to prioritize and implement approved improvements that increase service value, customer satisfaction, and business outcomes.

Governance & Best Practices
  
  

* Promote and enforce ITIL and continual improvement best practices across Digital Workplace Services.
* Support service governance activities, operational reviews, and improvement boards.
* Ensure improvement initiatives are measured, documented, and sustained through appropriate governance and change management practices.
* Drive the identification, adoption, and continuous improvement of scalable end-to-end service delivery processes.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, Operations Management, or related field.
* 3+ years of experience in Service Improvement, Process Improvement, Business Analysis, Service Management, or a related role.
* 2+ years of experience applying Lean Six Sigma, Continuous Improvement, or Operational Excellence methodologies.
* Experience supporting or improving Digital Workplace Services environments.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proven track record of identifying improvement opportunities and delivering measurable results.
* Demonstrated experience documenting and optimizing business and operational processes.
* Experience working cross-functionally within complex organizational environments.
* Ability to effectively collaborate with global and remote teams.
* Excellent reporting, dashboard creation, and performance measurement experience.
* Strong verbal, written, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, Teams, and Visio.
* Strong understanding of service management principles, KPIs, SLAs, and operational metrics.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Green Belt certification.
* ITIL Foundation or higher-level ITIL certification.
* Experience with Digital Employee Experience (DEX) platforms such as Nexthink, Lakeside, or similar technologies.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365, Endpoint Management, Intune, Windows Services, Collaboration Platforms, and Modern Workplace technologies.
* Experience with Power BI, ServiceNow, and service analytics platforms.
* Experience in managed services or enterprise IT environments.

You will maintain the book and records for the Entities in accordance with U.S. GAAP and/or prepare/review various technical accounting analyses with respect to mergers and acquisitions, structured debt, leases, power purchase agreements, variable interest entities, non-controlling interests, and other significant transactions that may be undertaken by the company from time to time.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
You will prepare Management reports including EBITDA reports, quarterly project forecasted trial balances, and conduct budget vs. actual and forecast vs. actual analysis.
  
  
You will have the opportunity to liaise with auditors and ensure timely closure of external audits, while interacting with the U.S. and Hyderabad-based asset managers, treasury and tax team associates, and external consultants. You will review financial information to be included in various regulatory reports, engage in various forms of management and investor reporting, coordinate tax reporting, and furnish investor account statements.
  
  
Throughout the role, you will also get the opportunity to work on initiatives related to establishing, standardizing, optimizing, and documenting accounting processes, workflows, and controls.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Chartered Accountant/Certified Public Accountant degree, with zero to two years of post-qualification work experience
* Exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to take initiative with limited direction and guidance
* Strong analytical abilities, with excellent written & verbal communication skills, and organizational skills
* Experience in U.S.-based audit and a good understanding of U.S. GAAP
* Experience in the energy, real estate, or financial services sector will have an added advantage

title: Principal Engineer – Software Architecture and Modernization
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!
  
  
Our Values
  
  
**Best Life**
We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.
  
  
**Growth Mindset**
We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.
  
  
**One Team**
From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
Lead software architecture and modernization
  
  
Shape the evolution of legacy applications into well-structured, domain-oriented software. Define target architecture, module and service boundaries, migration seams, compatibility strategies, and incremental paths that teams can implement safely.
  
  
Stay deeply hands-on in code
  
  
Contribute directly to critical implementations, prototypes, refactoring, code reviews, and production fixes. Work comfortably in backend code and frameworks such as Java/Springboot, Golang, Node/TypeScript, or similar backend ecosystems, and help teams improve application structure, runtime behavior, and maintainability.
  
  
Design strong domain models and APIs
  
  
Create clear domain abstractions, ownership boundaries, service contracts, and APIs. Improve how business rules are represented in code and keep consumers insulated from legacy storage and implementation details.
  
  
Modernize application foundations
  
  
Guide framework and runtime upgrades, dependency modernization, concurrency and lifecycle improvements, and the decomposition of tightly coupled code. Use practical refactoring strategies that keep large systems releasable throughout the work.
  
  
Engineer for correctness, performance, and reliability
  
  
Diagnose difficult behavior through code, runtime evidence, database interactions, and dependency flows. Fix root causes in implementation and design, including concurrency defects, inefficient data access, resource contention, failure propagation, and recovery behavior.
  
  
Improve data access and integration design
  
  
Move business logic out of database-centric implementations and into testable application code. Design effective persistence, transaction, caching, messaging, and event-consumer patterns while preserving historical, reporting, and audit needs.
  
  
Raise the bar for code quality and testing
  
  
Establish strong practices for unit, integration, contract, and functional testing. Improve code review, static analysis, dependency management, feature controls, and validation so teams can change complex software with confidence.
  
  
Create reusable engineering patterns
  
  
Turn successful designs into clear patterns, reference implementations, libraries, and architecture decisions that help teams solve recurring software problems consistently.
  
  
Turn technical strategy into cross-team execution
  
  
Translate architectural risk into clear code-level priorities, decisions, ownership, and sequenced implementation plans. Partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to move complex software initiatives from design through working code.
  
  
What This Is Not
  
  
This is not a people-management or architecture-only role. The engineer is expected to contribute directly to implementation and production outcomes.
  
  
This is not limited to greenfield design or modernization for its own sake. Decisions must balance long-term software quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications.
  
  
What You Bring
  
  
Deep backend and distributed-systems engineering
  
  
You have substantial experience designing, building, operating, and evolving production backend systems, services, APIs, and distributed applications.
  
  
Credible hands-on implementation depth
  
  
You can move from architecture into code, configuration, instrumentation, and diagnosis. Exact experience with Java/Springboot or Golang or Node/Typescript is relevant, but the key here is moving ideas into shippable software solutions and not on the technology.
  
  
Service transformation and architecture judgment
  
  
You can define service boundaries, domain ownership, migration strategies, integration patterns, and practical architecture decisions for complex existing environments.
  
  
Production reliability and performance expertise
  
  
You can trace difficult behavior through application code, runtime state, database interactions, and dependency flows, then implement fixes that improve correctness, concurrency, performance, and recovery behavior.
  
  
Software design and refactoring depth
  
  
You can improve large codebases through domain modeling, modular design, dependency management, incremental refactoring, and carefully chosen abstractions. You know how to create better seams without forcing risky rewrites.
  
  
Data and integration depth
  
  
You understand relational databases, SQL behavior, messaging, event consumers, data movement, caching, and the tradeoffs involved in separating applications from legacy data dependencies.
  
  
Strong testing and code-quality discipline
  
  
You treat automated testing, code review, static analysis, dependency health, secure coding, and production validation as essential parts of software design—not downstream concerns.
  
  
Principal-level technical leadership
  
  
You create clarity across teams, challenge weak assumptions constructively, communicate risk in business terms, and help groups converge on decisions they can execute.
  
  
An opportunity-focused approach to AI-assisted engineering
  
  
You actively look for ways AI can expand engineering leverage across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, refactoring, test generation, debugging, documentation, and planning. You help turn promising uses into repeatable practices that make strong engineers more effective.
  
  
Bonus Points
  
  
Experience modernizing large complex software systems, including runtime and framework upgrades.
  
  
Experience decomposing monoliths, extracting services, or establishing modular boundaries within large existing applications.
  
  
Experience with Oracle or other enterprise relational databases, Kafka or similar messaging systems, and complex data migration or reporting dependencies.
  
  
Experience with profiling, runtime instrumentation, concurrency analysis, database-performance diagnosis, or tuning.
  
  
Experience applying AI coding agents for codebase analysis, implementation, testing, and software modernization.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
Modernization advances without destabilizing the business
  
  
Critical migrations have clear boundaries, sequencing, ownership, and safety controls. Teams retire legacy constraints while maintaining compatibility and operational continuity.
  
  
Critical software becomes easier to change
  
  
Codebases have clearer boundaries, stronger tests, healthier dependencies, and fewer hidden couplings. Teams can add capabilities and modernize incrementally without destabilizing unrelated behavior.
  
  
Architecture decisions become executable
  
  
Teams understand the target state, the next practical step, and the tradeoffs behind key decisions. Cross-team dependencies and risks are surfaced early and actively managed.
  
  
Engineering quality improves across the lifecycle
  
  
Test coverage, code review, static analysis, dependency health, and production validation become stronger and more consistent across the software in scope.
  
  
AI expands engineering leverage
  
  
AI becomes an effective part of how teams understand code, explore designs, implement changes, generate tests, diagnose problems, and document systems.
  
  
Why This Matters
  
  
ABC Fitness depends on critical software and data flows that must evolve without compromising the businesses and members they support. Strong architecture is valuable only when it produces clearer code, better behavior, and software that teams can continue to change.
  
  
This role connects long-term technical direction with hands-on software engineering. Done well, it will help teams reduce codebase complexity, modernize with confidence, resolve production problems at their source, and build a stronger foundation for future product development.
  
  
**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.
  
  
**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION**
:  ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at
**abcfitness.com**
.
  
  
**About ABC Fitness**
ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.
  
  
From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at
**abcfitness.com**

title: Customer Engagement Manager
description:
**About CleanHarbors**
Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $6.5 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by Mr. Alan S. McKim, who today remains the company’s Chairman.
  
  
Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 18,000 employees and has over 450 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.
  
  
Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our shared services teams work seamlessly with their global counterparts in providing critical 24x7 support in various functions including Finance, HR, Procurement, IT and Operations. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Job Role:**
Process Specialist/SME/Assistant Manager - Customer Engagement Management (CEM)
  
  
**Job Location:**
Hyderabad (
**Work from Office only**
)
  
  
**Job Timing:**
3pm to 12am - should be willing to work from office with global working windows
  
  
**Job Description**

* Work backwards and set up the accounts correctly and ensure a regular health-check of the accounts is being done.
* Own and maintain the administrative responsibility for our largest (multi-million dollar) customers.
* Engagement Managers will be assigned 10, 25, or 50 customers (to be determined by customer size and complexity; # of locations, # of contracts).

* Also respond to requests from billers, collections or cash applications.
* Take action to correct issues directly or through escalation processes.
* Prepare necessary documentation and should be comfortable in presenting to C and E level leadership.

**Qualifications**
**Pre-requisites:**

* Excellent Customer handling skills with good communication.
* Ability to work independently on complex Order to Cash (O2C) scenarios by contacting the sales/ customers and work collaboratively with the various internal teams.
* Individuals must have in-depth O2C knowledge (Downstream & Upstream).

* Should be flexible to work and extend their support for any additional hours as per business requirements.
* Individuals are expected to work with high level of integrity, focus and always be proactive.

**Shift Timings: 3pm to 12am - should be willing to work from office with global working windows**

is a global leader in delivering high-impact business events, strategic conferences, and bespoke business intelligence solutions designed to drive success across industries. At
**Marcus Evans**

**Hyderabad**
office.

* Quick learner with a proactive and adaptable mindset, open to new technologies, processes, and evolving organisational needs.

title: Team Leader, Acquiring AR&I, Preventive Fraud, OM UK
description:
**About Tide**
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
  
  
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
  
  
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
  
  
**Tide Facts**

* Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members across UK and India
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* Over 2,800 Tideans globally
* Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

**About The Role**
Here at Tide, we are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Team Leader to oversee our Acquiring Transaction Monitoring team in our first line of defence with experience in transaction monitoring within the card acquiring space or merchant banking, with a deep understanding of fraud detection, compliance, and risk management. This role requires strong leadership skills, along with a deep understanding of fraud prevention, risk management, and compliance within the payments ecosystem.
  
  
Your team will be responsible for the monitoring of the transaction and behaviours across our customer base, ensuring we put our genuine members first, whilst spotting and investigating potentially suspicious activity. This role is a key element of our team, so we’re looking for someone who is a passionate investigator, possesses good knowledge on merchant payments, who will help reduce risk to tide, and let our members get back to doing what they love.
  
  

* Lead, manage, and mentor a team of Transaction Monitoring Analysts, ensuring they meet performance metrics, including transaction reviews, case resolution times, and fraud detection accuracy.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and develop individual training plans to improve team capabilities.
* Manage resources of the team by effective capacity forecasting and monitoring, setting priorities, work allocation and reallocation where necessary.
* Supervise the monitoring of acquiring transactions, ensuring suspicious activities are detected in real-time or through post-transaction analysis.
* Oversee the monitoring of merchant acquiring activities, including card payment authorizations, settlements, chargebacks, and disputes, ensuring all processes follow best practices.
* Ensure all monitored transactions comply with industry regulations and standards, including AML, and card network rules (Visa, MasterCard, etc.).
* Develop strategies to reduce fraudulent activities across merchant card payments and ensure merchants meet compliance requirements.
* Use data-driven insights to recommend improvements in transaction monitoring processes and fraud mitigation strategies.
* Keep the team updated on emerging fraud trends and adjust detection rules and constantly measure, assess and improve our risk policies, procedures and controls across products
* Foster a collaborative team environment focused on continuous improvement and high operational efficiency.
* Representing your area in front of different stakeholders, including internal and external auditors.

**What We Are Looking For**

* You are willing to work in flexible shift patterns.
* 3-5 years of experience in merchant banking, card acquiring, merchant acquiring, transaction monitoring, or merchant card payments with automated processes and data driven decisioning tools/culture.
* Proven leadership experience, with a track record of managing teams in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
* Deep understanding of card acquiring processes, merchant acquiring systems, payment networks (Visa, MasterCard, etc.), and fraud detection methodologies.
* Analytical mindset with a proven ability to interpret complex transaction data and identify fraud patterns.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience in handling escalations and coordinating cross-functional teams.
* Ability to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
  
  
At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
  
  
We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.*

We help people secure their futures and protect the ones they love through a broad portfolio of insurance, retirement, and financial solutions.The OpportunityAs a Senior SOC Analyst, you will join MassMutual’s Cyber Fusion Center and help protect the company’s data, systems, employees, customers, and policyowners. You will work with security analysts, engineers, Threat Intelligence, Offensive Security, Security Platforms, Network Security, Endpoint Security, and Identity and Access Management teams to detect, investigate, contain, and communicate cyber threats.The ImpactMonitor and investigate alerts across enterprise endpoints, networks, identity systems, email, applications, cloud platforms, and SaaS services. Minimum Qualifications5–8 years of progressive experience in security operations, incident response, threat detection, threat hunting, digital forensics, or a closely related discipline. Hands-on experience with an enterprise SIEM and EDR/XDR platform, including advanced querying, investigation, and alert tuning. Strong understanding of Windows and Linux internals, networking, authentication, Active Directory or modern identity platforms, and common attacker techniques. Experience investigating threats across on-premises and cloud environments, including at least one major cloud platform. Working knowledge of phishing, credential abuse, malware, ransomware, lateral movement, persistence, data exfiltration, and insider-risk scenarios. Ability to analyze logs, endpoint telemetry, network traffic, and threat intelligence and convert findings into defensible response decisions. Automation or scripting capability using Python, PowerShell, SQL, KQL, SPL, or a comparable query language. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risk and business impact clearly. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GIAC, SC-200, CompTIA CySA+, or equivalent technical credentials. Experience mentoring analysts, improving operational procedures, and contributing to purple-team or detection-validation exercises. What Success Looks LikeHigh-quality, timely investigations with clear evidence, risk assessment, and recommended actions. Reduced alert noise and measurable improvement in detection coverage, response time, and playbook effectiveness. Consistent collaboration and communication across global SOC shifts and partner teams. Actionable lessons learned that strengthen controls and reduce repeat incidents. Core CompetenciesAccountability, agility, continuous learning, communication excellence, resilience, self-awareness, sound judgment, and the courage to act in difficult situations.Work ExpectationsThe SOC supports continuous global monitoring and response through a follow-the-sun operating model. You will be responsible for the administration, security, reliability and continuous improvement of our Microsoft 365 environment, supporting colleagues across our global organisation.

This is a

You will:

Have good knowledge and relevant working experience on DQL (Dynatrace Query Language), Problem Alerting Profiles, Configuring Management Zones, Gen3 Dashboard features .

* Monitoring coverage and Critical Systems validation completion.
* Quality and timeliness of alert detection, routing, and resolution.

* OneAgent and ActiveGate lifecycle compliance.
* Faster, well-governed onboarding of applications and infrastructure.
* Reliable automation outcomes and reduction of manual operational effort.
* Complete, current documentation and clear operational ownership.

* Ability to create clear technical documentation, runbooks, shift handovers, and stakeholder updates.

**Good-to-have Skills And Knowledge**

* Experience with n8n, GitLab, REST APIs, workflow automation, or self-healing use cases.

title: Head of Systems
description:
**About The Company**
****Calamatta Cuschieri Moneybase plc****
is a privately held Fintech Group that operates in Investment Services, Fund Administration, Online Investing, and Payments. With roots dating back to 1971, the Group today is evolving at a fast pace whilst keeping the same core principles, that of providing clients the best service using the latest technology and the top professionals in their field, whilst ensuring the strong governance and ethics.
  
  
We are committed to attracting and selecting the very best people to join our team and to creating a workplace that promotes individual career growth; we value our people and their well-being. The group employs over 210 people from over 27 countries around the world with Assets Under Management and Administration of over 3 billion.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Head of Systems is responsible for CC Moneybase’s infrastructure, covering cloud, on-premises systems, networks and corporate IT. This role combines technical leadership with a hands-on approach, setting the direction while supporting the team in resolving complex technical challenges.
  
  
You will lead and develop the Systems team, ensuring our infrastructure is reliable, secure and resilient. Working closely with Information Security and other technology teams, you will drive modernisation, automation and continuous improvement to support the business as it grows.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Leadership and ownership**

* Set and deliver the infrastructure roadmap, agreed with the CEO, covering modernisation, automation, resilience and cost.
* Own the infrastructure budget, licences and vendor relationships, and manage costs effectively, balancing efficiency and business needs.
* Lead, coach and develop the IT Systems Manager and, through them, the two systems engineers. Identify skills gaps and close them.
* Build a culture of ownership: every system has a named owner, documentation and a runbook.
* Act as the senior technical escalation point for complex incidents, and lead post-incident reviews that fix root causes.

**Cloud: Microsoft Azure**

* Run and optimise our Azure estate: virtual machines, networking, storage, identity (Entra ID) and governance.
* Drive cost optimisation through right-sizing, reservations and removal of waste, reported monthly.

**On-premises and virtualisation**

* Oversee VMware vSphere, ESXi and vCenter, including VM management, performance monitoring, patching and upgrades.
* Own physical servers, virtualisation hosts and storage platforms through their full lifecycle.
* Manage hybrid connectivity and operations between on-premises and Azure so they work as one estate.

**Linux and server administration**

* Maintain and secure Linux servers across on-premises and cloud, including patching, hardening, troubleshooting and performance tuning.

**Corporate IT and end-user services**

* Own the corporate IT environment, setting the standards and direction for secure, reliable and well-managed IT services.
* Oversee end-user computing, including devices, operating systems, software deployment, patching and endpoint configuration.
* Establish and oversee identity and access management, including user provisioning, access controls, MFA, and joiner, mover and leaver processes.
* Define endpoint management and configuration standards using Microsoft Intune, Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Make sure corporate IT security controls, including endpoint protection, encryption, device compliance and vulnerability management, align with Information Security policies.
* Oversee the IT Systems Manager's delivery of IT support and services, including service levels, escalation management and continuous improvement.
* Oversee IT assets, software licensing, suppliers and lifecycle planning to control cost and use resources well.
* Drive standardisation and automation of IT processes to improve efficiency, consistency and scalability.
* Make sure technical documentation, operational procedures, access controls and business continuity arrangements are kept up to date.
* Set performance expectations, review operational risks and service reporting, and give direction on corporate IT improvements and technology lifecycle decisions.

**Resilience and disaster recovery**

* Own infrastructure availability, backup and disaster recovery, and test recovery on a set schedule.
* Deliver the infrastructure security controls and operational resilience evidence the business needs, working with Risk, Compliance and Information Security.

**Automation and Infrastructure as Code**

* Move provisioning and configuration to code using Terraform, Ansible or equivalent, across cloud and on-premises.
* Standardise and automate routine operational tasks to cut manual effort and configuration drift.

**AI-assisted security and monitoring**

* Evaluate and implement AI-driven tools that continuously check configurations across Azure, VMware, Linux, Windows and network, and flag misconfigurations and vulnerabilities.
* Use the AI and machine learning capabilities in our SIEM, EDR and monitoring platforms to improve anomaly detection and incident response.

**Essential**
**What you bring**

* 8+ years in infrastructure or systems engineering, with at least 3 years leading a team.
* Deep, hands-on Azure experience: compute, networking, storage, Entra ID, governance and cost management.
* Strong VMware vSphere, ESXi and vCenter experience in production.
* Confident Linux administration, plus working knowledge of Windows Server.
* Hands-on with Fortinet FortiGate or an equivalent next-generation firewall, and with load balancers in high-availability setups.
* Practical experience implementing Infrastructure as Code in production environments.
* Experience running Cloudflare or a comparable edge, DNS and WAF platform.
* A track record of designing and testing backup and disaster recovery.
* Experience running corporate IT and end-user services, including Microsoft Intune, Microsoft 365, Entra ID identity and access management, and joiner, mover and leaver processes.
* Able to explain technical risk and trade-offs clearly to a non-technical CEO.

**Desirable**

* Experience in financial services, payments or another regulated environment.
* Hands-on with SIEM and EDR platforms, including their AI and anomaly detection features.
* Certifications such as Azure Administrator or Solutions Architect, VCP or Fortinet NSE. Experience counts more than certificates.

**Remuneration**
We are committed to attracting and selecting top people to join our team. We are also committed to creating a workplace that encourages individual growth; we value our people and their well-being.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Ongoing internal training
* Study Leave
* Sponsorship schemes for further studies
* Opportunities for career growth
* Variable bonus linked to KPI

**Our Values**
🚀
**Innovation**
– Stay Curious, Move Fast
  
  
🔒
**Integrity**
– Do What’s Right, Always
  
  
🎯
**Accountability**
– Own It, Fix It, Learn
  
  
🤝
**Collaboration**
– Win Together
  
  
🌍
**Respect**
– Value Every Voice

I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Calamatta Cuschieri Moneybase Plc may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Calamatta Cuschieri Moneybase Plc's Candidate Privacy Notice*

The IT Systems Specialist is responsible for the maintenance/support of client Linux and Solaris-based enterprise infrastructure to ensure overall availability and reliability. title: Senior Manager, IT Operations – India
description:
**About Us:**
Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.
  
  
Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
  
  
**Overview:**
Seismic is seeking an experienced, hands-on IT leader to serve as the senior technical presence for our India offices. This is not a pure people-management role — it is a high-level systems administration position with a people-leadership component. The Senior Manager, IT Operations will be the final escalation point for all technical IT issues in India, personally own day-to-day operations and troubleshooting, and lead a team spanning systems administration and helpdesk/support by doing the work alongside them — not simply directing others to do it.
  
  
This role operates under Seismic’s India dual solid-line operating model: the Senior Manager reports solid-line to the Sr. Director, IT (functional direction, standards, and technical strategy) and solid-line to the India GM (day-to-day people management, coaching, hiring within budget, and local escalations).
  
  
**Who you are:**

* 8+ years of hands-on IT systems administration, infrastructure, or end-user support experience, including current, active technical work — not purely managerial.
* 3+ years leading or mentoring a technical team, ideally spanning both systems administration and helpdesk/support functions.
* Working knowledge of core enterprise IT tooling: identity/SSO (Azure AD), MDM (Jamf and/or Intune), ITSM/ticketing (Freshservice or similar), major cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), and security tooling.
* A demonstrated track record as a doer — someone who resolves issues directly and leads by example, not someone who only delegates.
* Experience operating within a US-headquartered multinational’s India office; SaaS or enterprise software company experience preferred.
* Comfortable operating in a matrixed, dual solid-line reporting structure, balancing global functional direction with local execution and people leadership.
* Strong troubleshooting, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills under time pressure.
* Clear, direct communicator, able to escalate risk transparently to both local and global stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Serve as the final escalation point for all technical IT issues across Seismic’s India offices, spanning systems, network, endpoint, identity, and helpdesk-tier issues.
* Own day-to-day IT operations for India — infrastructure administration, incident response, and end-user support — personally diagnosing and resolving issues rather than only assigning them.
* Directly manage, coach, and mentor India-based IT staff across both systems administration/integrations and helpdesk/support, setting the standard by leading from the front.
* Partner closely with the Sr. Director, IT and global IT functional leads to align India execution with global IT strategy, standards, and tooling (Jamf/Intune, Azure AD, Freshservice, Rapid7, 1Password, and similar).
* Own local hiring, performance management, and workload prioritization for the India IT team within approved budget, consistent with the India GM operating model.
* Drive local IT security posture and compliance execution (patching, endpoint management, incident response) in partnership with global Security and IT leadership.
* Identify and implement automation and self-service improvements (Workato, Freshservice Service Catalog, AI tools) to reduce ticket volume and manual effort rather than defaulting to added headcount or process.
* Provide clear, timely communication to global IT leadership on India IT health, risks, incidents, and escalations.
* Represent India IT in regional and global operating rhythms as needed.

**What we have for you:**
At Seismic, we’re committed to providing benefits and perks for the whole self. To explore our benefits available in each country, please visit the Global Benefits page.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the application or recruiting process, please click here.
  
  
Seismic is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, age, race, religion, or any other classification which is protected by applicable law.
  
  
Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: IT Administrator
description:

**technical leadership, influence, and long‑term reliability outcomes**
, rather than day‑to‑day alert handling.

**Enterprise Incident Response Leadership**

* Act as a principal technical authority during high‑severity and enterprise‑impacting incidents.

* Drive technical containment and restoration strategy in partnership with domain engineering teams.
* Establish incident command best practices, escalation models, and responder behaviors.

**Observability & Monitoring Strategy**

* Own and evolve the ICC monitoring and observability strategy, ensuring alignment with enterprise reliability objectives.
* Define standards for actionable alerting, thresholds, routing, deduplication, and noise reduction.
* Architect and oversee Dynatrace dashboards, service views, and eyes‑on‑glass experiences for mission‑critical services.
* Partner with Observability and SRE teams to improve logs, metrics, traces, and service telemetry coverage.

**Advanced Platform Diagnostics**

* Perform deep, cross‑stack troubleshooting across AWS, Windows, Linux, networking, middleware, databases, and application services.
* Validate hypotheses using evidence‑based diagnostics rather than trial‑and‑error recovery.
* Serve as a go‑to expert for complex, ambiguous failure scenarios and cascading incidents.
* Provide technical guidance to reduce time‑to‑diagnose during critical events.

**Root Cause & Resilience Engineering**

* Lead or significantly influence complex root cause analysis (RCA) for major or recurring incidents.
* Identify systemic weaknesses, architectural risks, and operational gaps.
* Translate incident learnings into preventative engineering, monitoring, or process improvements.
* Track recurring failure modes and sponsor long‑term remediation initiatives.

**Operational Readiness & Risk Management**

* Drive operational readiness reviews for new or materially changed services.
* Ensure services meet readiness standards including:

+ Monitoring and alerting coverage
+ Runbooks and escalation paths
+ Rollback and recovery procedures
+ Defined SLOs / SLIs (where applicable)

* Partner with engineering teams early in the delivery lifecycle to reduce production risk.

**Technical Influence & Mentorship**

* Mentor senior and mid‑level ICC, NOC, and production support engineers.
* Raise the technical bar for troubleshooting rigor, documentation quality, and incident response discipline.
* Influence reliability outcomes across teams without direct authority.
* Share expertise through post‑incident reviews, technical sessions, and operational drills.

**Goals & Outcomes**

* Deliver measurable, sustained improvements in MTTD and MTTR for priority platforms.
* Reduce repeat incidents and operational toil through systemic fixes.
* Improve signal‑to‑noise ratio across enterprise monitoring.
* Enable responders to diagnose complex failures rapidly and confidently.
* Increase overall production resilience and advisor/client experience.

**Required Expertise & Experience**

* 10-14+ years of progressive experience in Production Services, SRE, ICC/NOC, or large‑scale operations engineering roles.
* Deep expertise in enterprise incident management and ITSM practices.
* Advanced, hands‑on experience with Dynatrace (dashboards, alerts, service flows, diagnostics).
* Strong troubleshooting capabilities across:

+ AWS (EC2, ALB/NLB, RDS, IAM, networking, failure modes)
+ Windows & Linux (performance, services, logs, resource analysis)

* Proven experience operating in high‑severity, high‑stakes incident environments.
* Strong documentation and communication skills at technical and executive levels.

**Core Competencies**

* Systems thinking across complex, distributed architectures.
* Ability to resolve ambiguity and make sound decisions under pressure.
* Strong analytical mindset with a bias toward prevention and automation.
* Exceptional collaboration and influence across engineering, leadership, and operations teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Why This Role Matters**
**Role**
This Senior Engineer role is

. The decisions, standards, and influence of this position directly shape:
  
  

* Platform stability

Advisor and investor experience

title: CloudOps Engineer IV

description:
**Description**
Not many teams aspire to zero. Welcome to the Worldwide Returns, ReCommerce & Sustainability team (WWRR&S) at Amazon.com.
  
  
WW RR&S is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. The mission of WWRR&S is to eliminate defects that cause returns (Zero defects), deliver Zero cost of returns for Amazon, send Zero product waste to landfill, and deliver on Amazon’s commitment to deliver on the Climate Pledge (Net Zero Carbon) – “the 4 Zeros”. We do this by developing products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned and damaged product value, keep thousands of tons of waste from landfills, and create the best customer returns experience in the world. We have an eye to the future – we create long-term value at Amazon by focusing not just on the bottom line, but on the planet. We are building the most sustainable re-use channel we can by driving multiple aspects of the Circular Economy for Amazon - returns, recommerce, and sustainability.
  
  
Amazon WW RR&S is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.
  
  
Support engineers troubleshoot, debug, evaluate and resolve computer-identified alarms, perform software deployments and migrations, host management and automate routine operational tasks. The position requires a combination of strong troubleshooting, technical and communication skills and includes a mix of on call and operational tasks and may involve small-project software development work. Support Engineers also develop tools and automation to achieve human free operations. They use the right tool for the job, and modify software in a way that leverages the overall system architecture. If you have a strong Application Support background, are interested in growth and have passion to develop tools at large scale, this is the opportunity for you.
  
  
We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.
  
  
Amazon is earth’s most customer-centric company and through WW RR&S, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns, ReCommerce & Sustainability team!

* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting infrastructure
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes

* You break a complex problem into simple flows

* You research a new problem space on your own

* Final-year undergraduates in Design, HCI, CS or a related field

* Experience working in a cross-functional product team

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Specialist – Center for Energy & Industrials – Research & Insights - Industrial Products & Construction (IP&C)**
**Overview of the team and job profile:**
Deloitte’s ER&I research center is one of the industry research groups within the Research & Insights (R&I) organization. The Center's goals are to:
  
  

* Assess opportunities and challenges facing companies in the Industrial Products & Construction (IP&C) sector, including aerospace, & defense, industrial products manufacturing, and engineering & construction.
* Provide practical insights - whether they are strategic, technical, operational.
* Bring together a range of stakeholders to address issues impacting the performance, resilience, and evolution of the IP&C sector.
* Draw on leading practices from industry professionals across disciplines such as strategy, operations, supply chain, advanced manufacturing, sustainability, digital transformation, risk, finance, regulation, and human capital to identify innovative approaches to critical challenges.

Learn more about the ER&I research center and peek into Deloitte Insights for examples of the end-products of our work.
  
  
The candidate will contribute to the center’s research and thought leadership initiatives in the IP&C sector, with a particular focus on topics such as digital transformation, workforce, supply chain resilience, sustainability, industrial technology, aerospace & defense modernization, capital projects, data center construction, and other evolving industry issues. These include white papers, in-depth research reports, client presentations, account-specific collaterals, case studies, articles, and industry outlooks. These deliverables integrate information from a range of primary and secondary sources such as Deloitte subject matter experts, primary surveys, third-party research, analyst reports, presentations, industry commentary, and news articles.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Work with the US and India-based ER&I team to work on projects that align with the research agenda.
* Conduct research, focusing on primary and secondary data, data analysis, and insight development for IP&C sector (manufacturing, engineering & construction, and aerospace & defense) research projects.
* Work with project leads to support projects in the IP&C industry across all key phases.

**Responsibilities include:**
ü Data analysis: Create data analysis plans, perform deep dives and cross-tabs, validate hypotheses, extract insights, and synthesize findings into client-ready briefing decks.
  
  
ü Insight development: Work with stakeholders and research leads to identify storylines and insights; visualize survey results using data tables and charts for use in XL, PPT, Tableau, or Power BI outputs.
  
  
ü Presentation support: Present results and summarize insights and recommendations in client-ready decks to support senior colleagues and leaders in internal and external meetings.
  
  
ü Research support: Support research proposals and projects being developed by IP&C project leads.
  
  
ü Whitespace research: Work with IP&C project leads and industry SMEs to conduct whitespace research.
  
  
ü Stakeholder management: Work with project leads to understand, refine, and manage client expectations and priorities.
  
  
**Requisite Experience And Skills**

* Strong analytical skills and knowledge of both qualitative and quantitative research and analysis, including use of industry, market, company, and proprietary data sources.
* 3–6 years of experience in research or analytics roles within IP&C-related sectors, preferably across industrial manufacturing, heavy industries, aerospace & defense, or engineering & construction, with exposure to agile, dynamic, and insight-led projects.
* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Solid analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
* High attention to detail, responsiveness, and a strong track record of contributing to high-impact projects.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple aspects of a project, and meet deadlines with a high level of ownership and accountability.
* Proficiency in one or more research tools/databases, including LSEG Workspace, Gartner, Mergermarket, D&B Hoovers, Factiva, or similar tools.
* Strong presentation skills in MS PowerPoint and hands-on working knowledge of MS Excel.
* Strong experience using one or more AI-assisted tools is required, such as ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, or Gemini.
* Working knowledge of Tableau, Power BI, MarketSight, or AlphaSense is an advantage, but not a prerequisite.

**The broader R&I organization**
R&I’s vision is to be the digital source for the most differentiated, globally relevant, research-based thought leadership. We seek to help clients tackle their most complex challenges, improve executive relationships, position our practitioners as leaders, amplify Deloitte’s brand, and enable revenue-generating opportunities.
  
  
We undertake research and analysis to develop compelling and forward-looking perspectives that allow clients to anticipate, prepare for, and respond to “what’s coming next.” R&I plays an integral role in strengthening the firm’s strategic positioning through end-to-end development of high-quality thoughtware published on Deloitte Insights. Our work includes:
  
  

* Studying the right issues, asking the right business questions, and generating insights from data.
* Using the right research methods, including advanced data science/survey research capabilities, to strengthen credibility of our research and the insights that we present.
* Leveraging editorial and visualization capabilities to improve the stickiness of the thoughtware we publish .

**Qualifications, experience, work location, and timing**

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. You will build and run Navtech's demand generation engine for US mid-market banks, credit unions, and financial services firms. You'll use Navtech's marketing collateral across email, LinkedIn, paid media, and events to generate qualified sales meetings and measurable pipeline for the banking sales team.

This is not a cold-calling or closing role. You own the top of the funnel and hand qualified meetings to sales.

**Key responsibilities**

* Targeting and segmentation. Define and maintain the target account list, for example community and regional banks of roughly $1B–$20B in assets, credit unions, and specialty lenders. Map buying committees such as the CIO/CTO, COO, Chief Digital Officer, Head of Retail Banking, and Head of Risk.

* Email campaigns. Plan and run multi-touch outbound and nurture sequences that hold up for a banking audience. Manage domain health, deliverability, and CAN-SPAM compliance.

* LinkedIn. Run Navtech's company page content calendar for BFSI. Build thoughtleadership posts for leadership profiles. Run Sales Navigator-driven outreach programs.

* Paid media. Plan, launch, and optimize LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads campaigns aimed at target accounts. Own budget, cost per lead, and cost per meeting.

* Events. Identify and plan participation in US banking events, such as ICBA Capital Summit, ABA conferences, BAI Beacon, Finovate, Money20/20, and state banking association meetings. Run webinars and virtual roundtables. Handle pre-event outreach and post-event follow-up.

* Collateral use. Turn existing case studies, product pages, and decks into campaign assets like one-pagers, email copy, ad creative briefs, and landing pages, working with the designer, content writer, and web developer.

* Lead qualification and handoff. Agree lead stages (MQL to SQL) with sales, qualify inbound and campaign responses, and book meetings for the banking sales team.

* Reporting. Track and report weekly on the funnel: reach, engagement, MQLs, meetings booked, sales-accepted leads, pipeline value, and channel ROI.

**Success metrics (first 6–12 months)**

* Qualified meetings per month accepted by the banking sales team (target set jointly with sales)
* Pipeline value sourced by marketing
* Cost per qualified meeting, by channel
* Growth in engagement from target accounts, measured by account coverage and multi-contact engagement

* 5–8 years in B2B demand generation or growth marketing, with at least 3 years targeting US buyers
* Hands-on experience running email, LinkedIn (organic and paid), Google Ads, and event campaigns end to end
* Working knowledge of CRM and marketing automation tools (HubSpot or Salesforce), data tools (Apollo, ZoomInfo, or similar), and LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Campaign Manager
* Strong written English suited to senior US financial services executives
* Analytical and comfortable owning budgets, attribution, and funnel metrics
* Willing to work with regular overlap with US Eastern time

* Familiarity with how banks buy technology: long cycles, vendor risk and compliance reviews, committee decisions
* Exposure to account-based marketing (ABM)
* Understanding ofAI or enterprise software positioning

title: EY - GDS Consulting -AI Strategy & Go-To-Market
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**JOB DESCRIPTION | AI & DATA TECH CONSULTING**
**AI Strategy & Go-To-Market**
Career Family: AIA – AI Strategy & GTM
  
  

* Pursuits, RFPs & Offering Development

**LEVEL**
**Senior/Manager**
**Experience**
**8–12 years**
**LOCATION**
EY GDS
  
  

* Hybrid

**ORIENTATION**
**Strategy-led**
THE OPPORTUNITY
  
  
We are seeking a strategic Manager to join our AI & Data Tech Consulting team, focused on shaping how clients adopt Agentic AI and GenAI — and how the firm takes its AI offerings to market. The ideal candidate brings a blend of AI product strategy, solution positioning, and pursuit leadership, with enough technical fluency to credibly translate AI capabilities into business value, without being a hands-on builder.
  
  
You will work closely with account leaders, solution architects, C-suite stakeholders, and alliance partners to win and shape AI programs — owning the narrative from opportunity qualification and RFP response through solution storyboarding, commercial framing, and client orals.
  
  
**WHERE YOUR TIME GOES**
**40%**
**RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits**
Win themes, solution storyline, client orals
  
  
**30%**
**Go-To-Market & Offerings**
Positioning, enablement collateral, alliances
  
  
**30%**
**AI Strategy & Advisory**
Roadmaps, business cases, operating models
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
AI Strategy & Value Advisory
  
  
■ Partner with client leadership and Operating Partners to define AI / Agentic AI vision, use-case portfolios, and adoption roadmaps.
  
  
■ Build use-case prioritization frameworks (value vs. feasibility vs. risk) and translate them into phased roadmaps (discovery → MVP → scale).
  
  
■ Develop business cases with ROI, cost-to-serve, and value-realization metrics that leadership can fund against.
  
  
■ Frame AI operating models — CoE design, governance, Responsible AI guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
■ Knowledge of business process transformation and industry value chains (Health, FS, Consumer, Industrials) would be an added advantage.
  
  
Go-To-Market & Offering Development
  
  
■ Shape and package AI offerings, accelerators, and assets into market-ready propositions — positioning, messaging, pricing logic, and differentiation.
  
  
■ Build sales enablement collateral: pitch decks, solution one-pagers, executive pagers, demo storylines, case studies, and battle cards.
  
  
■ Conduct market, competitive, and analyst research (vendors, hyperscalers, AI-native startups) to inform build / buy / partner decisions and offering roadmaps.
  
  
■ Work with alliance partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, ServiceNow, Salesforce, etc.) on joint GTM motions, co-sell plays, and partner-funded programs.
  
  
■ Track adoption and pipeline KPIs for offerings and feed market signals back into the offering roadmap.
  
  
RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits
  
  
■ Lead end-to-end RFP / RFI / RFQ responses for AI and data programs — bid / no-bid qualification, win themes, solution storyline, and response orchestration.
  
  
■ Translate client requirements into a crisp solution narrative, scope, delivery approach, staffing model, and commercial construct, in collaboration with architects and delivery leads.
  
  
■ Own proposal quality — compliance matrices, executive summaries, value articulation, risk and assumption logs.
  
  
■ Prepare and lead client orals, executive workshops, and proof-of-value storyboards; coach pursuit teams on messaging.
  
  
■ Maintain a reusable pursuit library of proposal content, case studies, and credentials.
  
  
AI Fluency (Conversational, Not Hands-On)
  
  
■ Working understanding of LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI frameworks, AI evaluation & observability, and LLMOps — enough to engage architects and challenge solutions credibly.
  
  
■ Awareness of AI risk, regulation, and governance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001) and how they shape client buying decisions.
  
  
■ Familiarity with cloud AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) and enterprise data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake) at a solution level.
  
  
■ Comfort with AI productivity tools to accelerate research, content, and proposal creation.
  
  
Business Development & Client Management
  
  
■ Work closely with account leaders to identify, qualify, and shape opportunities and build tailored value propositions for strategic accounts.
  
  
■ Build trusted relationships with client CXOs, product owners, and transformation leaders.
  
  
■ Represent the firm at analyst briefings, industry forums, webinars, and thought-leadership platforms; author POVs, whitepapers, and blogs.
  
  
Team Leadership & Collaboration
  
  
■ Lead and mentor a small team of strategy consultants and pursuit analysts.
  
  
■ Orchestrate collaboration across solution architects, delivery, sector specialists, alliances, legal, and pricing teams.
  
  
■ Drive knowledge sharing, offering playbooks, and capability-building across the practice.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes**
Educational Background
  
  
■ MBA / PGDM in Strategy, Marketing, or Business Management from a premier institute. Engineering or quantitative undergraduate background preferred.
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  
■ 8–12 years of experience across AI / data product management, strategy consulting, solution / pre-sales, or GTM roles.
  
  
■ Proven track record of shaping and winning AI, GenAI, or data-driven transformation deals, or of taking AI products from strategy to launch and adoption.
  
  
■ Experience building offerings, roadmaps, business cases, and executive-facing collateral for enterprise clients.
  
  
■ Exposure to market research, competitive benchmarking, startup / vendor evaluation, or innovation programs is a strong plus.
  
  
Soft Skills
  
  
■ Exceptional storytelling and executive presence — able to turn complex AI concepts into a compelling, simple business narrative.
  
  
■ Strong structured thinking and problem-solving; comfortable working under pursuit deadlines.
  
  
■ Excellent written communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, especially with C-suite executives.
  
  
■ Influencing without authority across large, matrixed pursuit teams.
  
  
**Preferred Certifications**
■ GenAI / AI strategy certifications (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Coursera, ISB / IIM executive programs, etc.)
  
  
■ Product management or agile certifications (SAFe POPM / PM, Pragmatic, CSPO), Design Thinking.
  
  
■ APMP (proposal management) certification is a plus.
  
  
IDEAL PROFILE
  
  
**You will thrive here if you…**
■ Have taken AI / data products from 0 → 1 and know what drives adoption
  
  
■ Love building the story, the business case, and the winning proposal
  
  
■ Can hold your own with architects — and simplify for the CXO
  
  
■ Have run market scans, vendor evaluations, or innovation programs
  
  
**This role is not…**
■ A hands-on engineering or model-building role
  
  
■ Writing production code, data pipelines, or agent frameworks
  
  
■ Pure delivery / project management
  
  
■ A back-office bid-desk formatting role
  
  
WHY JOIN US
  
  
■ Shape how leading global enterprises adopt AI — and how the firm wins in the AI market.
  
  
■ Work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and growth, with direct visibility to account and practice leadership.
  
  
■ Collaborate with a team of AI experts, solution architects, and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  
■
**Continuous learning**
— You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
  
  
■
**Success as defined by you**
— We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
  
  
■
**Transformative leadership**
— We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
  
  
■
**Diverse and inclusive culture**
— You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
