title: Search Engine Optimization - Lead
description:
We are looking for an SEO Lead who writes and edits with the precision of a senior newsroom editor and the clarity of a seasoned news anchor.

* Job Title: SEO Lead - Editorial
* Website: Globalindian.com
* Location: Hitec City, Hyderabad
* Employment: Full time
* Works with: Editors, Writers, Web Developer, Design, Social and Digital PR
* Experience: 6-10 years in SEO (News, Media or Large content side background is an added bonus)

**About the Role:**

As SEO Lead, you will own the site's organic growth. You will decide what we publish for search, shape how every headline and summary reads, and make sure our journalism is found by the readers it was written for.

This is not a keyword-stuffing role. We want someone whose English is flawless, whose instinct for a headline matches a front-page editor's, and who knows that the best-ranking page is usually the best-written one.

**The language standard we expect**

•        Grammar, punctuation and usage that hold up to a senior copy desk, every time.

•        Headlines and meta descriptions that are accurate, compelling and never clickbait.

•        A clear, neutral, authoritative voice, in the manner of a respected news anchor.

•        Command of a house style guide, and the discipline to enforce it.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**SEO strategy and growth**

•        Own the organic search strategy for GlobalIndian.com and deliver sustained growth in traffic, visibility and engagement.

•        Build quarterly SEO plans tied to editorial priorities and business goals.

•        Track algorithm updates and adjust strategy quickly and calmly.

**Editorial SEO**

•        Write and edit SEO headlines, meta titles, descriptions, URLs and summaries to a publication-ready standard.

•        Brief writers on search intent, structure and angle before they start, not after they finish.

•        Edit copy for clarity, accuracy and readability without diluting the story.

•        Keep content aligned with Google's E-E-A-T and helpful-content principles.

**News and Discover**

•        Optimise stories for Google News, Top Stories and Discover.

•        Spot trending topics early and help the desk publish while interest peaks.

•        Refresh and consolidate evergreen pages so they stay accurate and competitive.

**Technical SEO**

•        Work with the web developer on site architecture, internal linking, Core Web Vitals, crawlability and indexing.

•        Manage structured data (NewsArticle, Article, FAQ, Breadcrumb), sitemaps, canonicals and redirects.

•        Audit the site regularly and resolve issues raised in Google Search Console.

**Authority building**

•        Grow high-quality backlinks through Digital PR and earned media, not paid or guest-post links.

•        Partner with the PR team to turn original stories and data into linkable assets.

**Analytics and reporting**

•        Report weekly and monthly on traffic, rankings, CTR and conversions using GA4 and Search Console.

•        Present findings in plain, precise English that senior leaders can act on.

**Leadership and standards**

•        Own the SEO and style guidelines, and train writers and editors to apply them.

•        Mentor junior SEO executives or freelancers as the team grows.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

•        Bachelor's or master's degree in English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Marketing or a related field.

•        6+ years in SEO, with at least 3 years on a news, media or high-volume content website.

•        Exceptional written and spoken English: error-free, elegant and confident, at the level of a top-tier newspaper editor or national news anchor.

•        A proven record of growing organic traffic, with figures you can show and explain.

•        Deep knowledge of Google News, Discover, E-E-A-T and core algorithm updates.

•        Hands-on with Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, and Screaming Frog.

•        Working knowledge of WordPress, HTML, schema markup and Core Web Vitals.

•        Sound editorial judgement on accuracy, tone and sensitive subjects.

•        Ability to work to news deadlines without lowering standards.

**Preferred Skills**

•        Newsroom experience as a sub-editor, copy editor or reporter.

•        Knowledge of the Indian diaspora, global mobility, education abroad or international careers.

•        Experience recovering organic traffic after a technical or algorithmic setback.

•        Familiarity with Digital PR campaigns and earned-media link building.

•        Experience with international and multilingual SEO.

**Required**
**Experience & Qualifications**

* A proactive communicator and project owner who thrives in cross-functional environments.

* Comfortable working with office productivity suites and project management tools to manage timelines, tasks, and cross-team coordination.

  , always

title: Senior Researcher, Device & Platform Intelligence
description:
Senior Researcher, Device & Platform Intelligence

**Location:**
Hyderabad

About the Role

We are looking for a senior researcher who owns the platform side of our device research strategy — how iOS, Android, browsers, CDNs, and network protocols expose signal that can be used to identify and contextualise a device. You will own research directions end-to-end: forming hypotheses about new signal sources, building prototypes and research tooling, validating findings, and partnering with product and engineering to graduate proven concepts into production.

This role is a company-wide subject-matter expert for platform-level research, sitting alongside a parallel researcher focused on adversarial detection (bots, anti-detect tooling, and threat actors), and collaborating with our data science function for signal modelling and productionisation.

What You Will Do

* Own research strategy for cross-domain device identity discovery across browser, native mobile app, network, and AI-agent surfaces.
* Track Apple and Android developer/product documentation, App Store and Play Store policy changes, OS betas, and browser vendor roadmaps to anticipate changes that affect signal availability — before they ship.
* Research web protocol innovation beyond JavaScript: HTTP semantics, TLS and network fingerprints, client hints, privacy sandbox mechanisms, and emerging browser standards, and their implications for device identification.
* Explore deployment directly into CDNs to observe traffic in flight across a client's entire estate, extending signal collection beyond the endpoint to the network path itself.
* Develop lightweight collectors that simplify deployment, maximise digital interaction coverage, and capture a growing set of digital attributes.
* Track the agentic AI ecosystem (MCP and similar agent protocols, agent architectures) and how agentic clients interact with web and API surfaces, identifying where cross-domain device identity needs to extend to agent traffic.
* Build proof-of-concept collectors and research tooling; document findings; hand validated techniques to engineering for product development.
* Partner with the data science function to translate raw signal discoveries into features and inputs for production models; you are not responsible for building or maintaining those models.
* Serve as the company-wide subject-matter expert for platform-level (iOS/Android/browser/network) research; produce detailed internal documentation.

Experience

* 8+ years in software engineering or platform/security research, with at least 3 years in a research-oriented role.

Tech Skills — Must Have

* Deep expertise in at least two of: native mobile app development at scale (iOS/Android SDKs, App Store/Play environments), browser internals and web protocols, network-level fingerprinting, or CDN architecture.
* Strong CDN knowledge — understanding of how content delivery networks route, cache, and terminate traffic, and how they could be used as a deployment point to observe traffic in flight.
* Demonstrated experience going beyond documented APIs — mining developer documentation, OS release notes, and standards proposals to discover signal opportunities and predict environment changes.
* Experience developing lightweight collectors that simplify deployment, maximise digital interaction coverage, and capture a growing set of digital attributes.
* Strong programming skills in JavaScript/TypeScript plus at least one of Swift, Kotlin, or Go; comfort writing non-production proof-of-concept code quickly.
* Ability to turn ambiguous problem statements into clear experiments with measurable outcomes; strong written and verbal communication in English.

Tech Skills — Nice to Have

* Familiarity with privacy regulation and privacy-preserving signal design (consent frameworks, on-device processing).
* Working knowledge of the agentic AI ecosystem: MCP or similar agent protocols, and how agentic clients interact with web and API surfaces.
* Exposure to reverse engineering or threat analysis, even if not the primary focus of past roles.

title: Founders Office Intern
description:
**Founder’s Office Intern – India**

**Job Description | Pramaanit**

**About**
**Pramaanit**

Pramaanit is building a global trust and verification infrastructure focused on verified identity, student credential verification, digital trust, eSign integrations, compliance workflows, and blockchain-backed verification systems for enterprises, universities, governments, and regulated industries.

We are looking for highly driven Founder’s Office Interns who want first-hand exposure to building a fast-scaling startup from the ground up.

The role involves working directly with the founders across strategy, operations, partnerships, market research, product execution, investor readiness, and growth initiatives. Founder’s Office roles in startups are typically high-agency, cross-functional positions designed to expand founder bandwidth and drive execution across the company.

**Role: Founder’s Office Intern**

**Location:**
India (Remote / Hybrid)

**Duration:**
6 Months

**Type:**
Internship

**Reporting To:**
Founder & Core Leadership Team

**Role Overview**

As a Founder’s Office Intern at Pramaanit, you will work directly with the founders on high-priority strategic and operational initiatives. This is not a conventional internship — you will be involved in real business decisions, product launches, GTM initiatives, partnerships, and market expansion projects.

This role is ideal for candidates who thrive in ambiguity, enjoy solving problems, and want exposure to startup building, business strategy, and execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy & Research**

* Conduct market research across India, UK, Singapore, and global markets
* Analyze competitors in identity verification, eSign, blockchain, RegTech, EdTech, and compliance sectors
* Support preparation of GTM strategies, expansion plans, and business models
* Build reports, dashboards, and strategic presentations

**Founder Support**

* Work closely with founders on daily business priorities
* Coordinate cross-functional projects and ensure execution timelines are met
* Assist in investor decks, partnership proposals, and business documentation
* Participate in leadership discussions and internal reviews

**Operations & Execution**

* Help streamline operational workflows
* Coordinate with product, tech, marketing, and sales teams
* Track KPIs and prepare weekly progress reports
* Support hiring, vendor coordination, and ecosystem outreach

**Growth & Partnerships**

* Research universities, enterprises, and ecosystem partners
* Support outbound outreach campaigns
* Assist in partnership onboarding and relationship management
* Identify new business opportunities and strategic collaborations

**Product & Innovation**

* Gather user feedback and market insights
* Assist in product testing and documentation
* Support product launch initiatives and pilot programs
* Work on AI, blockchain, identity, and verification use cases

**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication and presentation abilities
* High ownership mindset and execution capability
* Ability to work in fast-paced startup environments
* Curiosity about startups, technology, AI, blockchain, identity systems, or compliance ecosystems
* Comfortable handling ambiguity and multitasking

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Pursuing or recently completed:
* MBA
* Engineering
* Business / Economics
* Technology / Data-related programs
* Prior internship/startup experience is a plus
* Familiarity with Excel, PowerPoint, Notion, Canva, or project management tools

**What You’ll Gain**

* Direct mentorship from startup founders
* Exposure to fundraising, strategy, GTM, and startup operations
* Opportunity to work on global-scale trust infrastructure products
* Hands-on experience across multiple business functions
* Potential pathway to PPO / full-time Founder’s Office Associate role

**Ideal Candidate Traits**

* Entrepreneurial mindset
* Strong ownership mentality
* Fast learner
* Structured thinker
* Detail-oriented executor
* Comfortable taking initiative without constant supervision

**Compensation**

* Stipend: Based on experience and skill set
* Performance-based incentives / PPO opportunities
* Certificate & recommendation upon successful completion

title: Manager, Product Design: Application Observability
description: We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!Your opportunityNew Relic is hiring an on-site design manager for our Hyderabad team, leading design for Application Performance Monitoring (APM) and Log Management — two of the platform's most used products. APM gives engineering teams full-stack visibility across their applications: connecting traces, metrics, and infrastructure data so they can find what's breaking and understand why. Log Management is where engineers go to make sense of raw data at scale — ingesting, parsing, and querying log data across their entire stack, without the operational overhead of managing it separately. These are the products engineers open when something is on fire, which means the design work is high-stakes and high-visibility.This is an on-site role in Hyderabad. Many of the engineers and product managers you'll partner with are there too, and being present — in standups, reviews, and the quick conversations before a decision gets made — is part of how you'll build the relationships that make design effective. You'll also work closely with design, product, and engineering partners in the US and Spain, so operating across time zones and communicating well in writing are part of the job, not an afterthought.You'll manage a small team of designers, own the quality of design work across APM and Logs, and stay close enough to the craft to contribute directly when it matters. If you've led a small design team on complex technical products and want clear ownership of both the work and the people — this is that role.What you'll doManage and develop your designers — run consistent 1:1s including regular career development conversations, give direct and specific feedback, set clear expectations for each person, and invest in their growth. Build a team culture where people feel they belong and different perspectives are welcome. You'll represent your team in calibration conversations and advocate for their work and careers within the broader design org.Own design quality across APM and Logs — review work critically, raise problems before they reach partners, and make sure the team is solving the right problems at the right level of craft. You bring user needs and research insights into roadmap conversations, not just design reviews.Partner with PM and Engineering — work with your product and engineering counterparts as a peer. Hold the design perspective, push back when the direction needs it, and communicate design's value in terms of outcomes the business tracks: adoption, retention, time to value.Keep the team focused and on track — manage incoming work, maintain visibility into what's in flight, help the team balance competing priorities, and set clear expectations with PM and Engineering partners about what's possible and when.Help your team use AI well — stay curious about tools like Figma AI, Claude, and Gemini and how they can help your designers work better: faster exploration, smarter prototyping, better research synthesis. Use each hire to bring in diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and build the kind of team where different viewpoints make the work better.Connect Hyderabad to the rest of the design org — bridge your team to design, product, and engineering partners in the US and Spain. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. We celebrate our talented Relics’ different backgrounds and abilities, and recognize the different paths they took to reach us – including nontraditional ones. Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We’re looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes.If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please reach out to resume@newrelic.com.We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office-based, fully remote, or hybrid.Our hiring processIn compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and to complete employment eligibility verification. Note: Our stewardship of the data of thousands of customers means that a criminal background check is required to join New Relic.We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records based on individual circumstances and in accordance with applicable law including, but not limited to, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. description:
FMC Corporation is a global leader in agricultural sciences, driven by our purpose: Innovation for Agriculture. Solutions for the Planet. We are passionate about the power of science to solve agriculture’s biggest challenges. With one of the most productive and diversified pipelines in the industry, FMC is delivering cutting-edge and next-generation crop protection technologies – including Dodhylex™ active, Isoflex™ active, rimisoxafen, and fluindapyr – to help farmers increase the productivity and resilience of their land. Our employees are at the heart of this innovation. We’re looking for bold thinkers and collaborative doers. At FMC, your ideas matter. From day one, you’ll contribute to meaningful work that drives progress in agriculture, supported by a culture that values integrity, safety, respect, and results. Join us in advancing the future of agriculture. Together, we’re building a more resilient planet – one innovation at a time.
  
  
**Job Title: Principal Investigator – Process Engineer**
**Position Summary**
The Process Development group at Innovation Center in Hyderabad works as part of an interdisciplinary team to design and develop synthetic routes for commercial manufacturing processes. Principal Investigator – Process Engineer will provide engineering support of all phases of process development, with responsibility from early stage to commercial launch.  This role includes conducting laboratory-based programs to develop commercial manufacturing processes as part of a cross-functional team of process chemists, analytical chemists and engineers, also partnering with third party Contract Research Organizations (CRO) to ensure pilot campaign success and extract engineering learnings to be used in future commercial manufacturing designs.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**The Role (daily Responsibilities)**

* Lead chemical engineering deliverables for assigned synthetic programs from early and/or late-stage development through process characterization, technology transfer, piloting, validation, and commercial manufacturing.
* Develop and oversee process engineering deliverables, including Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs), Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), process descriptions, and detailed mass and heat balance calculations.
* Participate in rigorous risk assessments, HAZOP studies, failure-mode evaluations, and ensure adherence to safety and environmental standards.
* Provides subject matter expertise across development and scale-up, supporting technical package preparation, process and equipment fit assessment, scale-up strategies, facility readiness evaluations, technology transfer execution, validation activities, and post-transfer process stabilization.
* Provide strong technical leadership at CDMOs and manufacturing sites, including hands-on floor support, rapid troubleshooting, risk-based decision-making, issue escalation, and execution support during engineering, demonstration, pilot, and commercial campaigns.
* Build and maintain high-trust, high-accountability partnerships with external manufacturing partners by establishing clear governance, decision-making frameworks, communication pathways, performance expectations, and risk management processes.
* Lead or guide investigations, root-cause assessments, deviations, non-conformances, CAPAs, change controls, and process performance reviews using data-driven and science-based recommendations.
* Apply chemical engineering fundamentals, modeling, and manufacturing data to improve process capability, yield, purity, cycle time, safety, sustainability, productivity, and cost of goods.
* Proficiency in data analysis tools and process simulation software (e.g., Aspen, MATLAB, Minitab, AutoCAD).
* Apply reaction engineering, thermodynamics, kinetics, heat and mass transfer, mixing, hydrodynamics, separations, filtration, drying, solid-liquid handling, and equipment design to development and manufacturing challenges.
* Create fit-for-purpose laboratory and engineering experiments, representative scale-down models, and process characterization studies that define mechanisms, operating ranges, robustness, and scale-up criteria.
* Integrate process safety, equipment and facility fit, material compatibility, containment, operability, maintainability, and human-factor considerations into process and technology-transfer decisions.
* Author, review, and defend engineering reports, technology-transfer packages, risk assessments, control strategy documents, technical investigations, and regulatory filing sections.
* Establish trusted relationships with CDMO leaders and technical teams while maintaining clear accountability, protecting FMC requirements, and addressing conflict or performance gaps directly and professionally.
* Distill complex technical information into concise recommendations, decision points, risks, and trade-offs for senior leaders, governance forums, regulatory stakeholders, and external partners.

**The Candidate (requirements)**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Chemical Engineering (B.E./B.Tech. or M.E./M.Tech. in Chemical Engineering) is required; a Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering is preferred.
* Ph.D. level Chemical Engineers with a strong background in chemical engineering research and organic chemistry knowledge, as well as work experience in process development, pilot plant and commercial operations.

title: Founder's Office — Growth & Partnerships
description:
Founder's Office — Growth & Partnerships @ 1acre.in

At 1acre.in, we are building the digital infrastructure for India's land marketplace. Land is the country's most opaque asset class, and we are solving it. Take a look at the platform at
https://1acre.in
to understand what we do.

Complete ownership of the segment, and more as your scope scales.

₹50,000 per month + steep performance-linked incentives

Monday to Saturday

**Essential skills & experience:**

* Extensive experience with AWS Route53, including public and private hosted zones, delegation and DNS governance.
* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft DNS running on Active Directory Domain Controllers.
* Strong experience with BIND DNS administration and architecture.
* Deep understanding of DNS protocols, DNSSEC, recursive and authoritative DNS services.
* Experience managing enterprise domain portfolios and registrar relationships.
* Strong knowledge of TCP/IP networking, routing, switching and network security principles.
* Experience with DNS/IPAM integration and tooling.
* Experience with automation technologies such as Python, PowerShell, Terraform or similar.
* Experience using APIs and Infrastructure as Code to automate operational processes.

* AWS networking and infrastructure services.
* F5 DNS/GTM and load balancing technologies.
* NetBox, SolarWinds, Infoblox or similar IPAM platforms.
* VPN, firewall and cloud networking technologies.

**Key Attributes**

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Automation-first mindset.
* Excellent documentation and governance discipline.
* Ability to lead technical standards and best practices.

* Passion for innovation and the practical application of AI within infrastructure operations.

More about

and

.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Identity and Access Management team is responsible for ensuring smooth and secure access transitions across Wise. We handle all aspects of managing access rights and are dedicated to providing seamless support to end-users; from onboarding new joiners to resolving application access issues. We work globally across São Paulo, Tallinn, and Singapore, collaborating closely with Engineering and other UT teams.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
As an Identity and Access Management Technician on the team, you will be frontline support for identity and access management, working with guidance from senior technicians and your team lead. You will help ensure Wisers have the right access to the right tools at the right time — securely and compliantly.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Access Management & Issue Resolution**

* Handle support tickets in our Jira queue, including SailPoint access requests, manual provisioning, and access troubleshooting
* Manage access rights for joiners, movers, and leavers, ensuring timely and compliant provisioning and deprovisioning
* Troubleshoot and resolve routine IAM-related issues across platforms such as Okta, SailPoint, Google Workspace, and other integrated services

**Documentation & Knowledge Sharing**

* Follow existing documentation and processes using our internal wikis, and flag any gaps or outdated content to senior team members
* Create and update basic guides and knowledge base articles for common troubleshooting steps and frequently asked questions

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify frequently recurring tickets and signal process improvement areas to senior technicians and leads
* Escalate recurring issues and support senior team members in addressing root causes with Engineering

**Collaboration & Communication**

* Collaborate with Engineering, and other UT teams
* Communicate effectively with end-users, providing clear guidance and timely updates via Jira, Slack, and other channels
* Observe incident response procedures to develop understanding of major outage workflows and communication protocols.
* Actively seek feedback and mentorship from more experienced team members.

**Qualifications**
**What We're Looking For**
**Required**

* Experience in IT support, identity and access management, or a related technical support role
* Basic understanding of IAM concepts: provisioning, deprovisioning, access reviews, and least-privilege principles
* Experience working with ticketing systems (Jira Service Management or similar)
* Developing troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve routine issues
* Clear and effective written and verbal communication
* Ability to work collaboratively as part of a globally distributed team, seeking guidance when needed
* Customer-first mindset — you genuinely enjoy helping people
* Takes feedback and learning curves well and adjusts accordingly

**Nice to Have**

* Hands-on experience with SailPoint (Identity Security Cloud), Okta, or similar IAM platforms
* Experience with Google Workspace administration
* Understanding of ITIL fundamentals
* Eagerness to learn and pursue relevant certifications (ITIL Foundation, Okta, SailPoint, Atlassian fundamentals)

Additional Information
  
  
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
  
  
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
  
  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
  
  
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
  
  
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

******You Will:******
* Design, build, and maintain scalable Workday integrations (EIB, Core Connectors, Studio, and REST/SOAP APIs) to support HR, Payroll, Finance, and downstream business systems, with an emphasis on reliability, observability, and security.
* Serve as the primary technical owner for key Workday integration domains (e.g., HCM, Absence, Banking, Time Tracking, Talent, and Security), ensuring integrations are versioned, documented, and aligned with LiveRamp’s enterprise architecture and data governance standards.
* Partner closely with HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and external vendors to translate business requirements into technical specifications, sequence diagrams, and test plans, driving clarity on edge cases, SLAs, and operational runbooks.
* Lead the full integration lifecycle—requirements, design, configuration, development, unit testing, system/UAT support, cutover, and hypercare—for Workday feature releases, bi\-annual updates, and project\-based enhancements.
* Implement robust monitoring, alerting, and incident response processes for Workday integrations (including error handling, retries, and data reconciliation), and drive root cause analysis and permanent fixes for production issues.
* Maintain and optimize data flows between Workday and other enterprise applications (e.g., identity and access management, ATS, compensation, benefits, and data warehouse platforms), ensuring data quality, timeliness, and consistency.
* Establish and enforce Workday integration development best practices, including code review standards, naming conventions, configuration management, and re\-usable integration patterns.
* Create and maintain high\-quality technical documentation (design specs, interface contracts, configuration guides, dependency maps) and provide knowledge transfer to peers, admins, and support teams.
* Proactively identify opportunities to streamline business processes through Workday automation, calculated fields, condition rules, and integration\-driven workflows, and build business cases for proposed improvements.
* Track and evaluate new Workday integration features and product roadmap changes, assess potential impact to LiveRamp’s ecosystem, and lead experiments or POCs to validate value and feasibility.
* Define and track key success metrics (e.g., integration uptime, incident volume/MTTR, data defect rate, batch processing times, and audit findings) and regularly report progress to stakeholders.
* Act as a trusted advisor to HR, FINs, and business stakeholders on Workday data structures, integration constraints, and downstream impacts to reporting, controls, and compliance.
* Apply AI\-assisted development and troubleshooting tools (e.g., code copilots, log analyzers) to speed up integration design, debugging, and documentation while maintaining high quality.
* Analyze integration telemetry with AI/ML techniques to identify recurring failure patterns, performance bottlenecks, and opportunities for smarter alerting and auto\-remediation.


******Your Team Will:******
* Partner with People Operations, Payroll, Finance, Security, and other Business Applications teams to build and maintain the core HR technology foundation that powers the full LiveRamp employee lifecycle—from hire to retire. The team owns the Workday platform roadmap for integrations and is responsible for ensuring data flows are accurate, compliant, and resilient across our global systems landscape.
* You will join a small, highly\-collaborative group of Workday and SaaS application experts who:
* Lead key cross\-functional initiatives such as new country/entity rollouts, M\&A onboarding, org restructuring, and global HR process standardization, ensuring Workday integrations are ready to support business change.

* You are a strong collaborator and communicator, able to translate between business language and technical behavior so stakeholders understand both the “why” and the “how” of data flows and changes.
* You are calm under pressure and comfortable troubleshooting ambiguous or complex integration issues, methodically working through hypotheses until you find and fix the root cause.
* You are service\-oriented, finding energy in helping HR, Finance, and business partners be successful through reliable integrations, high\-quality data, and thoughtful support.
* Curious about AI and automation and comfortable learning new tools (e.g., copilots, log analyzers, or analytics platforms) to boost your impact even if you haven’t used them formally before.

******Preferred Skills:******

* Prior participation in Workday bi\-annual releases and major projects, including impact analysis on HR and FINS integrations, regression testing of critical interfaces, and rollout of new capabilities with appropriate monitoring.
* Familiarity with SOX, GDPR, and other privacy/security frameworks that impact HR and finance data, and experience designing integration\-level controls, logging, and audit evidence to support compliance across both domains.

title: Engineer, AI [T500-28844]
description:
**About T\-Mobile:** 




 T\-Mobile US, Inc. (NASDAQ: TMUS) is America’s supercharged Un\-carrier, powered by an award\-winning 5G network that connects more people in more places than ever before. With its unique value proposition of best network, best value, and best experiences, T\-Mobile is redefining connectivity, fueling competition, and driving the next wave of innovation in wireless and beyond. Headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, T\-Mobile provides services through its subsidiaries and operates its flagship brands, T\-Mobile, Metro by T\-Mobile, and Mint Mobile.
 



  





**TMUS Global Solutions:** 




 TMUS Global Solutions is a world\-class technology organization accelerating T\-Mobile’s global digital transformation. Our teams combine engineering talent, technology expertise, and collaborative ways of working to build secure, scalable solutions that improve customer and employee experiences. We foster innovation, agility, transparency, and strong enterprise partnerships to deliver measurable business outcomes.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 This role is responsible for designing, building, and scaling the foundational software platform that powers T\-Mobile’s agentic AI capabilities across conversational experiences, including text and voice interactions. The engineer develops the core execution, orchestration, and integration frameworks that enable AI systems to reason, plan, act, and interact safely with enterprise services at scale, while providing technical leadership for the architecture, evolution, and scalability of the AI execution platform.
 



 Working closely with AI/ML engineers, platform engineers, product teams, and enterprise application teams, this role focuses on building reusable platform capabilities rather than individual AI applications. Responsibilities include designing agent orchestration frameworks, workflow execution engines, SDKs, tool integration layers, memory and state management systems, and conversational runtime services that support next\-generation customer and employee experiences.
 



 Success in this role requires strong software engineering expertise, distributed systems knowledge, and practical understanding of LLM\-powered systems, with an emphasis on reliability, extensibility, scalability, and platform adoption. We pride ourselves on encouraging a culture of innovation, agile ways of working, and transparency in all we do. Join us in embodying the spirit of the Un\-carrier and making a tangible impact.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 



* Design and develop agent orchestration frameworks and execution engines supporting complex AI\-driven workflows.
* Design and optimize low\-latency services supporting real\-time conversational and voice interactions.
* Build reusable platform services, SDKs, APIs, and libraries that accelerate development of conversational AI applications.
* Design and implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations and frameworks that enable secure, scalable access to enterprise tools, APIs, data sources, and agent capabilities.
* Develop reusable tool\-calling, context\-sharing, and interoperability services that support MCP\-enabled agent ecosystems.
* Develop runtime services for text\- and voice\-based agent interactions, including context management, tool execution, memory, and state orchestration.
* Architect microservices and event\-driven systems that integrate AI reasoning with enterprise systems such as customer, billing, network, and support platforms.
* Design mechanisms that safely translate model outputs into deterministic business actions and workflows.
* Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to integrate foundation models, retrieval systems, evaluation frameworks, and agent capabilities into production platforms.
* Drive platform reliability, scalability, observability, and performance across high\-volume AI workloads.
* Establish software architecture standards, engineering best practices, and reusable design patterns for agentic systems.
* Contribute to technical strategy and platform evolution by evaluating emerging AI, orchestration, and distributed systems technologies.
* Mentor engineers and promote engineering excellence through design reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing.



  





**What You'll Bring:** 



* 7\+ years of software engineering experience building distributed systems and cloud\-native applications.
* Strong proficiency in Python or Java, with working knowledge of both preferred.
* Experience designing APIs, microservices, workflow engines, or platform services.
* Experience building systems that integrate with LLMs, AI services, or conversational platforms.
* Experience designing highly available distributed systems and service\-oriented architectures.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, scalability, resiliency, and performance optimization.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical design discussions, driving architectural decisions, and influencing engineering direction across teams.
* Experience with cloud\-native technologies, including containers, Kubernetes, and service\-based architectures.
* Excellent problem\-solving, debugging, and technical communication skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience integrating AI systems with enterprise applications, APIs, tools, or data platforms through standardized integration patterns.



  





**Must Have Skills:** 



* Python software engineering
* Distributed systems, APIs, and microservices
* LLM, AI service, and conversational platform integration
* Cloud\-native architecture, containers, and Kubernetes
* Software architecture and technical leadership.



  





**Nice\-to\-Have:** 



* Experience building agent orchestration frameworks, workflow platforms, or AI execution systems.
* Experience with conversational AI, voice platforms, speech technologies, or real\-time interaction systems.
* Familiarity with retrieval systems, vector databases, memory architectures, and evaluation frameworks.
* Experience designing internal developer platforms, SDKs, or reusable engineering frameworks.
* Knowledge of event\-driven architectures, distributed workflows, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent tool\-calling frameworks, or similar standards for connecting AI systems with external tools and services.
* Experience designing reusable tool integration frameworks, context management systems, or agent interoperability platforms.

title: Hardware Engineer - RF and Electronics
description:
This is a hardware job. You will lay out boards, populate and bring them up on a bench, tune a radio link and go outside to measure what its range actually is, and climb a mast at a helipad to make the thing work.
 



  





 WE ARE NOT HIRING A SOFTWARE ENGINEER. The firmware architecture and the ground\-station software sit with our founding innovator and will continue to. You will write firmware — plenty of it, bare\-metal and RTOS, against a datasheet and a scope, because that is part of hardware engineering. You will not own the software stack. If what you want is to write code for a living, this role will disappoint you inside a month and we would rather say so now.
 



  





 2–4 years. Hyderabad. First two months at Gandhinagar, Gujarat, on a live deployment.
 



  





 ABOUT US
 



  





 BharatVijay Nexgen Innovation Private Limited is a DPIIT\-recognised Indian startup (DIPP260346\) in aeronautics, aerospace and defence equipment, founded by Lt Col Shailendra Thapliyal (Retd).
 



  





 Our product is the Digital Windsock — an Automatic Helipad Weather Reporting System. It is solar\-powered and fully autonomous, measures wind speed and direction, temperature, humidity, pressure and rainfall, and delivers that weather to pilots through six independent channels: VHF/UHF radio broadcast out to roughly 10 km, an aviation data link that aircraft decode on approach, ATIS\-style local audio at the pad, a remote display in the operations office, SMS, and network integration over 4G with store\-and\-forward. It is built to run unattended for months, off\-grid, where nobody is coming to reset it.
 



  





 We are five people. Bootstrapped, no funding round.
 



  





 WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH
 



  





 One person currently does all of it — mechanics, PCB, firmware, software, commissioning. Everything in our products has come off his bench. This role exists to build a hardware capability around him. You will sit next to the person who built the product and take real ownership of its physical layers.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



  





 From month three: the RF and antenna chain and the power system, end to end. Antenna selection and siting, matching, link budget, the measured range at each site, and the solar and battery sizing that keeps a unit alive between them. You are the person on the phone when a link degrades at a customer site.
 



  





 At around month four: you commission a unit end to end, on site, on your own. Clear that and your first salary review is brought forward and uncapped.
 



  





 By around month six: one board revision end to end — schematic, layout, fabrication files, bring\-up and test record.
 



  





 WHAT WE NEED YOU TO HAVE EVIDENCED
 



  





 At least three of the following, and at least one from the first two:
 



  





 1\. PCB design — schematic and layout in KiCad, Altium, Eagle, OrCAD or EasyEDA, fabricated, populated and debugged by you
 



 2\. Board bring\-up and component\-level fault\-finding — bare board to working, faults found with a scope, meter and logic analyser
 



 3\. RF and wireless — a link you designed, matched or tuned, with range, RSSI or packet loss you measured outdoors
 



 4\. Sensor integration and calibration against a reference instrument
 



 5\. DC and solar power — panels, charge controller, battery, load budget, proven autonomy
 



 6\. Mechanical design and fabrication — enclosures, brackets, mounts or masts from CAD through fabrication, with weatherproofing and ingress protection
 



 7\. Qualification testing — EMI/EMC, thermal, vibration or environmental, with the documentation
 



 8\. Field installation and commissioning of equipment at a customer or field site
 



  





 Useful, and not a substitute for any of the above: embedded C and C\+\+, Python for tools and test scripts, bare\-metal and RTOS firmware, Linux command line, practical networking, version control.
 



  





 QUALIFICATION: B.E./B.Tech in ECE, Electronics, EEE, Mechatronics or Instrumentation. A Diploma holder with exceptional practical work will also be considered.
 



  





 ON FRESHERS: we are hiring at 2–4 years. One narrow exception — if you have designed a PCB, had it fabricated, populated it, brought it up and made it work, and you can show us the board, apply and say plainly that you are a fresher. A breadboard project or an Arduino build is not that.
 



  





 TERMS
 



  





 ₹6,00,000–₹9,00,000 per annum, fixed. One hundred per cent fixed pay, no variable component, paid on a fixed date every month. EPF from day one. ₹5,00,000 family medical floater including your parents, plus personal accident cover. Written salary review at 12 months with a committed minimum increase stated in your offer letter. Retention payments at 12 and 24 months. Annual tools and components budget. Field expenses reimbursed within seven days. Safety equipment provided and replaced when worn.

title: Advisor/Sr. Advisor – Process Engineer-Peptides/Small molecule Scientist
description:
At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life\-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.
   

  

**Company Overview**
 Lilly, a leading innovation\-driven corporation is developing a growing portfolio of pharmaceutical products by applying the latest research from its own worldwide laboratories and from collaborations with eminent scientific organizations. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, Lilly makes life better – through medicines and information – for some of the world’s most urgent medical needs. Founded over 145 years ago, the company has sustained a culture that values excellence, integrity and respect for people. This has resulted in Lilly frequently being ranked as one of the best companies in the world at which to work. Lilly knows its business has prospered because of its employees – people with a talent for innovation and a passion for making a difference by finding treatments for the most stubborn diseases; people whose talent is matched by their generosity, and people with strong values and a determination to prevail, regardless of the challenges. Join our team – and make a difference in improving health for people all over the world!
   

  

**Manufacturing and Quality Technical Hub Hyderabad**
 Lilly has made a strategic investment of more than $1B dollars to establish a Manufacturing and Quality technical hub. This hub will oversee the significant investment in contract manufacturing of starting materials and intermediates for API manufacturing in India and the technical services responsible for managing the scientific agenda for manufacturing and quality. The hub will be recruiting top talent in the areas of process engineering, chemistry, analytical and data sciences to build a cutting\-edge scientific organization supporting the exciting manufacturing portfolio of Lilly.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Overview and Key Responsibilities** 
 :
   

  

 Process Engineer provides technical leadership and hands‑on engineering support for the design, optimization, and scale‑up of laboratory‑based processes that enable robust manufacturing of drug substances and drug products. This role partners closely with development scientists, and cross‑functional engineering groups to deliver high‑quality technical solutions, reliable laboratory operations, and effective technology transfer. The successful candidate should have a proven track record of driving technical agendas and influence externally in the peptide and small molecule space.
   

  

**Technical Development \& Support**
* Partner with TS/MS scientists/analytical scientist in India, US and Ireland to design, develop, and refine laboratory‑scale processes.
* Establish, maintain, and optimize unit operations used in the process development lab (e.g., chromatography, filtration, mixing, crystallization, upstream/downstream studies, formulation experiments, and others).
* Develop scale‑down models that accurately represent full‑scale operations and use them to support process characterization, robustness studies, and troubleshooting.
* Conduct hands‑on laboratory experimentation, data analysis, and technical reporting to support key development and manufacturing decisions.


**Process Optimization \& Technology Transfer**
* Support tech transfer activities by preparing process documentation, generating process parameters, and enabling smooth movement of processes from lab to pilot or manufacturing scale.
* Support technical process issues and to implement long‑term improvements informed by lab experimentation.
* Apply engineering fundamentals and first‑principles thinking to develop innovative solutions, improve process understanding, and enhance robustness.
* Adhere to safe operation of laboratory equipment and ensure compliance with EH\&S expectations.
* Maintain high‑quality documentation practices, including experimental protocols, batch records, and engineering analyses.


**Cross‑Functional Collaboration**
* Collaborate closely with automation, analytical, mechanical, and instrumentation engineering groups to introduce new tools, models, and technologies.
* Partner with Quality, TS/MS, and manufacturing to align development activities with long‑term production needs.


**Education And Experience Requirement**
* Ph.D. in scientific disciplines of Biochemistry, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or related fields, or equivalent industry experience Ph.D., Post Doc in Chemistry (Small molecule and Peptide chemistry) with 5\-12 years’ experience.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in process development, lab‑scale engineering, or manufacturing support in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or similar industries.
* Experience with process modeling software (e.g., Aspen, MATLAB, statistical design tools).
* Working knowledge of GMP expectations and laboratory quality systems.
* Demonstrated experience in technology transfer and scale‑up/scale‑down, in laboratory‑scale unit operations relevant to the role (e.g., chromatography, TFF, bioreactors, mixing systems, filtration and drying technologies).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong problem‑solving abilities and abilities to work independently with minimal direction.


**Other Information**
* Some travel (domestic and international) less than 5% may be required.

**Job Title**
**Principal Analyst – Taleo Application (IT Enterprise Solutions)**
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced Principal Analyst to own the strategy, configuration, integration, and support of the Oracle Taleo Enterprise Edition (ATS) platform. The ideal candidate will bring strong functional command of the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle, deep hands\-on expertise across all Taleo modules and features, and proven experience delivering full\-cycle Taleo ATS implementations. This role requires a seasoned professional who can independently manage integrations with HRMS/ERP systems, background check providers, job boards, and career sites, while serving as the primary point of contact for stakeholders and external vendors.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
***End\-to\-End Recruitment Process \& Taleo Application Ownership***
* Own and drive functional and technical ownership of the Oracle Taleo Enterprise Edition platform across all modules, including Taleo Recruiting (OTAC), Onboarding, Career Sections (internal and external), and Taleo Connect Client (TCC).
* Demonstrate strong functional knowledge of the complete recruitment lifecycle – requisition creation and approval, sourcing, candidate screening, interview scheduling, offer management, background verification, and onboarding – and translate this knowledge into effective Taleo configurations.
* Lead the design, configuration, testing, and rollout of new Taleo features, workflows, and enhancements aligned to evolving recruitment and business needs.
* Provide advanced production support and root\-cause troubleshooting for issues related to requisitions, workflows, offers, career sites, and integrations.
* Manage Taleo upgrades, patches, and release cycles, ensuring minimal disruption to live recruitment operations.


***Taleo Connect Client (TCC) \& Integrations***
* Serve as the hands\-on subject matter expert for Taleo Connect Client (TCC), independently building, testing, scheduling, and troubleshooting inbound/outbound data integrations and exports/imports.
* Design, build, and maintain integrations between Taleo and HRMS/ERP systems, including Oracle ERP/HCM, ensuring seamless data flow for candidate, requisition, and employee records.
* Own integrations with background check providers, job boards/aggregators, and career site platforms, ensuring accurate posting, sourcing, and candidate data exchange.
* Work with XML, CSV, flat\-file structures, web services, and APIs to support integration development, monitoring, and error resolution.
* Ensure data integrity, security, and compliance across all integration touchpoints in line with organizational and regulatory requirements.


***Implementation \& Project Delivery***
* Independently manage and execute Taleo ATS implementations end\-to\-end, from requirements gathering and solution design through configuration, testing, cutover, and hypercare support.
* Prepare functional and technical specification documents, configuration workbooks, test scripts, and cutover/rollout plans.
* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) cycles, coordinate defect resolution, and manage go\-live readiness.
* Drive process improvement initiatives to optimize recruitment workflows, system performance, and user experience.


***Stakeholder \& Vendor Management***
* Act as the primary liaison between HR, Talent Acquisition, IT, and business leadership to gather requirements and translate them into scalable Taleo solutions.
* Build strong working relationships with stakeholders across geographies, managing expectations, timelines, and priorities effectively.
* Manage relationships with Oracle Taleo support, implementation partners, background check vendors, and job board/career site providers, including contract deliverables, SLAs, and issue escalation.
* Communicate clearly and confidently with technical and non\-technical audiences, through written documentation, presentations, and verbal updates to stakeholders and leadership.


***Reporting, Compliance \& Mentoring***
* Develop and maintain standard and custom Taleo reports and dashboards to support recruiting metrics, compliance reporting, and executive insights.
* Ensure recruitment processes and system configurations align with applicable compliance requirements (e.g., EEOC, OFCCP, GDPR, and internal audit/SOX controls where applicable).
* Provide technical and functional guidance to junior analysts and HR systems team members, and contribute to knowledge transfer, training, and documentation.


**Required Qualifications**
***Experience***
* 8–12\+ years of overall IT/HR systems experience, with a significant portion focused on Oracle Taleo Enterprise Edition.
* Proven track record of having managed and executed at least one full\-cycle Taleo ATS implementation, in addition to multiple enhancement and support engagements.
* Mandatory hands\-on expertise with Taleo Connect Client (TCC), including building and troubleshooting integrations independently.
* Demonstrated experience integrating Taleo with HRMS/ERP platforms (e.g., Oracle ERP/HCM), background check providers, job boards, and career sites.


***Technical \& Functional Skills***
* Strong functional command of the end\-to\-end recruitment process and how it maps to Taleo Recruiting, requisition lifecycle, candidate management, and offer processes.
* In\-depth, hands\-on knowledge of Taleo application features and functions across Recruiting, Onboarding, and Career Sections.
* Proficiency with XML, CSV, and data integration techniques, along with web services and APIs.
* Experience with Career Section configuration, branding, and localization.
* Strong reporting and analytics capability within the Taleo platform.


***Soft Skills***
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, negotiate, and drive alignment across cross\-functional and cross\-geography teams.
* Demonstrated vendor management experience, including managing SLAs, escalations, and deliverables with external partners.
