title: Product Management Intern
description:
**Description \& Requirements**
 Electronic Arts creates next\-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
   

  

**Product Management Intern – Growth \& Player Marketing**
**Location: Hyderabad (In office)**
**Duration: 8\- 10 weeks**
**About EA**
 Electronic Arts Inc. is a global leader in interactive entertainment. We develop and deliver games, content and online services across platforms. We have a broad portfolio of brands that span the most popular genres.
   

  

 We exist to Inspire the World to Play. We create extraordinary new game experiences for our millions of players everywhere by bringing together talented people that combine creativity, innovation, and passion. We immerse our employees in an inclusive culture and provide opportunities for learning and leading that allow our employees to do the most impactful and rewarding work of their careers.
   

  

 Join us in driving the next revolution in games.
   

  

**Help Us Create Games Players Love To Talk About**
 EA is looking for a Product Management Intern who is curious about players, data, culture, storytelling, and what makes a game stand out. The intern will report to a PM/ SPM and work closely with game designers, developers, artists, analysts, user researchers, and marketing teams to help us understand our audiences, shape how we communicate with players, and support campaigns that introduce more people to our games and encourage existing players to keep coming back.
   

  

 In this role, the intern will support the development and improvement of game features, live events, progression systems, monetization experiences, and player journeys. It will use a combination of player feedback, market research, game data, and structured problem\-solving to identify opportunities and help the team make better product decisions.
   

  

 This internship is ideal for someone who enjoys games, understands what makes players return to them, and wants to learn how successful games are designed, launched, measured, and improved.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Product and Creative Collaboration
+ Collaborate with analysts, designers, engineers and artists to gather inputs, scope product requirements and communicate decisions to stakeholders.
+ Support product managers in defining features, events, progression systems, social features, and monetization experiences.
+ Participate in playtests, design reviews, sprint planning, and feature retrospectives.
+ Create product collaterals to document learnings, and support teams in tracking feature scope, development progress \& utilization.

* Campaigns and Game Launches
+ Help develop player communication journeys across push notifications, email, social media, community channels, and in\-game messages.
+ Support the planning and execution of campaigns for new features, events, content updates, and game launches.
+ Help create campaign briefs that define the audience, player insight, message, channels, and success metrics.
+ Contribute ideas for social media content, creator partnerships, in\-game messaging, app\-store promotions, and community activations.
+ Support A/B tests across messages, creative concepts, channels, offers, and audience segments.

* Market Research:
+ Conduct competitor research \& emerging trends to identify growth opportunities and propose product features to game leads.

* Player Insights:
+ Analyze game telemetry data to understand player behavior across areas such as onboarding, progression, retention, engagement, conversion, and monetization.
+ Identify drop\-offs, friction points, and underserved player needs within the game.
+ Understand player persona and expectations based on qualitative data from surveys, app\-store reviews, community channels, customer support, and social media.


**Must Have**
* Interest in games and understanding games as a business
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with keen attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Structured problem\-solving and analytical thinking.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-moving, cross\-functional environment.


**Good To Have**
* Familiarity with free\-to\-play games, live\-service games, and mobile games, and understanding of game metrics
* Experience with SQL, Excel, Google Sheets, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or another analytics tool.
* Experience creating surveys, analyzing customer feedback, or conducting user research.
* Experience participating in gaming communities, esports, game jams, fandoms, creator communities, or student clubs.


**What Success Will Look Like**
 During the internship, the intern should be able to:
   

  

* Develop a practical understanding of game development and product management lifecycle.
* Independently analyze a player or product problem and recommend potential solutions.
* Contribute to at least one feature, event, experiment, or product improvement from discovery through evaluation.
* Produce clear product documentation that helps cross\-functional teams make decisions.
* Build strong working relationships with product, design, engineering, art, analytics, and other partner teams.


**Sample Internship Projects**
 Depending On The Team’s Priorities, The Intern Will Be Assigned To a Game Team, And They May Work On Projects Such As
   

  

* Creating go\-to\-market strategy for a new game under development
* Analyzing the new player onboarding funnel and recommending improvements.
* Conducting a competitive review of progression or social systems.
* Identifying causes of player churn within a specific segment


**About Electronic Arts**
 We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
   

  

 We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well\-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.
   

  

 Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

title: Senior Analyst - Procurement Research
description:
Do you have a strong understanding of end\-to\-end procurement processes and how emerging technologies are transforming these processes? Are you experienced in primary and secondary research methods? We are seeking an individual to play a pivotal role in our procurement practice, supporting the development of thought leadership and the creation of research content.
 



 At The Hackett Group®, we offer opportunities to learn, connect, and collaborate with professionals worldwide, helping them achieve new performance and competitive advantages. As a procurement research professional, you will partner with Hackett’s procurement advisors, clients, and global stakeholders across industries to understand key trends, issues, and challenges related to establishing world\-class performance. You will be a member of The Hackett Group’s research team, which covers G\&A functions (finance, HR, AI, and procurement), GBS, payroll, and other end\-to\-end process programs. You will work closely with advisors in the Applied Intelligence practice and colleagues across the research organization.
 



**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking an experienced procurement research professional to play a pivotal role in the development of high‑impact thought leadership, benchmarking insights, and client‑facing research deliverables. This role sits within The Hackett Group’s global research team and works in close partnership with senior procurement advisors and practice leaders.
 



 Success in this role requires exceptional PowerPoint capability, strong analytical skills, and proven research experience. Candidates must be able to operate independently, move quickly, and translate research insights into clear, compelling, executive‑ready deliverables with minimal guidance.
 



**Critical Success Factors for This Role** 




**PowerPoint Mastery – Mandatory** 




 PowerPoint is not a supporting skill in this role; it is
 *core* 
 . The successful candidate must:
 


* Walk in the door with advanced PowerPoint skills, including slide storytelling, visual structuring of complex ideas, charting, tables, and executive‑level layouts
* Work quickly and confidently in creating and refining slides for senior audiences
* Be capable of producing polished, client‑ready decks (e.g., Spotlight reports, benchmark readouts, research summaries) with limited iteration



**Excel \& Analytical Skills – Strongly Preferred** 



* Highly proficient user of Generative AI models (inc. Co\-Pilot) and a proven ability to interrogate and validate the model outputs.
* Solid Excel skills are required for analyzing benchmark data, survey results, and research inputs
* Ability to move from raw data to insights efficiently



**Prior Research Experience** 




 This role requires proven procurement research experience. The candidate must have:
 


* Hands‑on experience with primary and secondary research in a professional setting
* Prior responsibility for shaping research questions, analyzing findings, synthesizing insights, and developing structured research outputs
* Demonstrated ability to work independently in a fast\-paced, deadline driven environment



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop fresh perspectives on procurement business and technology trends, including emerging areas such as generative AI and agentic AI
* Lead and support the creation of procurement research deliverables, including:
* Benchmark‑driven and Spotlight reports
* Quantitative and qualitative research outputs
* Client\-specific insights and customized deliverables
* Executive presentations and and thought leadership content
* Training, enablement, and knowledge\-sharing materials
* Shape, execute, and synthesize findings from quantitative and qualitative research initiatives
* Translate research outputs into high‑quality PowerPoint deliverables for internal and external use
* Edit, critique, and refine research outputs to meet Hackett quality, storytelling and presentation standards
* Collaborate closely with procurement advisors to ensure research remains relevant, actionable, and client‑ready
* Track procurement and technology trends via market analysis, vendor activity, news, and investment signals
* Ensure turnaround\-time (TAT) targets for all deliverables/requests are consistently met



**Ways of Working / Operating Model** 



* This role works primarily with senior procurement leaders as internal customers who will
* Provide direction on research topics and priorities
* Set expectations for deliverable types, content focus, and timing
* Offer feedback and content insights
* The role holder is expected to:
* Self‑manage workstreams and deliverables
* Take ownership for execution, structure, and quality
* Operate with minimal project management support



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* 6 to 9 years of experience in procurement research and advisory role
* Demonstrated experience delivering research‑based insights in a professional environment
* Strong understanding of procure\-to\-pay, source\-to\-contract, supply base planning and strategy, and function management and administration activities within the procurement function
* MBA from a business school of repute with a major specialization in any of the following: Operations / Procurement / Supply Chain Management
* Exceptional written, verbal, and visual communication skills
* Strong proficiency in PowerPoint (advanced) and Excel
* Advanced understand of LLM models (inc. Co\-Pilot)



  





**Additional Skills \& Attributes** 



* Experience with survey design and research tools (e.g., Qualtrics, SPSS, SAS)
* Understanding and exposure to data visualization tools such as Power BI
* Ability to perform rigorous secondary research and synthesize diverse data sources
* High attention to detail, speed, and quality under time pressure
* Comfortable working with senior stakeholders and incorporating feedback quickly
* Self‑driven, intellectually curious, and highly accountable for outcomes
* Flexible and adaptable in responding to evolving research priorities and emerging stakeholder requests while maintaining ownership, quality and delivery discipline

title: Go-To-Market (GTM) Professional — India
description:
Go\-To\-Market (GTM) Professional — India
 
  
 





  
 




 Location: Hyderabad, India
 
  
 




 Work Mode: Work from office (Hyderabad)
 
  
 




 Function: Marketing / Go\-To\-Market / Demand Generation
 
  
 




 Reports to: GTM / Marketing Leader — India
 
  
 




 Role Type: Individual contributor
 
  
 





  
 




 Role Summary
 
  
 





  
 




 CloudNuro is hiring a Go\-To\-Market (GTM) Professional to drive demand generation, build and optimize web properties and landing pages, run multi\-channel marketing campaigns, and generate qualified marketing leads (MQLs) and sales\-qualified leads (SQLs) for CloudNuro’s B2B SaaS, Cloud Management, FinOps, and AI Governance platform. This is a hands\-on, work\-from\-office role based in Hyderabad that blends web development, campaign execution, and marketing operations — ideal for someone who is analytical, creative, data\-driven, and eager to grow demand and pipeline in enterprise SaaS.
 
  
 





  
 




 Key Responsibilities
 
  
 





  
 




 • Plan, build, and optimize landing pages, microsites, and web properties using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and CMS/landing\-page builders (WordPress, Webflow, HubSpot).
 
  
 




 • Design and execute multi\-channel demand\-generation campaigns across email, LinkedIn, paid media, SEO/SEM, webinars, and content syndication.
 
  
 




 • Generate, nurture, and qualify MQLs and SQLs; manage lead scoring, routing, and clean hand\-off to the sales team.
 
  
 




 • Set up and manage marketing automation, email workflows, forms, and campaign tracking (UTMs, pixels, GA4, conversion events).
 
  
 




 • Run A/B tests on landing pages, emails, and creatives to continuously improve conversion and engagement rates.
 
  
 




 • Manage on\-page and technical SEO basics, keyword research, and content optimization to grow organic traffic.
 
  
 




 • Track, analyze, and report on campaign performance — traffic, conversions, MQLs, SQLs, cost\-per\-lead, and pipeline contribution.
 
  
 




 • Learn CloudNuro’s value proposition across SaaS optimization, cloud cost management, and AI spend governance, and translate it into compelling messaging.
 
  
 




 • Collaborate closely with sales, product, and design to align on ICP, messaging, and overall GTM strategy.
 
  
 




 • Maintain accurate CRM and marketing\-automation records for accounts, contacts, campaigns, and attribution.
 
  
 





  
 




 Required Experience
 
  
 





  
 




 • 2–4 years of experience in GTM, growth, digital marketing, or demand generation — ideally for B2B SaaS or technology products.
 
  
 




 • Hands\-on web development skills: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, plus experience with CMS or landing\-page builders (WordPress, Webflow, HubSpot, Unbounce).
 
  
 




 • Proven track record of running campaigns and generating MQLs and SQLs across email, LinkedIn, paid, and organic channels.
 
  
 




 • Experience with marketing automation and CRM tools (HubSpot, Marketo, Salesforce) and analytics platforms (GA4, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager).
 
  
 




 • Working knowledge of SEO/SEM and conversion\-rate optimization (CRO).
 
  
 




 • Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with data, dashboards, and performance reporting.
 
  
 




 • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
 
  
 




 • High ownership, curiosity, and interest in SaaS, cloud, AI, FinOps, or enterprise technology.
 
  
 





  
 




 Success Measures
 
  
 





  
 




 • Volume and quality of MQLs and SQLs generated (including MQL\-to\-SQL conversion).
 
  
 




 • Campaign performance — traffic, conversion rates, and cost\-per\-lead.
 
  
 




 • Landing page and website conversion improvements.
 
  
 




 • Pipeline and revenue influenced or contributed.
 
  
 




 • Organic traffic and keyword ranking growth.

title: Retention & Growth Manager
description:
RETENTION \& GROWTH MANAGER \- XTOVIA
 



 Location: Hyderabad
 



 Work Mode: Full\-Time \| Work From Office
 



 Experience: 2\-5 years
 



 Industry: Beauty \& Haircare / D2C
 



  





 About XTOVIA
 



 Xtovia is a Hyderabad\-based, science\-backed haircare brand reimagining Indian beauty at global standards. Powered by our proprietary TriLayerX bond\-repair technology, Xtovia is building a new generation of high\-performance haircare for Indian hair.
 



 We are a fast\-growing D2C brand building a strong customer community and a long\-term relationship with our customers through product innovation, education and personalised experiences.
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We're looking for a Retention \& Growth Manager to take ownership of the customer lifecycle at Xtovia.
 



 The core focus of this role is retention marketing converting first\-time buyers into repeat customers, increasing customer lifetime value, and building a loyal customer base.
 



 You will work across CRM, customer segmentation, lifecycle campaigns, loyalty, referrals, reactivation and customer engagement. This is a highly hands\-on role where you will be expected to analyse, experiment, execute and learn quickly.
 



  





 What You'll Do
 



  





 Customer Retention
 



  





 \-Own and execute Xtovia's retention and repeat\-purchase strategy.
 



 \-Identify opportunities to increase repeat purchase rate, purchase frequency and LTV.
 



 \-Analyse customer behaviour to understand why customers repurchase, churn or become inactive.
 



 \-Build replenishment strategies based on product usage and consumption cycles.
 



 \-Develop cross\-sell and upsell journeys across the product portfolio.
 



 \-Build win\-back strategies for dormant and lapsed customers.
 



  





 CRM \& Lifecycle Marketing
 



  





 \-Own the customer journey from first purchase product experience replenishment repeat purchase loyalty advocacy.
 



 \-Plan and execute campaigns across WhatsApp, Email, SMS and other CRM channels.
 



 \-Build automated journeys for welcome, post\-purchase, product education, replenishment, cross\-sell, upsell, abandoned cart and win\-back.
 



 \-Test different messaging, offers, content, timing and customer segments.
 



 \-Work closely with the content and creative teams to develop high\-performing CRM campaigns.
 



  





 Loyalty \& Community
 



  





 \-Build and manage loyalty and rewards initiatives.
 



 \-Develop referral programs to turn existing customers into acquisition channels.
 



 \-Drive customer reviews, UGC, testimonials and referrals.
 



 \-Create campaigns that build engagement and brand affinity beyond discount\-led marketing.
 



  





 Data \& Experimentation
 



  





 \-Track Repeat Purchase Rate, LTV, Churn, Purchase Frequency, CRM Revenue, AOV and Reactivation Rate.
 



 \-Build customer segments based on purchase behaviour, recency, frequency, product purchased and customer value.
 



 \-Analyse campaign performance and identify growth opportunities.
 



 \-Run A/B tests and continuously optimise the customer lifecycle.
 



  





 What We're Looking For
 



 \-2\-5 years of experience in Retention Marketing, CRM, Lifecycle Marketing, D2C or E\-commerce.
 



 \-Strong understanding of customer lifecycle and retention marketing.
 



 \-Hands\-on experience with WhatsApp, Email, SMS and CRM/marketing automation platforms.
 



 \-Strong analytical skills and comfort working with customer data.
 



 \-Experience with Shopify and D2C analytics is a plus.
 



 \-Experience in beauty, personal care, wellness or consumer brands is preferred.
 



 \-Strong communication and copywriting skills.
 



 \-Someone who enjoys experimenting and finding out what actually makes customers come back.
 



 \-A hands\-on, ownership\-driven startup mindset.
 



  





 What Success Looks Like
 



  





 Your core goal: Turn first\-time customers into repeat customers and repeat customers into loyal Xtovia advocates.
 



  





 You will be responsible for improving: Repeat Purchase Rate \| Customer LTV \| Purchase Frequency \| CRM Revenue \| Reactivation \| Customer Engagement \| Referrals
 



  





 Why Join Xtovia?
 



 \-Work directly with the founding team.
 



 \-Own retention marketing for a fast\-growing Indian haircare brand.
 



 \-Build the CRM, loyalty and customer lifecycle engine from the ground up.
 



 \-Get exposure to D2C growth, consumer behaviour, data and brand building.
 



 \-High ownership, experimentation and learning.
 



  





 Apply
 



 Location: Hyderabad
 



 Work Mode: Full\-Time \| Work From Office
 



 Send your resume to:
 



 levelup@xtovia.com

title: Senior Content Strategist
description:
**Senior Content Strategist** 

 📍 Hyderabad \| Full\-time
 



  




**A note from the founders** 

 A lot of content today is written to fill space. Blogs get published, emails get sent, product pages get updated, but very little of it actually helps the customer understand or decide.
 



 We see content differently.
 



 At SkinBae, content is how we build trust. It’s how we explain products, educate customers, and shape how the brand is understood. This role is for someone who enjoys going deeper. Someone who likes researching, thinking, and explaining things clearly instead of just writing quickly.
 



 If you care about clarity, accuracy, and doing content properly, you’ll enjoy this role.
 



  




**About SkinBae** 

 SkinBae is building a curated Korean skincare platform in India. We work closely with global brands and focus on thoughtful storytelling, strong visuals, and education\-led marketing.
 



 We are growing fast, and the team we build now will shape how the brand communicates across every touchpoint.
 



  




**Role Overview** 

 This role is about owning content end to end across the brand. You will work across websites, marketplaces, CRM, performance marketing, campaigns, PR, customer communication, and offline marketing, ensuring that everything we write is clear, consistent, accurate, and aligned with the brand.
 



 This is not just writing. It involves research, strategic thinking, content planning, structuring information, maintaining the brand voice, and making sure content actually helps the business and the customer.
 



  




**What You Will Own** 

  




**Content Strategy \& Brand Voice** 
* Develop and execute content strategies aligned with SkinBae’s short\-term and long\-term marketing and business goals
* Define and maintain a consistent brand voice across website, marketplaces, CRM, campaigns, social media, PR, and other communication channels
* Provide content and messaging inputs for marketing campaigns, product launches, and brand initiatives
* Identify content gaps and opportunities across customer touchpoints
* Plan and manage content calendars, timelines, and workflows to ensure timely execution
* Continuously improve content processes and workflows for better quality and efficiency



  




**Website \& Marketplace Content** 
* Own content across SkinBae’s website and marketplace platforms
* Write detailed product descriptions and PDP content that clearly communicate product benefits, ingredients, usage, and key differentiators
* Develop and optimise product titles, bullet points, metadata, FAQs, and other listing content
* Adapt content for marketplace\-specific requirements across platforms such as Amazon, Nykaa, TIRA, and other relevant marketplaces
* Review and optimise existing product listings to improve clarity, discoverability, and conversion
* Ensure all product and marketplace content is accurate, consistent, and aligned with brand guidelines



  




**Marketplace \& Campaign Creative Content** 
* Develop copy for marketplace banners, sale banners, campaign creatives, and promotional communication
* Create brand\-led and performance\-focused messaging for marketplace campaigns
* Ensure banner messaging is aligned with ongoing campaigns, offers, launches, and marketing objectives
* Work with designers to ensure copy and visuals work together effectively



  




**SEO \& Blog Content** 
* Research and write long\-form educational content and blogs related to skincare, beauty, ingredients, products, and customer education
* Conduct SEO keyword research and incorporate relevant keywords naturally into content
* Optimise titles, headings, metadata, internal linking, and other on\-page content elements
* Review and update existing content based on SEO performance, search trends, and changing customer needs
* Ensure educational content is well\-researched, accurate, easy to understand, and genuinely useful



  




**Email \& WhatsApp Marketing** 
* Own content for email and WhatsApp campaigns across launches, promotions, sales, and brand initiatives
* Develop lifecycle communication including welcome, retention, repeat purchase, product education, and brand storytelling
* Write subject lines, headlines, body copy, CTAs, and other campaign messaging
* Adapt communication based on customer stage, campaign objective, and audience
* Work closely with the marketing and CRM teams to ensure content supports customer engagement and business goals



  




**Performance Marketing \& Ad Copy** 
* Write high\-converting copy for performance marketing campaigns across Meta, Google, and other relevant platforms
* Develop hooks, headlines, primary text, CTAs, and different messaging angles for performance creatives
* Work with Performance Marketing and Design teams to develop and improve campaign messaging
* Understand campaign objectives and customer intent when developing performance\-focused content
* Review content performance and use insights to improve future copy and messaging



  




**PR \& Brand Communication** 
* Develop content for press releases, PR emails, media communication, and brand announcements
* Support brand storytelling and communication for launches, partnerships, events, and other initiatives
* Ensure all external communication reflects SkinBae’s positioning, tone, and messaging



  




**Customer Success \& Sales Enablement** 
* Develop product decks, FAQs, scripts, product education material, and other customer\-facing content
* Create content that helps customer support and sales teams communicate product information clearly
* Work with relevant teams to identify recurring customer questions and improve educational content
* Ensure product communication is accurate, easy to understand, and consistent across channels



  




**Content \& Design Collaboration** 
* Work closely with designers to develop content for static creatives, video creatives, website banners, marketplace banners, CRM, and campaigns
* Provide clear content direction and messaging for creative execution
* Review and provide feedback on creatives to ensure they are aligned with the brand voice, campaign objective, and communication strategy
* Review and approve content before it goes live where required



  




**Retail \& Visual Merchandising** 
* Support content and communication for retail activations, in\-store branding, events, and offline marketing initiatives
* Develop messaging for retail displays, product communication, promotional material, and other offline brand touchpoints
* Ensure offline communication remains consistent with SkinBae’s overall brand voice and positioning



  




**Content Quality \& Governance** 
* Edit, proofread, and review content across channels to maintain high standards of grammar, clarity, accuracy, and consistency
* Ensure product claims, ingredient information, product benefits, and other factual content are properly researched and accurate
* Conduct regular content audits and identify areas for improvement
* Maintain consistency in terminology, messaging, tone, and brand guidelines across all content



  




**Performance \& Optimisation** 
* Monitor content performance across relevant channels and campaigns
* Analyse engagement, conversion, SEO, CRM, and campaign performance where relevant
* Identify content trends, gaps, and opportunities based on data and customer behaviour
* Continuously test, optimise, and improve content based on performance insights
* Work with relevant teams to understand what content is performing and why



  




**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 
* Work closely with Marketing, Performance Marketing, E\-commerce, Design, Social Media, Customer Support, and other teams
* Translate business and campaign objectives into clear content requirements
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure content is delivered accurately and within timelines
* Contribute content and strategic inputs to product launches, campaigns, and broader marketing initiatives



  




**Leadership \& Process Improvement** 
* Support the development of content processes, guidelines, and SOPs
* Help build scalable systems for content planning, creation, review, and publishing
* Support and guide junior writers and creators where required
* Review content produced by junior team members and provide constructive feedback
* Help maintain SkinBae’s content quality and brand standards as the team grows
* Stay updated with content trends, SEO developments, consumer behaviour, AI tools, and emerging content formats
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve the way SkinBae communicates with customers



  




**What We’re Looking For** 
* 3–5 years of content writing, content strategy, copywriting, or content marketing experience
* Strong command of written English
* Experience creating content across multiple formats and channels
* Strong understanding of SEO and content optimisation
* Experience with website, PDP, marketplace, CRM, and marketing content is preferred
* Ability to research, think independently, and structure information clearly
* Strong understanding of customer communication and brand storytelling
* Interest in beauty, skincare, consumer brands, or e\-commerce
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines independently
* Someone who takes ownership and cares about the quality of the final output



  




**Benefits** 
* 5\-day work week
* Direct exposure to founders and core team
* Learning support through courses and resources

description:
Glymph Technologies (Bramma) \& Alterax Realty · HITEC City, Hyderabad · On\-site, full\-time · 1–4 years
 



  





**About us** 




 Two companies, one office in Jubilee Enclave.
 



  





**Bramma** 
 (Glymph Technologies) is building an ambient AI device that sits in a meeting room, captures what was decided, attributes it to the person who said it, and makes it queryable later. We're pre\-seed, hardware in pilot, and building in public.

 builds Webverse — immersive 3D visualization for real estate developers. Live clients, shipping work.

* Own the daily posting calendar across Bramma, Alterax and the founder's LinkedIn \+ X

description:
Growth Specialist — Sales \& Partnerships
 



 Location: Hyderabad
 



 Employment type: Full\-time
 



 Experience: Exceptional final\-year students, recent graduates and early\-career candidates are welcome to apply.
 



 About Nextrap
 



 Nextrap is an analytics\-focused wearable and health technology company being built for India. Our first product combines a screenless smart band with a companion app that helps people understand sleep, recovery, activity, heart\-rate trends and the choices that shape their health.
 



 We are not looking to build just another gadget. We want to make health data genuinely useful, beautiful and actionable.
 



 The role
 



 This is not a narrow sales role and it is not a conventional marketing internship. You will be Nextrap’s first employee, working directly with the founder to help take an early wearable brand from product to real customer love, partnerships and revenue.
 



 You will speak to customers, sell the product, build early partnerships, run growth experiments, create sharp content, and bring back the honest insights that improve the product and brand.
 



 What you will own
 


* Turn early interest into sales through thoughtful outreach, product demos, follow\-ups and customer conversations.
* Build relationships with gyms, sports clubs, coaches, athletes, wellness communities, creators and relevant B2B partners.
* Represent Nextrap at events, activations and in\-person meetings.
* Run practical growth experiments across social media, WhatsApp, communities, partnerships and offline channels.
* Help shape customer\-facing messaging, sales collateral and product demos.
* Maintain a clean lead pipeline and clearly report what customers are asking for.
* Collect customer feedback and turn it into useful product and positioning insights.
* Take ownership of the work needed to move an early\-stage company forward.



 You may be a great fit if you
 


* Communicate with clarity, energy and empathy.
* Can confidently sell both a physical product and a software experience.
* Are proactive and follow through without needing every step defined.
* Care about fitness, health, technology, design or consumer brands.
* Are comfortable with rejection, ambiguity and fast iteration.
* Can write crisp messages, make a good presentation and hold an engaging product conversation.



 We would especially love to hear from people who actively
 **play sports** 
 or have competed at a high level. First\-hand experience of training, recovery and performance gives you a real advantage in understanding the product, discovering useful insights and speaking credibly with our early customers. This is a preference, not a requirement.
 



 Prior startup, consumer\-tech, fitness, sports, campus\-community, retail, sales, creator or partnership experience is useful, but not mandatory. We care more about hunger, judgment, communication and ownership than a perfect résumé.
 



**Compensation:** 

 ₹3\.0–3\.6 LPA CTC, depending on experience, demonstrated ability and fit for the role.
 




 How to apply
 



 Send your résumé and a short note answering: How would you convince a health\-conscious Indian customer to try a screenless smart band from a new brand?
 



 Also share:
 


* One example of something you have sold, grown, organised or built—at college, work or independently.
* Your sport or fitness background, if applicable, and one health or performance insight you would want a wearable to help you understand.
* One piece of honest advice you would give Nextrap as an early\-stage wearable brand.

description:

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in roles related to business analysis, statistical analysis/machine learning.
* Excellent problem\-solving and critical thinking skills with attention\-to\-detail in an ever\-changing environment.


**About the job** 
 Trust and Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know\-how, excellent problem\-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big\-picture thinker and strategic team\-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross\-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed \- with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.
   

  

 As a T\&S Ads Scams Analyst, you will be responsible for protecting users from offline scams, which take place outside the Google Ads Platform. You will use data to provide recommendations to products and devise solutions (global and hyperlocal) to stay ahead of the fraudsters. You will also be responsible for ensuring good advertisers are provided the right opportunity to serve. As an analyst, you will use Applied AI, machine learning or other techniques to optimize human review cost and efficiency while continuously identifying enforcement gaps and automation opportunities. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to achieve your business goals and lead projects end\-to\-end.At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust and Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with cross\-functional groups such as Product Management (PM), Engineering, Sales and Legal to drive projects that increases users' safety and provide better online experience through Google Ads.
* Execute complex queries and analyses, build visual models, and construct presentations on abuse trends to aid in fraud prevention and influence change in existing abuse detection systems without compromising advertiser experience.
* Conduct investigations to catch fraudsters, enforce product policies, learn scam patterns/trends and identify product vulnerabilities.
* Identify automation and efficiency opportunities and drive solutions through analysis or cross\-functional partnerships.
* Provide periodic on\-call coverage and address escalations from both internal and external stakeholders within established service level agreements, while acknowledging occasional exposure to some adult content and other potentially disturbing material during the course of these duties.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. title: Senior Manager – Information Technology  (TIS)
description:
**About DESRI**
 DESRI (formerly D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments) is a market\-leading owner and operator of renewable energy projects throughout the United States. We have acquired or developed approximately 11\.9 gigawatts of contracted capacity across a portfolio of over 80 renewable energy projects in 24 states. DESRI is run by a dynamic team with offices located at New York, Denver, and Hyderabad (India).
   

  

**About The Role**
 DESRI is seeking a Senior Manager, Information Technology, to build and lead the firm's internal IT function which is currently run by an MSP. This is a unique opportunity to establish and scale a modern IT organization within a growing infrastructure company. Reporting to senior leadership, Senior Manager, IT will be responsible for developing DESRI's overall IT strategy, managing enterprise systems and infrastructure, overseeing cybersecurity and compliance initiatives, and delivering exceptional end\-user support across the organization.
   

  

 The successful candidate will lead an IT team and will be responsible for building and scaling the IT organization over time. This role requires a hands\-on leader who can balance strategic planning with operational execution while partnering closely with stakeholders across all business functions.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Develop and execute DESRI's enterprise IT roadmap aligned with business objectives and long\-term growth plans.
* Establish the firm's internal IT operating model, governance structure, policies, and processes.
* Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing global IT team across the U.S. and India.
* Manage relationships with external technology vendors, consultants, and service providers.
* Develop and manage the IT budget, including software, infrastructure, and staffing investments.
* Oversee enterprise technology infrastructure, including networking, cloud services (primarily Microsoft Azure), identity management, endpoint management, and collaboration platforms.
* Ensure reliable, secure, and scalable technology services across multiple office locations and remote employees.
* Lead hardware lifecycle management and employee technology onboarding/offboarding processes.
* Drive continuous improvement in end\-user experience and IT service delivery.
* Lead cybersecurity strategy, governance, and operational security programs.
* Establish and maintain security policies, controls, and monitoring capabilities.
* Partner with internal stakeholders and external experts to manage cyber risk, incident response planning, and business continuity programs.
* Ensure compliance with applicable security, regulatory, and audit requirements.
* Partner with Human Capital, Finance, Legal, Development, Asset Management, and other teams to optimize technology solutions and workflows.
* Oversee implementation, administration, integration, and support of enterprise applications, including Microsoft 365, identity platforms (Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD), HRIS systems, and collaboration tools.
* Establish IT service management processes, a Help Desk, and performance metrics.
* Create a culture of responsiveness, accountability, and customer service within the IT organization.
* Ensure timely resolution of technical issues while maintaining high levels of employee satisfaction.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8\-10 years of progressive IT leadership experience, including responsibility for enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, and end\-user support functions.
* Experience leading IT operations in a multi\-site, cross\-border environment, including support for geographically distributed operating assets, remote facilities, and corporate offices across multiple jurisdictions.
* Experience building, scaling, or transforming internal IT organizations.
* Demonstrated success managing distributed or global technology teams.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, identity and access management, endpoint management, networking, and cybersecurity best practices.
* Hands\-on experience deploying and managing enterprise workloads in Microsoft Azure.
* Experience managing enterprise SaaS ecosystems, including Microsoft 365 and related collaboration technologies.
* Proven ability to communicate effectively with executive leadership and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong project management, vendor management, and budgeting experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting rapidly growing organizations.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks such as NIST or ISO 27001\.
* Experience implementing AI\-enabled productivity tools and automation solutions.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, PMP, ITIL, Azure, AWS, or equivalent.

title: Shift Manager
description:
**Business Unit:**
 Cubic Transportation Systems
   

  

**Company Details:**
 When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
   

  

 We have a top\-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.
   

  

**Job Details:**
**Job Summary**
 As a Shift Coordinator on the CTS 24x7 Service Operations team, you will provide direct supervision to Tier 1 and Tier 2 staff across the Network Operations Center (NOC), Security Operations Center (SOC), and Service Desk during your assigned shift. You act as the technical and operational command authority during the shift. You are responsible for ensuring that events across all three functions are correctly triaged, tickets are properly assigned and tracked, incidents are escalated per defined protocols, and shift handovers preserve full situational awareness for the incoming shift.
   

  

 You are responsible for confirming shift staffing coverage in real time and for adjusting assignments to accommodate last\-minute absences. You are the immediate escalation path for issues that exceed the authority of the Tier 1 and Tier 2 analysts on the shift, and you escalate to the Director of Technical Service Operations for issues that exceed shift authority.
   

  

 Work is conducted under the compliance frameworks that govern CTS operations, in particular ITIL 4 (Monitoring and Event Management, Incident Management, Continual Improvement), ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (Annex A logging, monitoring, and incident management controls), and PCI DSS v4\.0\.1 (Requirements 10 and 12\.10\). You will be recognized inside CTS as the shift\-level owner for cross\-function coordination and evidence continuity.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities**
**Shift Command and Team Coordination**
* Provide direct supervision to Tier 1 and Tier 2 NOC, SOC, and Service Desk analysts during the assigned shift.
* Assign work at shift start and re\-balance workload throughout the shift based on ticket volume, incident severity, and individual analyst capacity.
* Confirm complete shift coverage across NOC, SOC, and Service Desk queues at shift start; adjust in real time when staff are unavailable because of sick calls, unplanned PTO, or emergency absence.
* Serve as the initial escalation point for any Tier 1 or Tier 2 analyst who needs additional authority, judgment, or cross\-functional coordination.
* Track and report shift\-level metrics (ticket volume, SLA adherence, incident count by severity) at shift close.


**Shift Handover Discipline**
* Execute a formal shift handover at the start and end of every shift, per the protocols defined in the NOC Scope Definition and the CTS SOC Scope of Operations.
* Ensure the handover record captures, at minimum: open incidents with owner and next action; active containment actions in progress; watchlist items; active maintenance windows; tooling or coverage gaps.
* Retain handover records as ISMS evidence supporting ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.5\.10 and ITIL 4 Monitoring and Event Management practice.


**Incident Management Coordination**
* Apply ITIL 4 Incident Management practice throughout the shift: validate alerts, classify severity, assign ownership, coordinate escalation, and track resolution against SLA.
* Coordinate the first 15 to 30 minutes of any SEV 0 or SEV 1 incident: declare the incident, engage the appropriate tiers, initiate stakeholder communications, and hand off to the Incident Commander or on\-call Tier 3 engineer.
* Enforce severity special rules from the NOC Scope Definition (for example, loss of logging or monitoring is never a SEV 4 event; SEV 0 or SEV 1 with a recent production change requires a change correlation step).
* Ensure joint NOC\-SOC coordination during Major Incidents: NOC leads operational recovery; SOC leads security investigation and containment; the Shift Coordinator maintains the shared incident bridge until the Incident Commander takes over.


**Cross\-Function Ticket Routing and Escalation**
* Monitor NOC, SOC, and Service Desk queues in the ITSM platform; ensure tickets are correctly categorized and assigned per the RACI.
* Route security\-relevant events from the NOC or Service Desk to the SOC per the defined Escalation pathway with enriched context.
* Route operational recovery actions from the SOC to the NOC or regional IT Operations per the defined protocol.
* Escalate to the Director of Technical Service Operations for any issue that exceeds shift authority.


**Compliance Evidence and Documentation**
* Ensure shift activities produce audit\-ready evidence supporting PCI DSS v4\.0\.1 Requirement 10 and Requirement 12\.10, and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.5\.24\-A.5\.28 and A.8\.15\-A.8\.16\.
* Verify handover records, incident timelines, and containment action logs are complete and accurate before shift close.
* Support monthly and quarterly evidence pack preparation.


**Continuous Improvement Contribution**
* Identify recurring patterns during the shift (repeat incidents, noisy alerts, gaps in playbook coverage) and log them for review by the NOC, SOC, and Service Desk Managers.
* Participate in post\-incident reviews and contribute to the Continual Improvement Register per ITIL 4 Continual Improvement practice.
* Recommend changes to shift\-level procedures where the shift experience identifies opportunities.


**General Duties And Responsibilities**
* Reliably demonstrate accountability for work assignments and proactive communications about issues and status. A strong history of proactively identifying effective solutions for challenges.
* Able to work effectively and uphold professional standards, with the customer and system stakeholders.
* Self\-motivated and able to work unsupervised.
* Methodical and attentive to detail.
* Proactive in seeking advice from senior operations and security subject matter experts when required.
* Comfortable working with staff at all levels and in other geographical locations within the organization.
* Comply with Cubic's Quality Management System.
* Comply with Cubic's quality, health, safety, and security policies.
* Support the company's strategic objectives and collaborate across departments.
* Comply with Cubic Human Resources Procedures.


**Skills / Experience / Knowledge**
**Essential:**
* Experience providing direct supervision to a team of individual contributors in a technology operations, security operations, or service desk environment.
* Working knowledge of NOC operations: event monitoring, incident management, SLA management, change and configuration control.
* Working knowledge of SOC operations: SIEM and EDR alert triage, security incident classification, escalation protocols.
* Working knowledge of Service Desk operations under a Tier 1\-3 tiered model.
* Familiarity with ITIL 4 practices, in particular Monitoring and Event Management and Incident Management.
* Ability to interpret and explain incident status, containment actions, and escalation decisions to peers, subordinate staff, and functional peer groups. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Collaboration and Interaction expectations.
* Sound judgment in resolving problems that require analysis of data and relevant factors under real\-time pressure. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Complexity and Problem Solving expectations.
* Ability to develop and manage routine operational plans and meet targets against a monthly performance plan. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Discretion and Impact expectations.
* Experience preparing accurate shift reports and handover records.
* Comfort operating 24x7 shift patterns, including nights, weekends, and public holidays.


**Desirable:**
* Familiarity with PCI DSS v4\.0\.1 requirements, in particular Requirement 10, Requirement 11\.5, and Requirement 12\.10\.
* Familiarity with ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A controls covering logging (A.8\.15\), monitoring activities (A.8\.16\), and incident management (A.5\.24 to A.5\.28\).
* Exposure to NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2\.0 (NIST CSWP 29\) Detect and Respond Functions.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow (or equivalent enterprise ITSM) and Jira.
* Understanding of the ITIL 4 Major Incident model and Problem Management practice.
* Experience coordinating across NOC, SOC, and Service Desk boundaries.


**Qualifications**
**Essential:**
* Must be able to work on\-site at Cubic Hyderabad, Aparna Plaza, on a 24x7 rotating shift pattern.
* Minimum 5\-8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree.
* University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or other technical field; or Business Administration with relevant IT work experience.
* At least 5 years of experience in a Tier 1\-3 operations environment (NOC, SOC, Service Desk, or NOC/SOC hybrid).
* At least 3 years’ experience managing shift workers.
* Demonstrated ability to make severity classification and escalation decisions in a real\-time operations setting.
* Demonstrated ability to lead a team through a shift, including workload assignment, coaching, and formal handover.
* At least 3 years’ experience working in an ITIL 4 operation.


**Desirable:**
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification; ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Strategic Leader preferred.
* CompTIA Security\+, ISC2 SSCP, or equivalent security operations certification.
* ServiceNow ITSM administrator or user certification.
* Experience in a payment card processing environment, or in a similarly regulated real\-time operations environment.
* Experience with global follow\-the\-sun shift models spanning NAM, EMEA, and APAC time zones.


**Condition of Employment:**
 Successful outcome of a National Police Check
   

  

 The description provided above is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all job duties, responsibilities and requirements. Duties, responsibilities and requirements may change over time and according to business need.
   

  

 ‎

 Employee

title: Zscalar/Zero Trust Security Architect - Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Zscalar/Zero Trust
   

  

 Consultant**
 We are seeking an experienced Zscaler Architect / Senior Engineer to lead and support the implementation, configuration, and migration of Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) solutions in enterprise environments. This role will help design and deliver Zero Trust access models, modernize remote access, and support migration from legacy VPN and proxy technologies. The ideal candidate brings strong hands\-on Zscaler delivery experience, solid network security fundamentals, and the ability to work across security, network, IAM, and endpoint teams.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Consultant on the Cyber team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Leading and supporting the implementation, configuration, and migration of Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) solutions.
* Assessing current\-state network and security architecture and designing Zero Trust access models aligned to business and security requirements.
* Planning and executing migration from legacy VPN, proxy, and remote access technologies to Zscaler platforms.
* Configuring ZIA and ZPA policies, application segmentation, connector deployment, authentication, forwarding methods, and user\-to\-application connectivity.
* Troubleshooting connectivity, performance, and policy issues and supporting pilot, rollout, cutover, and post\-migration activities.


**The team**
 Deloitte’s Cyber team helps organizations build, operate, and enhance security capabilities across identity, network, cloud, and application environments. The team works with clients to modernize security architecture, enable secure access, and support enterprise transformation through scalable, business\-aligned solutions. Professionals in this practice collaborate across cybersecurity, infrastructure, and technology stakeholders to address complex security and connectivity challenges.
   

  

**Location: Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Pune/Chennai**
**Shift Timings: Regular India Shift Timing**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 6\-9 years of experience in network security, cloud security, or enterprise security architecture.
* Experience implementing and migrating Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) in enterprise environments.
* Experience configuring ZIA security policies, including URL filtering, Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) inspection, authentication, forwarding methods, and access controls.
* Experience configuring ZPA application segmentation, connector deployment, access policies, and user\-to\-application connectivity.
* Experience integrating Zscaler with identity and security platforms, including Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), System for Cross\-domain Identity Management (SCIM), security information and event management (SIEM), endpoint detection and response (EDR), or cloud access security broker (CASB) tools.
* Experience with Domain Name System (DNS), Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP), routing, firewall policies, proxy technologies, and VPN migration.
* Experience creating technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, runbooks, migration plans, and operational handover materials.


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience designing Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solutions and remote access modernization programs.
* Experience with Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) for experience monitoring and user troubleshooting.
* Experience deploying Zscaler Client Connector and integrating with endpoint platforms.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise transformation or network security modernization programs.
* Zscaler Certified Cloud Administrator (ZCCA), Zscaler Certified Cloud Professional (ZCCP) for ZIA or ZPA, or Zscaler Certified Cloud Specialist (ZCCS).


 This position is aligned with the Core Talent Model. To view the associated benefit package, please reference this document https://resources.deloitte.com/sites/dnet\-tod\-usi/Shared Documents/Benefits/USIBenefitsBrochureforPlanG.pdf
   

  

**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**
 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Sr Manager, SSO Engineering People Leader (Cyber Security)
description:
Your opportunity
   

  

 At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
   

  

 Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values\-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region
   

  

 As a Senior SSO Engineering People Leader, you will provide strategic direction and senior functional leadership for teams delivering enterprise SSO, modern authentication, federation, and identity security capabilities. This role requires strong technology understanding, broad functional experience, and the ability to lead people leaders or senior engineers through complex, high\-impact identity initiatives. You will shape engineering priorities, influence enterprise identity strategy, strengthen operational resiliency, and ensure authentication services support business growth, security, compliance, and client trust.
   

  

 The Senior SSO Engineering People Leader owns broader execution strategy, operational governance, and functional leadership for SSO engineering capabilities across enterprise platforms, applications, and identity ecosystems. The role is accountable for roadmap alignment, talent development, stakeholder engagement, risk reduction, audit readiness, platform modernization, and measurable delivery outcomes. This leader will partner with senior technology, cybersecurity, risk, compliance, application, infrastructure, and business leaders to advance secure, scalable, and user\-centered identity services
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Provide overall leadership for the SSO Engineering function, including senior engineers, technical leads, and other IAM engineering resources.
* Define and execute the strategic roadmap for enterprise authentication, federation, and SSO services.
* Provide leadership and governance across technologies including SAML, OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, federation, MFA, passwordless authentication, FIDO2, passkeys, and adaptive authentication.
* Establish architecture and engineering standards for enterprise authentication platforms.
* Lead modernization of legacy authentication patterns toward standards\-based, cloud\-ready, and Zero Trust\-aligned architectures.
* Provide strategic leadership for platforms such as PingFederate, PingAccess, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or equivalent identity technologies.
* Drive platform scalability, resiliency, disaster recovery, high availability, security, observability, and operational maturity.
* Establish standardized patterns for workforce, application, API, cloud, and service authentication.
* Partner with enterprise architecture and cybersecurity teams to define target\-state authentication architecture.
* Drive automation across application onboarding, configuration management, testing, deployments, certificate management, and platform operations.
* Champion CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, policy\-as\-code, automated testing, and DevSecOps practices within IAM engineering.
* Provide governance and technical oversight for high\-risk or complex authentication integrations.
* Lead major platform transformations, migrations, upgrades, consolidations, and modernization initiatives.
* Establish controls to address authentication threats including credential compromise, token misuse, session attacks, unauthorized access, and configuration vulnerabilities.
* Ensure authentication capabilities meet applicable regulatory, cybersecurity, risk, audit, and enterprise control requirements.
* Own engineering performance metrics and executive reporting covering reliability, availability, security, delivery, incidents, onboarding, automation, and technical debt.
* Partner with Product and Application Engineering leaders to prioritize demand and establish scalable application onboarding models.
* Lead capacity planning, workforce strategy, talent development, succession planning, performance management, and engineering skill development.
* Serve as an escalation point for critical authentication incidents and major technology risks.
* Influence senior leaders and stakeholders on identity strategy, technology investments, engineering priorities, and risk decisions.


 What you have
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, 12\+ years of technology experience, with substantial experience in IAM, cybersecurity, authentication, or enterprise security engineering.
* Extensive experience designing or leading enterprise\-scale SSO and federation platforms.
* Deep understanding of SAML 2\.0, OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, JWT, MFA, PKI, certificates, session management, and modern authentication patterns.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise IAM technologies such as Ping Identity, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or comparable platforms.
* Demonstrated experience leading senior engineers and complex engineering organizations.
* Experience establishing technical roadmaps, architecture standards, engineering governance, and operating models.
* Strong understanding of Zero Trust and identity\-centric security architecture.
* Experience with cloud, APIs, containers, CI/CD, automation, and modern software engineering practices.
* Demonstrated success delivering large, complex, cross\-functional technology programs.
* Strong executive communication, influencing, stakeholder management, and decision\-making skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, SC\-300, AZ\-500, enterprise architecture, cloud security, or relevant identity provider certifications are desirable.
* Experience leading IAM engineering within financial services or another highly regulated enterprise.
* Experience modernizing large\-scale legacy authentication environments.
* Knowledge of Privileged Access Management, Identity Governance, Non\-Human Identities, secrets management, API security, and machine\-to\-machine authentication.
* Experience with Kubernetes, containerized platforms, cloud\-native architectures, and public cloud security.
* Knowledge of identity threat detection, authentication telemetry, SIEM/SOC integration, and continuous monitoring.
* Relevant cybersecurity, IAM, architecture, cloud, or leadership certifications.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Ping Identity, Zscaler Private Access, FIDO2/Passkeys, SCIM, REST APIs, Terraform, Python, PowerShell, Git, CI/CD, AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, identity analytics, observability, AI\-driven identity security, and Non\-Human Identity management.
* Experience in financial services, cybersecurity risk management, regulated enterprise technology, or large\-scale identity platform modernization.
* Experience leading Zero Trust, passwordless, identity governance, privileged access, cloud security, non\-human identity, and resilience initiatives across multiple teams or platforms.
* Experience managing vendor relationships, platform strategy, funding/capacity tradeoffs, security control remediation, audit outcomes, and executive\-level reporting.


 What’s in it for you
   

  

 At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long\-term financial security.
   

  

**Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include**
* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more
* Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage
* Annual reimbursement for health check\-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
* Transportation and meal benefits that support your day\-to\-day work
* Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance

title: Software Engineering PMTS - Cloud Security - Hyderabad
description:
**Description**
 Come join our growing Hyperforce Enterprise Security organization. We are chartered with architecting, implementing, and operating security solutions that protect Salesforce’s complex, multi\-cloud technology landscape at scale.
   

  

 As a Principal Member of Technical Staff, you will provide technical leadership in building the next generation of infrastructure security and developer security guardrails. You will work across the software development and deployment lifecycle to identify security risks early, build scalable controls, and enable secure\-by\-default engineering practices without compromising developer velocity.
   

  

 Our team operates at the intersection of cloud security, application security, infrastructure security, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and runtime security. We build and operate security guardrails that identify and prevent high\-risk security issues from source code and Infrastructure as Code through CI/CD and into runtime environments.
   

  

 You will be expected to operate at both strategic and hands\-on technical levels, defining architecture and technical direction while also diving deeply into complex engineering problems, writing production\-quality code, and driving solutions from concept through deployment and operation.
   

  

 This role is an opportunity to shape security capabilities that operate at significant scale across Salesforce infrastructure and to influence how security is embedded throughout the engineering lifecycle.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Act as a technical leader and subject matter expert for infrastructure security and security guardrails, providing architectural direction across teams.
* Design and build scalable shift\-left security capabilities that identify security risks in source code, Infrastructure as Code, containerized workloads, and deployment configurations before they reach production.
* Architect and build shift\-left security controls that identify security risks early while providing developers with actionable findings and straightforward remediation paths.
* Design scalable policy\-as\-code and security enforcement frameworks for consistent security controls across multiple gates and environments.
* Drive risk\-based security engineering by identifying exploitable, high\-impact, and meaningful security risks rather than treating all scanner findings equally.
* Design mechanisms for security finding correlation, prioritization, deduplication, and enforcement when signals originate from multiple security systems.
* Lead architecture and implementation of Kubernetes admission control and workload security capabilities.
* Define technical strategies for reliability, scalability, performance, observability, fault tolerance, and operational readiness of security services.
* Establish and evolve SLIs, SLOs, telemetry, rollout strategies, and operational practices for critical security services.
* Own technical outcomes across the complete lifecycle — requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, production readiness, rollout, and ongoing operations.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve security coverage, automation, detection quality, enforcement, and developer experience.
* Establish engineering standards and best practices for reliability, scalability, observability, testing, and operational readiness of security services.
* Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar across the organization.
* Influence technical strategy and roadmap decisions across teams and drive initiatives from concept through production.
* Build and ship high\-quality, production\-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow by pushing the boundaries of AI development tools to deliver secure, optimized, and high\-quality code.
* Design and orchestrate complex systems where AI agents integrate seamlessly into human workflows, driving efficiency and innovation at scale.
* Contribute to building and maintaining the shared system context, an explicit repository of system designs, constraints, and standards that enables AI to operate accurately and reliably.
* Critically evaluate code (human or AI\-generated) for correctness, quality, security, and performance.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field involving software/systems engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 15\+ years of software engineering, systems engineering, security engineering with significant experience designing and delivering large\-scale production systems.
* Strong programming experience in one or more languages such as Go, Java, or Python, with the ability to design, implement, debug, and review production\-quality systems.
* Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure and cloud security, including experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Kubernetes, containers, and cloud\-native infrastructure.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD architecture and DevSecOps, including deployment pipelines, security gates, policy enforcement, and automation.
* Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code, such as Terraform, Helm, CloudFormation, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience designing distributed, highly scalable, reliable, and secure systems.
* Strong understanding of security engineering concepts including vulnerability management, configuration security, policy enforcement, workload security, identity/access controls, and risk assessment.
* Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous security problems, identify the core technical challenge, and drive an architecture and implementation to completion.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex architectures and trade\-offs to senior technical and business audiences.
* Preferred Qualifications
* Deep experience in cloud\-native security, DevSecOps, infrastructure security, or application security.
* Experience building security platforms/services or guardrails that operate at large enterprise scale.
* Experience with Kubernetes Admission Controllers, admission policies, OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, or similar policy enforcement technologies.
* Experience with policy\-as\-code and security\-as\-code frameworks.
* Experience with IaC security and tools such as Checkov, OPA, Terraform security scanning, or equivalent technologies.
* Strong understanding of container and workload security, including Seccomp, Linux security mechanisms, container isolation, and runtime security.
* Experience building systems that correlate security signals from multiple sources and prioritize findings based on risk, exploitability, exposure, and business impact.
* Experience with vulnerability management, cloud security posture management, container security, or automated security remediation.
* Experience designing developer\-facing security products with a strong focus on actionable findings, low friction remediation, and developer experience.
* Experience designing security controls across the complete lifecycle: source → IaC → CI/CD → deployment → admission → runtime.
* Strong understanding of cloud networking, identity, workload architecture, and distributed systems.
* Experience driving technical strategy across multiple engineering organizations.
* Demonstrated ability to identify new security opportunities and turn them into scalable engineering solutions.
* Experience mentoring senior engineers and serving as a technical leader for complex, multi\-team initiatives.
* A demonstrated, genuine AI\-first approach to engineering — using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty.
* Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in development workflows.
* Advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production\-ready


**What Success Looks Like**
 In this role, you will be expected to:
   

  

* Raise the technical bar for infrastructure and developer security engineering.
* Build security controls that are effective, scalable, reliable, and developer\-friendly.
* Move security closer to the point where risks are introduced through strong shift\-left and automated enforcement.
* Improve the ability to distinguish noise from meaningful and exploitable risk.
* Establish consistent security coverage and enforcement across the software delivery lifecycle.
* Drive complex initiatives from architecture and design through implementation, production deployment, and operational maturity.

title: SAP SD
description:
**Job Summary**
