The role drives end to end order to cash solutions that optimize billing accuracy pricing flexibility and logistics execution. The individual will partner with business teams to refine processes for consumer goods and broader supply chain operations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead end to end design of S4 HANA contracts and agreements processes to ensure accurate lifecycle management from contract creation through renewal and closure while aligning with enterprise policies and compliance needs.
* Drive configuration and optimization of S4 HANA billing and revenue capabilities to improve invoice accuracy reduce revenue leakage and support transparent reporting for finance and business stakeholders.
* Oversee the implementation of S4 HANA advance pricing scenarios to support complex discount structures surcharges and promotions ensuring data integrity and consistent pricing decisions across channels.
* Coordinate process flows in S4 HANA advance order to cash to streamline order intake fulfillment and invoicing enabling faster cycle times and enhanced customer satisfaction.

* Guide configuration and testing activities in S4 HANA basic logistic execute to strengthen delivery processing shipment management and goods issue so that physical flows align smoothly with system records.
* Collaborate with supply chain and consumer goods domain teams to translate business scenarios into robust S4 HANA solutions that improve forecast accuracy service levels and product availability.
* Provide detailed functional specifications for enhancements integrations and reports ensuring that technical teams can deliver stable solutions that maintain system performance and usability.
* Conduct fit gap analysis workshops with business partners to evaluate current processes identify improvement opportunities and recommend standardized S4 HANA practices that reduce complexity.
* Facilitate system testing cycles including unit testing integration testing and user acceptance testing to validate configurations and reduce defects before deployment to production environments.
* Mentor junior functional consultants by sharing best practices reusable templates and business insights to build team capability and ensure consistent solution quality across projects.
* Coordinate with change management teams to prepare training content process documentation and adoption plans helping end users embrace new ways of working with minimal disruption.
* Support production operations through incident analysis root cause identification and continuous improvement activities thereby increasing system reliability and business confidence.


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrate strong practical expertise in S4 HANA contracts and agreements billing and revenue advance pricing advance order to cash sales BOM and basic logistic execute with proven success in project delivery.
* Bring solid exposure to supply chain management and consumer goods industry scenarios including demand planning distribution and retail execution turning business requirements into S4 HANA solutions.
* Apply advanced skills in business process analysis documentation and testing to ensure that configurations are traceable auditable and aligned to agreed functional designs.

* Show experience in working within global MNC environments adhering to standard templates governance models and quality benchmarks while meeting day shift expectations and no travel requirements.


**Certifications Required**
 SAP certification in S4 HANA Sales or S4 HANA Logistics highly preferred

title: Associate Support Engineer - Salesforce
description:
**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.** 
 It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.
   

  

**Overview**
 We are seeking an Associate Software Engineer for our Salesforce Salesforce Developer to provide expert\-level support for our Salesforce Consumer Goods (CG) Cloud platform, with a particular focus on Trade Promotion Management and Key Account Management modules. In this support\-focused role, you will ensure the ongoing smooth operation, troubleshooting, and optimization of the TPM \& KAM application. This role reports to the application lead.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Provide hands\-on development support for incident resolution, break\-fix efforts, and system enhancements related to the Salesforce TPM \& KAM application.
* Analyze and troubleshoot issues reported by global business teams, delivering timely resolutions in line with SLA requirements.
* Act as the primary point of contact for escalated support tickets and investigate and resolve issues related to TPM \& KAM functionality.
* Collaborate with business analysts and global stakeholders to gather, clarify, and refine requirements for new features or process improvements.
* Participate in the full development lifecycle, including estimation, technical design, development, code reviews, testing, deployment, and post\-deployment support.
* Perform system maintenance activities such as routine updates, patches, and configuration changes to ensure seamless application performance.
* Monitor and evaluate system performance, identifying issues and opportunities for optimization and long\-term stability.
* Troubleshoot and resolve data integrity issues, working with cross\-functional teams to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
* Support and troubleshoot integrations with external systems (e.g., ERP, TPM tools, analytics platforms) related to the TPP application.
* Stay up to date with Salesforce releases, applying relevant updates and patches to maintain system currency.
* Document support processes, known issues, and solutions in the knowledge base for training and reference purposes.


**Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 1\-2 years of experience in Salesforce administration, support, or architecture, with a strong focus on Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud and Trade Promotion Management (TPM).
* Proven experience in supporting TPM/TPP processes such as promotion execution, fund management, claim management, and performance evaluation within the Consumer Goods industry.
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Field Service, Einstein Analytics, MuleSoft, and Salesforce integration tools (including API management and data integration).
* Knowledge of Salesforce data models, security models, and process automation.
* Experience managing support tickets and working with cross\-functional teams to resolve production issues quickly.
* Ability to perform detailed root cause analysis and deliver actionable solutions in a timely manner.
* Ability to review and support Apex based customizations in collaboration with the development team.
* Knowledge of declarative automation tools such as Flows, validation rules, and approval processes to support and optimize TPM business processes.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Certified Administrator, Consumer Goods Cloud Accredited Professional, or Sales Cloud Consultant are preferred.


 Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
   

  

**How We Work**
 We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors
   

  

* We collaborate Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.

* We execute We are a performance\-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best\-in\-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.


**Our Approach to Flexible Work:**
 We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in\-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.

 Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.
   

  

 Mattel’s award\-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.
   

  

 Visit us at https //jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers .

title: Infrastructure Platform Engineering (SMTS, Software Engineering)
description:
**Description**
**About the Role
   

  

 Title \- Software Engineer, SMTS \- Infrastructure Platform Engineering**
 We're looking for a strong infrastructure engineer to contribute to high\-impact modernization and cloud platform efforts at Salesforce. A core focus is supporting the migration of Tableau's legacy hypervisor and VM infrastructure into Salesforce\-managed infrastructure — owning defined workstreams (e.g., discovery, design, and delivery for a specific domain or service area) within a broader effort spanning Public Cloud, Networking, Security, SRE, and Database teams. More broadly, this role also builds and operates scalable, secure public cloud solutions (AWS, with Azure/GCP exposure) as part of the platform team.
   

  

 You'll bring solid technical depth to discovery conversations, help translate ambiguous legacy environments into concrete implementation plans for your area, and contribute to a reusable migration and platform engineering foundation that serves future acquisitions and ongoing cloud operations alike.
   

  

 You'll bring deep technical credibility to discovery conversations, translate ambiguous legacy environments into clear architectural plans, and help build a reusable migration and platform engineering foundation that serves future acquisitions and ongoing cloud operations alike.
   

  

 If you thrive in environments where the map doesn't exist yet and you have the skills to draw it, this role is for you.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Conduct technical discovery for a defined portion of the legacy infrastructure (e.g., a specific service or workload class within Tableau's hypervisor/VM environment), documenting findings and gaps for your area
* Partner with Public Cloud, Networking, Security, Storage, OS, and SRE teams to design and implement your piece of the target infrastructure architecture (AWS, Private Cloud, or hybrid), working from the broader architecture direction set by architects/LMTS\+ leads
* Develop and implement cloud solutions for medium\-complexity problems, designing for performance, scalability, and reliability
* Produce implementation plans for your workstream — design, effort estimates, resource needs — and deliver reliably against them
* Execute migration and modernization work for your assigned portion of the legacy VM\-based infrastructure, ensuring continuity of dependent services throughout the transition
* Build components with reusability in mind, contributing to a scalable migration framework and infrastructure model that reduces repeated engineering effort for future M\&A integrations
* Build, maintain, and deploy infrastructure as code (IaC) and modern CI/CD pipelines to streamline deployment velocity
* Build automation for operations, self\-healing systems, proactive alerting, and event auto\-remediation within your area
* Collaborate across infrastructure disciplines to deliver your workstream on schedule, escalating cross\-team dependencies as needed
* Apply and help refine security and networking standards aligned with Salesforce requirements (e.g., supporting retirement of legacy auth systems)
* Participate in an on\-call rotation to ensure timely incident response, root\-cause analysis, and minimal downtime
* Document decisions, architecture diagrams, runbooks, and operational playbooks to support long\-term maintainability


**Coding \& Technical Depth**
 Given The Scope Of Building On AWS, Working At The Hypervisor Level, And Supporting Large\-scale File Transport, Candidates Should Be Comfortable Coding — Not Just Configuring — Across
   

  

* Infrastructure\-as\-Code \& automation: Terraform, Ansible/Puppet, and Python for tooling, orchestration, and operational scripts
* AWS SDK/API\-level development: boto3 (Python) or AWS SDK for Go/Java, to build directly against AWS APIs (EC2, VPC, S3, EBS, networking) rather than console/Terraform alone
* Hypervisor/virtualization internals: experience with VMware APIs (vSphere API/PowerCLI), KVM/libvirt, or Nitro\-based EC2 bare metal for building and operating hypervisor infrastructure including vSphere clustering, HA/DRS configuration, and storage vMotion\-level troubleshooting
* Large\-scale file transport \& data movement: experience with high\-throughput transfer protocols and services — AWS DataSync, Transfer Family, S3 multipart/accelerated transfer — for large file transport projects on AWS
* Systems\-level languages: Go or Java for performance\-sensitive, throughput\-heavy infra tooling, alongside Python for automation
* Networking\-level coding: scripting/automating routing, SDN, and network virtualization configs where hypervisor build\-out includes network virtualization
* Linux/Windows OS fundamentals: Solid Linux administration skills and working knowledge of Windows Server administration


**Mandatory Skills \& Experience**
* 6\-8\+ years of infrastructure engineering experience, with a strong background in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or DevOps
* Hands\-on experience with hypervisor/VM environments (VMware vSphere, ESXi, Hyper\-V, KVM, or equivalent) and/or public cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred; Azure/GCP a plus)
* Proven experience migrating on\-prem or legacy VM workloads to public or private cloud at scale by applying appropriate migration strategies (lift\-and\-shift, re\-platform, or re\-architect) based on workload constraints
* Deep understanding of networking fundamentals — VPCs, VLANs, routing, firewall rules, DNS, load balancing
* Strong knowledge of infrastructure security principles: identity management, Okta/SSO integration, zero\-trust networking, secrets management
* Proficiency with infrastructure\-as\-code tooling (Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, or equivalent) and CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure
* Demonstrated ability to conduct technical discovery in complex legacy environments and produce structured architecture documentation and effort decompositions
* Strong working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies and software development lifecycles
* Comfortable operating across multi\-disciplinary teams — able to hold detailed technical conversations with storage engineers, security architects, and SREs in the same day
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to present architecture decisions and trade\-offs clearly to technical and leadership audiences
* Experience with vulnerability management — CVE triage, patch cadence, scanning tools (Qualys/Tenable/Nessus), and remediation SLAs


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience supporting SaaS or enterprise software customer environments (e.g., environment reproduction for support/troubleshooting use cases)
* Familiarity with Salesforce's infrastructure ecosystem — Trust, Public Cloud, or internal platform engineering experience is a meaningful advantage
* Prior experience with M\&A infrastructure integration or post\-acquisition platform consolidation
* Background in Storage and Database infrastructure in hybrid or multi\-cloud environments
* Containerization \& orchestration experience (Docker, Kubernetes/AWS EKS)
* Modern CI/CD \& GitOps expertise (GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Argo Workflows)
* Strong scripting/programming skills (Python, YAML, JSON)
* AWS Certifications (Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional) a plus
* VMware certification (VCP\-DCV or equivalent) preferred, or demonstrated equivalent hands\-on production experience with vSphere/ESXi environments
* Ability to break down infrastructure workstreams into milestones and communicate progress to stakeholders
* Experience prioritizing work based on risk, dependencies, and business impact in a fast\-moving delivery environment
* Familiarity with SRE/operational excellence principles — SLOs, runbooks, on\-call readiness

title: Systems Software Principal Engineer
description:
**Systems Software Principal** 
**Engineer**
 Attract, develop \& engage a world\-class workforce
   

  

 For more than 30 years, TTEC has anticipated customer needs and stayed ahead of consumer demands. As the leading global provider of technology\-enabled customer experience solutions, TTEC designs, enables, manages, and grows superior customer experiences that drive shareholder value. Simply put, we help companies grow the value of their business by growing the value of their customer base. From design to delivery, our comprehensive solutions create value across the entire customer life cycle with industry\-specific services.
   

  

**Our Capabilities Include**
* Design: Customer Strategy Services
* Enable: Customer Technology Services
* Manage: Customer Management Services
* Grow: Customer Growth Services


**Position Summary**
 The Systems Software Principal Engineer provides enterprise\-level technical leadership for TTEC’s core systems, identity, messaging, endpoint, automation, and infrastructure platforms. This role owns architectural direction, lifecycle strategy, modernization roadmaps, platform resilience, and engineering standards for services that support a highly distributed global environment. The Principal Engineer defines reference architectures, guides security\-by\-design practices, influences cross\-functional technical decisions, and provides Tier 4 escalation support for the most complex service reliability and platform issues. This role partners across Infrastructure, Information Security, Networking, Operations, and business technology teams to align technical strategy with enterprise outcomes while mentoring senior engineers and raising the overall maturity of engineering practices.
   

  

* Enterprise directory services, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, PKI, clustering, and domain services architecture
* Endpoint and systems management, including Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager, Tanium, PowerShell, and automated deployment practices
* Identity and access management, including hybrid identity, Microsoft Entra ID, MFA, Ping, Okta, privileged access, and identity governance
* Cloud and hybrid platform integration, including Microsoft 365, Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, Google Cloud Platform, and on\-premises Active Directory
* Messaging and collaboration platforms, including Exchange Online, Microsoft 365, Proofpoint, and Google Workspace
* Security, audit, and compliance programs, including FedRAMP, PCI, CAP, HIPAA, SOX, vulnerability management, patching, monitoring, and reporting
* Storage, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery platforms, including Cohesity, NetApp, replication, recovery validation, and service continuity planning
* Virtualization and platform infrastructure, including Nutanix, VMware, Hyper\-V, high availability, capacity planning, and service reliability engineering


**Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Own enterprise architecture, technical strategy, and lifecycle direction for highly distributed systems, identity, endpoint, messaging, and infrastructure platforms
* Define and maintain reference architectures, engineering standards, governance models, and technical patterns that promote consistency, resilience, security, and operational excellence
* Provide Tier 4 escalation support for the most complex Windows, identity, messaging, endpoint, cloud integration, and platform reliability issues
* Lead modernization initiatives across legacy and hybrid platforms, including automation strategy, platform rationalization, cloud integration, and lifecycle risk reduction
* Establish automation, scripting, and repeatable engineering practices using PowerShell and related tooling to improve reliability, speed, compliance, and operational efficiency
* Drive security\-by\-design practices across platform architecture, change design, access control, vulnerability remediation, compliance readiness, and customer data protection
* Partner with Information Security, Networking, Operations, Application, and business technology teams to deliver integrated solutions that meet performance, compliance, security, and business continuity objectives
* Govern system changes, design reviews, release readiness, and operational handoffs in accordance with TTEC standards and enterprise change practices
* Create and maintain engineering documentation, support models, knowledge articles, and operational playbooks for Tier 1 through Tier 4 support teams
* Improve service reliability through monitoring, alerting, observability, capacity planning, incident trend analysis, problem management, and proactive risk mitigation
* Mentor senior engineers through architecture reviews, technical coaching, standards adoption, troubleshooting strategy, and knowledge sharing
* Participate in an on\-call rotation and provide after\-hours support for critical incidents, major escalations, and business\-impacting platform events as required


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and progressive enterprise systems engineering experience
* 10\+ years of progressive systems engineering experience supporting enterprise\-scale Windows Server, identity, endpoint, messaging, cloud integration, and infrastructure platforms
* Expert\-level knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, PKI, LDAP, ADSI, clustering, domain services design, and enterprise directory governance
* Expert\-level experience with hybrid identity, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, endpoint management, Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager, and enterprise access management practices
* Advanced scripting and automation experience using PowerShell and related tools to design, deploy, govern, and operate repeatable enterprise engineering solutions
* Deep understanding of Windows Server, IIS, Hyper\-V, load balancing, LAN/WAN dependencies, shared storage, replication, and highly available platform design
* Demonstrated ability to design and govern high availability, disaster recovery, backup, recovery validation, monitoring, alerting, and service reliability practices
* Strong understanding of security, compliance, vulnerability management, privileged access, audit readiness, and regulatory frameworks including FedRAMP, SOX, HIPAA, PCI, and related reporting obligations
* Experience defining architecture, technical standards, support models, operational documentation, and governance practices across enterprise platforms
* Strong working knowledge of IT service management frameworks such as ITIL, including incident, problem, change, configuration, and service continuity practices
* Proven ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders, lead technical decision\-making, and translate ambiguous business or operational needs into scalable engineering outcomes
* Experience leading complex enterprise initiatives, mentoring senior engineers, coordinating customer\-facing or internal projects, and driving outcomes across multiple technical teams


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Advanced Microsoft certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert , Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert, Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate, or equivalent credentials
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools and practices such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, configuration automation, CI/CD pipelines, and Git\-based change management
* Familiarity with platform engineering patterns, internal developer platforms, containerization, orchestration, Docker, Kubernetes, and modern operating models for infrastructure delivery
* Practical experience with backup, storage, virtualization, identity provider, monitoring, alerting, and security platforms such as Cohesity, NetApp, Nutanix, VMware, Ping, Okta, Proofpoint, and enterprise observability tools
* Responsible use of AI\-enabled engineering tools to improve documentation, automation, troubleshooting, operational analysis, and engineering productivity while maintaining governance and data protection standards


**What Sets You Apart**
* Enterprise technical breadth with the depth to guide architecture across systems, identity, endpoint, messaging, automation, security, and infrastructure platforms
* Ability to define ambiguous problems, create technical direction, and make sound architectural decisions in complex enterprise environments
* Trusted technical judgment with the ability to balance reliability, security, cost, modernization, operational impact, and business outcomes

title: AI Architect
description:
**AI Architect** 

*Enterprise AI \| Generative AI \| Agentic AI \| Cloud Architecture \| Hyderabad* 




 Generative AI and agentic systems are moving from pilots to the core of how enterprises operate — and Tachyon Technologies is where that shift is being architected. We're looking for a senior AI Architect who wants to own that transformation end to end: designing the systems, setting the standards, and seeing solutions run in production at enterprise scale, not just in a slide deck.
 



 This is a role for someone who has already done real cloud architecture, has since built genuine depth in LLMs, RAG, and agentic design, and wants a platform where that combination is the whole job — not a side project bolted onto something else.
 


**What You Will Do** 
* Architect end\-to\-end enterprise AI solutions spanning applications, APIs, data, cloud infrastructure, security, integrations, and user experience.
* Design and lead Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions using LLMs, RAG, enterprise search, tool/function calling, and multi\-agent orchestration.
* Define cloud\-native architectures for AI workloads on Azure, AWS, and/or GCP using managed AI services, containers, Kubernetes, and serverless patterns.
* Evaluate and select models, frameworks, vector databases, and cloud services against business, security, performance, and cost requirements.
* Design integrations between AI solutions and enterprise platforms — Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow, ERP/CRM, data platforms, and external APIs.
* Create architecture blueprints, reference patterns, reusable components, and technical standards for AI delivery.
* Lead technical discovery, architecture workshops, design reviews, and proof\-of\-concept initiatives with engineering and customer teams.
* Define AI evaluation and observability approaches — grounding, accuracy, hallucination risk, latency, cost, and safety.
* Establish guardrails, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, identity and access models, and Responsible AI practices.
* Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, and help build strong architecture practice across AI initiatives.
  


**What You Bring** 
* 15\+ years in software engineering, solution architecture, enterprise architecture, or cloud architecture, with recent hands\-on technical work.
* A production GenAI or Agentic AI system you've personally architected and shipped — not a POC — using LLMs, RAG, tool/function calling, or multi\-agent orchestration.
* Deep, hands\-on cloud architecture experience on Azure, AWS, or GCP; multi\-cloud experience is a strong plus.
* Working fluency with modern AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or CrewAI.
* Strong software engineering foundation with hands\-on programming, preferably Python, and the ability to review implementation\-level decisions.
* Solid grounding in microservices, REST APIs, event\-driven architecture, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience with relational, NoSQL, and vector data platforms, and designing data/knowledge access patterns for AI.
* Excellent communication — equally comfortable with engineering teams and business/technology leaders.
  


**Also Great to Have** 
* Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation), CI/CD, and production support practices.
* Hands\-on exposure to Azure OpenAI/AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI/Gemini.
* Cloud architecture certification from Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Experience building reusable AI platforms, accelerators, or enterprise AI capabilities.
* Exposure to Model Context Protocol (MCP), knowledge graphs, or advanced enterprise search.
* Background in customer\-facing architecture, solutioning, or technical consulting.
  


**Why Tachyon** 
* Own architecture decisions on high\-visibility enterprise AI programs, from first workshop to production rollout.
* Work at the intersection of deep cloud engineering and cutting\-edge agentic AI — not one at the expense of the other.
* Shape reusable patterns and standards that other architects and engineers will build on.
* Direct exposure to customer stakeholders and technology leadership, with real influence over technical direction.

Translate the needs of engineering teams, reference architectures, and governance requirements into reusable frameworks, the data platform, and governance\-as\-code enforcement. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.

Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well\-structured arguments and trade\-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.
* Engagement and Collaborative Co\-Creation: Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co\-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.

 Level: Mid\-Senior \| Function Owner \| Reports into Org Leadership
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We're looking for a Parent Relationship Head to own our parent relationship function end to end — the playbook every campus runs on, two zonal Senior Managers, and the final escalation point for issues no Manager or Senior Manager can resolve. This is a build\-stage leadership role for someone still hands\-on and hungry to build — not a caretaker role for an already\-mature function.
 



  





**Mandatory Requirements** 




  




* 10–14 years of total professional experience
* Minimum 4–5 years managing managers (not just frontline staff) in a relationship\- or trust\-facing function
* Has personally built or significantly reshaped a relationship/customer\-experience playbook — not just inherited and maintained one
* Proven experience as the final escalation point on sensitive, emotionally charged, or reputation\-sensitive issues
* Able to represent a function to leadership and own a company\-wide performance metric
* Still hands\-on — personally reviews hard cases, not just dashboards
* Graduate degree (minimum qualification)



  





**Good to Have** 




  




* MBA
* Background in higher education, ed\-tech, or family/parent\-facing operations
* Experience building a trust or expectation\-management standard across a distributed team



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Set the function's playbook — hiring bar, SLAs, staffing ratio policy, tracker and reporting standards — applied consistently across zones
* Hire, review, and hold accountable two zonal Senior Managers
* Own escalations that neither Managers nor Senior Managers could close
* Consolidate both zones into a single company\-wide trust/NPS and function\-health view for leadership
* Own the company\-wide parent education and communications calendar
* Represent the function cross\-functionally with Program Ops, Partnerships, Student Relations, and Facilities teams



  





**Ideal Backgrounds** 




  





 Heads of Customer Success/Experience from growth\-stage ed\-tech, fintech, or D2C companies; multi\-property Guest Experience leaders in hospitality; Dean of Student Affairs or Head of Alumni \& Parent Relations in higher education; relationship\-banking or wealth\-relationship vertical heads in BFSI; senior stakeholder\-engagement leaders in the social sector.
 



  





**Growth Path** 




  





 This is currently the function's senior\-most role. Scope grows — more zones, a larger team, a deeper education program — as the organization scales.

title: Process Intelligence Specialist
description:
We are Reckitt
   

  

 Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.
   

  

 Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
   

  

 Global Business Services
   

  

 Our Finance team is not just another department; we're strategic partners and catalysts for change, who use our expertise to drive sustainable growth and create and protect value for Reckitt.
   

  

 With a strong emphasis on cross\-functional collaboration and partnership, our inclusive, diverse and energised team breaks down traditional barriers, enabling you to thrive in a dynamic environment where you and your ideas matter.
   

  

 From leveraging insights and analysis to make data\-driven decisions \- to spearheading sustainable business practices that contribute to consistent and reliable business growth \- we are unwaveringly passionate about making a meaningful impact, and always doing the right thing.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Process Intelligence Specialist is responsible for delivering data‑driven insights into how business processes actually run, using process mining, modelling, and advanced analytics. The role focuses on hands‑on analysis, converting complex process data into clear, actionable insights that help teams improve service, cost, speed, adherence, and automation readiness. This role works closely with process leads, business operations, data analytics, transformation teams, IT, and analytics functions and plays a key role in embedding process intelligence into day‑to‑day decision‑making.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

* Model process flows, ensure quality of modelled processes and act as SME to support \& coach business modelers
* Develop As‑Is and To‑Be process models based on input of process owners, operations and real execution data
* Support process standardization efforts while clearly highlighting justified local or channel‑specific variants
* Contribute to scenario and impact modelling (e.g. what\-if models for promotions, capacity constraints, demand shocks)
* Set\-up \& Analysis of end‑to‑end process mining use cases on end\-to\-end processes e.g., O2C, S2P, R2R, Hire\-to\-Retire, Plan\-to Fulfil
* Discover actual execution flows, variants, bottlenecks, rework, and deviations from standard processes
* Support audit, SOX, and regulatory requirements with data‑based evidence
* Help define preventive controls and leading indicators
* Translate analytical findings into clear, business‑oriented insights
* Create dashboards, views, and visuals that answer, “what happened, why, and where to act.”


 The experience we're looking for
   

  

 5\-7 years in process analytics, process improvement, or operational analytics
   

  

 Hands‑on experience with process intelligence tools
   

  

 Exposure to FMCG, consumer goods, or other high‑volume operational environments preferred
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in business, Data Analytics or related field
   

  

 Certifications in Lean Six Sigma, Agile working, Process Mining, Analytics are a plus
   

  

 The skills for success
   

  

 Process Mining, Celonis, Process data analysis, Business process transformation, Six Sigma, Finance Process transformaiton, Lean, Process Intelligence, Process Modelling
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

 With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way.
   

  

 We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
   

  

 Equality
   

  

 We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Sr Engineer Analog Simulation CAD
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**
 Seniority level: Mid\-Senior Level
   

  

 Min Experience: 5\+ years

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
   

  

 We are seeking a talented CAD Staff engineer specialized in analog and digital simulations to join our high\-achieving engineering team. As a CAD staff engineer, you will play a pivotal role in optimizing and simulating complex analog and digital circuits, contributing to the development of state\-of\-the\-art products that shape our industry. You will get a chance to develop the industry's first and unique flows to enhance productivity and reduce pre\-silicon failures.

* Work closely with memory design teams and solve their daily challenges and provide complete solutions for the future
* Proactively identify problem areas for improvement, propose, and develop innovative solutions
* Develop highly scalable, and clean software systems
* Continuously evaluate and implement new tools and technologies to improve the current software flows
* Work with EDA vendors to evaluate and integrate EDA tools in CAD flows
* Lead agentic flow implementation using AI‑assisted and automated workflows, applying copilot‑based assistants, agentic AI flows, and rule‑aware automation to circuit simulation \& verification
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to junior engineers, fostering their professional growth and development
* Integrates AI\-assisted tools and insights into daily work to improve efficiency, quality, or effectiveness, exercising sound judgment and complying with organizational standards and legal requirements
* Contributes to a culture of continuous improvement by identifying, testing, and sharing AI\-enabled enhancements within one’s scope of work


**Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:**
* 8\+ years of progressive experience in analog circuit simulation flows
* Expert in circuit simulation debugging with required knowledge of leading\-edge circuit design and simulation methodologies
* Hands on experience with one of the circuit simulators (Finesim/Primesim/XA/Spectre/VCS/Xcelium etc.)
* Hands\-on experience with Cadence custom IC Virtuoso platform, Virtuoso\-L, and Virtuoso\-XL, schematic capture, or Synopsys custom compiler or equivalent
* Develop and deploy AI‑enabled methodologies for Circuit Simulation Flows
* Hands on with Python/Perl Object Oriented Programming
* Good understanding of CMOS concepts and electronic fundamentals
* Knowledge of Linux, LSF, shell scripting, TCL scripting, SKILL(Cadence) language
* Knowledge of parasitic extraction tools like StarRC/Quantus will be an added advantage
* Excellent problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex circuit issues effectively
* Proficiency in working effectively with global teams and stakeholders
* Experience in EM/IR \& STA (Static Timing Analysis) will be an added advantage
* Experience in AI/ML will be an added advantage
* Ability to apply baseline digital fluency and role‑appropriate AI literacy to use
* AI‑enabled tools responsibly and effectively for research, analysis, content creation, problem‑solving, operational tasks, and achieving business outcomes


 Must\-have skills
   

  

 CAD, simulation, analog

title: Product Support Analyst
description:

 Customer Support
   

  

**Location:**

**Description**
 Product Support Analyst plays a critical role in delivering world\-class technical support for Infor's Workforce Management (WFM) application to enterprise clients. This role requires an individual who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, excels in multi\-tasking, and can prioritize effectively to meet both individual and team objectives.
   

  

 As a Product Support Analyst, you will investigate and resolve complex software issues reported by customers, collaborating closely with R\&D and Services teams to deliver timely and impactful solutions. This position offers an exciting opportunity to apply and develop your strong technical and problem\-solving skills through extensive product training and hands\-on coaching. Your contributions will ensure consistent and excellent service to Infor’s global client base, making a tangible impact on their business operations.
   

  

 If you are passionate about customer success, thrive on solving challenging problems, and aspire to grow your career within a dynamic Product Support team, this role is for you.
   

  

**A Typical Day In The Life Includes**
* Provide high\-quality technical support for Infor applications, ensuring customer satisfaction and product usability.
* Troubleshoot application issues, perform root cause analysis, and guide customers through solutions via phone, email, and web\-based tools.
* Collaborate with internal teams including Product Management, Development, and Cloud Operations to resolve escalated issues.
* Document knowledge in the form of incident notes, technical articles, and operational procedures.
* Prioritize and manage multiple open issues while delivering consistent updates to stakeholders.
* Participate in customer calls and screen\-sharing sessions to support complex issues.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the support organization.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience in application or technical support, preferably in a SaaS or ERP environment.
* Problem solving experience; being able to dissect technical problems and translate findings to non\-technical users.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases (e.g., MS SQL Server, Oracle).
* Experience with enterprise software in areas like HR Talent, Workforce Management, etc is a plus.

* Familiarity with ITIL Processes and Support Tools: Hands\-on experience with ITIL\-compliant processes and ticketing systems, such as ServiceNow, Salesforce, or Jira.
* Technical Expertise: Practical experience with Java for troubleshooting and resolving technical issues.

title: Transformation Officer
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

 The Transformation Officer is an intellectually curious, analytically driven role at the foundation of the Transformation Office. Working as a core member of a transformation program team, this individual supports the delivery of discrete workstreams by conducting structured business analysis, gathering and synthesising operational data, mapping processes, engaging with subject matter experts, and producing clear outputs that drive informed decision\-making and program progress.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for an early\-career professional with the mindset of a consultant — someone who is energised by problem\-solving, takes initiative to dig into the detail, and takes pride in producing high\-quality, rigorous work. The Transformation Officer will work closely alongside global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business, gaining broad exposure to the firm's operations and technology landscape while contributing meaningfully to real transformation outcomes from day one.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
**Analysis \& Research**
* Conduct structured current\-state analysis to understand existing processes, workflows, roles, and operational pain points, through interviews, workshops, and data review
* Gather, clean, and analyse quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement
* Develop and maintain process maps, data models, and analytical frameworks that underpin workstream findings and recommendations
* Analyse interdependencies between people, process, technology, and governance elements of the operating model, under the guidance of the Senior Officer or Program Lead
* Proactively research best practices, benchmarks, and comparable approaches to inform solution design
* Contribute to the development of business cases, options papers, and other analytical outputs that inform senior decision\-making


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Requirements Gathering**
* Engage day\-to\-day with global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business to gather information, validate analysis, and support the change process
* Support the facilitation of workshops and interviews with stakeholders across functions to capture requirements, surface pain points, and gather input
* Assist in translating business needs into clear, structured requirements and user stories for technology and process workstreams
* Support change impact assessments and stakeholder mapping activities
* Build constructive working relationships with subject matter experts and operational counterparts across the business
* Communicate findings and workstream updates clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing, in a manner appropriate to the audience


**Technology\-Enabled Transformation**
* Support work with Global Process Owners, Tech, Product, and Operations teams to understand technology solutions and their implications for the operating model

**Company Description** 
 Dunbar \& Boardman (D\&B), founded in the UK in 1981, is an independent specialist consultancy focused on Vertical Transportation and Façade Access advisory services across the UK, Middle East, India, and other international markets. With over four decades of experience, D\&B supports clients through the full building lifecycle, from feasibility and concept design to construction, commissioning, and asset management. The consultancy works on a wide range of projects, including high\-rise and supertall buildings, commercial, residential, hospitality, healthcare, transport infrastructure, and mixed\-use developments. As a manufacturer\-neutral advisor, D\&B provides recommendations driven by safety, performance, operational efficiency, and lifecycle needs rather than equipment supply.  The Graduate Engineering Trainee will support senior engineers and consultants in delivering Vertical Transportation and Façade Access projects, including data collection, technical analysis, and preparation of reports and drawings. Day\-to\-day tasks may include assisting with feasibility studies, reviewing design documents, supporting traffic analysis and simulations, and contributing to tender and construction\-phase documentation. The role involves collaborating with cross\-functional teams, attending project meetings, and maintaining accurate project records and documentation. This is a full\-time, hybrid role based in Hyderabad, with a mix of office\-based work and some flexibility to work from home. The trainee will receive guidance and training to develop technical competence, professional communication skills, and an understanding of industry standards and best practices.

* Proficiency in standard office and engineering tools (e.g., MS Office, spreadsheets; exposure to CAD or simulation software is an advantage).

* Attention to detail, commitment to safety and quality, and willingness to learn about Vertical Transportation and Façade Access systems.
* Any internship or academic project experience in building services, mechanical systems, or construction\-related fields is beneficial.

title: Senior API Platform Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different \- in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 We are looking for an API Developer who builds the platform APIs other teams depend on, and runs them in production. You will write the code in
 **TypeScript and Python** 
 , and you will own the
 **Kubernetes** 
 deployments, pipelines and monitoring that keep it running.
   

  

 These are platform APIs, so your users are other developers. That changes how you work: an API only succeeds if it is easy to adopt. We want someone who puts themselves in the user’s shoes before shipping.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

**Building Platform Capabilities**
* Design and build APIs in TypeScript and Python that other teams use as building blocks
* Treat other developers as your customers. Talk to them, understand how they will integrate, and design for that
* Write clear OpenAPI contracts, useful documentation and error messages that actually help the caller
* Pick sensible defaults so the common case works with minimal setup
* Keep versioning and backwards compatibility in mind, so adopting your API today does not create work for someone tomorrow


**Deployment \& Operations**
* Package services as containers and deploy them to Kubernetes, writing and maintaining your own Helm charts
* Ship through GitOps with Flux, so what is in the repository is what is running in the cluster
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions for automated testing, building and release
* Configure the API layer in front of your services: routing, authentication, rate limiting and versioning
* Instrument your services with OpenTelemetry so traces, metrics and logs show you a problem before a user reports it
* Debug issues across application code, infrastructure and networking


**Working in the Team**
* Take a problem with its context and come back with a proposal. You will not be handed a solution to implement
* Review other people’s code and take review well on your own
* Work with security and operations to keep services aligned with our controls


**Qualifications \& Skills**
**Must Have**
* 3–5 years building production APIs, comfortable in both TypeScript and Python
* Good grasp of API design and OpenAPI (REST conventions, versioning, error handling, pagination)
* Real Kubernetes experience: you can debug a pod that will not start, not just deploy to a cluster someone else built
* Hands\-on with Docker and Helm
* CI/CD experience, ideally GitHub Actions
* Familiar with authentication patterns such as OAuth2, OIDC and JWT
* Working knowledge of relational databases
* You use AI tools every day, to get up to speed on unfamiliar technology, to explore options before committing, and to move faster on routine work, while still understanding what you ship. Tell us how you use them.
* Able to work autonomously, raise questions early and own a piece of the platform end to end
* Fluent in English


**Nice to Have**
* API gateway experience such as Kong, a plus and not a requirement. We will train the right person
* GitOps tooling such as Flux or Argo CD
* OpenTelemetry and an observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo or similar)
* Event\-driven architectures and messaging (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, Azure Service Bus)
* Cloud platform experience (AWS or Azure)
* Terraform basics, enough to provision your own databases, caches and queues
* GraphQL
* Previous platform engineering or developer experience work
* Background in financial services or another regulated industry


 Mindset
   

  

**We Are Looking For Someone Who**
* Thinks about the developer on the other end of the API, and asks "would I want to integrate with this?" before shipping
* Enjoys building the foundations other people build on
* Is curious and self\-directed, you research what you do not know rather than waiting to be taught
* Uses AI as a normal working tool, not a novelty, and stays critical of what it gives back
* Is comfortable owning a service from the API contract through to production
* Prefers asking a good question early over guessing quietly


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.

Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering platform capabilities that delight the engineers who depend on them, while driving tangible leverage and value across Deloitte’s AI engineering investments. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to design, build, and operate the enabling layer for AI engineering at scale.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for engineering\-leverage and adoption outcomes. Build platform capabilities that solve recurring problems once, well, for many teams—reducing per\-team build and operate toil while ensuring consistency and compliance by default through high\-quality, lean designs and implementations.
* Serve as the technical advocate for the platform as a product, ensuring capability integrity, feasibility, and alignment with the needs of the engineering teams who consume it. Lead requirement discovery with consuming teams, component design of platform services, frameworks, and the AI control plane, and their development, testing, integration, and support.
* Maintain accountability for the integrity of the platform architecture and for the enterprise tech\-stack conformance baseline that engineering teams build against. Manage platform dependencies, code design, implementation, the data and policy\-as\-code enforcement layers, and the OpenTelemetry\-based instrumentation substrate—building capabilities that are operable, instrumented, performant, and drift\-resistant by design, to the production standards set by SRE. Stay hands\-on, self\-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, codify recurring patterns into reusable components and golden paths, and write high\-quality, supportable, scalable code to ensure all platform KPIs (adoption, reliability\-by\-design, and developer experience) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
* Develop lean platform capabilities through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve the real needs of consuming engineering teams. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right capability is delivered at the right time—and adopted, not shelved.
* Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning\-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering platform capabilities as lean, adoption\-validated increments rather than big\-bang builds, and keeping them supportable and maintainable.
* Work collaboratively with empowered, cross\-functional partners: engineering, SRE, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Integrate their constraints into the paved roads so that the secure, compliant, and reliable path is the easy path. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize platform solutioning and delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.
* Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the enterprise data estate and the AI use\-case patterns the platform must serve. Translate the needs of engineering teams, reference architectures, and governance requirements into reusable frameworks, the data platform, and governance\-as\-code enforcement. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.
* Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well\-structured arguments and trade\-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.
* Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co\-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.

title: Oracle CDP/Unity- Manager
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As an Oracle CDP/Unity Manager, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients optimize operational efficiency through business application consulting. You will analyze client needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilization of business applications, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will focus on working with Oracle's suite of applications and tools designed to manage the entire customer journey, from lead generation to revenue realization and customer satisfaction.
   

  

 As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be responsible for implementing and configuring Oracle lead management, sales automation, marketing automation, and customer experience solutions to meet the specific needs of an organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Implementing and configuring Oracle lead management, sales automation, and marketing automation solutions to optimize client operations
* Analyzing client needs to develop tailored software solutions that enhance customer experience and satisfaction
* Providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of Oracle applications
* Managing the entire customer journey from lead generation to revenue realization using Oracle's suite of tools
* Building meaningful client connections and fostering relationships to understand and anticipate client needs
* Navigating complex situations and using critical thinking to solve problems and generate new ideas
* Upholding professional and technical standards, including PwC's code of conduct and independence requirements
* Utilizing analytical thinking to interpret data and inform insights and recommendations
* Collaborating with teams to deliver quality and strategic objectives in business application consulting
* Embracing change and leveraging digital tooling to enhance client service delivery


 What You Must Have
   

  

* Overall experience of 8–12 years, with strong hands\-on and leadership experience in Oracle Unity Customer Data Platform (CDP) implementations.
* Experience leading at least 2–3 end\-to\-end Oracle Unity/CDP implementations.
* Good working experience with Oracle Eloqua Marketing Automation, particularly integrations between Unity, Eloqua, CRM, and other enterprise applications.
* Strong experience in solution architecture, technical design, data modelling, integrations, delivery management, stakeholder management, and team leadership.
* Ability to lead teams comprising developers, consultants, administrators, data engineers, and business stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of Customer Data Platforms, Customer 360, CRM, Marketing Automation, Service, Loyalty, Analytics, Data Warehouses, and enterprise integrations.


**Role And Responsibilities**
* Lead the overall solution design, architecture, implementation, and support of Oracle Unity solutions.
* Work closely with business, marketing, sales, service, IT, data, and architecture teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable Oracle Unity solutions.
* Own technical design decisions and ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, integration, data governance, and performance standards.
* Lead requirement\-gathering and solution\-design workshops and provide recommendations based on Oracle Unity capabilities and best practices.
* Review and approve technical requirements, solution design documents, integration specifications, source\-to\-target mappings, test strategies, deployment plans, and operational documentation.
* Manage multiple Unity workstreams and ensure delivery within agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, and business expectations.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, training, feedback, and guidance to developers, consultants, administrators, and end business users.
* Perform solution and design reviews and establish reusable development, integration, and configuration standards.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, data\-quality issues, integration challenges, and performance bottlenecks and drive them to resolution.
* Coordinate with Oracle Support and other vendors for product issues, enhancements, patches, and technical escalations.
* Work with marketing teams to define how customer segments and attributes from Oracle Unity can be activated through Oracle Eloqua campaigns and marketing programs.
* Manage key business and technology stakeholders, align priorities, and communicate scope, risks, dependencies, and delivery status for Oracle Unity initiatives.Build strong relationships across Marketing, Sales, Service, CRM, Data, Analytics, Security, Architecture, and Operations teams.
* Own the overall Oracle Unity solution architecture and define scalable, secure, reusable, and maintainable CDP solution patterns.Design end\-to\-end data ingestion, identity resolution, segmentation, activation, integration, and Customer 360 architecture across enterprise systems.
* Lead solution demonstrations, proof\-of\-concepts, and capability showcases for Oracle Unity use cases and platform features.Present Customer 360, identity resolution, segmentation, intelligent attributes, dashboards, integrations, and activation flows to business and technical stakeholders.
* Support pre\-sales activities including discovery sessions, solutioning, effort estimation, proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and client presentations.Work with sales and delivery teams to define Unity solution approaches, scope, timelines, assumptions, integrations, and resource requirements.
* Manage resource planning, allocation, capacity, utilization, workload, and delivery commitments across multiple Oracle Unity projects and workstreams.Identify skill gaps, support hiring and onboarding, and drive training, cross\-skilling, mentoring, and capability development within the team.


**Oracle Unity / CDP Technical Responsibilities**
* Design the overall Oracle Unity data architecture, including source systems, ingestion strategy, data models, identity resolution, segmentation, activation, and downstream integrations.
* Design and configure data feeds and ingestion jobs to bring customer, transactional, behavioral, engagement, and other enterprise data into Oracle Unity.
* Define and review source\-to\-target mappings between source systems, data warehouses, Oracle Unity, CRM, Marketing, Service, Loyalty, Analytics, and other downstream platforms.
* Configure and extend Oracle Unity data models based on business, reporting, analytical, and activation requirements.
* Maintain strong understanding of Oracle Unity data objects, relationships, attributes, metadata, and query capabilities.
* Design and configure Identity Resolution rules, including match rules, survivorship rules, master entity identification, and resolution of duplicate or conflicting customer records.
* Review and troubleshoot MCPS queries and optimize queries for performance and scalability.
* Design and create Intelligent Attributes and use them in calculations, segmentation, personalization, analytics, and activation use cases.
* Define and implement customer segmentation strategies using demographic, transactional, behavioral, engagement, and predictive attributes.
* Create, configure, and manage Data Science and Machine Learning models available within Oracle Unity and assess their applicability to business use cases.
* Configure and manage address validation, standardization, enrichment, and data\-quality processes.
* Design and develop Customer 360 dashboards using rules, sub\-rules, data source views, calculated attributes, and custom widgets.
* Develop dashboards for customer engagement, segmentation, campaign performance, customer behavior, and other business KPIs.
* Design and manage integrations between Oracle Unity and enterprise applications such as Oracle Sales, Salesforce, Oracle Service, Oracle Loyalty, Oracle Eloqua, Oracle Infinity, Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, Analytics platforms, and third\-party systems.
* Strong understanding of Oracle Unity REST APIs, batch integrations, outbound activation mechanisms, webhooks, and integration patterns.
* Define and manage Access Control, users, roles, permissions, and security governance within Oracle Unity.
* Establish data\-governance standards covering data ingestion, customer identity, data quality, data privacy, retention, consent, security, and downstream data activation.
* Monitor Unity ingestion jobs, data pipelines, identity\-resolution processes, segmentation jobs, calculations, data\-science processes, and integrations.
* Perform root\-cause analysis and drive resolution of data\-processing, integration, identity\-resolution, API, segmentation, and performance issues.
* Review platform usage and recommend performance, scalability, and operational improvements.
* Define customer\-data activation patterns to support Customer 360, personalization, lead generation, cross\-sell, up\-sell, churn management, customer engagement, and next\-best\-action use cases.


**Oracle Eloqua Exposure**
* Good understanding of Oracle Eloqua architecture, campaign management, contacts, custom objects, segments, forms, landing pages, and lead\-nurturing programs.
* Experience integrating Oracle Unity with Oracle Eloqua for customer segmentation, campaign activation, audience synchronization, and marketing personalization.
* Understand the data flow between Unity, Eloqua, CRM/Salesforce/Oracle Sales, and other downstream marketing systems.
* Support marketing teams in using Unity customer attributes, Intelligent Attributes, and segments within Eloqua campaigns.
* Good understanding of Eloqua integrations, APIs, native connectors, and data synchronization mechanisms.
* Support troubleshooting of data synchronization, campaign activation, contact\-management, and integration issues between Unity and Eloqua.
* Understand lead management, lead scoring, campaign responses, and lead hand\-off processes between Eloqua and CRM systems.


**Integration And Technical Skills**
* Strong knowledge of Oracle Unity REST APIs and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience integrating Oracle Unity with:
* Oracle Sales / Fusion CRM
* Salesforce
* Oracle Service
* Oracle Loyalty
* Oracle Eloqua
* Oracle Infinity
* Data Warehouses
* Enterprise Data Lakes
* Analytics platforms
* External marketing and customer\-engagement platforms
* Experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, middleware, batch interfaces, scheduled integrations, and event\-driven integration patterns.
* Good understanding of SQL/query concepts, data modelling, data transformation, and data\-quality principles.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex integration, data\-processing, API, identity\-resolution, segmentation, and performance issues.
* Understanding of customer\-data activation from Oracle Unity into Eloqua and other marketing channels.


**Leadership And Management Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage a team of Oracle Unity developers, consultants, administrators, and data specialists.
