 ScienceLogic scored a leadership position in the “Forrester Wave” AI Observability report. We are a global, growing software company reinventing the way companies manage their hybrid cloud data and systems by driving operational and business insights from the extensive data types contained in the SkylarOne data lake with AI.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing...**
 You'll lead a ten\-person team comprised of full\-time employees and contractors, covering the following day\-to\-day:
   

  

* Owning technical direction and architecture for SkylarOne platform modernization, including OS migrations, cloud infrastructure, and system reliability.
* Managing delivery across systems engineering, DevOps/test infrastructure, and networking, staying hands\-on with design reviews, troubleshooting, and code/config review while delegating as the team grows.

* A hands\-on background in systems engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering: comfortable reviewing architecture, debugging production issues, and making infrastructure decisions rather than just relaying them.
* Strong understanding of Linux administration, automation, and cloud infrastructure.
* Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, routing) sufficient to guide a networking specialist on the team.
* Experience with CI/CD and infrastructure\-as\-code practices (e.g., Terraform, Jenkins).
* Comfortable operating across a matrixed reporting structure and collaborating with stakeholders in different time zones.

* Scripting or programming experience (Python, Golang, or Bash).

title: Agentic AI Enginner - Social Impact Projects
description:
\*\*\*\*\*\*\*THIS POSITION IS FOR EXPERIENCED PROFESSIONALS ONLY. COLLEGE STUDENTS AND RECENT GRADUATES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*
 



  





 🚀 We’re Hiring: Agentic AI Engineer \- Social Impact projects
 



  





 VitaInspire Private Limited📍 Hyderabad \| Full\-Time \| Onsite🏥 Healthcare \| 🎓 Education \| 🤖 Agentic AI \| 🌍 Social ImpactImportant:
 



 This is a Hyderabad\-based onsite role.
 



  





 Candidates should be based in Hyderabad or willing to relocate and must be available to attend an in\-person interview in Hyderabad.
 



  





 About VitaInspire
 



 At VitaInspire, we are building practical AI solutions designed to create meaningful impact in healthcare and education particularly for communities underserved by technology.We are now building the next generation of Agentic AI systems—AI agents that can reason, collaborate, use tools, access knowledge, make decisions, and execute complex real\-world workflows.We are looking for an exceptional AI Agentic Systems Lead who wants to build these systems from the ground up.
 



  





 🚀 The Opportunity
 



 We are looking for a hands\-on builder who has experience developing production\-grade Agentic AI systems and understands how to take an idea from 0 → 1 → production.You will:• Architect and build production\-grade multi\-agent AI systems• Design agent orchestration, planning, memory, communication, and tool\-use architectures• Build agents that execute real\-world workflows• Develop RAG and knowledge\-grounded agent systems• Integrate agents with APIs, databases, enterprise systems, and external tools• Implement agent evaluation, observability, reliability, and monitoring• Evaluate emerging Agentic AI frameworks, models, and protocols• Lead and mentor a small AI engineering team while remaining deeply hands\-on• Own architecture, technical decisions, delivery, and outcomes• Move rapidly from idea → prototype → productionWe are looking for a builder, not a technology follower.
 



  





 🏥 What You Will Build
 



  





 Agentic Healthcare
 



 Examples include:• AI\-assisted clinical workflows• Multi\-agent patient support systems• Clinical knowledge and decision\-support agents• Patient follow\-up and care coordination• Medical information retrieval and reasoning• Healthcare workflow automation• Agents interacting with EMRs, APIs, messaging platforms, and other healthcare systems
 



  





 Agentic Education
 



 Examples include:• AI tutoring agents• Multi\-agent personalized learning systems• Student assessment and feedback agents• Teacher and coordinator assistants• Curriculum and learning\-path agents• Educational content generation and verification• Agents integrated with learning platforms and educational toolsOur objective is simple:Build AI systems that can actually do useful work for people—not just talk about doing it.
 



  





 \*\*\*\*\*\*\*THIS POSITION IS FOR EXPERIENCED PROFESSIONALS ONLY. COLLEGE STUDENTS AND RECENT GRADUATES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*
 



  





 🔍 What We’re Looking For
 



 We are looking for candidates with 2–3\+ years of relevant AI/software engineering experience, including meaningful hands\-on experience building and deploying AI agent systems.You should be able to demonstrate experience with:• Multi\-agent orchestration• Agent\-to\-agent communication and coordination• Tool calling and function execution• Planning and task decomposition• Agent memory and state management• RAG and knowledge\-grounded agents• Human\-in\-the\-loop workflows• Agent evaluation and observability• Production deployment and monitoringExperience with LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, OpenAI Agents SDK, or similar technologies is valuable.However, we care more about what you have built than which framework you used.
 



  





 💻 Strong Software Engineering Skills
 



 We are looking for hands\-on experience with technologies such as:
 



 Python \| FastAPI \| REST APIs \| PostgreSQL \| Redis \| Docker \| Git \| Cloud \| Async/Event\-Driven Architectures \| Third\-Party APIsExperience with AWS, Azure, or GCP is preferred.
 



 🛠️ You Must Be a Builder
 



 We are particularly interested in people who:• Start with the problem rather than the technology• Can rapidly turn ideas into working prototypes• Are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information• Can take products from 0 → 1• Debug and solve difficult problems independently• Think about reliability, latency, cost, security, and user experience• Constantly experiment with new AI models, frameworks, and capabilities• Can distinguish genuinely useful technology from hype
 



 You should be the kind of person who sees a new AI capability and immediately thinks:“What can I build with this?”
 



  





 🧠 Founder\-Type Mindset
 



 You don't need to have been a founder.But you should bring a founder's sense of ownership, urgency, curiosity, and accountability.We want someone who takes responsibility for outcomes, challenges assumptions constructively, identifies problems before they become blockers, and cares deeply about building something that works.
 



  





 👥 Hands\-On Leadership
 



 This is a hands\-on technical leadership role, not a pure management position.You will help define technical direction, review architecture and code, mentor engineers, establish engineering standards, remove blockers, and build a culture of experimentation and execution.You will still be expected to write code and build systems.
 



  





 🌟 Why VitaInspire?
 



 This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of:
 



 Agentic AI \+ Healthcare \+ Education \+ Social ImpactIf you want to build sophisticated AI systems while solving problems that can make a meaningful difference in people's lives, we'd like to hear from you.Interested? Send your profile/resume along with links to your GitHub, portfolio, demos, or Agentic AI projects you have built.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\-Cyber Security\- Senior AI Engineer – IAM \& Cybersecurity**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to support the design and delivery of AI\-led solutions across Identity and Access Management and Cybersecurity domains. This role will help shape how AI capabilities are applied to modern IAM challenges such as identity governance, access management, privileged access, directory services and non\-human identity security.
   

  

 As a senior profile, the candidate will work closely with IAM, Cyber, cloud and business stakeholders to understand client problems, identify practical AI opportunities and convert them into working solutions, prototypes and scalable delivery assets. The focus is not only on technology implementation, but also on improving identity risk visibility, access decisioning, governance efficiency and operational effectiveness.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should bring strong hands\-on engineering experience, curiosity to work in the IAM and Cyber domain, and the ability to apply AI, automation and analytics to solve real enterprise identity challenges. While the role requires practical exposure to AI and IAM technologies, the emphasis is on problem solving, consulting mindset, solution ownership and the ability to contribute to enterprise\-scale IAM transformation programs.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop and operationalize AI solutions for IAM and Cybersecurity use cases across SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, IGA, PAM, AD/Entra ID and NHI domains.
* Build hands\-on AI/ML capabilities using Python, PowerShell, LLM/SLM APIs, embeddings, RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, ADKs and AI orchestration engines.
* Develop agentic AI workflows, copilots and automation frameworks for access requests, certification campaigns, provisioning, privileged access, remediation and identity operations.
* Integrate AI solutions with SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure, AWS, Microsoft Graph API, SIEM/SOAR, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike and XDR platforms.
* Analyze identity, access, privilege, vault, directory, activity and security logs to identify risk patterns, anomalies, access recommendations, role mining opportunities and policy gaps.
* Support AI\-driven IAM governance including risk\-based authentication, risk\-based provisioning, access reviews, compliance checks, SOD, identity lifecycle orchestration and audit\-ready reporting.
* Apply ML, classification, optimization, time series analysis, pattern recognition, NLP, UEBA, anomaly detection and predictive risk scoring for identity and access intelligence.
* Work on Non\-Human Identity use cases including service accounts, managed identities, service principals, enterprise applications, API\-based identities, workload identities, agent identities, token misuse and agent overreach controls.
* Contribute to PAM analytics and automation across CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secret lifecycle management, session monitoring and vault log analytics.
* Create dashboards and insights using Power BI, Tableau and identity analytics views to explain access risk, compliance posture, user activity trends and remediation priorities.
* Collaborate with business, cyber and IAM stakeholders to convert problem statements into working prototypes, scalable solutions and executive\-ready recommendations.


**QUALIFICATIONS:**
**Required Skills**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in AI engineering, software development, data science, automation, cybersecurity analytics or IAM technology delivery.
* Practical experience building AI applications using LLM/SLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, agentic AI, AI agents, copilots and multi\-agent workflows.
* Strong programming and automation experience in Python, PowerShell, APIs, SQL basics and Microsoft Graph API; exposure to HTML, CSS and JavaScript is preferred.
* Hands\-on exposure to Azure AI, OpenAI, AWS, Python\-based AI/ML frameworks, ML models, classification, optimization, NLP, pattern recognition, time series analysis and anomaly detection.
* Working knowledge of IAM concepts including SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, SAML, OAuth, OIDC with PKCE, authentication, authorization, federation, certificate management and key management.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Entra Connect, Cloud Sync, Directory Services, DNS, Global Catalog, GPO, OU, Domains/Forests, FSMO roles and Sites and Services.
* Experience or strong exposure to IGA platforms and concepts such as SailPoint, Saviynt, identity lifecycle, access reviews, certification campaigns, role mining, SOD, access risk and policy compliance.
* Experience or strong exposure to PAM concepts and tools including CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secrets, session monitoring and vault logs.
* Understanding of NHI and AI identity security including service accounts, managed identities, service principals, enterprise applications, API\-based identities, workload identities, agent identities and token controls.
* Experience with security monitoring or analytics platforms such as SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, XDR and Identity Protection.
* Strong consulting mindset with the ability to communicate AI, IAM and Cybersecurity topics clearly to technical teams and leadership stakeholders.


**Nice to have**
* Experience identifying AI use cases for IAM transformation, identity analytics, access recommendations, privileged access recommendations, NHI governance and automated remediation.
* Experience with data pipelines, identity and privilege analytics pipelines, model monitoring, observability, MLOps and scalable deployment of enterprise AI solutions.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, dashboards and data storytelling for access risk, compliance posture and identity operations.
* Exposure to SOX, GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001, CISSP, CISM, SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, Azure AI or Google ML certifications is preferred.
* Prior experience in a consulting, professional services or large enterprise environment is a plus.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

**Our Commitment:**

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits**

**How to Apply:**

title: International Travel & Mobility Coordinator
description:
International Travel \& Mobility Coordinator
 



**Function:** 
 Global Travel / Administration / Global Mobility
 



**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
 



**Reports to:** 
**Head of Finance \- Hyderabad** 




**Level:** 
 Coordinator / Senior Coordinator
 



  





 1\. Role Purpose
 



 The International Travel \& Mobility Coordinator will be responsible for managing
 **end\-to\-end international travel, visa and immigration coordination, and ground transportation/cab services** 
 for employees, executives, visitors and other business travellers.
 



 The role will ensure that all travel is
 **safe, compliant, cost\-effective, policy\-compliant and delivered with a high level of employee experience** 
 .
 



 2\. Key Responsibilities
 



 A. International Travel Management
 


* Coordinate end\-to\-end domestic and international business travel.
* Arrange and manage:
* International and domestic flights
* Hotels and accommodation
* Rail travel
* Airport transfers
* Rental cars
* Local transportation/cabs
* Prepare detailed travel itineraries and ensure all arrangements are confirmed before departure.
* Manage flight changes, cancellations, delays, rebooking and other travel disruptions.
* Provide 24/7 escalation support for critical travel issues, where required.
* Coordinate travel for executives, senior management, expatriates, employees, consultants and visitors.
* Ensure travel arrangements comply with the company’s Travel Policy and approval matrix.



 B. Visa \& Immigration Coordination
 


* Coordinate visa applications for international business travel.
* Support employees with:
* Visa requirements
* Invitation letters
* Appointment scheduling
* Supporting documentation
* Visa application forms
* Passport requirements
* Work permits/business visas where applicable
* Coordinate with embassies, consulates, visa application centres and external immigration/visa agencies.
* Maintain a database of employee visa status, validity and expiry dates.
* Proactively alert employees and management regarding upcoming visa/passport expiries.
* Maintain accurate records of visa applications and outcomes.
* Ensure travel is undertaken only after required documentation is available.
* Maintain knowledge of changing visa and entry requirements across key countries.



 C. Cab \& Ground Transportation Management
 


* Manage employee airport transfers and local business transportation.
* Coordinate corporate cab/ground transportation vendors.
* Maintain preferred vendor arrangements and service standards.
* Manage cab bookings for employees, visitors and executives.
* Monitor service quality, punctuality, safety and employee feedback.
* Validate invoices and resolve billing discrepancies.
* Track transportation spend and identify opportunities for cost optimisation.
* Ensure appropriate escalation procedures are available for travel emergencies.



 D. Travel Vendor Management
 


* Coordinate with Travel Management Companies (TMCs), airlines, hotels, cab providers and visa agencies.
* Monitor vendor performance against agreed SLAs.
* Review service quality, pricing and responsiveness.
* Support vendor onboarding and periodic performance reviews.
* Identify opportunities to consolidate suppliers and improve commercial terms.



 E. Travel Policy \& Compliance
 


* Ensure all travel arrangements comply with the company’s Travel Policy.
* Review and escalate policy exceptions for appropriate approval.
* Maintain travel documentation for audit and compliance purposes.
* Ensure traveller information is accurate and up to date.
* Support duty\-of\-care requirements by maintaining accurate traveller itineraries and emergency contact information.



 F. Travel Cost \& Reporting
 


* Monitor travel expenditure against approved budgets.
* Review travel invoices and supporting documentation.
* Track flight, hotel, visa and ground transportation costs.
* Prepare monthly travel MIS covering:
* Travel spend
* Visa spend
* Cab/ground transportation spend
* Number of travellers
* International trips
* Cost per trip
* Policy exceptions
* Vendor performance
* Identify opportunities for cost savings and process improvement.



 3\. Stakeholder Management
 



 The role will interact with:
 


* Employees and senior management
* Executive assistants
* HR / Global Mobility
* Finance
* Procurement
* Security / Risk Management
* Immigration and visa consultants
* Travel Management Companies
* Airlines and hotels
* Cab and ground transportation providers
* Embassies / Consulates



 4\. Required Skills \& Experience
 


* 3–6 years of experience in
 **corporate travel, travel management, mobility, visa coordination or a similar role** 
 .
* Strong experience handling international travel.
* Practical knowledge of visa and immigration processes.
* Experience managing travel agencies/TMCs and transportation vendors.
* Strong knowledge of airline, hotel, rail and ground transportation booking processes.
* Excellent coordination and organisational skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to handle multiple urgent requests simultaneously.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel, Outlook and Microsoft 365\.
* Experience with corporate travel platforms such as
 **Amadeus, Concur, Navan, Cytric or similar systems** 
 is desirable.
* Excellent written and spoken English; additional European/local languages are an advantage.



 5\. Key Competencies
 


* International Travel Management
* Visa \& Immigration Coordination
* Vendor Management
* Cost Management
* Customer/Employee Service
* Problem Solving
* Attention to Detail
* Stakeholder Management
* Confidentiality
* Crisis \& Travel Disruption Management
* Process Improvement



 6\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 


* Visa processing turnaround time
* % of travel completed without documentation issues
* Travel policy compliance
* Travel cost savings
* Vendor SLA compliance
* Cab/transportation service quality
* Invoice accuracy
* Employee satisfaction
* Number of travel disruptions successfully resolved
* Timely renewal of visas/passports
* Travel spend versus budget

title: Capacity Planner
description:
We are looking for an experienced and analytical
 **Capacity Planner** 
 to oversee workforce planning, forecasting, scheduling, and resource management functions. The ideal candidate will have strong Workforce Management (WFM) experience, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to optimize staffing levels, ensure accurate forecasting, and manage real\-time operations to meet service level agreements (SLAs) and operational goals.
 



 The role involves working closely with leadership and cross\-functional teams to analyze performance metrics, mitigate staffing risks, and drive continuous improvement across team operations.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Capacity Planning \& Forecasting** 



* Develop accurate short\-term and long\-term volume forecasts and staffing models based on historical trends, business growth projections, and operational requirements.
* Analyze call, chat, and ticket patterns to identify workload trends and optimize capacity planning across teams and shifts.
* Determine staffing requirements based on forecasted workload, service level targets, shrinkage, and operational KPIs.
* Identify potential staffing gaps, capacity risks, and resource constraints.
* Partner with business and operations leadership to align workforce plans with business objectives.



**2\. Scheduling \& Resource Allocation** 



* Create, maintain, and publish optimal staff schedules that balance business requirements, agent preferences, and statutory compliance.
* Manage shift trades, time\-off requests, overtime, and offline activities to ensure adequate operational coverage.
* Optimize resource allocation across teams, shifts, and operational queues.
* Ensure staffing plans support service level commitments and operational efficiency.
* Coordinate with Operations and HR teams to address scheduling and workforce requirements.



**3\. Real\-Time Management \& Operations** 



* Monitor intra\-day volume, staffing levels, and schedule adherence in real time.
* Execute timely staffing adjustments to mitigate unexpected volume spikes, outages, and operational disruptions.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for operational escalations related to staffing shortages, outage management, and SLA risks.
* Monitor real\-time performance against forecasted volumes and staffing plans.
* Recommend corrective actions to maintain service levels and operational continuity.
* Collaborate with Operations and leadership teams during critical staffing or service disruptions.



**4\. Analytics \& Reporting** 



* Build and present daily, weekly, and monthly workforce management reports.
* Track and analyze key workforce metrics, including:
* Shrinkage
* Occupancy
* SLA Compliance
* Utilization
* Schedule Adherence
* Staffing Variance
* Forecast Accuracy
* Identify root causes for SLA misses, staffing variances, and operational inefficiencies.
* Provide actionable recommendations to improve workforce efficiency and service delivery.
* Develop dashboards and reporting solutions to support operational and leadership decision\-making.
* Drive continuous improvement through data\-driven workforce analytics.



**5\. Stakeholder \& Team Collaboration** 



* Work closely with Operations, Workforce Management, HR, and senior leadership teams.
* Provide insights and recommendations to support staffing, scheduling, and capacity decisions.
* Communicate staffing risks, operational challenges, and performance trends to relevant stakeholders.
* Support workforce planning initiatives, process improvements, and operational transformation projects.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure alignment between business demand and workforce availability.



**Required Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Statistics, Supply Chain, Operations Management, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in Workforce Management (WFM), Capacity Planning, or Resource Planning.
* Minimum 2\+ years of experience in a supervisory or managerial capacity.
* Strong experience in workforce forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, and real\-time management.
* Proficiency in WFM tools such as NICE IEX, Aspect, Teleopti, and Verint
* Experience working with CRM platforms and contact center operations.
* Strong analytical skills with expertise in Excel/Google Sheets, forecasting models, and data visualization tools.
* In\-depth understanding of contact center dynamics, staffing requirements, shrinkage, occupancy, and workforce KPIs.
* Strong knowledge of Erlang C models and their application in workforce planning.
* Excellent communication, problem\-solving, and cross\-functional leadership skills.



**Preferred Qualifications (Bonus Points)** 



* Experience with SQL, Python, or advanced reporting frameworks for automated workforce analytics.
* Experience developing automated dashboards and workforce reporting solutions.
* Certifications in Workforce Management, Project Management, or related fields, such as:
* PMP (Project Management Professional)
* COPC certification or relevant COPC experience
* Workforce Management certifications
* Experience in large\-scale contact center operations or multi\-team workforce planning.
* Exposure to advanced forecasting, scenario modeling, and workforce optimization techniques.



**Personal Skills** 



* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent planning, organizational, and time management abilities.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage operational escalations.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in forecasting and reporting.
* Proactive approach to identifying staffing risks and operational challenges.
* Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams and leadership.
* Strong decision\-making skills with a data\-driven mindset.
* Adaptability to changing business requirements and operational priorities.
* Commitment to continuous improvement and operational excellence.



**Why Join Us?** 



* Opportunity to lead workforce planning and capacity optimization initiatives.
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams and senior leadership.
* Drive operational efficiency through data\-driven decision\-making.
* Exposure to advanced workforce management tools, analytics, and automation.
* Contribute to continuous improvement and service delivery excellence.



**Apply Now** 




 If you are an experienced Workforce Management professional with strong forecasting, scheduling, and capacity planning expertise, we invite you to apply for the Capacity Planner role in Hyderabad and become part of our growing team.

title: ABM Outbound Manager
description:
**About SmartWinnr** 

  
 




 SmartWinnr is an enterprise\-grade sales enablement platform that helps organizations build sales readiness through AI sales roleplay, coaching, and certification at scale. The platform serves Fortune 500 clients including Boston Scientific, Johnson \& Johnson, and AstraZeneca, along with other major companies such as Abbott, Medtronic, HDFC Life, SBI Life, ICICI Prudential, and Aditya Birla to boost sales productivity. SmartWinnr has earned recognition from G2 as one of the top 50 sales products for two consecutive years, based on authentic customer reviews and feedback.
 



  





  





**Job Role:** 

 ABM Outbound Manager
 




  
 



**Job Location:** 



 Hyderabad
 
 (On\-site)
 



  





  





**About the role:** 




  






 SmartWinnr is a revenue enablement platform for life sciences, serving pharmaceutical and medical device companies. Our customers include some of the largest life sciences organisations in the world, and most of our revenue comes from the United States.
 

  
 




  






 We are building an account\-based program across cohorts: enterprise pharmaceutical, enterprise medtech and medical devices, and the mid\-size specialty companies in both. The accounts are named and the entry points are mapped. What is missing is someone to build and run it.
 

  
 




  






 This is a senior individual contributor role. We need someone who writes the sequences and sends them, not someone who manages people who do. Team building comes later, and this person would be first in line for it.
 




  





  





  





**What you will own** 



* **The account\-based program.** 

 Each cohort with its own entry logic, buying committee and message. Building the lists, writing the sequences, running the campaigns, and reporting on what happens.
* **Event follow\-up.** 

 We attend and sponsor major industry conferences and run our own. Turning the contacts we meet there into conversations is a significant part of this role.
* **Multi\-channel orchestration.** 

 Email, LinkedIn, and paid where it helps. The buying committees we sell into run to twenty people, so single\-channel outreach does not work.
* **Working with sales.** 

 Agreeing target accounts, defining what a qualified meeting is, and making sure what we generate actually gets worked.
* **Measurement.** 

 Owning the numbers for the program and being able to defend them.



  





**What the first 90 days look like** 



* 2 to 4 cohorts live, with sequences running against named accounts.
* A repeatable event follow\-up process, running against our most recent conferences.
* A target account list built and agreed with sales, not handed to them.
* Reporting that shows which cohorts, messages and channels are producing meetings.



  





**What we are looking for** 



* Five or more years in account\-based marketing, demand generation or outbound.
* You have personally built and sent sequences. We will ask to see one and talk through why it was written that way.
* Experience with enterprise deals: long cycles, multiple stakeholders, named accounts. Volume mid\-market outbound is a different skill and does not transfer cleanly.
* You work well with sales. This role fails if sales does not trust what you send them.
* Hands\-on with the tooling. HubSpot, Apollo or equivalents. You will be in the systems yourself.



  





  





  





**Useful but not required** 





 Experience selling into life sciences, healthcare or another regulated industry. Event\-led demand generation. Familiarity with intent data and website de\-anonymisation tools.
 




  





**What this role is not** 





 It is not a people management role to begin with. It is not a brand or content role. And it is not a paid media role, though you will use paid channels where they support the program.
 




  





**Things worth knowing before you apply** 





 You will be based in India working on a United States market. Some overlap with US hours is part of the job, particularly around events and campaign launches.

Chapter members lead by designing and deploying innovative, compliant solutions that optimize regulatory workflows while maintaining the highest standards of integrity and data quality. Success in this chapter requires strategic thinking, systems thinking, data and content management expertise, an enterprise mindset, and the ability to drive continuous improvement and change leadership in a matrix environment.
   

  

 Your Opportunity
   

  

 As a Regulatory AI \& Automation Specialist within PD Regulatory Innovation and Sustainment Chapter at RSS Hyderabad, you will drive the hands\-on digital execution of regulatory operations. In this role, you will design, build, and deploy AI\-driven tools, document intelligence engines, and automated workflows that accelerate regulatory document processing, submission dossier management, and compliance tracking across global health authorities

* Collaborate with regulatory stakeholders to evaluate incoming AI/automation requests, assess technical feasibility, and help prioritize high\-value use cases for regulatory document workflows

title: POD Manager
company: Digital Mojo - Branding and Digital Marketing Agency in Hyderabad
description:
**Company Description** 





 Digital Mojo is a results\-driven digital marketing agency based in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. Since 2016, we have been helping brands scale through performance\-focused digital strategies, storytelling, lead generation, branding, and high\-impact marketing campaigns.
 




  





**Role Description** 




**We are looking for a highly ownership\-driven Pod Manager with 5\-7 years of agency experience to lead a pod of clients end\-to\-end.** 





 The Pod Manager is not a delivery coordinator. They are the business head of their pod. They own the P\&L of their accounts, drive client growth strategy, lead the pod team, and are the last point of escalation before it reaches the CEO. Every commercial decision, every retention risk, every growth opportunity within the pod runs through them.
 





 If something goes wrong in the pod, the Pod Manager owns it. If something goes right, the Pod Manager drove it.
 




**What This Role Is Not** 



* Not a senior Account Manager with a fancier title
* Not someone who only reviews reports and attends calls
* Not someone who escalates client problems to the CEO without first attempting resolution
* Not a task manager or execution coordinator
* Not someone who waits for strategy to come from above



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Pod P\&L Ownership** 



* Own the revenue, profitability, and commercial health of all accounts within the pod
* Track pod\-level billing, scope utilization, and team bandwidth against revenue
* Identify accounts where the agency is over\-servicing and course\-correct scope or pricing
* Protect agency margins by managing team allocation and delivery efficiency
* Flag accounts at commercial risk to the Founder with a clear plan, not just a problem
* Identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities and close them in coordination with the Founder
* Own monthly pod revenue targets and report against them with clarity



**2\. Client Growth Strategy** 



* Go beyond delivery. Actively think about what is next for each client's business
* Develop quarterly growth plans for key accounts covering new campaigns, channels, and opportunities
* Proactively bring ideas to clients before they ask. Be the strategic voice in every client relationship
* Identify gaps in a client's current marketing mix and recommend solutions backed by data
* Lead strategic review meetings with clients, not just performance catch\-up calls
* Connect client business goals to marketing strategy and keep both aligned as the business evolves
* Be the person a client calls when they want a fresh perspective, not just a status update



**3\. Escalation Leadership** 



* Serve as the final internal escalation point before the CEO for all pod\-level issues
* Handle client escalations, conflicts, and difficult conversations directly and with confidence
* Resolve delivery failures, team gaps, and quality issues at the pod level without pushing them upward
* Make judgment calls on scope disputes, pricing conversations, and client dissatisfaction independently
* Know when to involve the Founder and walk in with context, options, and a recommendation
* Protect the Founder's bandwidth by resolving 90% of pod issues at the pod level



**4\. Team Leadership and Pod Management** 



* Lead and manage Account Managers, Social Media Managers, Performance Marketers, and SEO Specialists within the pod
* Set clear expectations, review output quality, and hold team members accountable
* Run pod reviews, identify underperformance early, and address it directly
* Build a culture of ownership, speed, and quality within the pod
* Identify training or skill gaps in the team and flag them to the Founder
* Ensure Account Managers are handling day\-to\-day client communication so the Pod Manager can focus on strategy and commercial outcomes



**5\. Delivery and Quality Oversight** 



* Own the quality of everything that leaves the pod, from reports to creatives to campaign performance
* Ensure all client deliverables across social media, SEO, and performance marketing are on time and to standard
* Review monthly performance reports before they reach the client
* Maintain SLA adherence across the pod and flag risks before they impact delivery
* Coordinate with centralized teams including design, SEO, website, and automation for seamless execution



**6\. Performance and Campaign Strategy** 



* Understand performance marketing fundamentals including CPL, ROAS, CTR, lead quality, and funnel structure
* Review campaign performance across accounts and push for optimization when results are not meeting targets
* Work with Performance Marketers on budget planning, channel strategy, and campaign direction
* Ensure SEO, social, and paid strategies are aligned and working toward the same client business outcome
* The character in sitcom is Ross



**7\. Commercial Responsibility and Client Retention** 



* Own client retention across all pod accounts
* Conduct regular health checks on every account and know the status of each relationship at all times
* Identify at\-risk clients early and create a recovery plan before it becomes a churn situation
* Manage contract renewals, scope expansions, and pricing conversations
* Track client satisfaction and act on early signals before they escalate



  





**Key KPIs** 



* Pod Revenue vs Target
* Pod Gross Margin and Profitability
* Client Retention Rate
* Upsell and Cross\-sell Revenue Generated
* Client Satisfaction Score
* Escalations Reaching CEO (target: minimal)
* On\-Time Delivery Percentage
* Team Utilization and Bandwidth Efficiency
* Strategic Growth Plans Delivered per Quarter



  





**Required Skills and Qualifications** 



* 4\-7 years of experience in a digital marketing agency
* Proven experience managing multiple client accounts and cross\-functional teams
* Strong understanding of agency P\&L, billing, scope management, and margin control
* Deep knowledge of performance marketing, social media, SEO, and content marketing
* Experience handling client escalations and difficult commercial conversations independently
* Strong strategic thinking with the ability to build and present growth plans for clients
* Excellent English communication skills, written and verbal
* Confident in senior client\-facing discussions and presentations
* Experience with project management and reporting tools
* Ability to lead, motivate, and hold a team accountable in a fast\-paced environment



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile** 



* **Agency experience is mandatory.**
* Has managed a revenue\-bearing portfolio of clients, not just a team of people
* Has had commercial conversations with clients around scope, pricing, and renewals
* Thinks in terms of client business growth, not just campaign delivery
* Is a problem\-solver who finds solutions before escalating
* Can lead a room whether it is a team standup or a senior client strategy session



  





**Reporting Structure** 



* Reports To: Founder / CEO
* Manages: Account Managers, Social Media Managers, Performance Marketers, SEO Specialists
* Coordinates With: Creative Team, SEO Team, Website Team, Automation Team
* Escalation Authority: Final internal point before the CEO

 :

 Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field.

title: Data Centre Linux & HW Engineer, Data Center Operations
description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Data Center Operations designs, installs \& maintains the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure. We are looking for skilled Data Centre Operation Technician at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”) with a passion for technology to help us expand AWS Cloud offerings to the next level.
   

  

 To keep up with this demand on both disk and network capacity, we continue to expand our Data Centers in India. Also, our content delivery AWS service, CloudFront, has expanded its Data Centers presence by over 50% worldwide in the last 12 months and are expecting to increase by a similar number over the next 12 months. This requires talented people to build \& manage. We hope it is you! Come and work for the world’s most Customer Centric Company. The location for this job to be discussed, as there may be opportunities in several India locations.
   

  

 The Opportunity: Data Centre Operation Technician This role is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most advance data centers in the world. ADSIPL’s data centers are large\-scale high\-density centers where you will be working on changing the face of Cloud technology in India.
   

  

 A Data Centre Operations Tech at ADSIPL may be the primary point of contact for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Database Engineers, Technical Operations) and external customers (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:
   

  

 Problem Solving: Maintain a high level of system reliability by prioritizing and resolving trouble tickets efficiently, these include:
   

  

* Escalation point and technical troubleshooter for all Systems and Network hardware problems
* Deep diving into Linux server issues
* XEN service virtualization troubleshooting


 Technical: Troubleshoot technical issues on various platforms ranging from Systems through Networking to Power/Mechanical
   

  

* Remediation of physical layer outages, both Systems \& Network
* Remediation or recovery of physical power issues on racks
* Participate in Data Center power \& cooling events


 Operations: Meet 24x7 On\-Call requirements and response during shift rotations.
   

  

* Install \& configure racks of hosts in line with internal SLAs
* Triage \& resolve trouble tickets for all devices in your region
* Data Center point of contact for all High Severity issues
* Physical replacement of server and network device parts
* Ensure correct rotation of parts \& spares
* Help define metrics to increase our customer uptime
* Enforcing Security Best Practices at ADSIPL
* Interact with third party vendors \& contractors
* Contribute ideas to improve operational efficiency


**Project Management**
* Participate in and deliver on a number of high impact small to mid\-scale projects
* Participate in internal team meetings at ADSIPL for metric analysis and project status updates
* Help build the world’s largest Cloud infrastructure in India


 Mentoring: Share knowledge and help educate less technical staff on the best practices related to all break fix issues
   

  

 Hiring: Contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the ADSIPL’s hiring process/candidate interviews
   

  

**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 1\+ years of computer networking experience
* 1\+ years of Linux operating systems experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: IT Applications Engineer - Technology IT
description:
**About Signant Health** 




 At Signant Health, we help bring life\-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands\-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
 



  





 Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
 



  





 If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
 



  





**About The Role** 




 The
 **IT Applications Engineer** 
 is a generalist engineering and support role responsible for the day\-to\-day administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of Signant Health's core business applications. The role carries particular depth in NetSuite, Microsoft 365, Box, and Atlassian (Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence), while also supporting the broader enterprise application portfolio as needed.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on, individual\-contributor role that blends technical engineering — configuration, scripting, integrations, automations, and upgrades — with day\-to\-day operational support — tickets, incidents, and user requests. The IT Applications Engineer is a trusted first\- and second\-line point of contact for application issues, and is equally comfortable delivering enhancements and automations that improve reliability and reduce manual effort across the application landscape. Where the IT Application Operations Manager sets direction and leads the team, this role does the technical and support work directly, partnering closely with the Service Operations, Infrastructure Operations, and Security Operations teams.
 



  





**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES \- Function** 



* Application Administration \& Configuration — Own day\-to\-day administration and configuration of NetSuite, Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, Entra ID), Box, and Atlassian (Jira, JSM, Confluence), plus other assigned enterprise applications, including user provisioning, permissions, and platform settings.
* Technical Support \& Incident Resolution — Act as a key point of escalation for tier 2/3 application support tickets, diagnosing and resolving issues across the supported application stack and coordinating with vendors and other IT teams as needed.
* Engineering \& Customization — Build and maintain customizations to meet business requirements — including SuiteScript/SuiteFlow (NetSuite), Power Automate/Graph API automations (Microsoft 365\), workflow and scripting configuration (Atlassian), and equivalent customizations for other supported applications.
* Integrations \& Automation — Develop and support integrations between applications using APIs, webhooks, and low\-code/iPaaS tooling, building automations that reduce manual effort and improve reliability.
* Change, Release \& Patch Management — Plan, test, and execute upgrades, patches, and configuration changes across supported applications, minimizing disruption to the business.
* Security \& Compliance — Apply access control, licensing, and data\-handling practices aligned with company security policy and relevant regulatory and quality requirements.
* Monitoring \& Continuous Improvement — Monitor application health, usage, and performance; proactively identify issues and recommend and implement improvements.
* Vendor \& Stakeholder Coordination — Liaise with software vendors and business stakeholders on support cases, licensing, and roadmap requests for supported platforms.
* Documentation \& Knowledge Sharing — Maintain runbooks, configuration standards, and knowledge base articles; participate in knowledge transfer and cross\-training to build coverage across the application portfolio.
* AI \& Automation Adoption — Identify and pilot opportunities to apply AI\-assisted tooling, agents, and low\-code automation to improve support efficiency and business workflows.
* Roadmap Support — Contribute to application\-specific roadmaps for releases, improvements, and vendor\-provided enhancements, in partnership with the IT Application Operations Manager.



  





**Knowledge, Skills \& Attributes** 




**Essential:** 



* NetSuite — Administration and configuration; SuiteScript 2\.x and SuiteFlow; saved searches/SuiteAnalytics; SuiteTalk and REST API integrations.
* Microsoft 365 — Administration of Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, and Entra ID (Azure AD); familiarity with Intune and the Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps).
* Box — Content management administration, permissions and governance, and API\-based integrations.
* Atlassian — Administration and configuration of Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence, including workflow design and scripting (e.g., ScriptRunner).
* APIs \& Integrations — Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, and low\-code/iPaaS tools (e.g., Power Automate, N8N, Boomi) for connecting applications.
* Scripting \& Automation — Proficiency in at least one scripting language (JavaScript, PowerShell, or Python) for customization, troubleshooting, and automation.
* Application Lifecycle Management — Experience with patching, upgrades, testing, and change management for SaaS/cloud and on\-premise applications.
* Security \& Compliance Awareness — Understanding of access management, data protection, and relevant compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GxP where applicable).
* ITSM \& Monitoring Tools — Familiarity with ticketing/ITSM tooling (e.g., Jira Service Management) and application monitoring/observability tools.



  





**Desirable:** 



* Clear and effective communication with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills across competing priorities.
* Ability to document clearly and concisely for varied audiences.
* Adaptability and resilience amid changing priorities and technologies.
* Effective cross\-team collaboration with Infrastructure, Security, Automation, and Business Analyst teams.



  





**Why Signant Health?** 




 At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
 



  





 We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
 



  





 If you are looking for purpose\-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
 



  





 At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all candidates are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.
 



  





 Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third\-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

title: Entrepreneur in Residence - Product (Travel)
description:
**Why are we building Nuclei?**
 Before we started Nuclei, we listed down a few guiding principles. These were essentially our learning from previous startups/companies:
   

  

* Think big, think global, and not limit ourselves only to India.
* Build a company. We wanted to be sustainable from day 1 and build a profitable business. This does not mean that we compromise on growth, but we most definitely avoid unsustainable growth.
* Build for the long term, not flip it in a few years.
* And most importantly, we wanted to change the perception about India, from being a back\-office/outsourcing destination, to a product destination.


 All the above points came together to form Nuclei's vision — "To build a well respected global product company." At Nuclei, we are building innovative products that help enterprises increase customer engagement and build deeper relationships with their customers, by offering value\-added services like travel and gifting ecosystems.
   

  

**About This Role**
 As part of this vision, we're building a full travel ecosystem including Flights, Hotels, and Experiences, for one of the largest telecom operators in Europe, and expanding this proposition across multiple markets in Europe. This particular EIR seat sits within that travel team. You'll take ownership of category features and initiatives from first identifying the problem through to launch and iteration, working closely with the rest of the product, design, and engineering team.
   

  

**Please note: This is a remote job.**
**Who should apply?**
* Someone with 3 to 5 years of product building experience
* We're looking for product builders who can go 0→1 as well as 1→10 — building something new, and then scaling it through product\-led growth, journey optimization, and continuous iteration. It's not just build and forget.
* Prior experience in a startup would be preferred
* Founder or entrepreneurial experience is strongly preferred for this role — whether that's starting a company, being an early team member somewhere, or building a meaningful project of your own from scratch
* We have a strong preference for candidates with prior experience in travel, marketplace, or high\-volume consumer products


**Who are Product Builders?**
* Product Builders don't get hassled by chaos and constant change, they actually enjoy it and thrive in it. They understand that this is necessary for success.
* Product Builders work on building products from scratch (0 to 1\).
* Product Builders have a high bias for action.
* Product Builders think from first principles.


**What will you do?**
* Own category features and initiatives within our Flights, Hotels, and Experiences, product from problem definition through to launch and iteration.
* Translate customer problems and business inputs into clear requirements and prototypes. Scope and prioritize your own work based on customer and business impact.
* Work closely with the engineers, designers, and analysts who care deeply about their product. Should be able to quickly build rapport with them.
* Understand the tech that goes behind the product like data flow among systems, tech bottlenecks, and RCAs when things break.
* Analyze user behavior, funnel metrics, and feedback to identify opportunities for improvement, and drive product\-led growth initiatives \- journey optimization, activation, retention \- to keep pushing your category forward.
* Plan your features in smaller sprints while staying aware of the larger vision for the travel product and hold a high bar for quality. We're building a world\-class consumer product, so both the customer journey and the underlying tech need to be top\-notch.

title: Associate Staff Digital Identity Architect [T500-29459]
description:
**Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients.** 




**Who are we:** 




 Core Insurance Platforms (CIP) is Zurich’s global capability responsible for building, running, and evolving core insurance technology. We set a unified, scalable operating model—covering governance, standards, architecture, service delivery, and reuse—so our business units can deliver at speed and scale.
 



 CIP is the strategic steward of Zurich’s Guidewire ecosystem, aligning platform roadmaps to business strategy while driving stability, modernization, reduced supplier dependency, and long term cost efficiency.
 



 India delivery center is one of our global delivery and capability hub. We bring together experts in AI, engineering, analysis, quality, and architecture to deliver product \& process solutions, application run services, change and transformation initiatives, and centralized platform services across both on prem and Guidewire Cloud environments. **Digital Identity (DI) Architect**

 This role requires a strong blend of technical architecture expertise, stakeholder management, delivery leadership, and the ability to leverage AI\-enabled capabilities to accelerate solution design, implementation, operations, and continuous improvement.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Architecture \& Strategy:** 



* Define and maintain the target\-state Digital Identity architecture aligned with Zurich's global security, governance, and Zero Trust strategy.
* **Design scalable, secure, and cost\-effective identity governance and workforce access management solutions across workforce, contractor, and partner populations.**
* Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards, cybersecurity requirements, compliance frameworks, and business objectives.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend innovative identity capabilities that improve security, user experience, and operational efficiency.
* **Lead architecture decisions primarily across Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Identity Lifecycle Management, Access Management, Authentication, Authorization, and Identity Analytics, while maintaining awareness of adjacent identity domains.**



  





**Solution Delivery \& Execution:** 



* Translate business requirements into implementable architecture roadmaps and technical designs.
* Collaborate with engineering teams, vendors, project managers, and business stakeholders to deliver solutions according to agreed timelines and budgets.
* Identify dependencies, risks, and technical constraints early and drive resolution.
* Provide end\-to\-end technical leadership throughout the project lifecycle from concept through production deployment.
* Ensure architecture decisions balance security, user experience, operational supportability, and total cost of ownership.



  





**Stakeholder \& Collaboration Leadership:** 



* Act as the primary technical liaison across business units, security teams, platform teams, infrastructure teams, vendors, and project sponsors.
* Facilitate alignment across multiple stakeholders and drive consensus on architecture decisions.
* Present technical solutions, risks, trade\-offs, and recommendations to senior leadership and governance forums.
* Coordinate across global and regional teams to ensure successful program execution.



  





**AI\-First Responsibilities:** 



* Champion Zurich's AI First strategy by embedding AI capabilities across architecture, engineering, operations, and support functions.
* Utilize AI\-assisted tools to accelerate solution design, documentation, testing, troubleshooting, reporting, and operational analysis.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive IAM activities through AI, intelligent workflows, and orchestration platforms.
* Define AI\-enabled architecture patterns that improve identity governance, access risk analysis, certification campaigns, and operational support.
* Promote responsible AI adoption aligned with Zurich governance, security, privacy, and ethical standards.
* **Drive adoption of AI\-enabled engineering and delivery practices that improve productivity, quality, and operational efficiency across the Digital Identity organization.**



  





**Operational Excellence:** 



* Drive simplification and standardization through reuse of enterprise platforms and services.
* Ensure solutions are resilient, supportable, auditable, and compliant with regulatory requirements.
* Support major incident reviews, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Contribute to roadmap planning, platform modernization, and transformation initiatives.



  





**Required Qualifications:** 




**Experience:** 



* 10\+ years of experience in Identity and Access Management, Cybersecurity, or Enterprise Architecture.
* 5\+ years of experience designing and implementing large\-scale IAM solutions.
* Demonstrated experience leading global identity transformation programs.
* Experience working with senior business stakeholders, security teams, vendors, and technology leadership.
* **Demonstrated experience delivering Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) programs at enterprise scale.**
* **Experience defining and implementing identity governance, certification, lifecycle management, and access control processes in complex organizations.**



  





**Technical Expertise:** 




**Deep expertise in Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), including:** 



* **SailPoint IdentityIQ and/or SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC)**
* Identity Governance and Administration (IGA)
* Access Certifications and Compliance Controls
* Identity Lifecycle Management
* **RBAC, Role Engineering, and Identity Governance Operating Models**
* API\-based integrations and cloud identity architectures



  





**Strong experience with workforce access management technologies, including:** 



* Okta
* Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
* MFA, SSO, Federation (SAML, OIDC, OAuth)



  





**Broad architectural understanding of:** 



* Active Directory / LDAP
* **Directory Services and cloud identity platforms**
* **Adjacent identity capabilities such as Privileged Access Management (PAM) and Identity Analytics**



  





**AI \& Automation Skills:** 



* Experience leveraging Generative AI and AI\-assisted engineering tools.
* Understanding of AI governance, security, and responsible AI practices.
* Experience applying AI to automate operational processes, reporting, testing, support, or engineering activities.
* Ability to assess and recommend AI\-enabled solutions that deliver measurable business value.



  





**Leadership Competencies:** 



* Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.
* Exceptional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to influence without direct authority.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Results\-oriented with strong execution focus.
* Ability to balance innovation, risk, cost, and delivery timelines.
* Continuous improvement and AI\-first mindset.



  





**Success Measures:** 



* Successful delivery of Digital Identity initiatives within agreed timelines and budgets.
* Increased automation and AI adoption across IAM processes.
* Reduction in operational effort through AI\-assisted capabilities.
* Improved security, compliance, and audit outcomes.
* Increased reuse of enterprise services and standardized architecture patterns.
* Enhanced stakeholder satisfaction and business value delivery.
* **Successful delivery of IGA modernization initiatives, including lifecycle governance, certification, and access governance capabilities.**



  





**Preferred Certifications:**

At the same time, you’ll mentor the engineers around you, raise the bar on code quality, and help build an engineering culture that people are proud to be part of.

*“If you want your next role to be the one where you point at a system and say ‘I designed that, and it’s still standing under real load’ — this is that role.”* 




  





**Tech Stack**

 Java 17\+, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, SQL, REST APIs, Microservices
 



**Frontend**

 Hyderabad

 : 8\+ years

 Work From Office, 5 days a week

 Full\-Time
