title: Supervisor - Document Intelligence
description:
**About This Role**
 GHX is standing up a new Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HiTL) operations team in Hyderabad to support its ADM (Automated Document Management) platform — an AI\-powered document processing system replacing legacy UiPath automation for GFax North America. The platform processes over 2\.2 million Purchase Orders per year and targets a 75–85% fully\-automated (touchless) rate. The team handles every document the AI cannot process autonomously.
   

  

 The Operations Supervisor is building this team from zero and is accountable for everything within it: throughput, field accuracy, team development, day\-to\-day operations management, and real\-time coordination with GHX Engineering and Product teams in the United States. This is a high\-visibility, inaugural role — the team’s accuracy and throughput directly determine the speed and confidence with which GHX can expand the ADM platform beyond GFax North America.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**People** 
**\& Performance Management — 70%**
* Directly supervise 15\-20 Document Review Specialists; own rostering across rotational shifts, attendance tracking, and queue capacity planning against daily document volume
* Manage operations SLA – TAT, Quality, along with people metrics
* Own day\-to\-day operations management: shift rosters and week\-offs, leave planning, planned \& unplanned shrinkage, absenteeism control, and real\-time reallocation of staffing to protect SLAs \& operations performance metrics
* Set and communicate daily, weekly, and monthly throughput, AHT, and accuracy targets; monitor individual and team performance against SLA and productivity standards
* Participate in and present at weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews (WBR / MBR / QBR) — performance against KPIs, root\-cause analysis of misses, and committed corrective actions
* Own the full performance cycle for direct reports, including goal setting, mid\-year and annual appraisals, with documented performance ratings, development plans, and calibration against peer supervisors
* Conduct weekly 1:1s and team calibration sessions; coach on accuracy, field interpretation, and escalation judgment
* Manage performance improvement plans for specialists not meeting accuracy, AHT, or throughput standards; drive engagement and retention to control attrition
* Participate in hiring, onboarding, and training of new team members; maintain a bench and cross\-skilling plan to cover leave and attrition
* Proactively escalate capacity gaps and SLA risk to GHX US management before they impact queue throughput


**Quality Assurance \& Continuous Improvement— 20%**
* Identify patterns in AI extraction errors that indicate model weaknesses (e.g., systematic misread of specific templates); surface findings as structured product feedback to GHX Engineering
* Develop and maintain team SOPs, job aids, audit checklists, and the GHX field\-standards reference guide
* Recommend tool and process improvements to reduce per\-document review time (AHT) and improving accuracy
* Contribute to the ADM continuous improvement cycle by translating on\-the\-ground operational insight into prioritized product feedback
* Own team field accuracy at or above 99% for mandatory (Tier 1\) fields; track and report accuracy, throughput, and SLA attainment in a weekly dashboard
* Conduct periodical audits of each team member's work on a defined cadence (daily sampling, weekly per\-specialist audit, and monthly deep\-dive) with documented findings, scores, and feedback logged per specialist
* Conduct structured quality audits — sampled review of completed documents across team members — to detect systematic errors and training gaps
* Run audit\-driven coaching loops: convert audit findings into individual feedback, refresher training, and re\-audit to confirm the correction held
* Maintain and execute the escalation protocol for documents that cannot be resolved by specialists (damaged images, ambiguous formatting, novel document types)
* Own the error log: categorize error types, track frequency and trend, deliver structured feedback to GHX Engineering as actionable product input


**Cross\-Functional Coordination — 10%**
* Serve as the primary GHXI point of contact for GHX US Product and Engineering on Document Queue status, error patterns, and team capacity
* Participate in ADM platform update reviews; translate tool changes into updated team procedures and retraining plans before each release
* Deliver clear, data\-backed written status updates to US stakeholders; communicate GHX US expectations and standards to the Hyderabad team
* Coordinate with GHXI local management on workspace, IT, HR, compliance, rostering, transport, and facilities matters


**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS OWNED BY THIS ROLE**
 The Supervisor Is Accountable For The Standard Operational KPI Set Of a Production Contact\-center / Transaction\-processing Environment, Reported In The Weekly Dashboard And Reviewed In WBR, And MBR, Forums
   

  

* Productivity \& throughput: documents processed per specialist per hour, daily/weekly volume completed
* AHT (Average Handling Time) and average review time per document type
* SLA / TAT attainment: % of documents completed within committed turnaround; queue aging and backlog carried over
* Service level and queue wait for real\-time\-facing work; abandonment rate where applicable
* Quality: field\-level accuracy (Tier 1 ≥ 99%), audit score per specialist, critical vs. non\-critical error rate, rework %, first\-pass yield, FCR (First Contact / First Pass Resolution)
* Occupancy and utilization; schedule adherence and conformance
* Shrinkage — planned (leave, training, meetings, breaks) and unplanned (unscheduled absence, late logins, system downtime)
* Absenteeism — planned and unplanned — and attrition (voluntary, involuntary, and early\-life attrition)
* Forecast vs. actual volume accuracy and staffing variance (required vs. rostered vs. actual)
* Escalation rate, reopen rate, and aging of escalated or exception items
* Customer\-impacting measures: CSAT / internal stakeholder satisfaction, NPS where measured, and downstream EDI failure or defect leakage rate
* Cost per transaction and productivity per FTE against the operating plan
* Training and certification: nesting graduation rate, time\-to\-proficiency for new hires, cross\-skilling coverage %


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree required; postgraduate qualification in Operations, Business Administration, or a related field preferred
* Minimum 6 years of total experience in BPO, KPO, shared services in a document processing operations
* Minimum 2 years in a confirmed Supervisory or Team lead role with accountability for 10 or more staff
* Demonstrated understanding \& ownership of core operational KPIs — SLA, AHT, quality/accuracy, shrinkage, absenteeism, and attrition — in a production environment
* Experience running periodical quality audits and sample\-based audit methodologies, with documented feedback and coaching loops
* Experience in owning the people\-management cycle: rostering, leave and shrinkage planning, mid\-year and annual appraisals, and performance improvement plans
* Experience in preparing for and presenting in weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews
* Strong business English — written and verbal — for regular written and video communication with stakeholders
* Comfortable building and presenting weekly operational reports (throughput, AHT, accuracy trend, error categories) in Excel or Google Sheets
* Demonstrated ability to write clear SOPs, job aids, and team process guides from scratch
* Willing and able to work rotational shifts, including US Mountain Time night rotations, on\-site 5 days per week


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior exposure to AI\-augmented operations: annotation platforms, RLHF review queues, AI quality assurance, or document intelligence tools
* Experience coordinating with US\-based counterparts across time zones on a regular basis
* Background in procurement or supply chain document processing (Purchase Orders, invoices, order acknowledgements)
* Understanding of how AI confidence scoring works and the relationship between human corrections and model retraining
* Workforce management exposure — forecasting, capacity planning, and roster optimisation experience
* Six Sigma, Lean, or equivalent process improvement certification
* Greenfield experience — prior role that required standing up a new team or operations function with minimal existing infrastructure


**WORKING CONDITIONS**
**Location:** 
 GHX India (GHXI) office, Hyderabad, Telangana — on\-site, 5 days per week;
 ***no remote or hybrid option***
**Shift:** 
 Rotational shifts on a 24x7 roster, including night rotations aligned to US Mountain Time (\~8:30 PM–4:30 AM IST (MDT) / \~9:30 PM–5:30 AM IST (MST)); week\-offs rotate with the roster
   

  

**US Coordination:** 
 Regular video calls with GHX US Engineering, Product, and Director, Automation \& Scalability (functional line)
   

  

**GHX: It's the way you do business in healthcare**
 Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes.
   

  

 GHX is a healthcare business and data automation company, empowering healthcare organizations to enable better patient care and maximize industry savings using our world class cloud\-based supply chain technology exchange platform, solutions, analytics and services. We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe \- who rely on smart, secure healthcare\-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions.
   

  

 It is our passion and vision for a more operationally efficient healthcare supply chain, helping organizations reduce \- not shift \- the cost of doing business, paving the way to delivering patient care more effectively. Together we take more than a billion dollars out of the cost of delivering healthcare every year. GHX is privately owned, operates in the United States, Canada and Europe, and employs more than 1000 people worldwide. Our corporate headquarters is in Colorado, with additional offices in Europe.

 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Content Creation \& Copywriting
 



  





 \* Research and develop original content ideas aligned with AevumX’s brand and business objectives.

 \* Develop and maintain weekly and monthly content calendars.

 \* Adapt messaging and creative formats to suit each platform rather than simply reposting identical content.
 



 \* Monitor comments, messages, mentions, and audience engagement.

 Reels \& Video Content

 \* Create, record, coordinate, and edit video content when required.
 



 \* Add captions, graphics, transitions, audio, branding, and other creative elements.

 Design \& Brand Management

title: Senior Service Desk Analyst
description:
**Are you ready to shape the future of data?** 



  


 Matillion is the company behind Maia, the AI Data Automation platform. 
 


  


 In the AI economy, demand for data is exploding. Manual data engineering can’t keep up. Maia fixes that by combining 15 years of data expertise with agentic AI to eliminate the manual work that slows data teams down. Organisations like Cisco, DocuSign, and Slack are already using it to deliver real business impact, faster.
 


  


 We started in Manchester and now we’re global \- with teams across the UK, US and India.
 


  


 We are driven, curious, energetic people who move fast, think big and hold ourselves to a high standard. We’re here to make a dent in the universe bigger than ourselves. And we’re looking for people who want to be part of it.
 


  





  




 Role Purpose
   


  


 As an IT Service Desk Analyst in our Hyderabad office, you will be the primary point of contact for our US\-based team during their business hours, while also picking up and resolving support tickets raised by our global workforce.
 **Please note: this role covers US business hours, which means working night shifts from our Hyderabad office.** 
 This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of AI\-driven support, collaborating with Felix — our AI virtual teammate — to maintain a high\-velocity, high\-quality service queue.
 


  


 Your team will leverage advanced AI tools like Claude, Gemini and n8n to automate routine workflows and triage incidents, allowing you to focus your expertise on resolving technical challenges across Windows, macOS, and our SaaS ecosystem. You will operate with significant autonomy as the sole Service Desk analyst on shift, backed by a global IT network across the UK and India, ensuring seamless handovers and collaborative problem\-solving.
 


  


 We are seeking a proactive professional who takes complete ownership of the user experience, blending human technical intuition with AI efficiency to deliver world\-class support in a fast\-paced, innovative environment.
 


  






  




**What You Will Be Doing** 
  


**Ticket Ownership \& Technical Support:** 
 Be the primary point of contact for the Service Desk during US hours, triaging and independently troubleshooting hardware, software, network, and application issues across Windows and macOS — supporting our global workforce, with a focus on the US\-based team during your shift.
 


  


**Partnering with Felix:** 
 Work alongside Felix, our AI virtual Service Desk teammate, picking up tickets it can't fully resolve and using its triage and summaries to work efficiently. Continuously look for opportunities to improve automation and self\-service.
 


  


**SLA Management \& Escalation:** 
 Own tickets end\-to\-end in the ITSM system, working to ITIL/ITSM best practice and meeting SLA targets, escalating to the wider IT team in the UK — or to third\-line specialists and external vendors — only where genuinely necessary, with full context handed over.
 


  


**Identity \& Endpoint Management:** 
 Execute secure user provisioning and device lifecycle management using Okta, Jamf, and Microsoft Intune to maintain fleet compliance and security integrity.
 


  


**SaaS Platform Administration:** 
 Administer core SaaS platforms — including Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and the Atlassian suite (Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence) — managing users, access, configuration, and licensing.
 


  


**Onboarding \& Offboarding:** 
 Work closely with PeopleOps to onboard and offboard users as they join or leave the organisation, ensuring provisioning and de\-provisioning is completed accurately and on time.
 


  


**AI \& Automation Tooling:** 
 Use AI assistants such as Claude and Gemini, and automation platforms such as n8n, to speed up triage, draft responses, summarise incidents, and automate repetitive workflows; suggest new areas where automation could reduce manual effort.
 


  


**Cross\-Timezone Handover \& Documentation:** 
 Maintain clear, accurate handover notes for the wider IT Service Desk team covering open escalations, overnight developments, and anything requiring follow\-up; maintain and improve knowledge base articles and documentation.
 


  


**Change \& Project Support:** 
 Take ownership of smaller changes and contribute to larger IT projects — system upgrades, deployments, and migrations — including testing, documentation, and rollout.
 


  


  




**What We Are Looking For** 
  

 Technical / Role Specific — Essential
   


 2–4 years' experience in a 2nd line or standalone IT support role, with a track record of resolving complex issues independently rather than simply triaging them.
 


  


 Strong working knowledge of both Windows and macOS environments.
 


  


 Hands\-on experience administering an identity provider (e.g. Okta or similar) and an MDM platform (e.g. Jamf, Intune).
 


  


 Comfortable working within ITIL/ITSM frameworks and using a ticketing system such as Jira Service Management, with a genuine understanding of SLAs and the ability to work effectively within them.
 


  


 Practical experience with core SaaS platforms: Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and the Atlassian suite.
 


  


 Comfortable using AI assistants (e.g. Claude, Gemini) as part of daily troubleshooting, documentation, and communication, and genuinely enthusiastic about working alongside an AI virtual teammate (Felix) rather than seeing it as a threat.
 


  


 A self\-starter who can review and improve business processes, take ownership of IT initiatives, and prioritise workload based on urgency and impact.
 


  


  




**Desirable** 
  


 Experience with Confluence for documentation and knowledge base management.
 


  


 Exposure to workflow automation tooling such as n8n, or a strong enthusiasm to learn it, to build or improve automations.
 


  


 Experience with endpoint security / EDR tooling (e.g. CrowdStrike).
 


  


 Experience working in a SaaS\-first, multi\-office, or globally distributed organisation, including handing over work across time zones.
 


  


 Experience with software licence audits and vendor management.
 


  


 Familiarity with formal change management processes and change tickets.
 


  


  




**Personal Capabilities Required** 
  


 This role covers US business hours (night shift) and is based in our Hyderabad office.
 


  


 Comfortable working with a high degree of autonomy as the only Service Desk analyst on shift, with the judgement to know when to handle something yourself and when to escalate to the wider IT team in the UK, rather than relying on a local backup.
 


  


 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical detail for non\-technical stakeholders and write clear handover notes for colleagues in other time zones.
 


  


 A genuine sense of ownership — proactively drives tickets and projects to resolution rather than waiting to be told what to do.
 


  


 Ability to manage your own workload, prioritise effectively and stay organised under pressure.
 


  


 The business invests significantly in personal development; a strong desire to use these opportunities and turn new skills into continual service improvement is important to success.
 


  





  




  


  


**More about Matillion** 



  


  
 


  


 We operate a flexible working culture that promotes work\-life balance, with benefits including:

* 27 days paid time off
  
* 12 days of Company Holiday
  
* 5 days paid volunteering leave

**Your Safety** 



  


  
 


  


 Matillion recruiters will only contact you from @matillion.com email addresses. We occasionally work with trusted recruiting partners; they will always tell you they are working on our behalf. We will never ask for money, fees, or bank details at any point in the hiring process. If something feels off, trust that instinct. Don't click any links. Go straight to

title: Generalist Trainer
description:
**Role Summary** 




 You will train everyone at NIAT except the instructors — program ops, success coaches, curriculum and assessment, and the specialist cluster. That is 16 of our 40 cohorts. You teach the common NIAT standard first, then the part that is specific to each role. You work remotely from Hyderabad. You do not travel to campuses to teach. The one thing only you can do: you decide what is actually wrong, and you decide whether it got fixed. That is the value of this seat. You talk to people, you listen to recorded calls, you read tickets and audit data, and you work out the real problem. You then decide the topic and exactly what the training must cover, and you hand that brief to the Content Creator. They decide how it is taught. You teach the sessions. Thirty days later you go back and say whether people work differently. If they do not, you start again. Nobody else in the team makes those two calls. The hardest part of this job is range. A program ops person and a success coach need very different things from you, sometimes in the same week, and neither one will sit through a session built for the other.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 ● Find the real gap first — Before you design anything, work out what people actually cannot do. Sit in classes, listen to recorded calls, read tickets, look at audit tool output, and talk to the people doing the job and the people who manage them. Write down the gap you found and why. Do not design from a brief or from what someone said in a meeting.
 



 ● Decide the topic and write the brief — Decide what the training must cover, role by role. Write it down for the Content Creator: the problem, the topic, what a person must be able to do at the end, and the real situations it must use. You decide what. They decide how.
 



 ● Deliver the 5 trainer\-led hours — Run 5 hours a month for your cohorts, live and remote: the common NIAT standard first, then the role track.
 



 ● Get managers ready for the 2 practice hours — Managers run 2 hours a month of practice with their own teams, using real cases from their own work. You write the case pack, brief the managers, and check that it actually happened.
 



 ● Set up the 1 self\-paced hour — One module a month per person, matched to that person's own gap. You set the rules for your cohorts and check who finished.
 



 ● Test people after the training — After each module, check whether the person can now do the thing. Attendance is not a pass. Anyone who does not clear the check gets another round.
 



 ● Go back weeks later and say whether it worked — About 30 days after training, look at the real work again — recordings, tickets, audit output — and talk to the managers. Say plainly what changed and where nothing changed. If nothing changed, go back in. Your job is not over when the session ends.
 



 ● Take part in the impact review — Sit in the impact meetings each cycle. You are the person who says whether the training was worth the hours.
 



 ● Decide what to do nex
 



 platform. Reading them and deciding the next move is your call, not theirs.
 



 ● Write the playbooks — Turn what works into simple written steps, one set per role, so it lasts after your call ends.
 



 ● Plan inside the delivery limit — A trainer can teach about 5 hours a day, roughly 120 hours a month. Build your plan inside that. This limit does not cover time spent building content, writing assessments or doing impact work.
 



 ● Use AI where it helps — Use it where it saves real time, such as pulling common themes out of recordings or writing a first version of a case. Not everywhere.
 



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




 ● Has stood in front of a room of adults every week, and can describe how they handled the group that did not want to be there.
 



 ● Has run sessions over video to people who were not in the room, and can say what they did to keep that group with them.
 



 ● Has trained more than one kind of team — say a support team and an operations team — and can say how they changed the session for each.
 



 ● Has gone back after a training to find out what changed on the job, and can say what they found, including where it did not work.
 



 ● Has worked out what was going wrong by looking at records, tickets or recordings, instead of waiting to be told.
 



 ● Has changed their own material after feedback from the ground, and can point to what they cut.
 



 ● Has handled a hard conversation with a parent or a student themselves, or has trained the people who do.
 



 Education: Graduate. No specific degree required.
 



 Languages: English is a must for all three. Across the three seats: one Telugu, one Hindi, one English\-only. See the language note below.
 



 Number of seats: 3
 



  





**Good to Have** 




 ● Has run train\-the\-trainer sessions and helped certify other trainers.
 



 ● Has worked with an LMS and with recorded content, not only live sessions.
 



 ● Has coached managers to run their own team sessions.
 



  





**Growth Path** 




 Next designation: Senior Trainer (Level 2\). You earn it when your departments run your pack themselves and it still works with you out of the room — the 30\-day check holds for three cycles in a row.

title: Parent Relationship Senior Manager
description:
**Parent Relationship Senior Manager**




***Zonal (North \& West, or South \& East) · Reports to the Parent Relationship Head***




  





**Function:** 
 Parent Relationship Management
 



**Reports into:** 
 Parent Relationship Head
 



**Zone owned:** 
 North \& West, or South \& East (one Senior Manager per zone)
 



**Direct reports:** 
 All Parent Relationship Managers across the zone's campuses
 



**Experience:** 
 8–10 years overall, incl. 2–3\+ years in people management
 



**Education:** 
 Graduate; MBA / relevant PG preferred, not mandatory
 



  





**Role Summary**




  





 The Parent Relationship Senior Manager owns parent trust and engagement across every campus in a zone. This is a people\-management role first, and — because parent conversations can be sensitive and emotionally charged — it calls for real maturity too: you will hire, ramp, coach, and review a bench of Parent Relationship Managers, hold the line on the 1:300 mapping ratio as the zone grows, and act as the second\-level escalation point for the harder, trust\-critical conversations a Manager can't close alone.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**



* **Zonal ownership** 
 — be accountable for parent trust and NPS across every campus in the zone — not any single campus, all of them
* **People management** 
 — hire, ramp, coach, and review Parent Relationship Managers in the zone, adding headcount as campuses or batch sizes grow so the 1:300 ratio holds
* **Escalation** 
 — pick up anything a Manager can't close on their own — especially sensitive or trust\-critical conversations — and coach Managers on how those are handled
* **Trust oversight** 
 — sample how cases were handled — the tone and the follow\-through, not just closure speed — and hold the expectation\-management standard, not only the SLA
* **Reporting** 
 — consolidate every campus dashboard in the zone into one view, report it to the Parent Relationship Head, and coordinate with Program Ops and the Student Relationship function



  





**What Success Looks Like — Key Result Areas** 




  





**Zonal parent trust / NPS:** 
 NPS rolled up across all campuses in the zone
 



**2nd\-level escalation TAT:** 
 Time to close issues escalated past the Manager
 



**SLA adherence across zone:** 
 % of managers' concerns closed within SLA
 



**Ratio adherence:** 
 Managers in zone operating at or near 1:300
 



**Manager stability:** 
 Retention of Parent Relationship Managers in the zone
 



  





***Note: Targets and review cadence for each KRA are being finalised by the function.***




  





**Who We're Looking For**



* 8–10 years of total experience, with demonstrated people management — has directly managed a team of 5 or more
* Background in a relationship\-, trust\-, or service\-delivery function, ideally one involving sensitive or emotionally\-charged conversations
* Strong escalation handling — stays calm, decisive, and empathetic when an issue is urgent, emotional, or high\-visibility
* A track record of hiring and coaching a frontline team on tone and judgment, not just supervising for numbers
* Comfortable owning a number (trust/NPS, SLA adherence, retention) and reporting on it upward with a plan, not just a status
* Willing to travel across campuses within the zone



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience running distributed or multi\-location teams
* Exposure to trust\-building, expectation\-management, or escalation frameworks in a client\- or family\-facing context

With simple, natural language search and AI, anyone can ask questions, discover insights, and act with confidence. Unlike legacy tools that sacrifice performance for complexity, ThoughtSpot is intuitively designed for every business user while being built to handle the most complex, large\-scale data, wherever it resides. This unique combination of speed and simplicity is why enterprise leaders trust ThoughtSpot to transform decision\-making into a truly data\-driven culture.
   

  

 At ThoughtSpot, we’re a curious, data\-driven bunch. We believe the world works better when everyone has access to facts. That’s why we build products that make asking and answering data questions as natural as having a conversation.
   

  

**Mandatory And Required Skills For All ThoughtSpot Roles**
 Spotters are expected to demonstrate AI literacy and workflow integration to include to ability to:
   

  

* Comfortably and confidently integrate artificial intelligence into their daily workflow to increase productivity and quality.
* Hands\-on experience to leverage AI tools (industry\-leading LLMs) to increase productivity, automate routine tasks, and improve work quality.
* Speak to the experience of using AI for research, content creation, and document summarization while maintaining ownership of judgment and final decisions.
* Write effective prompts to get the most accurate and creative results from AI tools.


 Spotters are expected to exemplify these key traits and AI Mindset:
   

  

* Curiosity in exploring new AI tools
* Adaptability to quickly learn and implement new, emerging AI technologies
* Critical thinking to know when to identify when AI should be used versus when human judgement is necessary


 This combination of curiosity, adaptability, and discernment defines the AI mindset, and it’s required for every role at ThoughtSpot.
   

  

****AI Mindset for All Spotters****
 At ThoughtSpot, we believe AI is a necessary and essential part of how we work. Every role, across every team, is expected to be fluent and comfortable with using AI to do their best work.
   

  

 All Spotters are expected to experiment with ThoughtSpot’s AI tools (like Spotter and SpotterViz) and leading industry LLMs to streamline workflows, enhance output, and uncover new insights. Whether drafting content, analyzing data, or summarizing documents, AI is a daily partner. We value curiosity, openness to learning, and thoughtful application of AI to create real value. Training and resources are provided so every Spotter can confidently create with AI.
   

  

****ThoughtSpot for All****
 At ThoughtSpot, diverse teams build better products. Complex data problems need many perspectives, not just one. We welcome different backgrounds, identities, and experiences, and we work to create a place where everyone can be themselves and do their best work. If this role excites you and you believe you’re a strong match, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

****What Makes ThoughtSpot a Great Place to Work?****
 ThoughtSpot is the Agentic Analytics Platform that empowers every enterprise to transform insights into action, on a mission to make the world more fact driven. We hire people with unique identities, backgrounds, and perspectives \- this balance\-for\-the\-better philosophy is key to our success. When paired with our culture of Trust, Customer Obsession, Innovation and Intensity, ThoughtSpot cultivates a respectful culture that pushes norms to create world\-class products. **Location:** 
 Hyderabad, India
 



**Job Type:** 
 Fulltime
 



  





**Role Purpose** 




 The Business Transformation Consultant will help drive the VMNext enterprise transformation initiative by partnering with business leaders and SMEs across ValueMomentum to understand, document, and reimagine business processes, stakeholder journeys, and operating models. The role focuses on improving business outcomes while reducing complexity, effort, cycle time, and operational friction through process redesign, user\-centered thinking, automation, and AI\-enabled solutions. The role aligns with VMNext's focus on enterprise process reimagination, stakeholder experience transformation, and outcome\-driven operating model redesign.

* Partner with functional leaders and SMEs to understand business goals, current processes, challenges, and desired outcomes.

* Facilitate discovery sessions, workshops, and Design Thinking engagements to identify improvement opportunities.
* Apply Design Thinking, UX, and Service Design principles to create intuitive, efficient, and outcome\-driven experiences.
* Design future\-state ("To\-Be") processes, workflows, and operating models that improve effectiveness and productivity.
* Identify opportunities for simplification, standardization, automation, AI enablement, and workflow optimization.
* Develop business requirements, process maps, journey maps, business cases, and transformation recommendations.
* Collaborate with business, technology, data, and AI teams to ensure solutions are practical, scalable, and measurable.
* Define success measures and track expected business value and outcome realization.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* At least 5\+ years of experience in Business Consulting, Business Analysis, Process Improvement, or Digital Transformation.
* Strong experience in process mapping, business process reengineering, value stream analysis, and requirements gathering.
* Hands\-on experience with Design Thinking, Journey Mapping, User Experience (UX), and Human\-Centered Design methodologies.
* Excellent facilitation, stakeholder engagement, communication, and analytical skills.
* Ability to translate business needs into actionable transformation opportunities and solution designs.
* Experience working across multiple business functions and influencing stakeholders at various organizational levels.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience in enterprise transformation, operating model redesign, or continuous improvement initiatives.
* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, BPMN, or Process Mining.
* Familiarity with AI, intelligent automation, workflow platforms, and digital workplace technologies.
* Experience in professional services, technology services, or insurance\-related industries.



  





**Core Competencies** 




**Business Consulting \| Process Reimagination \| Design Thinking \| UX \& Service Design \| Stakeholder Management \| Business Analysis \| Value Stream Mapping \| Change Enablement \| Process Automation \| AI\-Enabled Transformation**

title: Operation Specialist, GROCERY ECO
description:
**Description**
 Operations Specialist is responsible for validation and analysis of shopping sessions and events. As a part of the role, individual should root cause the technical irregularities and analyze the discrepancy reason(s), impact on receipt(s) further categorize the irregularities into appropriate buckets. Scope of this role also includes innovation, deep dive into unusual scenarios. The ideal candidate has a strong track record of research analysis, influence through collaboration, driving measurable business results, and attention to detail. This position is part of the world\-wide grocery stores and supports a global customer base.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Perform data collection tasks related to Amazon devices, applications, or services.
* Execute tasks assigned on daily basis by adhering to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and guidelines.
* Participate in process improvement to increase the quality, efficiency, and accuracy of the teams’ processes.
* Partner with your team manager when your work is delayed or blocked due to technical issues.
* Report issues with tools and software to the development team when necessary.
* Maintain strict confidentiality and follow all applicable Amazon policies for securing confidential information.
* Leverage technology and process innovation to bring continuous improvement to the operations.
* Analyze data to identify the root of a problem and solve it.


**About The Team**
 Grocery ECO is a new kind of shopping experience for customers with smart shopping carts \- no lines and no checkout. Simply use the ECO cart to enter the store, take what you want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals, grocery essentials, and go through dedicated lane.
   

  

 ECO carts enable scanning of products as they are taken from the shelves and you can keep track of live receipt via screen on cart. When you’re done shopping, you just leave the store. Shortly after, we’ll charge your Amazon account.
   

  

 Our technology uses computer vision, sensor fusion, and advanced machine learning.

title: Enforcement Detection Analyst, YouTube, Trust and Safety
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in data analysis, including identifying trends, generating summary statistics, and drawing insights from quantitative and qualitative data.
* 2 years of experience managing projects and defining project scope, goals, and deliverables.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience or demonstrated interest in anti\-abuse operations at scale.
* Track record of leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI technologies to solve business problems.
* Ability to work with a variety of stakeholders to gather requirements, explain models and iterate to make improvements.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical abilities with a history of going above and beyond to make operational improvements and solve tough problems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


**About The Job**
 Fast\-paced, dynamic, and proactive, YouTube’s Trust \& Safety team is dedicated to making YouTube a safe place for users, viewers, and content creators around the world to create, and express themselves. Whether understanding and solving their online content concerns, navigating within global legal frameworks, or writing and enforcing worldwide policy, the Trust \& Safety team is on the frontlines of enhancing the YouTube experience, building internet safety, and protecting free speech in our ever\-evolving digital world.
   

  

 At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. Working at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun.
   

  

 YouTube’s Trust and Safety team is dedicated to making YouTube a safe place for users, viewers, and content creators around the world. Whether understanding and solving their online content concerns, navigating within global legal frameworks, or writing and enforcing worldwide policy, the Trust and Safety team is on the frontlines of enhancing the YouTube experience, building internet safety, and protecting free speech in our ever\-evolving digital world.
   

  

 As an Enforcement Detection Analyst , you will be directly responsible for ensuring that we effectively identify and remove disruptive content and users as quickly as possible, in an environment where hundreds of hours of new content is uploaded every minute. The primary focus is abuse within the YouTube Partner Program.
   

  

 At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and implement strategies and solutions to enforce YouTube policies at scale. Provide data\-driven insights and recommendations for effective abuse prevention and enforcement. Leverage Machine Learning and AI, as appropriate.
* Collaborate closely with stakeholders and partners in Engineering, Product, Policy and Operations to drive complex anti\-abuse solutions involving and impacting various cross\-functional areas.
* Provide rapid incident response for abuse problems, operating independently. Analyze and draw conclusions on root\-causes and define and implement mitigation steps.
* Learn complex and technical concepts and systems and deliver meaningful results using them. Communicate technical results and methods clearly.
* Design and refine LLM solutions and agents to improve accuracy of identifying and classifying abusive content and behavior.

***Strategic context:***

In doing so, our Hubs are a crucial part of how we innovate, improving performance across every Sanofi department and providing a springboard for the amazing work we do. Our mission is to transform decision\-making across our end\-to\-end commercialization process, from business development to late lifecycle management. * Communicate effectively with internal stakeholders and present key insights and recommendations.
* Provide evidence\-based recommendations to support decision\-making.
* Proactively troubleshoot and offer solutions/options before escalating and reaching out for help

* Performance indicators: Adherence to timeline, quality target
* Weightage: 50%

* Regularly refresh reports and conduct quality checks using the latest tools, technologies, and methodologies.
* Work cross\-functionally to gather requirements, analyze data, and generate actionable insights and reports.
* Performance indicators: Feedback from stakeholders on satisfaction with deliverables Adherence to plan/calendar

* Strategic thinking in an ambiguous environment.

title: Senior Capability Analyst
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
**Primary Responsibilities**
* Serve as the Product Owner for one or more formulary management applications, providing strategic direction and day\-to\-day oversight of product capabilities
* Act as the primary voice of the business and end users, ensuring product priorities align with organizational goals and customer needs
* Define and communicate product vision, strategy, and roadmap to Agile delivery teams and stakeholders
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to support successful solution delivery
* Evaluate business value, develop use cases, and prioritize the product backlog to maximize value delivery and achieve targeted outcomes
* Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization activities to ensure development efforts align with business objectives
* Partner closely with Scrum Masters, business stakeholders, and technology teams to identify and resolve impediments impacting delivery
* Foster collaboration across Product Owners, Scrum teams, and cross\-functional partners to support enterprise\-scale Agile initiatives
* Facilitate and actively participate in Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and demonstrations
* Ensure compliance with governance and audit requirements by supporting the creation and maintenance of required documentation and deliverables
* Monitor industry trends, emerging technologies, and Agile best practices to continuously improve product management and delivery processes
* Collaborate with business and technology partners to assess incoming enhancement requests, estimate effort, and determine implementation priorities
* Work directly with stakeholders to understand business challenges, identify opportunities for improvement, and define solution requirements
* Analyze operational processes, user feedback, and performance metrics to identify enhancements that improve efficiency, user experience, and business outcomes
* Support release planning, user acceptance testing, and production readiness activities to ensure successful product deployments
* Build and maintain strong relationships with business, operational, and technology partners to drive alignment and product success
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so


**Required Qualifications**
* 3\+ years PBM or pharmacy experience
* 3\+ years of experience working as a Business Analyst or Product Owner
* Experience with project methodology (requirements, design, development, test and implementation)
* Experience presenting to stakeholders, written release notes, documentations of requirements, etc.
* Experience leading project workstream, deliverables, timelines


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Client facing experience
* Experience working with Agile process and principles
* Experience with formulary management and drug data
* Experience with RxClaim or RxBuilder


*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

* Support root cause analysis discussions for recurring operational issues

**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 4–6 years of experience in Systems Engineering, Infrastructure Operations, Platform Operations, or Enterprise IT environments

* Strong understanding of Active Directory, DNS, Group Policy, and enterprise identity/access concepts
* Strong experience with Windows Server patching and operational governance processes
* Hands\-on exposure to VMware vSphere technologies including ESXi and vCenter
* Good understanding of enterprise infrastructure operations and platform lifecycle management
* Experience working within large enterprise environments
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
* Ability to work independently and know when to escalate operational issues appropriately
* Good communication and stakeholder coordination skills


**Good to Have**

**Why Join Foundever**
* Exposure to large\-scale global enterprise infrastructure
* Opportunity to work across multiple technologies and platforms
* Collaboration with international teams across regions
* Opportunity to contribute to operational standards and enterprise platform governance
* Diverse technology landscape including multiple virtualization platforms and enterprise systems
* High\-visibility role supporting global infrastructure operations

title: Senior Service Engineer
description:
**🎯 Role Summary**
**✅ Job Description – L2 Storage Administrator**
 The L2 Storage Administrator is responsible for
 **day\-to\-day operations, monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimization** 
 of enterprise storage and backup infrastructure, ensuring high availability, data protection, and SLA compliance across on\-prem and cloud environments.
   

  

**🛠️ Key Responsibilities**
* Operations \& Monitoring
* Perform daily monitoring of storage and backup jobs, ensuring successful completion and SLA adherence
* Track storage utilization, capacity, and performance metrics
* Generate operational reports on backup success rates, failures, and storage usage
* Incident \& Problem Management
* Troubleshoot storage, SAN/NAS, and backup failures and restore services within SLA
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring issues
* Handle Major Incident (MI) calls and escalations (common L2 ownership – based on enterprise practice)
* Backup \& Recovery Management
* Administer backup solutions (e.g., Cohesity, IBM Spectrum Protect, Azure Backup)
* Execute backup, restore, and recovery requests
* Ensure data integrity, retention policies, and recoverability testing are maintained
* Storage Administration
* Manage storage arrays, volumes, LUNs, and storage pools
* Perform capacity planning and allocation
* Support SAN/NAS provisioning and migrations
* Configuration \& Change Management
* Implement configuration changes, patching, and upgrades
* Perform impact analysis and risk assessment before changes
* Follow ITIL processes for Change \& Release management
* Automation \& Optimization (Important for your org)
* Execute and maintain automation scripts (Ansible, PowerShell, etc.)
* Support optimization initiatives like deduplication, compression, encryption
* Reduce manual effort (TOIL) through automation
* Security \& Compliance
* Enforce access control, encryption, and security policies
* Ensure systems comply with audit requirements (SOC2, HIPAA\-like environments)
* Participate in backup immutability and ransomware protection initiatives
* Documentation \& Process Adherence
* Maintain SOPs, knowledge articles, and environment documentation
* Update runbooks for incident resolution and operational processes


**Technical Skills**
**🧠 Required Skills**
* Storage platforms: Dell EMC (Unity, PowerStore, PowerMax), NetApp, Pure, IBM
* Backup tools: Cohesity, IBM Spectrum Protect, Azure Backup
* SAN technologies: Fibre Channel, iSCSI
* OS knowledge: Windows, Linux
* Cloud: Azure storage \& backup services
* Scripting: PowerShell, Python, or Ansible (preferred)


**Functional Skills**

The role is expected to be practical, technical, and service\-oriented, with the ability to analyze cryptographic findings across applications, cloud, infrastructure, identity, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), certificates, Key Management Services (KMS), secrets, data protection, Software as a Service (SaaS), and third\-party ecosystems.
   

  

 This position will translate architecture direction into working implementation tasks, data quality rules, dashboards, tool integrations, remediation tickets, secure patterns, developer guidance, and repeatable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). The engineer will partner with Digital Identity Access Service (DIAS), PKI and certificate service owners, Application Security, Artificial Intelligence (AI) Security, Enterprise Architecture, cloud, infrastructure, platform, Risk and Compliance, Procurement, Legal, Third Party Risk Management (TPRM), Operational Technology (OT), and vendor teams to help make Amgen's PQC roadmap measurable, actionable, and sustainable.
   

  

 The role is also expected to identify high\-volume, human\-intensive Encryption Agility Service processes and design Artificial Intelligence (AI)\-enabled orchestration patterns that reduce manual work, improve analysis speed, increase team throughput, and strengthen service consistency. This includes the ability to architect AI agents or coordinated teams of AI agents that support cryptographic inventory analysis, Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM) data quality, remediation tracking, reporting, evidence review, and governance workflows while maintaining human\-in\-the\-loop decision points for risk acceptance, exception handling, production change decisions, and other activities requiring accountable human judgment.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**
* Execute assigned Encryption Agility Service workstreams, including intake analysis, backlog execution, roadmap tracking, service metrics, reporting inputs, SOP updates, and service improvement actions under the direction of the Senior Manager and Principal Architect.
* Operate enterprise cryptographic discovery across source code, binaries, cloud key services, endpoints, file systems, network traffic, PKI and certificates, KMS and secrets, vendor attestations, Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) inputs, and Subject Matter Expert (SME) interviews.
* Build, maintain, and improve the Amgen CBOM using CycloneDX 1\.6\+ as the target format, including required fields, source systems, ownership attributes, quantum\-vulnerability status, remediation status, data quality checks, reporting views, and asset correlation.
* Support tool integration and data normalization across Amgen Enterprise and cryptographic discovery platforms.
* Analyze cryptographic scan outputs, source code findings, certificate chains, cipher suite configurations, Transport Layer Security (TLS) settings, Secure Shell (SSH) settings, Open Authorization (OAuth), Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), JSON Web Token (JWT) patterns, cloud key configurations, and key or secret storage patterns.
* Implement and document remediation patterns approved by the Principal Architect, including hybrid TLS, proxy\-based crypto agility, Network encapsulation, Internet Protocol Security (IPsec), Media Access Control Security (MACsec), Key Management Interoperability Protocol (KMIP), Public\-Key Cryptography Standard \#11 (PKCS\#11\), provider libraries, custom code libraries, symmetric cryptography, Hash\-Based Message Authentication Code (HMAC), TLS termination, reverse proxies, encrypted overlays, segmentation controls, compensating controls, and risk\-based replacement or decommission pathways.
* Coordinate with Digital Identity Access Service (DIAS), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) service owners, certificate management teams, identity teams, cloud, infrastructure, and platform teams on certificate visibility, Certificate Lifecycle Manager (CLM) evaluation, certificate rotation, manual\-to\-automated deployment migration, post\-quantum PKI readiness, hybrid certificate testing, Certificate Authority (CA) modernization, KMS strategy, Hardware Security Module (HSM) patterns, secrets management, key rotation, key retirement, storage standards, ownership, reporting, and centralized or federated control options.
* Partner with Application Security, Artificial Intelligence (AI) Security, Enterprise Architecture, Development and Operations (DevOps), and engineering teams to publish approved cryptographic libraries, secure code examples, reusable patterns, Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) controls, Secure Software Development Life Cycle (SSDLC) requirements, scanning rules, developer remediation playbooks, and practical implementation guidance.
* Apply Amgen's approved quantum risk\-prioritization approach to discovery and remediation planning for business\-critical applications, high\-volume sensitive data flows, third\-party dependencies, identity services, legacy platforms, Key Computerized Systems (KCS), validated Good x Practice (GxP) systems, and OT scope.
* Support vendor and third\-party technical governance with Procurement, Legal, Risk and Compliance, Third Party Risk Management (TPRM), and business owners by preparing technical questionnaire content, CBOM requests, evidence reviews, roadmap tracking, contract language inputs, escalation triggers, and supplier remediation follow\-up.
* Provide technical escalation and mentoring for Global Career Framework level 4 (L4\) analysts and contributors, maintain cryptographic knowledge articles and implementation guides, and track changes in National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF), National Security Agency Commercial National Security Algorithm Suite 2\.0 (NSA CNSA 2\.0\), International Organization for Standardization (ISO), Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), Health Information Trust Alliance (HITRUST), and broader industry cryptography guidance.
* Design, implement, and govern Artificial Intelligence (AI)\-enabled process orchestration for human\-intensive Encryption Agility Service workflows, including cryptographic inventory analysis, Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM) data normalization, scan output review, evidence collection, remediation tracking, reporting, and governance workflows; architect AI agents or coordinated teams of AI agents for data ingestion, finding correlation, false\-positive triage support, ownership enrichment, remediation recommendation drafting, dashboard preparation, and knowledge article generation, while ensuring human\-in\-the\-loop controls for risk decisions, exceptions, production changes, and final approval actions.


**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**
* Doctorate degree in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Cryptography, Security Architecture, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field OR
* Master's degree with 4 to 6 years of experience in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Cryptography, Security Architecture, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field OR
* Bachelor's degree with 6 to 8 years of experience in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Cryptography, Security Architecture, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field OR
* Diploma with 10 to 12 years of experience in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Cryptography, Security Architecture, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field


**Functional Skills:**
**Must\-Have Skills:**
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of enterprise cryptography, including PKI, X.509 certificates, TLS, cipher suites, KMS, HSMs, secrets management, key lifecycle, encryption at rest, encryption in transit, cloud key services, identity protocols, and certificate lifecycle automation.
* Practical experience with cryptographic discovery, CBOM\-driven inventory, source code scanning, network and endpoint telemetry, cloud key service analysis, false\-positive triage, data quality controls, dashboards, and remediation tracking.
* Working knowledge of post\-quantum cryptography, crypto agility, NIST\-approved algorithms and standards, hybrid transition patterns, Steal\-Now\-Decrypt\-Later (SNDL) risk reduction, and risk\-prioritized remediation.
* Ability to convert cryptographic policy, architecture direction, and scan findings into actionable engineering guidance across CI/CD, SSDLC, cloud platforms, PKI and certificates, KMS and secrets, identity, infrastructure, applications, third\-party governance, and risk management.
* Mandatory experience designing and implementing Artificial Intelligence (AI)\-enabled process orchestration for security, cryptography, governance, risk, compliance, or technology operations workflows, including the use of AI agents or multi\-agent patterns to reduce manual effort, improve analysis consistency, increase team throughput, and maintain human\-in\-the\-loop review for high\-risk or decision\-bearing activities.
* Mandatory ability to architect AI agents to achieve defined service actions and outcomes, including workflow decomposition, agent role definition, tool and data\-source integration, prompt and instruction design, validation checkpoints, exception handling, auditability, and escalation paths for human review.


**Good\-to\-Have Skills:**
* Hands\-on experience with ServiceNow Configuration Management Database (CMDB)/Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), Guard, Wiz, Qualys, Fortinet, Netskope, CrowdStrike, GitLab, Veracode, GitGuardian, Amazon Web Services (AWS) KMS, AWS Certificate Manager, AWS Secrets Manager, Microsoft PKI, Sectigo, HashiCorp Vault, HSMs, Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) platforms, and Security Information and Event Management (SIEM)/data lake integrations.
* Experience creating or operating CBOM/SBOM data models using CycloneDX 1\.6\+, Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), Comma\-Separated Values (CSV), JavaScript Object Notation (JSON), dashboards, data quality checks, and audit\-ready reporting.
* Experience with PKI modernization, certificate automation, certificate rotation, CA hierarchy changes, hybrid certificate testing, and Post\-Quantum Public Key Infrastructure (PQ\-PKI) transition support.
* Experience with key management and secrets management across AWS, Azure, on\-premises platforms, HSMs, vault technologies, automation workflows, and centralized or federated operating models.
* Experience with application security, DevOps, SSDLC governance, CI/CD quality gates, approved cryptographic libraries, static analysis, dynamic analysis, composition analysis, and developer enablement.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, regulated, validated, GxP, KCS, manufacturing, OT, or other change\-controlled environments.
* Scripting and automation experience with Python, PowerShell, Bash, Representational State Transfer Application Programming Interfaces (REST APIs), data pipelines, parsing of certificate or scan data, or lightweight integration development.


**Professional Certifications:**
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) (preferred)
* Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), AWS Certified Security \- Specialty, Microsoft Azure Security Engineer, or equivalent cloud security certification (preferred)
* Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), or Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC) (preferred)
* Security\+, Systems Security Certified Practitioner (SSCP), or equivalent security certification (preferred)
* Relevant PKI, KMS, HSM, cryptographic discovery, certificate lifecycle management, cloud key management, or post\-quantum cryptography training/certification (preferred)


**Soft Skills:**
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong technical ownership and ability to drive complex discovery, analysis, and remediation work to completion.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills for technical, business, compliance, procurement, and vendor audiences.
* Ability to translate cryptographic findings into clear risk statements, remediation options, and implementation steps.
* Ability to influence without direct authority across global security, Digital, Technology and Innovation (DTI), DIAS, procurement, legal, compliance, OT, infrastructure, cloud, and application teams.
* High degree of initiative, accountability, judgment, and self\-motivation in ambiguous or evolving technical domains.
* Team oriented, with a focus on shared outcomes, reusable patterns, practical implementation, and service maturity.
* Strong coaching and mentoring skills for L4 analysts and technical contributors.
* Strong documentation, presentation, and knowledge\-sharing skills for technical reviews, service updates, and architecture forums.
* Strong ability to identify manual process bottlenecks, redesign workflows for automation and Artificial Intelligence (AI) augmentation, and balance productivity improvement with quality, accountability, and human judgment.

* Strong understanding of RBAC and ABAC access control models.

* IAM data exports (e.g., PIM assignments, access packages)
* Sign\-in \& activity log queries
* Provisioning/Deprovisioning tasks
* Knowledge of modular and maintainable scripting best practices


**Security \& Compliance:**
* Understanding of frameworks: NIST 800\-53, HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS

* Experience supporting audits through evidence gathering and documentation


**Azure Cloud \& Microsoft Ecosystem:**
* Manage Azure subscriptions, resource groups, and RBAC
* Experience with Intune, Defender for Endpoint, and Company Portal
* Troubleshoot Conditional Access and authentication issues
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 Security \& Compliance Center


**Documentation \& Process Management:**
* Develop SOPs, process flows, and policy documents
* Create and maintain IAM maturity models and strategic roadmaps
* Prepare documentation to support regulatory audits


**Key Competencies:**
* Process Automation: Streamline IAM operations through scripting and workflows
* Security Focus: Deep understanding of IAM security challenges and solutions

title: Forward deployed engineer
description:
Forward Deployed Engineer / Solutions Architect \- Deccan AI
 



**About** 
 :
 



 Deccan AI is a venture\-backed AI infrastructure company ($25M Series A, Prosus Ventures), headquartered in the Bay Area with an engineering hub in Hyderabad. We build the infrastructure layer for Reinforcement Learning and Agentic AI and work with frontier labs including Google DeepMind and Snowflake.
 



  





 Deccan AI builds the data, evaluation, and agentic infrastructure that helps frontier labs and enterprises ship AI that actually works in production. Our Helix and EnterpriseOS platforms put humans and AI side by side to catch failures, close evaluation gaps, and run mission\-critical workflows. As we move from data and evals into full\-scale enterprise deployments, we're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer / Solutions Architect to sit at the center of that motion: embedded with customers, owning the technical relationship, and turning ambiguous problems into shipped, reliable AI systems.
 



  





 This is a customer\-facing, build\-heavy role. You will spend as much time in a client's codebase and infrastructure as you do in a whiteboard session with their VP of Engineering. You are equally comfortable designing an architecture and writing the code that proves it out.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Embed directly with enterprise customers to scope, design, and build production AI solutions on top of Deccan AI's Helix and EnterpriseOS platforms.
* Own the end\-to\-end technical relationship for key accounts: requirements gathering, solution architecture, implementation, deployment, and post\-launch iteration.
* Translate ambiguous, often messy customer workflows into concrete technical designs data pipelines, agent architectures, evaluation harnesses, and integration points with the customer's existing infra.
* Write production\-grade code alongside customer engineering teams; this is not a slideware role.
* Build reusable patterns, tooling, and accelerators from each engagement so the next deployment moves faster than the last.
* Act as the technical voice of the customer internally feeding field learnings back into product and platform roadmaps.
* Debug and resolve issues in live, high\-stakes deployments, often under time pressure and with imperfect information.
* Present architecture, tradeoffs, and rollout plans to both engineering counterparts and executive stakeholders.



**What we're looking for** 



* 4\+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, or a forward\-deployed / professional\-services engineering role, ideally with exposure to AI, ML, or data\-intensive systems.
* Strong hands\-on coding ability (Python and/or a modern backend language) you can prototype, productionize, and debug your own work, not just review someone else's.
* Experience designing and deploying systems on at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including data pipelines and API\-level integrations.
* Working knowledge of LLM\-based systems: prompting, evaluation, RAG, agentic workflows, or fine\-tuning you don't need to have built a foundation model, but you need to have shipped something that uses one.
* Excellent communication skills you can move fluidly between a technical deep\-dive with engineers and a business conversation with a customer sponsor.
* A bias toward ownership: comfortable being the one person accountable for a customer's technical outcome, without a large team behind you at every step.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed and to work occasionally across customer time zones.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Prior experience in a forward\-deployed engineering, solutions engineering, or technical consulting role at an AI/ML or enterprise software company.
* Experience building or operating evaluation systems for AI agents or LLM applications.
* Familiarity with human\-in\-the\-loop workflows and production monitoring for AI systems.
* Startup experience, particularly in a 0\-to\-1 or early\-scale environment.



  





**Why Deccan AI** 



* Work at the point where AI research meets real enterprise deployment your work ships to production, not to a slide.
* High\-trust, high\-ownership culture: capable people who move fast and hold a high bar.
* Direct exposure to frontier AI labs and enterprise customers solving genuinely hard problems.
* Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and a seat at the table as the company scales.

description:
IND Staff Cloud Engineer \- GCC008
   

  

 We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 Our organization is modernizing customer identity and access management to support secure, seamless authentication across all digital channels. We are seeking a
 **Staff IAM Engineer** 
 to serve as the technical lead for our Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) platform team in
 **Hyderabad, India** 
 . You will design and implement customer identity solutions using the
 **Ping x ForgeRock Identity Platform** 
 , while balancing hands\-on technical execution with team\-level leadership. You'll guide daily design decisions, sprint delivery, and technical quality standards—ensuring our CIAM capabilities are secure, scalable, and deliver measurable business value across web, mobile, and API channels. This role is critical to enabling frictionless customer experiences while maintaining enterprise\-grade security and compliance.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 You'll design and evolve CIAM patterns—updating existing ones to meet business objectives and building new ones that strengthen security or drive value—while reviewing code, guiding sprint cadence, unblocking your team, and making daily decisions that keep momentum.
   

  

**TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP \& TEAM GUIDANCE**
* Own CIAM design and implementation decisions for the team, guiding user story creation and refinement to ensure technical clarity and feasibility.
* Help refine features into well\-defined user stories and technical spikes; ensure stories are sized and scoped appropriately for team velocity and sprint capacity.
* Guide sprint planning and backlog refinement, leading technical trade\-off discussions that balance security, performance, and delivery timelines.
* Write and review policy scripts, API integration code, and orchestration logic to implement identity flows and custom abstractions.
* Provide hands\-on code and configuration reviews, ensuring delivery aligns with definition of done, security standards, and engineering best practices.


**CIAM PLATFORM DESIGN \& IMPLEMENTATION**
* Design and implement CIAM capabilities using Ping x ForgeRock products, including authentication flows (OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML), MFA, password less authentication, adaptive/risk\-based authentication, identity federation, and user journey orchestration.
* Configure and customize identity flows using Ping policies, orchestration rules, policy scripts, and SDKs to meet functional requirements.
* Design, develop, and own a custom abstraction layer that simplifies Ping Identity integration, enabling application teams to implement secure identity patterns without deep platform expertise.
* Own end\-to\-end integrations with web/mobile applications, backend APIs, and API gateways.
* Evolve existing patterns to meet changing objectives.


**SECURITY \& COMPLIANCE**
* Embed security by design in all CIAM implementations; partner with security teams on threat modeling, design reviews, fraud detection, and anomaly detection strategies.
* Ensure CIAM solutions meet privacy, regulatory, and compliance requirements (OIDC, OAuth2, NIST, GDPR, CCPA, NYDFS).
* Own non\-functional requirements including performance targets, system resiliency, and availability SLAs.


**DEVOPS, RELIABILITY \& INCIDENT RESPONSE**
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for CIAM configuration and code using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar tools.
* Promote configuration\-as\-code and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) practices across CIAM delivery.
* Support automated testing, logging, monitoring, and alerting for identity services to enable rapid incident detection.
* Troubleshoot production issues and lead incident resolution in collaboration with SRE and platform teams, working toward rapid response times.


**MENTORING, EXPERTISE \& STRATEGIC ALIGNMENT**
* Mentor CIAM engineers and application developers on identity patterns, security best practices, and Ping platform capabilities through code reviews, pair sessions, and knowledge\-sharing.
* Serve as the CIAM technical authority for the Agile team, making feature/integration\-level design decisions that unblock team members and keep momentum.
* Create and maintain CIAM architecture documentation, integration guides, and decision records to support team knowledge and onboarding.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects and product teams to align team\-level CIAM solutions with broader organizational strategy and roadmaps.
* Coordinate with Ping Identity vendor teams for platform guidance, technical support, and issue escalation as needed.


**Required Qualifications**
**CORE IAM \& CIAM EXPERTISE**
* 7–10\+ years of professional experience in identity and access management (IAM), with a strong focus on Customer IAM (CIAM) design and implementation.
* Hands\-on experience with Ping Identity PingOne, ForgeRock, or similar IAM/CIAM platforms designing, configuring, and deploying CIAM solutions in production.
* Deep knowledge of authentication and authorization standards: OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, JWT, and REST API security patterns.
* Proficiency in MFA, passwordless authentication strategies, identity federation, and risk\-based authentication policies.
* Experience deploying and managing CIAM solutions in cloud environments (AWS or GCP).


**PLATFORM \& ABSTRACTION LAYER DEVELOPMENT**
* Proven experience designing and maintaining custom integration layers (SDKs, abstraction layers, or API wrappers) that simplify platform integration for downstream consumers.
* Hands\-on development and scripting proficiency in JavaScript, Java, Groovy, Python, or similar languages.


**DEVOPS, SECURITY \& RELIABILITY**
* Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using modern tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with configuration\-as\-code and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) practices for identity platforms.
* Strong understanding of application security principles, authentication/authorization threat models, and secure coding practices.


**TEAM LEADERSHIP \& COMMUNICATION**
* Proven experience working as a Senior or Lead Engineer, balancing hands\-on technical execution with team leadership, mentoring, and technical decision\-making in Agile environments.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with Product Owners, Security teams, Enterprise Architects, and Engineering partners.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical discussions, resolve design trade\-offs, and influence technical decisions across teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience migrating identity solutions from on\-premises IAM platforms to cloud\-based SaaS CIAM platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with ForgeRock Identity Cloud or other SaaS IAM platforms.
* Experience designing and supporting mobile identity use cases (native apps, token lifecycle management, device trust).
* Familiarity with API gateways, Web Application Firewalls (WAFs), and fraud detection/anomaly detection tools.
* Relevant certifications: Ping Identity, ForgeRock, Cloud (AWS/GCP), or Information Security certifications.
* Experience coordinating with IAM vendor teams for technical support, platform guidance, and strategic alignment.

 📍

**About The Role**

 This isn't a role about running tests — it's about
 **defining what matters, establishing how we measure it, and driving action when reality diverges from goals**

If you thrive at the intersection of deep technical expertise, cross\-functional influence, and strategic thinking, we'd love to connect.
   

  

**Your Role Responsibilities? Here's What You'll Do.**
* Define and own the organization\-wide performance engineering strategy — establishing which customer archetypes to benchmark against, which metrics matter, and which trade\-offs engineering teams should make to deliver consistent, production\-representative results.
* Establish performance SLOs and scalability envelopes tied directly to real ECM usage patterns; design infrastructure recommendations based on performance analysis — identifying configuration gaps, resource allocation inefficiencies, and architectural constraints that limit scale.
* Apply machine learning to performance data for anomaly detection, predictive bottleneck identification, and automated root\-cause analysis; surface patterns in telemetry that signal architectural risks or optimization opportunities before customers encounter them.
* Define shared performance frameworks across engineering teams so latency SLOs, throughput targets, and scalability trade\-offs speak one language org\-wide; partner with feature teams during design reviews to surface scalability risks early and validate changes at production scale.
* Work backwards from customer outcomes — ensuring every benchmark, every metric, and every analysis exists to inform better engineering choices rather than simply generate data.
* Coach engineers across the organization on performance profiling, load generation, and building diagnosable systems — raising the performance engineering bar org\-wide through credibility and judgment, not authority.
