title: Solutions Architect
description:
**Company Description**
 Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About us, but we'll be brief:**
 Experian is the world's leading global information services company, unlocking the power of data to create more opportunities for consumers, businesses and society. We are thrilled to share that FORTUNE has named Experian one of the 100 Best Companies to work for. In addition, for the last five years we've been listed as one of the 100 "World's Most Innovative Companies" by Forbes Magazine.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
 You will be the architecture owner for Experian's telephony, Teams Calling, and Contact Center services. As we modernize, we are moving toward a cloud‑first, Teams‑centric model. In this model, NICE will serve as the contact center platform, and we will use Teams Calling for corporate/campus telephony. This role is accountable for the end‑to‑end technical design and standards. This includes global telephony transformation. We mean this transformation to replace EOL Avaya, reduce on\-premise dependencies. It will also deliver features such as advanced IVR, dashboards, reporting, AI/speech recognition, omnichannel, call recording, and call accounting, etc. Additionally, I designed and guided Experian's contact center capability uplift. This included Presence Bi‑Sync with Salesforce Omni‑Channel, advanced quality, sentiment analysis, self‑service/automation, and ACD enhancements. I measured all of these against efficiency targets and business benefits. APAC modernization and discovery work (e.g., Teams Calling \+ NICE CXone direction; addressing EOL Cisco/Ribbon, India calling enablement constraints, and staff augmentation needs). This role directly owns PSTN/calling architecture, carrier/SBC design, numbering/porting, call routing, contact center flows, recording/QA/analytics, and compliance\-aligned controls. You will report to a Senior Director.
   

  

**Summary Of Primary Responsibilities**
* Own global telephony \& contact center target architectures: Define and maintain end‑to‑end designs for Teams Calling, NICE contact center, call routing, numbering, porting, recording/CDR, and integration patterns across regions.
* The UKI \& EMEA telephony modernization architecture authority is responsible for leading the technical approach. This approach involves replacing legacy Avaya, including the decommission of \~60 Avaya devices, and delivering the proposed campus/contact center changes. These changes include desk phone removal as standard, power\-user and VIP retention models, mandatory CC training, and enhanced IVR/ACD/analytics/automation capabilities.
* Contact center evolution and feature enablement involve architecting and governing advanced CC capabilities. We plan or have in\-flight these capabilities. They include integrating Salesforce enhancements, implementing Presence Bi\-Sync, developing omnichannel, creating QM\+/quality, conducting sentiment analysis, and designing automation/self\-service patterns. Examples of automation/self\-service patterns are password reset self\-service IVR flows and Origins integration.
* Compliance, risk, and data\-flow architecture: Own the technical inputs required to satisfy multi‑region risk/compliance needs, including DPIA/LIA/ROPA/TPRA patterns, country data residency constraints, and risk items affecting schedule/solution design. Drive "secure by design" call recording and processing architectures.
* Carrier/SBC and routing design leadership involves leading carrier/provider architecture decisions. It also includes solution designs, considering constraints that require Teams and NICE migrations to occur together in certain routing models. Additionally, it requires finalizing EMEA routing designs.
* Operational reliability and ITSM guardrails: Define architecture standards for availability, survivability, monitoring, and change rigor while modernization executes—balancing "run" stability with transformation delivery.
* Executive\-ready architecture artifacts: Produce reference architecture, option papers, sequencing plans, and risk statements to support business cases, funding approvals, vendor due diligence, and leadership decision forums.


**Qualifications**
* 10–15\+ years developing enterprise telephony/voice and contact center solutions in several environments (global/multi‑region preferred).
* Demonstrated experience modernizing from legacy PBX/contact center platforms to cloud SaaS models with emphasis on routing/porting/numbering, agent workflows, and service continuity.
* You have Contact center domain depth (e.g., NICE\-like platforms) including call flows, IVR/ACD, recording, QA, analytics, and CRM integration patterns.
* You have good partner communication—able to translate architecture tradeoffs into clear decisions for all kinds of audiences.
* You have operational governance and discipline; comfortable operating in environments with active risk, compliance review cycles, and change controls.


**Additional Information**
 Our uniqueness is that we truly celebrate yours. Experian's culture and people are important differentiators. We take our people agenda very seriously and focus on what truly matters; DEI, work/life balance, development, authenticity, engagement, collaboration, wellness, reward \& recognition, volunteering... the list goes on. Experian's strong people first approach is award winning; Great Place To Work™ in 24 countries, FORTUNE Best Companies to work and Glassdoor Best Places to Work (globally 4\.4 Stars) to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or our Careers Site to understand why.
   

  

 Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. Innovation is a critical part of Experian's DNA and practices, and our diverse workforce drives our success. Everyone can succeed at Experian and bring their whole self to work, irrespective of their gender, ethnicity, religion, color, sexuality, physical ability or age. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.
   

  

**Recruitment Fraud Awareness** 
 \- Experian's recruitment process is conducted only through authorised channels. Recruitment communications will only be sent from an @experian.com email address. Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Experian care for employee's work life balance, health, safety and wellbeing. In support of this endeavor, we offer best\-in\-class family well\-being benefits, enhanced medical benefits and paid time off.
   

  

 Experian Careers \- Creating a better tomorrow together

title: Application Support Specialist
description:
**Overview** 




 We are seeking a highly skilled and detail\-oriented Tier 3 Support Analyst to join our technical support team. This role is the highest level of application support, responsible for resolving complex, high\-priority production issues across our benefits administration platform. The ideal candidate will be a technical expert with deep knowledge of enterprise applications, strong analytical abilities, and experience in healthcare benefits systems.
 



 You will serve as a critical escalation point for unresolved incidents, leading root cause analysis, troubleshooting complex integrations, and driving resolution through collaboration with Engineering, Product, QA, and Customer Success teams. Your work ensures system stability, data integrity, and exceptional customer experience in a fast\-paced, mission\-critical environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Serve as the primary escalation point for complex, high\-impact production issues reported by customers or internal teams.
* Conduct in\-depth root cause analysis (RCA) using application logs, database records, API traces, and system workflows.
* Reproduce and validate reported issues in staging or test environments to isolate technical and business\-process defects.
* Perform advanced troubleshooting across multi\-tiered systems, including backend services, databases, APIs, and integrations (e.g., HRIS, payroll, third\-party benefit providers).
* Write and execute complex SQL queries to analyze data anomalies, validate business logic, and support diagnostics.
* Collaborate closely with Engineering teams to triage, document, and prioritize fixes; provide detailed technical feedback and reproducible test cases.
* Partner with Product and QA to clarify requirements, validate bug fixes, and support regression testing.
* Work with Customer Success to communicate technical status, timelines, and resolution strategies to stakeholders.
* Document findings, solutions, and knowledge base articles to improve team efficiency and reduce future escalations.
* Monitor system health and proactively identify potential issues through log analysis and performance trends.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3\+ years of experience in technical support, application support, or software engineering roles, with proven experience at Tier 3 or equivalent level.
* Deep understanding of benefits administration systems (e.g., health, dental, vision, retirement, FSA/HSA) and associated workflows.
* Strong hands\-on experience with SQL (query optimization, joins, subqueries, stored procedures) and database troubleshooting.
* Proficiency in analyzing logs (application, server, API), understanding system behavior, and identifying patterns in error messages.
* Working knowledge of RESTful APIs, web services, and integration platforms (e.g., MuleSoft, Informatica, Zapier, etc.).
* Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash for automation and log parsing.
* Experience with agile development methodologies and ticketing systems (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow).
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple high\-priority incidents simultaneously under pressure.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Prior experience or similar benefits administration platforms.
* Background in US healthcare benefits, payroll integration, or HR technology (HRIS) environments.
* Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience with monitoring tools (e.g., Datadog, New Relic, Splunk).
* Certification in IT support, cloud computing, or software development (e.g., AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, CompTIA A\+/Network\+, etc.).

 , delivering tailored solutions that create real business value.

 , empowering you to take initiative, solve problems, and lead change.

 , where diverse perspectives, cultures, and collaboration fuel our success.

title: Associate / Senior Associate
description:

We add professional aspects to the strengths of the scores of grassroots workers supporting the Prime Minister and ensure optimal electoral results not as an end in itself but to add to the Prime Minister's vision for a developed India.  1\. Bachelor's degree from a Tier 1 academic institution.

 :
 



 Local candidates are preferred.

 Telugu

* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross\-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast\-paced, high\-accountability environment

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e\-commerce, Q\-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on\-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in\-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell\-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability

title: Content Specialist

**The Content Specialist Has The Following Responsibilities**
* Content Development \& Optimization \- Develop, write, and refine high\-quality content for digital marketing assets including emails, landing/webpages, campaign materials, and ecommerce/product content. Ensure all content is aligned with campaign messaging, audience needs, and brand voice. Optimize content for discoverability and engagement across digital channels using best practices in content structuring and search optimization.
* Ecommerce Content \& Product Experience \- Develop and maintain ecommerce and product\-focused content that supports product discovery, understanding, and conversion.


 Create clear, structured, and informative product descriptions, value propositions, and supporting content aligned with user intent and business objectives. Ensure consistency and accuracy across product content, and optimize content presentation for usability and digital experience.

Work closely with campaign managers and content strategy lead to translate requirements into clear, accurate, and effective content deliverables. Ensure consistency, accuracy, and timely delivery across all assigned tasks.
* Content Reusability \& Asset Management \- Develop content in a modular and reusable format to support scalability across campaigns and channels. Contribute to and leverage structured content repositories, ensuring proper organization, version control, and alignment with content standards. Identify opportunities to reuse and adapt existing content.

Set up and manage automated content workflows, including audience segmentation, dynamic content insertion, and nurture journeys. Collaborate with campaign and marketing operations teams to enable personalized content experiences based on user behavior, lifecycle stage, and preferences. Ensure content is structured and tagged appropriately to support automation, scalability, and targeted delivery across campaigns.
* Organic Content \& Channel Support – Support the development and execution of content for organic channels such as LinkedIn, Facebook, and thought leadership initiatives. Adapt content formats and messaging for different platforms while maintaining consistency with overall campaign objectives.
* Content Optimization \& Continuous Improvement \- Review and refine content based on feedback, stakeholder inputs, and performance insights (where available). Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to improve content effectiveness, clarity, and audience engagement over time.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Life Sciences, or a related field
* 2–5 years of experience in digital content creation or ecommerce content

* Strong understanding of SEO/GEO/AEO fundamentals and content optimization for digital discovery
* Experience writing for multiple formats including campaign content, emails, landing pages, and ecommerce/product content
* Ability to interpret briefs and translate them into structured, high\-quality content with minimal iterations
* Familiarity with content reuse, modular content approaches, and content management systems
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to assess content performance and optimize accordingly
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple deliverables and work collaboratively across teams with minimal supervision


**Additional Desired Preferences**

* Exposure to ecommerce content optimization and product\-led storytelling
* Experience working with AI\-assisted content tools (e.g., content generation, translation, or optimization tools)
* Familiarity with analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, SEO tools like SEMrush, etc.)
* Strong working knowledge with Acquia DAM, Salesforce, for journey builder, dynamic content rendering and real\-time personalization logic.

 None, this is an individual contributor role.

 Sales \& Marketing
   

  

**Job Type** 
 Full\-Time

* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.


****Role Summary And Impact****
 As part of the
 **Global Operations Centre (GOC)** 
 , you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high\-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for an Associate Director Cross channel who will do:
   

  

* Client \& Channel Leadership Act as the lead and primary point of contact for key digital marketing channels—including Search, Social, Programmatic Buying Units (PBU), Ad Operations, or Commerce (all or couple of them). Represent the Global Operations Center (GOC) in all channels wise agency/market interactions, ensuring expectations are managed and consistently met. Serve as the custodian of activation excellence for assigned channels, driving trust and accountability across global stakeholders.

Ensure flawless execution that aligns with broader media strategies and brand objectives. Work in close partnership with local and regional teams to maintain consistency, enhance performance, and deliver measurable impact through detailed reporting and actionable insights.

Act as a strategic advisor, offering data\-driven solutions tailored to regional needs while upholding global standards. Partner with leadership and internal clients to drive innovation, resolve challenges, and influence strategic decisions that contribute to business growth.

Enforce compliance with global taxonomy, quality assurance, and platform governance standards. Analyze operational data and feedback to identify improvement areas, ensure process adherence, and escalate issues to the appropriate stakeholders for resolution.
* Team Leadership \& Talent Development Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing team of subject matter experts responsible for campaign execution, optimization, and reporting. Foster a collaborative, accountable, and growth\-oriented team culture. Ensure efficient team resourcing, continuous skills development, and alignment with organizational objectives through regular feedback, coaching, and performance evaluation.
* Innovation, Automation \& Business Growth Proactively identify new business opportunities within existing accounts and emerging markets. Collaborate with directors and senior leadership to develop compelling discussions for onboarding new scopes of work. Champion the adoption of internal and external automation tools and technology solutions to drive operational efficiency and future\-proof activation capabilities.
* Coordination with internal team to overall smooth running for operations.


****Skills And Experience****
 If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:
   

  

* Graduation or Post Graduation Degree in Any stream
* 8\+ year's professional experience in digital media execution
* You are an expert \& executed on respective channel platforms
* You are proficient in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheet
* Working knowledge in HubSpot, Smartly, 4C, Scibids, or third\-party tools like Dataroma, Google Studio is an added advantage
* Experience managing multi\-location media activation teams.
* Experience training and maintaining quality standards at scale.
* Experience providing service to local teams from a centralized location.
* Passion for everything digital, with an active interest and understanding of online advertising industry trends.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
* Possess a solution\-oriented mindset and analytical skillset.
* Proactive, display exemplary leadership with a positive go\-getter attitude.


****Life At WPP Media \& Benefits****
 Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media \& WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in\-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
   

  

 WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
   

  

 We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

title: Data & Governance Senior Analyst
description:
**Overview**
 Join the Data \& Governance Team, part of PepsiCo's A\&M Management Capability, at the intersection of Finance, Data, and Marketing. If you enjoy solving data challenges, building new capabilities, and helping shape the future of how global Advertising \& Marketing (A\&M) investments are managed, measured, and optimized, this is the role for you.
   

  

 The Data \& Governance team plays a critical role in enabling A\&M Excellence initiatives across PepsiCo by providing the data foundations, reporting capabilities, governance processes, and automation solutions that power better decision\-making. We partner closely with global teams, markets, Finance, and Marketing stakeholders to support both annual strategic programs and a wide range of ad\-hoc business priorities.
   

  

 In this role, you will help shape and scale capabilities such as A\&M Reporting, Taxonomy, A\&M Hub, and data governance solutions. You will translate business needs into actionable insights, reporting solutions, and process improvements, while helping advance PepsiCo's transformation agenda through automation and innovative ways of working. This is a unique opportunity to become an expert in PepsiCo's global A\&M ecosystem and make a direct impact on how marketing investments are measured, managed, and optimized across key markets worldwide.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Overall
   

  

* Act as a key enabler of A\&M Excellence initiatives through quality data, analytics, governance, automation, and digital solutions that support projects delivery and business decision\-making.
* Partner with internal teams, markets, and global stakeholders to drive end\-to\-end data readiness, including data collection, validation, governance, reporting, and Projects execution.
* Support Executive and ad\-hoc business requests by connecting data, and insights across multiple sources to enable actionable recommendations.


 Data Management, Validation \& Governance
   

  

* Own data collection, validation, cleansing and consolidation across multiple marketing, media and finance data sources.
* Support KPI tracking, governance processes, recurring reporting cycles and ad\-hoc business requests.
* Assess data readiness, support definition of data requirements, and enable integration of datasets into A\&M Hub and other reporting solutions to help establish a trusted source of truth.


 Continuous Improvement, Automation \& AI
   

  

* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate data, reporting, and business processes.
* Partner with business and technical teams to explore, test, and implement digital solutions, including enhancements to A\&M Hub capabilities and reporting tools.
* Leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve efficiency, data quality, reporting, and insight generation.


 Project Management
   

  

* Lead and coordinate assigned data\-related projects and workstreams from project kick\-off through delivery, ensuring clear timelines, milestones, and ownership.
* Facilitate project kick\-offs, meetings, and workshops related to data collection, governance, reporting, analytics, and solution delivery, while confidently communicating with stakeholders across different functions and levels.
* Coordinate with other Data \& Governance team members to align deliverables, share best practices, and support successful project execution.


**Qualifications**
* 10 \-12 years of experience in Data Governance, Business Intelligence, Marketing Analytics, Finance Analytics, Consulting, or a related field.
* Analytical skills with the ability to collect, validate, connect, and interpret complex data from multiple sources.
* Experience working with reporting and analytics tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar).
* Proficient in PowerPoint and Think\-Cell, with the ability to analyze data and present insights in a clear and structured way.
* Experience coordinating data\-related projects, including stakeholder management, data requirements gathering, understanding, and translating finance and business data into A\&M Excellence reporting needs.
* Effective communication skills and fluent English, with confidence collaborating with global stakeholders and facilitating data related discussions.
* Curiosity and passion for continuous improvement, automation, AI, and digital solutions that drive business value.
* Self\-starter mindset with the ability to manage ambiguity, solve problems proactively, and deliver results in a fast\-paced environment.

The Senior VMware Windows Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the organizations virtualized infrastructure and Windows server environments. This role requires expertise in VMware technologies and Windows operating systems management to ensure high availability, performance, and security of IT services.
  
  

**Primary Skill:** Automation
  
  

**What will you do in this role:**  

**VMware Environment Management:**  

Design, deploy, and maintain VMware infrastructure solutions, including vSphere, vCenter, and NSX.
  
Manage and optimize virtual machines and host environments, ensuring high availability and performance.
  
Implement backup and disaster recovery solutions for virtual environments, ensuring data integrity and business continuity.
  
Monitor and troubleshoot VMware performance issues, applying root cause analysis for effective resolution.
  
  

**Windows Server Administration:**  

Install, configure, and maintain Windows Server operating systems in a multi\-domain environment.
  
Manage Active Directory, Group Policy Objects (GPO), and Domain Name System (DNS) services to ensure seamless integration and security.
  
Develop, implement, and enforce best practices for Windows security, patch management, and system updates.
  
Automate system administration tasks using PowerShell scripting to enhance efficiency and reduce manual interventions.
  
  

**System Integration and Collaboration:**  

Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including network, security, and application teams, to ensure robust infrastructure integration.
  
Provide technical support and guidance to team members and end\-users on VMware and Windows\-related issues.
  
Develop and maintain system documentation, including architecture diagrams, configurations, and operational procedures.
  
  

**Performance Monitoring and Optimization:**  

Utilize monitoring tools to assess and optimize the performance of VMware and Windows environments.
  
Identify opportunities for improvement in system performance, availability, and scalability.

* Bachelors’ degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or any Technology stream.
* 3 years of experience in VMware technologies and Windows Server administration.
* VMware Certified Professional (VCP) and Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE) certifications preferred.
* Strong understanding of networking concepts, virtualization best practices, and server hardware.
* Proficiency in PowerShell scripting and familiarity with automation tools.


**Desirable Skills:**  

Experience with VMware Cloud offerings or hybrid cloud environments.
  
Knowledge of security best practices for both VMware and Windows environments.
  
Familiarity with storage solutions and technologies (SAN, NAS) and relevant backup solutions.

description:
**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Work Mode:** 
 5 days WFO
 



  





**Notice Period: 15\-30 days maximum**




  





 We are hiring a Growth Manager to own performance marketing end to end for one or more of our consumer brands. This is not a media buying seat that only manages budgets someone else has already figured out. You will run the full loop yourself: finding what customers are actually searching for and struggling with, finding the ad angles and formats that are already winning in the market, briefing our in\-house creative team to build against those angles, and then living inside the performance data every day to decide what scales, what gets killed, and what gets tested next.
 



  





 You will work closely with our video editors and graphic designers, and with the operations
 



 and finance side of the business, to make sure that whatever you scale is something we can actually fulfill and that genuinely makes money.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 • Research keywords and customer problems using tools such as Helium10, and use search intent and demand signals to decide which product angles are worth building campaigns around.
 



 • Source winning creative concepts from competitors and organic content using tools such as Foreplay, along with manual scouting on platforms like TikTok and Instagram, and identify why a given hook or format is working.
 



 • Generate ad scripts using our in\-house AI tools, refining them so that the final script is genuinely high quality rather than a rough first pass.
 



 • Brief our video editors and graphic designers clearly, including the reference creative, the hook, and the intended angle, and review and approve their work before it goes live.
 



 • Launch, manage, and optimize paid campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.
 



 • Monitor performance daily against clear benchmarks, including CPM under thirty dollars, CPC under one dollar fifty, CTR above three percent, CAC in the range of forty to fifty dollars, and cost per add to cart under fifteen dollars, along with hook rate, hold rate, and click rate.
 



 • Make clear scale or kill decisions based on return on ad spend. Scale an ad when Meta ROAS is above one. Hold with no action when it is between zero point seven and one. Kill an ad when Meta ROAS stays below zero point seven for two to three consecutive days.
 



 • Understand and work within a subscription\-driven revenue model, where a Meta ROAS below one can still be a healthy result once repeat and subscription revenue is accounted for, and track blended Shopify ROAS against a breakeven target of one point four.
 



 • Own the revenue target and budget allocation for your assigned brand or product line.
 



 • Work closely with channel managers and growth executives to keep paid social, marketplaces, and organic efforts aligned rather than working against each other.
 



 • Provide regular, structured reporting on campaign performance, budget pacing, and revenue against target.
 



  





**Required Qualifications and Experience** 




  





 • At least three years of experience in performance or growth marketing, with a proven track record of scaling paid campaigns and delivering measurable return on investment.
 



 • Hands\-on experience running and optimizing campaigns in Meta Ads Manager, along with familiarity with TikTok Ads or similar platforms.
 



 • A strong grasp of direct response marketing metrics and unit economics, including CAC, ROAS, and lifetime value, and how they connect to actual profitability.
 



 • Experience briefing and iterating with a creative team, since this role is as much about creative direction as it is about media buying.
 



 • Comfortable working in a fast\-testing, high\-volume creative environment where campaigns and creative are refreshed constantly rather than left to run untouched.
 



 • Working knowledge of analytics and attribution tools such as Google Analytics and Meta Ads Manager reporting.
 



 • A master’s degree is preferred but not required.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  





 • Experience in health, wellness, supplements, or adjacent consumer categories.
 



 • Experience at a growth\-stage direct\-to\-consumer company, for example at businesses such as Bellavita, BetterAlt India, or Mosaic Wellness.
 



 • Experience with subscription or retention\-driven revenue models, rather than only one\-time purchase businesses.
 



 • Experience owning a channel or product line, P\&L, not just its ad spend.
 



  





**Where We Expect to Find This Person** 




  





**Strong candidates are likely to come from one of the following backgrounds.** 




  





 • A performance or growth marketer at a direct\-to\-consumer or e\-commerce brand, ideally one with a subscription or repeat\-purchase revenue model.
 



 • A media buyer at a performance marketing agency who has grown into owning strategy and creative direction, not just ad account management.
 



 • A growth marketer at a company in health, wellness, or a related consumer category who is ready to own a full brand or product line rather than a single channel.
 



  





**Key Competencies** 




  





 • You are genuinely data\-driven, and can look at CPM, CTR, ROAS, and CAC together and know what story they are telling you, rather than optimizing for one metric in isolation.
 



 • You are creative\-literate, and can brief an editor or designer clearly enough that what comes back actually matches what you had in mind.
 



 • You are comfortable owning a number, and treat your product line's revenue and profitability as your own responsibility rather than something to report on.
 



 • You are decisive under ambiguity, and can make a scale or kill call on a campaign without waiting for someone else to tell you it is safe to do so.
 



 • You work well cross\-functionally, particularly with creative, operations, and finance, since a good campaign idea is worthless if we cannot fulfill it profitably.
 



  





**Compensation and Benefits** 




  





 • Pay is based on experience, in line with market standards.
 



  





**Success Metrics for the First Three to Six Months** 




  





 • Revenue and ROAS targets for your assigned brand or product line are consistently met or exceeded.
 



 • CAC is held within target range as spend scales, rather than rising uncontrolled with volume.
 



 • A clear testing cadence is in place, with new creative angles and hooks tested on a regular schedule rather than ad hoc.
 



 • Scale and kill decisions are made promptly and correctly, without campaigns being left to run well past the point they should have been cut.
 



 • Strong working relationship established with the creative team, reflected in fewer revision rounds and faster turnaround from brief to finished ad.

* Knowledge\-Based Resolution: Utilize internal knowledge repositories, SOPs, and operational documentation to maximize first\-touch resolution while continuously expanding personal expertise.

title: Digital-Twin & Robotics Simulation Lead
description:
**Job Requirements**
 At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.
   

  

 We are looking for a Digital\-Twin and Robotics Simulation Engineer to build and maintain the simulation\-first pipeline for a humanoid robotics program. The role centers on building high\-fidelity digital twins in NVIDIA Omniverse / Isaac Sim, generating synthetic data, and supporting policy training and validation for a humanoid robot before it is deployed on physical hardware. Candidates with a strong real\-time 3D / simulation background (Unity, Unreal Engine, or similar, using C\+\+/C\#) who have since transitioned into the NVIDIA Omniverse / Isaac ecosystem are strongly preferred.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain physically accurate digital twins of robot platforms on OpenUSD using NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim.
* Set up scenes, sensors, physics properties, and environment randomization for synthetic data generation using Isaac Lab / Cosmos world models.
* Support training and post\-training of foundation\-model robot policies (e.g., Isaac GR00T\-class VLA models) by preparing simulation\-ready datasets and trajectories.
* Develop Python\-based tooling and pipelines to automate scene generation, domain randomization, data export, and simulation\-to\-training hand\-off.
* Integrate Omniverse / Isaac Sim outputs with ROS 2 nodes, middleware bridges, and downstream AI training workflows.
* Work with the embedded / MCU team to align simulation timing, sensor models, and control interfaces with hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) requirements.
* Validate simulation fidelity against real robot behaviour and iterate on physics tuning, sensor noise models, and scene accuracy.
* Collaborate with 3D content, AI/ML, and embedded engineers to keep digital assets, physics rigs, and policies in sync across the pipeline.
* Document simulation architecture, pipelines, and configuration for reuse across future robot programs.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and technical design reviews.


 We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.
   

  

 We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference\-makers in our workplace.
   

  

**Work Experience**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* 4\-9 years of software / simulation engineering experience, including current hands\-on work with NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim.
* Working experience with Isaac Lab, Isaac GR00T, and/or NVIDIA Cosmos world models (or clear ability to ramp up quickly on these).
* Strong Python scripting skills for simulation automation, data pipelines, and tooling.
* Solid foundation in 3D graphics, physics\-based simulation, and real\-time rendering concepts.
* Prior professional experience with Unity3D or Unreal Engine using C\+\+ and/or C\# — this real\-time engine background, later transitioned into NVIDIA Omniverse/Isaac, is a strong plus.
* Understanding of USD (Universal Scene Description) based workflows and asset/scene pipelines.
* Familiarity with robot description formats (URDF/USD physics articulation) and basic robotics concepts (kinematics, sensors, actuators).
* Experience with version control (Git), Agile development, and collaborative engineering practices.
* Good communication and documentation skills; comfortable working with cross\-functional AI, embedded, and simulation teams.


**Desired / Good\-to\-have Skills**
* Exposure to synthetic data generation, domain randomization, and dataset annotation for AI/ML model training.
* Familiarity with ROS/ROS2 middleware and robot control stacks.
* Experience with GPU\-accelerated reinforcement learning or imitation learning workflows.
* Exposure to humanoid, AMR, AGV, or robotic\-arm simulation projects.
* Knowledge of sensor simulation (LiDAR, depth cameras, IMU) within Omniverse/Isaac Sim.
* Understanding of sim\-to\-real transfer challenges and techniques.
* Familiarity with cloud/on\-prem GPU compute environments for large\-scale simulation and training.


**Domain Experience**
* Digital Twin \& Simulation Platforms
* Robotics / Humanoid Systems
* NVIDIA Omniverse / Isaac Ecosystem
* Synthetic Data Generation for AI/ML

title: Quality Engineering Lead (US Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
description:
Job Description
 



  





 We are looking for a highly skilled and hands\-on
 **Quality Engineering Lead** 
 with strong experience in the
 **US Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)** 
 domain. The ideal candidate should have deep healthcare business knowledge, proven QA leadership capabilities, and expertise in driving end\-to\-end testing across complex healthcare applications.
 



 This role requires an individual who can lead QE teams, work closely with business and technology stakeholders, define quality strategies, mentor team members, and ensure high\-quality product delivery.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  




* 7\+ Years of experience in Quality Testing, US Healthcare, RCM, Manual Testing.
* Lead and manage Quality Engineering activities for healthcare applications and RCM platforms.
* Define and drive QA strategy, test planning, execution, automation adoption, and quality governance.
* Work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, Operations, and Client stakeholders.
* Provide leadership to QA teams across multiple projects and PODs.
* Conduct requirement analysis and identify test scenarios, risks, and quality gaps.
* Drive functional, integration, regression, API, and end\-to\-end testing initiatives.
* Review test cases, execution results, defect reports, and quality metrics.
* Establish QA best practices, testing standards, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Participate in release planning, defect triage, and production support activities.
* Coach and mentor QA engineers and leads to build a high\-performing QE organization.
* Implement automation and AI\-driven testing approaches wherever applicable.



  





 Mandatory Domain Expertise
 



 Strong hands\-on experience in US Healthcare with deep understanding of:
 


* Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
* Claims Lifecycle Management
* Patient Registration
* Eligibility \& Benefits Verification
* Prior Authorization
* Charge Capture
* Medical Coding
* Claims Submission
* Denial Management
* Payment Posting
* Accounts Receivable (AR) Follow\-up
* Appeals \& Collections



  





 Strong understanding of:
 


* Medicare \& Medicaid
* Commercial Payers
* Provider and Payer workflows
* HIPAA compliance
* EDI Transactions:
* 837 Claims
* 835 Remittance
* 270/271 Eligibility
* 276/277 Claim Status
* Healthcare data validation and testing



  





 Technical Skills
 


* Strong expertise in Functional Testing and Test Management.
* Experience in API Testing using Postman, Swagger, or similar tools.
* Hands\-on experience with Automation frameworks using Selenium, Playwright, or equivalent.
* Good understanding of SQL and Database Validation.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and quality metrics.
* Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar ALM tools.



  





 Leadership Expectations
 


* Manage and lead QA teams of 10\+ members.
* Drive accountability, ownership, and delivery excellence.
* Strong stakeholder management and client\-facing communication.
* Experience presenting quality metrics to leadership.
* Ability to identify risks early and drive resolution.
* Build and scale QE practices across projects.



  





 Preferred Qualifications
 


* Experience leading QA for Healthcare RCM transformation programs.
* Exposure to AI\-assisted testing and test automation initiatives.
* ISTQB certification preferred.
* Experience with Facets, Epic, Cerner, Athena, QNXT, or other healthcare platforms is an added advantage.



  





 Success Profile The ideal candidate is:
 


* Strong in Healthcare RCM domain.
* Hands\-on and technically sound.
* Able to challenge requirements and drive quality improvements.
* Strong communicator and people leader.
* Comfortable working with business, operations, and technology teams.
* Focused on delivery, accountability, and measurable quality outcomes.

 Notice Period: Immediate to 15 Days

 Shaik Thanveer Ahamed

title: Operations Associate (E-Commerce)
description:
**About Joify** 




  





 Joify is a new\-age ice cream brand built on our family's four decades of expertise in ice cream manufacturing. We make real ice cream (not frozen dessert), formulated with 11% milk fat to deliver superior richness and creaminess. We're on a mission to build a strong regional FMCG brand across South India, starting with Andhra Pradesh \& Telangana.
 



  





***Instagram***
 : @joifyicecreams
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 Joify is an FMCG brand at its core, and we've also launched a direct\-to\-consumer online store for Hyderabad. We're hiring someone to run Joify's D2C e\-commerce operations end\-to\-end. You'll be the single point of accountability for everything that happens after a customer clicks "buy" on our website \- inventory, packing, dispatch, delivery coordination, customer communication, managing helpers and the numbers behind all of it. This is a hands\-on operational role, not a desk job \- expect to be on your feet in a cold storage area, packing boxes, and on the phone with delivery riders and customers throughout the day.
 



  





***Compensation***
*: Rs.30,000 per month* 




  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





***Shopify \& Inventory Management***




  




* Manage the Shopify backend: update stock levels, process and fulfill orders, mark shipments, handle cancellations and refunds
* Track SKU\-level inventory across individual ice cream units and curated packs; flag low stock and place replenishment requests with the factory
* Conduct daily physical inventory counts of e\-commerce stock in cold storage, reconciling counts against Shopify records
* Manage inventory of packaging materials (boxes, tapes, labels, etc.) — track stock and place restock orders with vendors before running low



  





***Order Fulfillment \& Pre\-Packing***




  




* Assemble curated boxes from individual ice cream units ahead of demand, keeping them neatly organized and dispatch\-ready in cold storage
* Pack individual customer orders with support from a packing helper
* Perform quality control on every pre\-packed box before dispatch \- checking for melt, damage, and seal issues
* Supervise and manage the packing helper's day\-to\-day work, including task allocation and scheduling



  





***Logistics \& Delivery Coordination***




  




* Book and coordinate orders with delivery partners (Rapido, Uber, Porter, etc.) for each dispatch, choosing the best option on cost and speed
* Track deliveries in real time and troubleshoot issues as they arise \- wrong turns, delays, failed drop\-offs



  





***Customer Communication***




  




* Contact customers post\-order to verify delivery address and confirm someone will be available to receive the ice cream
* Own WhatsApp Business as a customer channel \- understand requirements, resolve queries, and log requests



  





***Reporting \& Analytics***




  




* Track sales analytics \- order volume, SKU performance, delivery success rate, refund/complaint rate
* Send a daily report to the director covering order volume, stock levels, customer queries, and any open issues



  





**Requirements** 



* Prior experience in e\-commerce operations, D2C fulfillment, or logistics coordination (food/FMCG experience is a strong plus)
* Comfortable working in a cold storage/freezer environment and doing physical packing work
* Strong communication skills in Telugu, English and Hindi for customer\-facing calls
* Basic proficiency with Shopify (or willingness to learn quickly), spreadsheets, and WhatsApp Business
* Familiarity with Hyderabad\-area geography for delivery ETA estimation is a plus
* Location: Jubilee Hills, Road No 36\. Timings: 11AM \- 8PM
* 6 days a week. Holiday is on Monday. Saturday and Sunday are working days.
* Comfortable working weekends/evenings, since ice cream order volume peaks then.

title: Software Asset Analyst II
description:
**Role Overview**
 The Software Asset \& License Analyst II handles the work that is too complex or too consequential for the Level I queue: unlisted software triage and due diligence, renewals and true\-ups tracked as events against contract records, M\&A software integration, and the configuration and auditing of automated licence reclamation. Where Level I is measured on speed and accuracy against high\-volume queues, Level II is measured on judgment — deciding whether a request should proceed at all, what evidence it needs, and what it commits the client to.
   

  

 The analyst works one of the three IST\-anchored shifts, reporting to that shift's Level III lead, and mentors the Level I associates on the same window. Eight of these roles exist across the team — two on APAC and three each on EMEA and NAMER — with the heavier weighting on the shifts that carry the larger request volumes. Because the client is the licensee on every agreement, the analyst's discipline in gating, evidencing and recording is what keeps commercial and compliance exposure off the client's books.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Complex Requests \& Unlisted Software Triage
* Triage unlisted software requests in the enterprise ticketing queue, logging eligible items in the unified tracker and advancing due\-diligence\-complete requests to weekly triage review.
* Enforce intake gating rules: identify and reject high\-risk use cases (e.g., customer\-facing code, personal device use, reverse engineering) using standard responses and appropriate routing.
* Secure sensitive data by immediately moving tickets containing license keys, audit notifications, or accessibility info to the private queue.
* Manage security and legal gates by collecting VSA project IDs, verifying EULA/clickwrap reviews, and flagging cases requiring director\-level signatures.
* Escalate signed agreements to the formal contract intake path; do not accept or process these locally within the unlisted queue.
* Resolve complex entitlement and edition decisions, prioritizing reusable existing assets before initiating new purchases.
* Renewals, True\-Ups \& Contract Event Management
* Create and track contract events against the correct Deal Radar ID using the standard event types — new contract, contracted renewal, true\-up and predict\-and\-purchase — with correct recurrence numbering.
* Work the milestone schedule on assigned events: compile the Initial Licence Position from usage scans and consumption snapshots, gather domain Invest/Maintain/Divest sentiment, and produce the Final Licence Position with harvested licences already pruned from the baseline.
* Apply the correct commercial workflow for true\-ups — an amendment where a signature alters contracted baseline quantities, a purchase\-order addition where no signature is required.
* Maintain contract metadata accurately: products, pricing, start and end dates, evergreen clauses and committed spend, extracted from executed agreements.
* Process business\-as\-usual change management — licence changes, publisher name changes and product version updates — through the change log.
* Prepare purchase requisitions and support downstream three\-way matching, cross\-verifying invoices, unit prices and payment terms against the purchase order and the analyst's own records.
* M\&A Software Integration
* Maintain M\&A software inventory trackers, utilizing population scripts to map raw vendor data into unified deal tracking formats.
* Normalize publisher and title names against the master catalog, flagging net\-new vendors for portfolio review and insertion.
* Filter out\-of\-scope embedded technology; exclude software embedded in acquired public\-facing products from the termination queue.
* Automate ticket creation from tracker rows, bundling records under hotlists for executive visibility while maintaining master sync integrity.
* Process pre\-close terminations by collecting cancellation evidence and updating trackers without recording cost avoidance.
* Execute post\-close terminations under privacy controls: audit privacy sheets and pull details directly to avoid unauthorized vendor contact.
* Apply correct termination timelines: resolve short\-usage via cancellation proof and route long\-usage for security/legal exception approvals.
* Automated Reclamation, Audits \& Mentoring
* Configure automated harvesting: map product IDs, set inactivity thresholds, and classify software correctly as high\-risk (potential data loss on unassignment, requiring repeated use\-it\-or\-lose\-it warnings) or low\-risk (no data loss, reclaimed automatically after the 14\-day inactive notice).
* Run the daily former\-user sweep to reclaim licences from leavers, and execute manual reclamation surveys where automation does not yet cover a publisher.
* Record realised savings accurately in the licence\-reclaim audit table — deprovisioning date, software, user, initiative and reason — since the cost\-avoidance dashboards are built directly from these entries.
* Run the weekly and monthly licence audits for the assigned portfolio and act on the exceptions they surface.
* Mentor Level I associates on the shift: review their work, coach on gating judgment, and take the cases they should not decide alone.
* Flag automation candidates where a publisher's transaction volume approaches the 1,000\-per\-year threshold.


 PERFORMANCE \& SERVICE LEVELS
   

  

 Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured per shift.
   

  

* Intake Gating Accuracy: 100% of high\-risk and out\-of\-scope use cases correctly identified and routed; zero signed agreements actioned through the unlisted queue.
* Due Diligence Completeness: every request pushed to triage review carries complete security, privacy and legal evidence.
* Contract Event Integrity: correct Deal Radar ID, event type and recurrence on 100% of events created, with milestone deliverables on their due dates.
* Licence Position Quality: Initial and Final Licence Positions reconcilable to usage evidence, with harvested licences pruned before the renewal baseline is set.
* Reclamation \& Savings: reclamation rules configured to the correct risk class, and 100% of realised savings recorded completely enough to stand as the audit record.
* M\&A Tracker Discipline: tracker and ticket records kept synchronised, and privacy controls observed on 100% of post\-close terminations.
* Audit Cadence: weekly and monthly audits completed on time with exceptions actioned.
* Mentoring: agreed coaching and review commitments met for the Level I associates on the shift.


 TOOLS \& SYSTEMS
   

  

* Intake \& Queue: the enterprise ticketing queue with strict category coding for tracking tickets and bugs, the unified intake tracker, and the private queue for sensitive tickets.
* Contract \& Entitlement: Deal Radar for contract and event records, and Flexera / ServiceNow SAM for entitlement and consumption tracking.
* Legal \& Security Gating: vendor security assessment tooling, and Pactfinder / Accord for legal review and signature cases.
* Automation \& Reclamation: gHive automated harvesting and UiPath, plus Apps Script automation on the M\&A trackers.
* Financial: SAP Materials Management for purchase orders, amendments and three\-way matching.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
 Mandatory
   

  

* 3–7\+ years in software asset management, software licensing operations or software procurement.
* Practical command of licensing models and their governance differences across SaaS user\-based, installed device\-based, cloud\-hosted, floating and consumable\-credit software.
* Hands\-on renewal and true\-up experience, including building licence positions from usage data.
* Demonstrated gating judgment — able to recognise a request that must be stopped, escalated or re\-routed rather than fulfilled.
* Strong ticket and data discipline, with attention to category coding, evidence retention and audit\-ready records.
* Comfortable working one of three IST\-anchored shifts, including the NAMER window (22:00–06:00 IST).
* Clear English communication with requesters, approvers, publishers and resellers.


**Preferred**
* Software asset management certification (IAITAM CSAM, ITIL, Flexera or ServiceNow SAM credential).
* M\&A software integration experience, including terminations under privacy constraints.
* Experience configuring automated licence harvesting and setting risk\-based reclamation rules.
* SAP Materials Management experience and exposure to three\-way matching.
* Spreadsheet automation or scripting (Apps Script, Python) applied to tracker and reporting work.

title: AI Operations Incident Commander
description:
**Role Summary** 




 As the AI Operations Incident Commander (Offshore), you will lead live incident coordination during offshore hours and provide structured command for production issues impacting the clients AI support environment. We need someone who can rapidly size the situation, confirm severity, engage the right teams, keep the bridge disciplined, and maintain an accurate view of what is happening technically. This role sits close to the work: you should be comfortable coordinating engineers, reviewing evidence, challenging weak updates, and preparing clean handoffs to the onshore lead and client stakeholders when needed.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Live incident command and technical coordination
 


* Lead Severity 1, Severity 2, and priority production incidents during offshore coverage, including bridge setup, severity confirmation, responder coordination, action tracking, and restoration cadence.
* Drive structured technical triage across SRE, platform, integration, application, service desk, security, and vendor teams so incidents continue moving and do not stall in ambiguity.
* Maintain a current command view of symptoms, likely causes, actions in progress, risks, dependencies, and next decisions required.



 2\. Handoffs, escalation, and operational discipline
 


* Prepare concise, high\-quality handoffs to the onshore lead with clear incident status, unresolved risks, owners, timestamps, and recommended next actions.
* Escalate early when severity, business impact, stakeholder sensitivity, or technical uncertainty requires broader engagement or onshore leadership attention.
* Ensure ticket hygiene, bridge notes, timelines, and action logs are complete enough to support RCA, reporting, and clean follow\-through.



 3\. Change risk, problem management, and improvement support
 


* Support operational readiness for risky changes, releases, and maintenance activities by asking the right questions about rollback, validation, monitoring, and support readiness.
* Contribute incident evidence and technical observations into post\-incident reviews and corrective\-action planning.
* Identify repeat failure patterns, weak runbooks, and support\-process gaps, then push improvements back into the service.



 4\. Stakeholder engagement and team ways of working
 


* Work closely with the onshore incident lead, offshore engineers, resolver groups, vendors, and service leadership to keep decision\-making and recovery aligned.
* Engage stakeholders proactively to unblock work rather than waiting for direction when an incident is already live.
* Create structure in fast\-moving situations and help less experienced responders operate with clarity and confidence.



**Preferred Skills and Experience** 




  





**Major incident leadership** 




 Experience coordinating high\-severity production incidents, including bridge management, severity assessment, action tracking, and restoration management.
 



**Technical support depth** 




 Enough technical depth to follow cloud, application, integration, and observability signals and challenge incomplete or weak technical updates.
 



**Service operations and ITIL** 




 Experience working within ITIL\-aligned incident, problem, change, and service\-request processes with strong ticket hygiene.
 



**Communication and handoffs** 




 Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to provide concise bridge updates and high\-quality handoffs across shifts.
 



**Problem solving under ambiguity** 




 Ability to make sound decisions with incomplete information, prioritize quickly, and keep progress moving.
 



**Ownership and teamwork** 




 Strong sense of ownership, comfort operating in ambiguity, and willingness to engage stakeholders proactively to unblock work.
 



**Nice to Have** 



* Experience in cloud platform support, AI platform support, complex enterprise application support, or NOC / command\-center style operations.
* Experience coordinating high\-priority incidents in an ITIL\-aligned environment with strong documentation discipline.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow, bridge tooling, service reporting, shift handoffs, and working in a managed\-services model.
* Comfort working across offshore and onshore support teams with shared ownership and tight communication loops.



**Working Style \& Core Behaviors** 



* Stays calm and methodical when incidents are noisy, urgent, or under\-defined.
* Knows how to separate signal from noise and keep the bridge focused on the next best action.
* Works well with engineers, service desk teams, vendors, and leadership without waiting for perfect direction.
* Pushes for clarity, evidence, and ownership while still being collaborative and pragmatic.
* Treats clean handoffs and documentation as part of the job, not admin work.



**What Good Looks Like** 



* Can take control of a live incident quickly and make it obvious what the team is doing and why.
* Keeps technical responders focused, escalates at the right time, and does not let issues drift.
* Hands off incidents cleanly to onshore leadership without losing context or forcing rework.
* Turns repeated failure patterns into better runbooks, monitoring, and support discipline.



**Team Context** 




 You will join PwCs AI Operations \& Platform Support team supporting clients run\-state AI environment. The operating model is centered on Level 2 and Level 3 support, monitoring, incident response, service requests, minor enhancements, and continuous improvement across AWS/Bedrock, OpenAI, and related platform components.
 



 This role will work in a managed\-services model focused on incident management, service requests, monitoring, minor enhancements, knowledge management, and continuous improvement. Success depends not only on technical skill, but also on ownership, collaboration, and the ability to engage stakeholders to progress work.

title: Analyst - Cyber Defense
description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Your Team**
 The Cyber Defense team is responsible for monitoring Security alerts, investigating potential data loss events, and helping protect sensitive information across the enterprise. The team works closely with Engineering, Insider Risk, to ensure alerts are reviewed consistently, and risk\-based outcomes are documented. This role is part of the operational team that provides insights, tuning recommendations, and policy\-level suggestions to the DLP Committee while Engineering continues to own implementation of platform and policy changes.
   

  

**Your Role**
* 3\+ Yrs of experience in cyber security.
* Monitor and triage DLP alerts, including email, endpoint, Teams/SharePoint/OneDrive, and cloud activity where applicable.
* Review alert context, validate true positives versus false positives, collect supporting evidence, and document outcomes clearly.
* In consultation with the Insider Threat Team, assist in engaging users and business contacts when additional context or business justification is required for data movement activity.
* Escalate confirmed, high\-risk, or repeat data loss events to the Senior DLP Operations Lead, Incident Response, Insider Risk, as appropriate.
* Identify recurring false positives, noisy rules, data classification gaps, and process pain points; provide tuning and policy\-level recommendations to the DLP Engineering team.
* Support operational reporting by tracking alert volumes, disposition trends, SLA adherence, repeat offenders, common data types, and control effectiveness indicators.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive investigation steps such as enrichment, evidence collection, user notification, ticket routing, case closure, and reporting.
* Contribute operational observations and metrics for DLP Committee discussions, including emerging risks, policy friction points, and recommended improvement actions.


**Academic Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Information Security, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
* Foundational understanding of data protection, information security, security operations, incident handling, and enterprise collaboration platforms.
* Exposure to Microsoft Purview DLP, Microsoft 365 security/compliance tools, SIEM, ticketing systems, or case management workflows is preferred but not mandatory
* Professional certifications such as Microsoft SC\-400, SC\-200, Security\+, SSCP, or equivalent security/privacy certifications are preferred but not mandatory.
* Strong written communication, analytical thinking, attention to detail, and ability to document investigation findings in a clear, audit\-ready manner.


**Full Time / Part Time**
 Full time
   

  

**Worker Type**
 Employee
   

  

**Job Exempt (Yes / No)**
 Yes
   

  

**Workplace Model**
 At Invesco, our workplace model supports our culture and meets the needs of our clients while providing flexibility our employees value. As a full\-time employee, compliance with the workplace policy means working with your direct manager to create a schedule where you will work in your designated office at least three days a week, with two days working outside an Invesco office.
   

  

**Why Invesco**
 In Invesco, we act with integrity and do meaningful work to create impact for our stakeholders. We believe our culture is stronger when we all feel we belong, and we respect each other’s identities, lives, health, and well\-being. We come together to create better solutions for our clients, our business and each other by building on different voices and perspectives. We nurture and encourage each other to ensure our meaningful growth, both personally and professionally.
   

  

 We believe in diverse, inclusive, and supportive workplace where everyone feels equally valued, and this starts at the top with our senior leaders having diversity and inclusion goals. Our global focus on diversity and inclusion has grown exponentially and we encourage connection and community through our many employee\-led Business Resource Groups (BRGs).
   

  

**What’s in it for you?**
 As an organization we support personal needs, diverse backgrounds and provide internal networks, as well as opportunities to get involved in the community and in the world.
   

  

 Our benefit policy includes but not limited to:
   

* Competitive Compensation

* 30 days’ Annual Leave \+ Public Holidays

 In Invesco, we offer development opportunities that help you thrive as a lifelong learner in a constantly evolving business environment and ensure your constant growth. Our AI enabled learning platform delivers curated content based on your role and interest. We ensure our manager and leaders also have many opportunities to advance their skills and competencies that becomes pivotal in their continuous pursuit of performance excellence.

**Google Ads Specialist – Google Ads \| Lead Generation \| Demand gen \| Pmax \| Search campagin** 




**Managed monthly budget of minimum 5 lakhs and above** 




  





**Full\-Time \| Work From Office: 5days Working \| Banjara Hills, Hyderabad** 
 \| Reports to: Pod Manager
 



  





**Company Description** 




  





**Digital Mojo** 
 is a results\-driven digital marketing agency based in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. Since 2016, we have been helping brands scale through performance\-focused digital strategies, lead generation, branding, and high\-impact marketing campaigns.
 



  





**Role Description** 




  





**We are looking for a Google Ads Expert with 4\-6 years of hands\-on agency experience managing Google Ads campaigns across multiple industries and budget scales.** 
 This is not a role for someone who sets up campaigns and waits for results. Senior Performance Marketer/Google Ads Specialist is expected to own campaign outcomes, drive lead quality, manage budgets strategically, and bring proactive optimization thinking to every account they handle. You will work closely with the Pod Manager and Account Managers and will be the performance authority within the pod.
 



 At this level, you are expected to mentor junior performance marketers, contribute to campaign strategy, and have direct conversations with clients on performance when needed.
 



  





**What This Role Is Not** 



* Not someone who only executes what is briefed without questioning the strategy
* Not someone who reports numbers without explaining what they mean and what to do next
* Not a junior marketer with more years of experience
* Not someone who needs to be told when to optimize



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Campaign Strategy and Execution** 



* Plan, build, and manage Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns end\-to\-end across multiple client accounts
* Run campaigns across Search, Display, Performance Max, YouTube, Demand Gen, Meta Feed, Reels, and Stories
* Own campaign architecture including structure, targeting, bidding strategy, ad copy, and budget allocation
* Develop campaign strategies aligned with client business goals and not just platform defaults
* Conduct deep keyword research, audience building, competitor analysis, and market sizing before going live
* Recommend campaign types and budget splits based on funnel stage and client objective



**2\. Performance Ownership and Optimization** 



* Own CPL, CTR, ROAS, conversion rate, and lead quality metrics for all assigned accounts
* Proactively identify underperforming elements and optimize without waiting to be asked
* Run structured A/B tests on creatives, audiences, landing pages, and ad formats
* Monitor campaigns daily and make real\-time adjustments to protect budget and performance
* Know when a campaign needs a tweak and when it needs a complete strategic overhaul
* Deliver consistent performance improvement quarter on quarter across accounts



**3\. Budget and Spend Management** 



* Manage monthly ad spends ranging from small accounts to large multi\-lakh budgets
* Allocate budgets across campaigns, platforms, and ad sets based on performance data
* Pace spending efficiently throughout the month without over\-spend or under\-delivery
* Flag budget risks, anomalies, and opportunities to the Pod Manager proactively
* Maintain a clear spend vs performance log for each account at all times



**4\. Reporting and Client Communication** 



* Prepare accurate, insightful, and well\-presented performance reports for each account
* Go beyond numbers in reports. Explain what happened, why it happened, and what comes next
* Present performance updates to clients independently or alongside the Account Manager
* Translate complex campaign data into clear business language that clients understand
* Respond to client performance queries with confidence and data



**5\. Lead Generation and Funnel Strategy** 



* Understand the full lead generation funnel from ad click to qualified lead to conversion
* Work with Account Managers and the Pod Manager on landing page recommendations, form optimization, and funnel improvements
* Track and improve lead quality, not just lead volume
* Coordinate with creative teams on ad creatives that are built to convert, not just look good
* Set up and maintain conversion tracking, pixel integrations, and tag management accurately



**6\. Tools, Tracking, and Tech** 



* Set up and manage Google Tag Manager, GA4, Meta Pixel, and conversion tracking across accounts
* Use platform tools including Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, Search Ads 360, and third\-party reporting tools
* Identify tracking gaps and fix them before they impact reporting or optimization decisions
* Stay current on platform updates, algorithm changes, and new ad formats and implement them where relevant
* Leverage AI tools for campaign ideation, copy generation, audience research, and performance analysis



**7\. Mentorship and Team Contribution** 



* Guide and review the work of junior performance marketers within the pod
* Share best practices, optimization frameworks, and campaign learnings with the team
* Contribute to agency\-level performance marketing SOPs and processes
* Participate in new business pitches and proposal building when required



  





**Key KPIs** 



* CPL and ROAS across assigned accounts
* Lead Quality Score
* Month\-on\-Month Campaign Performance Improvement
* Budget Utilization Efficiency
* Report Accuracy and Submission Timeliness
* Client Satisfaction on Performance
* Conversion Tracking Accuracy
* Optimization Frequency and Impact



  





**Required Skills and Qualifications** 



* 4\-6 years of hands\-on performance marketing experience in a digital marketing agency
* Expert\-level knowledge of Google Ads including Search, Display, Performance Max, and YouTube
* Expert\-level knowledge of Meta Ads including Feed, Reels, Stories, and Lead Gen campaigns
* Strong understanding of CPL, ROAS, CTR, CPC, conversion tracking, and funnel optimization
* Experience managing campaigns across multiple industries and monthly budgets at scale
* Proficiency in GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and Meta Ads Manager
* Strong analytical thinking with the ability to derive actionable insights from data
* Good English communication skills for client\-facing reporting and calls
* Experience with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or Perplexity for campaign support
* Google Ads certification and Meta Blueprint certification preferred



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile** 



* Agency experience is mandatory
* **Has independently managed monthly budget of minimum 5 lakhs and above**
* Has run campaigns across real estate, education, healthcare, or other high\-CPL industries
* Can own a campaign from brief to results with minimal supervision
* The character in sitcom is Phoebe
* Brings strategy to the table and does not just execute instructions
* Has mentored or reviewed the work of at least one junior team member



  





**Reporting Structure** 



* Reports To: Pod Manager
* Works Closely With: Account Managers, Creative Team, SEO Team
* Client Facing: Yes, on performance calls and reporting when required



  





**Career Growth** 




 Google Ads Expert → Performance Marketing Lead → Pod Manager → Head of Performance
 



  





**Job Type:** 
 Full\-Time, Work From Office, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad
 



  





**Benefits:** 
 Health Insurance \| Provident Fund \| Leave Encashment

 EHS Implementation at Site: Ensure end\-to\-end execution of all site\-level EHS plans, procedures, and compliance obligations in line with corporate policies and legal requirements. ?
