title: GTM & Growth Intern
description:
We’re looking for a GTM \& Growth Intern who wants hands\-on experience building and executing goto\-market strategies for B2B technology products.
 



 This is a high\-ownership role for someone who is comfortable moving between market research, ICP
 



 development, prospecting, messaging, outreach, and marketing execution. You will work closely with
 



 the sales and leadership teams to identify the right accounts, reach the right decision\-makers, test GTM
 



 hypotheses, and turn market interest into qualified conversations.
 



 We are looking for someone who is curious, commercially minded, persistent, and comfortable taking
 



 initiative rather than waiting for a predefined checklist.
 



  





**What you will do** 



* Work on go\-to\-market strategy for defined customer segments and help refine or define the Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) where required.
* Research industries, target accounts, competitors, buying signals, and relevant market opportunities.
* Map target organisations, understand their structure, and identify the right decision\-makers, influencers, champions, and economic buyers within each account.
* Build, enrich, segment, and maintain high\-quality prospect and account lists.
* Run multi\-channel outbound outreach across email, LinkedIn, calls, industry networks, and other relevant channels.
* Write and test outreach sequences, positioning, hooks, and messaging for different ICPs and buyer personas.
* Follow up rigorously, qualify initial interest, and help generate a consistent flow of relevant meetings for the sales team.
* Develop positioning and value propositions based on customer pain points, industry context, buying priorities, and market feedback.
* Create GTM and sales collateral including one\-pagers, case studies, short decks, comparison sheets, account\-specific material, and outreach assets.
* Support founder\-led LinkedIn communication, product narratives, webinars, industry events, partnerships, associations, and other relevant market\-building initiatives.
* Maintain disciplined tracking of outreach, responses, meetings, opportunities, and experiments.
* Analyse GTM performance every week and identify what should be scaled, changed, tested, or stopped.
* Bring insights from prospect conversations and market research back to the sales, product, and leadership teams to continuously improve our GTM strategy.



  





**Who we are looking for** 



* Final\-year student or recent graduate with an interest in B2B growth, sales, marketing, business development, or go\-to\-market strategy.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills. You should be equally comfortable writing a sharp cold email and speaking confidently with a prospective customer.
* Strong research ability and the curiosity to understand unfamiliar industries, businesses, organisational structures, and buyer personas quickly.
* Commercial thinking — you should naturally ask who should we target, why would they care, what would make them respond, and how do we reach them effectively?
* Clear and concise writing. We value specific, thoughtful communication over generic marketing language.
* Comfortable initiating conversations and following up persistently without becoming mechanical or spammy.
* High agency and ownership. You should be willing to experiment, solve problems independently, and figure things out when the playbook is not already written.
* Comfortable switching between strategy and execution — from researching an ICP in the morning to writing outreach, building a prospect list, creating a sales asset, or making calls later in the day.
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, CRM systems, LinkedIn, prospecting tools, AI tools, and basic design tools such as Canva or Figma.
* Resilient enough to handle experimentation, rejection, and changing assumptions — all of which are part of building an effective GTM motion.



  





**Preferred, but not required** 




 The following are strong advantages, but not mandatory requirements:
 



  




* Previous internship, project, or professional experience in technology, SaaS, mobility, electric vehicles, logistics, healthcare, or other B2B industries.
* An existing professional network within the technology or relevant industry ecosystem, including relationships with founders, operators, business leaders, industry professionals, associations, or potential buyers.
* The ability to leverage relevant relationships for warm introductions, market intelligence, partnerships, or faster access to prospective customers.
* Previous exposure to B2B sales, lead generation, business development, founder\-led sales, partnerships, or outbound GTM.
* Familiarity with modern GTM and prospecting tools such as Apollo, Clay, HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Instantly, Smartlead, or equivalent platforms.



  





 Having an established industry network will be considered a meaningful advantage because it can
 



 accelerate market access and early conversations, but the quality of your thinking, communication,
 



 execution, and ability to generate new relationships matters more than the size of your existing
 



 network.
 



  





**What you will learn** 



* How an ICP is defined, tested, challenged, and refined using actual market feedback.
* How a B2B go\-to\-market strategy moves from market selection and positioning to prospecting, outreach, qualification, and pipeline generation.
* How to research and navigate complex organisations and identify the people who influence purchasing decisions.
* How to build a repeatable outbound and lead\-generation engine rather than simply sending cold messages.
* How messaging and positioning change across industries, buyer personas, and stages of the buying journey.
* How to design and evaluate GTM experiments using real commercial outcomes.
* How sales, marketing, partnerships, content, and customer conversations work together in an early\-stage growth function.



  





**What success looks like** 



* By the end of the internship, you should be able to take ownership of a target market or ICP and independently:
* Build and continuously improve a high\-quality target account and prospect universe.
* Map the relevant stakeholders and decision\-makers within priority accounts.
* Develop a clear GTM hypothesis, positioning, and outreach strategy for the segment.
* Execute structured multi\-channel outbound campaigns and follow\-up sequences.
* Generate a consistent flow of relevant, qualified conversations and meetings.
* Identify patterns in objections, responses, buyer behaviour, and market feedback.
* Use data to recommend changes to ICP, messaging, channels, and GTM strategy.
* Build reusable playbooks, collateral, account intelligence, and market insights that strengthen the broader sales and growth engine.
* Demonstrate measurable contribution to qualified pipeline and commercial opportunities.

 Joining: Immediate
 



  





***About AutoXperia***




 AutoXperia is an automotive technology and customer acquisition platform helping automobile dealerships convert digital enquiries into verified customer appointments, test drives, showroom visits and vehicle sales.
 



 We work with multiple automotive brands and dealership groups and are building technology, marketing and operational infrastructure to transform the way automotive customers and dealerships connect.
 



 As our customer enquiry volume grows, we are building a 24/7 Customer Verification \& Response Team to ensure that every genuine customer receives a fast and professional response.
 



  





***🎯 The Role***




 We are looking for high\-energy, customer\-focused Telecallers who can join our rapidly growing startup and become an important part of AutoXperia's customer acquisition engine.
 



 Your primary responsibility will be to connect with incoming automotive enquiries quickly, understand customer requirements, verify the enquiry and convert the customer into a qualified appointment/test\-drive opportunity.
 



  





 Our Core Principle:Every Lead Matters. Every Minute Matters.
 



 Our target is to connect and close/qualify every incoming lead within 30 minutes, wherever customer availability permits.
 



  





 Key Roles \& Responsibilities
 



 📞 1\. Immediate Lead Response
 


* Receive and respond to fresh customer enquiries generated through AutoXperia's website and digital campaigns.
* Make the first call to the customer as quickly as possible.
* Attempt to connect with new leads within the 30\-minute response window.
* Maintain a professional and customer\-friendly communication style.



  





 🚗 2\. Understand Customer Requirements
 



 Understand the customer's:
 


* Preferred car/bike model
* Location
* Purchase timeline
* Budget
* Finance requirement
* Exchange requirement
* Test\-drive requirement
* Preferred dealership
* Other relevant purchase preferences



  





 ✅ 3\. Lead Verification
 


* Verify customer details and mobile number.
* Confirm genuine interest in the selected vehicle.
* Identify genuine purchase intent.
* Avoid submitting incomplete or misleading customer information.
* Maintain accurate remarks and call dispositions in the CRM.



  





 📅 4\. Appointment \& Test Drive Conversion
 



 Where applicable:
 


* Schedule test drives.
* Schedule showroom visits.
* Coordinate customer availability with the dealership.
* Confirm appointments.
* Follow up on pending appointments.
* Update the CRM with appointment status.



  





 🤝 5\. Dealer Coordination
 



 AutoXperia operates between customers and automotive dealerships.
 



 You will therefore coordinate with dealership teams to:
 


* Share qualified customer information.
* Confirm appointment acceptance.
* Follow up on appointment status.
* Capture dealership feedback.
* Escalate unresolved customer/dealer issues to the concerned team.



  





 💻 6\. CRM \& Data Management
 



 Every interaction matters.
 



 You will be responsible for:
 


* Updating every call disposition.
* Maintaining accurate customer remarks.
* Recording follow\-up dates.
* Updating appointment status.
* Maintaining lead lifecycle information.
* Ensuring no lead is left unattended.



  





 📊 Startup Mindset – What We Expect
 



 AutoXperia is a high\-growth startup, and this is not a role where you simply make calls and complete a daily call count.
 



 We expect team members to:
 


* Take ownership of their leads.
* Move quickly.
* Learn continuously.
* Suggest process improvements.
* Work collaboratively.
* Be comfortable with changing processes.
* Take responsibility for outcomes rather than just activities.
* Understand that their work directly contributes to company revenue.



 If you identify a problem in the process, we want you to tell us and help us solve it.
 



  





 🏆 Performance Metrics
 



 Your performance will be evaluated on meaningful business outcomes, including:
 


* Lead response time
* Call connection rate
* Lead verification rate
* Qualified lead percentage
* Appointment conversion
* Test\-drive bookings
* Showroom visits
* Follow\-up efficiency
* CRM accuracy
* Customer feedback
* Dealer feedback



 Most Important KPI:⚡ Lead → Human Connection → Qualification → Appointment
 



 Our objective is to build a system where no genuine customer waits unnecessarily for a response.
 



  





 💰 Salary \& Incentives
 



 Fixed Salary: ₹15,000/month (For Freshers)
 



 Additional Performance Incentives: Based on individual/team performance.
 



 Incentives may be linked to parameters such as:
 


* Qualified leads
* Verified appointments
* Test drives
* Successful follow\-ups
* Overall campaign performance



 High performers will have an opportunity to grow rapidly with the company.
 



  





 🌱 Why Join AutoXperia?
 



 You will be joining at an exciting stage of our journey.
 



 At AutoXperia, you will get exposure to:
 



 Automotive \+ Technology \+ Digital Marketing \+ AI \+ CRM \+ Sales \+ Customer Acquisition
 



 You won't be just a telecaller.
 



  





 You will learn how a startup takes a digital customer from:
 



 Advertisement → Lead → Verification → Appointment → Test Drive → Dealership → Booking → Retail
 



 This exposure can open career paths into:
 


* Senior Customer Acquisition Executive
* Team Leader
* Customer Success
* Dealer Relationship Management
* Sales Operations
* Business Development
* Campaign Operations
* Startup Operations



  





 👤 Who We're Looking ForFreshers are welcome.

* Excellent communicators

* Good listeners
* Comfortable working with CRM/software
* Target\-oriented

 Experience in any of the following is an advantage:
 


* Telecalling

* Lead generation
* Automobile dealerships
* Digital sales



 Automotive enthusiasts are especially welcome.

title: Senior Associate - Identity & Security Operations Engineer
description:
**Our Company**
 Oaktree is a leader among global investment managers specializing in alternative investments, with $224 billion in assets under management. The firm emphasizes an opportunistic, value\-oriented and risk\-controlled approach to investments in credit, private equity, real assets and listed equities. The firm has over 1500 employees and offices in 26 cities worldwide.
   

  

 We are committed to cultivating an environment that is collaborative, curious, inclusive and honors diversity of thought. Providing training and career development opportunities and emphasizing strong support for our local communities through philanthropic initiatives are essential to our culture.
   

  

 For additional information please visit our website at www.oaktreecapital.com.
   

  

 Identity \& Security Operations Engineer
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 We are seeking a hands\-on Identity \& Security Operations Engineer to support and improve the firm’s enterprise identity, access, and security operations capabilities. This role will sit at the intersection of identity administration, identity governance, directory services, access control, authentication, security operations, and compliance.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has strong operational experience with Saviynt, Microsoft Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, privileged access concepts, access governance, and enterprise security controls. This is not a purely governance or policy role. The successful candidate must be comfortable troubleshooting production issues, supporting identity integrations, resolving access and authentication problems, improving operational processes, and partnering with Security, Infrastructure, HRIS, Application, Audit, and Service Desk teams.
   

  

 This role will be responsible for maintaining reliable identity operations while also helping mature the firm’s security posture through stronger access controls, better visibility, automation, lifecycle governance, and secure administration practices.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Identity Governance and Saviynt Operations
   

  

 Provide day\-to\-day operational support for the Saviynt Identity Governance and Administration platform.
   

  

 Troubleshoot and resolve complex Saviynt issues involving access requests, entitlement visibility, requestability, certifications, provisioning failures, reconciliation errors, job failures, workflow issues, and user lifecycle events.
   

  

 Support onboarding and maintenance of applications, entitlements, roles, owners, approval workflows, and access request models within Saviynt.
   

  

 Partner with application owners to validate entitlement mappings, access models, role definitions, and provisioning behavior.
   

  

 Support joiner, mover, leaver processes across Workday, Saviynt, Active Directory, Entra ID, and downstream applications.
   

  

 Monitor scheduled jobs, connectors, feeds, reconciliations, and provisioning tasks to ensure identity data remains accurate and timely.
   

  

 Identify recurring operational issues and recommend process, workflow, connector, or data\-quality improvements.
   

  

 Microsoft Identity Administration
   

  

 Administer and support Microsoft Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, hybrid identity, directory synchronization, groups, service accounts, privileged groups, and access\-related directory objects.
   

  

 Troubleshoot authentication, authorization, directory replication, group membership, LDAP, Kerberos, DNS\-related identity issues, and Entra ID synchronization problems.
   

  

 Support identity\-related components such as Entra Connect, conditional access dependencies, enterprise applications, SSO integrations, group\-based access, and directory\-based provisioning.
   

  

 Assist with cleanup and rationalization of legacy identity objects, stale accounts, orphaned groups, privileged access paths, service accounts, and over\-permissioned access structures.
   

  

 Support secure administration practices across Microsoft identity platforms, including administrative role assignments, privileged group management, break\-glass account monitoring, and access reviews.
   

  

 Security Operations and Access Control
   

  

 Partner with Security Operations to investigate identity\-related alerts, suspicious sign\-ins, access anomalies, risky users, privilege misuse, and potential account compromise events.
   

  

 Support enforcement and monitoring of access controls across enterprise platforms, including MFA, Conditional Access, privileged access, least privilege, and separation of duties.
   

  

 Assist with security incident response activities where identity data, account access, authentication logs, or entitlement history are required.
   

  

 Review identity and access logs to support investigations, audit requests, control validation, and root cause analysis.
   

  

 Help improve detection, alerting, and reporting around privileged access, stale access, failed provisioning, unauthorized access changes, and identity lifecycle gaps.
   

  

 Support operational controls for high\-risk accounts, privileged accounts, service accounts, shared accounts, emergency access accounts, and application administrator access.
   

  

 Access Governance, Audit, and Compliance
   

  

 Support access certification campaigns, entitlement reviews, privileged access reviews, and compliance\-driven access validation activities.
   

  

 Partner with Audit, Compliance, Risk, and application owners to gather evidence, validate access controls, and remediate access findings.
   

  

 Help maintain control documentation for identity lifecycle management, access provisioning, deprovisioning, privileged access, role\-based access, and access review processes.
   

  

 Investigate and remediate access exceptions, orphaned entitlements, inappropriate access, excessive privileges, and failed deprovisioning events.
   

  

 Support control testing for SOX, SOC, internal audit, regulatory examinations, and other compliance requirements.
   

  

 Ensure identity operations are performed in accordance with firm policies, security standards, and documented procedures.
   

  

 Identity Integrations and Application Support
   

  

 Support identity integrations between Workday, Saviynt, Active Directory, Entra ID, ServiceNow, and enterprise applications.
   

  

 Troubleshoot identity data flow issues, attribute mismatches, provisioning failures, connector errors, group assignment problems, and access synchronization issues.
   

  

 Work with application teams to define access models, entitlement structures, approval workflows, provisioning requirements, and access review expectations.
   

  

 Assist with onboarding new applications into identity governance, SSO, lifecycle management, or access review processes.
   

  

 Support SAML, OIDC, LDAP, and directory\-based access patterns from an operations and troubleshooting perspective.
   

  

 Automation, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement
   

  

 Develop and maintain scripts, reports, queries, dashboards, and operational checks to improve IAM reliability and visibility.
   

  

 Use PowerShell, SQL, Python, Saviynt reporting, Entra admin tools, and ITSM data to identify trends, recurring issues, control gaps, and automation opportunities.
   

  

 Create repeatable procedures for common IAM operations, access corrections, incident response support, application onboarding, and audit evidence collection.
   

  

 Improve documentation, knowledge base articles, runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and handoff materials for IAM and Service Desk teams.
   

  

 Participate in change management, incident management, problem management, and post\-incident reviews.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 5\+ years of experience in Identity and Access Management, identity operations, security operations, directory services, or access administration.
   

  

 3\+ years of hands\-on experience administering or supporting Saviynt in an enterprise environment.
   

  

 Strong working knowledge of identity governance, access provisioning, access certifications, entitlement management, RBAC, identity lifecycle management, and joiner/mover/leaver processes.
   

  

 Strong hands\-on experience with Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.
   

  

 Experience troubleshooting authentication, authorization, directory, synchronization, group membership, provisioning, and access\-related issues.
   

  

 Experience supporting Workday\-to\-IAM or HR\-driven identity lifecycle integrations.
   

  

 Understanding of security operations concepts, including account compromise investigation, privileged access monitoring, access anomalies, and identity\-related incident response.
   

  

 Experience supporting audit, compliance, access reviews, evidence gathering, and control remediation.
   

  

 Working knowledge of SSO, SAML, OIDC, LDAP, Kerberos, MFA, Conditional Access, and hybrid identity concepts.
   

  

 Strong scripting or reporting experience using PowerShell, SQL, Python, or similar tools.
   

  

 Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.
   

  

 Ability to work with technical teams, application owners, business stakeholders, auditors, and security teams.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Saviynt certification or formal Saviynt training.
   

  

 Microsoft identity or security certifications.
   

  

 Experience with privileged access management platforms such as CyberArk, Delinea, BeyondTrust, or Microsoft Entra Privileged Identity Management.
   

  

**Experience With ServiceNow Or Another Enterprise ITSM Platform.**
 Experience with Microsoft Defender, Entra ID Protection, Sentinel, Splunk, or other SIEM/security monitoring tools.
   

  

 Experience in financial services, asset management, investment management, or another regulated enterprise environment.
   

  

 Experience supporting SOX, SOC, SEC, FINRA, HIPAA, or similar control frameworks.
   

  

 Experience with API\-based integrations, connector troubleshooting, identity data transformation, or IAM workflow design.
   

  

 Familiarity with Zero Trust principles, least privilege, separation of duties, and privileged access governance.
   

  

 Core Competencies
   

  

 Strong hands\-on operational mindset.
   

  

 Ability to troubleshoot complex identity and access issues across multiple systems.
   

  

 Security\-focused approach to identity administration and access control.
   

  

 Strong understanding of how identity, access, authentication, and security operations intersect.
   

  

 Ability to identify root causes and drive long\-term fixes, not just one\-time access corrections.
   

  

 Comfortable working in a complex, high\-control enterprise environment.
   

  

 Strong documentation discipline and attention to detail.
   

  

 Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

 Tools and Technologies
   

  

 Saviynt Identity Governance and Administration
   

  

 Microsoft Active Directory
   

  

 Microsoft Entra ID
   

  

 Entra Connect
   

  

 Conditional Access
   

  

 Microsoft MFA
   

  

 Privileged Identity Management
   

  

 Workday
   

  

 ServiceNow
   

  

 PowerShell
   

  

 SQL
   

  

 Python
   

  

 SAML
   

  

 OIDC
   

  

 LDAP
   

  

 Kerberos
   

  

 Microsoft Defender
   

  

 SIEM tools such as Sentinel or Splunk
   

  

 Privileged access management platforms
   

  

 Windows Server identity services
   

  

 Success Measures
   

  

 Improved stability and reliability of Saviynt operations.
   

  

 Faster resolution of provisioning, reconciliation, access request, and identity lifecycle issues.
   

  

 Improved access visibility and entitlement accuracy.
   

  

 Reduced stale, orphaned, excessive, or inappropriate access.
   

  

 Stronger privileged access monitoring and operational controls.
   

  

 Improved audit readiness and faster evidence collection.
   

  

 Better integration between IAM operations, security operations, and application access management.
   

  

 Clearer documentation, runbooks, and support processes.
   

  

 Measurable reduction in recurring IAM incidents and manual access correction work.

title: Collateral Management - Senior Associate
description:
****Job Description****
**Who we are looking for:**
 We are looking for a candidates with experience in Collateral Management to reduce credit risk by exchanging cash/securities with counterparties. Should have knowledge in calculations based on MTM and results in sending Margin calls. The position will contain a basic training to carry out activities by working both remotely from home and from office.
   

  

****Why This Role Is Important To Us:****
 Collateral management main focus is to reduce credit risk by exchanging eligible cash or securities between counterparties. The daily calculations are based on MTM of the underlying trades and results in sending Margin Calls, which in turn lead to agreeing transfers. Based on the agreements between our clients and the counterparties the Collateral team in India ensures that all the exposures are fully collateralized and the agreed collateral transactions settle as agreed..
   

  

**What you will be responsible for: As Senior Associate you will:**
* Margin call processing \- Process daily margin calls daily for all agreed clients, who will include banks and fund clients and both cash and security margin calls.
* Reconcile collateral balances, investigate and solve discrepancies; be the main point of contact/ escalations
* Fails investigation \- Checking the cash non\-receipt reports and the custody settlement system and initiating correspondence with the client and counterparties
* Reporting \- Generate a variety of reports, which includes client and internal
* Portfolio reconciliations \- Completing any daily or ad hoc manual portfolio reconciliations.
* Interest Processing \- Month end interest statement generation, settling interest, updating interest agreements, and updating and validating interest rates.


 Substitutions
   

  

 Coupon / Maturities
   

  

 Transformation initiatives
   

  

****What We Value:****
* These skills will help you succeed in this role
* Proficient knowledge of MS Excel and Outlook; Power Point and Word will be an advantage
* Proficient knowledge of MS Access and VBA
* Very good command of English; effective communication, ability to write and sing off official documents
* Experience in finance and custody
* Knowledge of OTC markets/ derivatives instruments, Collateral Onboarding
* Numeracy skills; attention to details
* Accuracy and ability to work with tight deadlines
* Ability to collaborate and teamwork; organizational skills; supervising group of specialist if need be
* Self\-motivated and reliant, flexible
* Project Management methodologies would be an advantage


****Education \& Preferred Qualifications:****
* Graduate and above preferably in Finance
* B.COM, BBM/BBA. MBA (Finance), M.COM or any degree related to Finance or Commerce

* Certification on NCFM / CISI (Chartered Institute for Securities \& Investment)

title: Site Engineer - Structural Steel
description:
The Site Engineer \- Structural Steel is responsible for planning, coordinating, supervising, and executing all structural steel fabrication, erection, and installation activities in accordance with approved drawings, project specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and construction schedules. The role involves managing the erection of structural steel frameworks, columns, beams, bracings, trusses, platforms, staircases, grating systems, equipment support structures, pipe racks, and miscellaneous steel components. The engineer shall review shop drawings, fabrication drawings, connection details, erection methodologies, lifting plans, and material specifications to ensure compliance with project requirements and applicable standards.
   

  

 Responsibilities include coordinating with clients, consultants, subcontractors, fabricators, survey teams, cranes, and erection crews to ensure safe and efficient execution of works. The engineer shall monitor fabrication quality, material traceability, bolt tightening, welding activities, dimensional control, alignment, verticality, plumbness, and connection installations. Additional duties include conducting site inspections, ensuring compliance with approved method statements, coordinating non\-destructive testing (NDT), supporting quality audits, resolving technical issues, managing manpower and equipment resources, and tracking project progress against approved schedules.
   

  

 The Site Engineer shall prepare daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports, maintain erection records, coordinate inspection requests, and support testing, punch\-list clearance, and project handover documentation. The role also requires strict adherence to HSE regulations, lifting safety requirements, and quality procedures to ensure incident\-free project execution. Experience in Data Centre, Industrial, Power, Infrastructure, Oil \& Gas, or Commercial Construction projects is preferred. The candidate should possess strong knowledge of structural steel erection methodologies, welding practices, bolted connections, fabrication processes, lifting operations, NDT requirements, and relevant codes such as AISC, BS, ASTM, IS, and project\-specific standards. A Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Civil/Mechanical Engineering with 3\+ years of relevant experience is required. Strong technical, planning, coordination, and communication skills are essential for successful project delivery.

title: Zscaler ZPA SME- Hybrid HYBRID at Hyderabad, Telangana 500032
description:
Location \- Hybrid 2\-3 Days/week at \- 14th and 15th Floor, Nexity Tower 20, Survey No. 83/1, Knowledge City, Raidurgam, Gachibowli, Hyderabad, Telangana 500032
 



 Fully remote as contractor \- This is contract role with 12 Months duration (12 months to start likely to extend or be ongoing)

 Zscaler ZPA SME
 



  





 Position Overview
 



 We are seeking an experienced Zscaler ZPA (ZTNA) Subject Matter Expert to serve as a key member of the implementation team for an enterprise Zscaler Private Access deployment.
 



 The initial architecture and design will be completed by Zscaler and/or an implementation partner. This role will serve as the primary technical interface between the client and the implementation partner, working closely with both teams throughout the deployment to ensure a successful implementation.
 



 The ZPA SME will remain engaged for the duration of the deployment, providing technical guidance, coordination, validation, troubleshooting, and knowledge transfer.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 · Serve as the primary client\-facing technical resource for the ZPA implementation.
 



 · Work alongside the Zscaler implementation partner/subcontractor throughout the deployment.
 



 · Act as the technical liaison between the client’s internal teams and the implementation partner.
 



 · Develop a strong understanding of the established ZPA architecture and help ensure it is implemented as intended.
 



 · Participate hands\-on in the configuration, deployment, testing, and validation of ZPA.
 



 · Support configuration of App Connectors, application segments, server groups, segment groups, access policies, and related ZPA components.
 



 · Coordinate with client networking, security, identity, infrastructure, and application teams as needed throughout deployment.
 



 · Support identity and authentication integrations, including SAML, MFA, and enterprise identity providers.
 



 · Assist with application onboarding, testing, troubleshooting, and migration to ZPA.
 



 · Identify technical issues, dependencies, and deployment risks and work with the appropriate teams to drive resolution.
 



 · Provide limited design guidance or configuration recommendations when requirements evolve during deployment.
 



 · Remain engaged following the implementation partner’s involvement as needed to support stabilization, troubleshooting, and transition to operations.
 



 · Provide knowledge transfer and documentation to the client’s internal teams.
 



  





 Required Experience
 



 · Strong hands\-on experience implementing and supporting Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) in enterprise environments.
 



 · Demonstrated experience participating in enterprise\-scale ZPA deployments, not solely ongoing administration.
 



 · Strong understanding of ZTNA and Zero Trust security concepts.
 



 · Hands\-on knowledge of ZPA App Connectors, application segmentation, access policies, and application onboarding.
 



 · Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including DNS, routing, firewalls, proxies, and application connectivity.
 



 · Experience integrating ZPA with enterprise identity and authentication platforms such as Entra ID/Azure AD, Okta, SAML, and MFA.
 



 · Strong troubleshooting skills across networking, security, identity, and application environments.
 



 · Experience working with third\-party implementation partners and cross\-functional client teams.
 



 · Strong client\-facing communication skills with the ability to translate technical issues and coordinate across multiple teams.
 



  





 Ideal Candidate
 



 We are looking for a hands\-on ZPA implementation expert who can be the client’s technical point person throughout the deployment. This person does not need to be the primary architect of the solution, but should have enough ZPA expertise to understand the architecture, work effectively with the implementation partner, recognize potential issues, and help drive the deployment through completion and stabilization.
 



 Zscaler certifications and previous experience with large enterprise ZPA implementations are strongly preferred.

**Role Overview**
 As Specialist of HPC Cloud Engineering, you will maintain and support HPC solutions in the cloud using IaC, CICD, job schedulers (both cloud and on\-premise), researcher pipelines, and cloud\-native services. Automate low\-value tasks to allow scientists to focus on high\-value work, leveraging elastic cloud resources to accelerate workflows. **Primary Skills (must\-have)**

* Experience with job schedulers and orchestrators viz. GridEngine, PBS Pro, and Altair NavOps.
* Knowledge of network architectures and high\-speed interconnects.
* Strong analytical skills to assess and interpret complex data.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to convey findings and recommendations.
* Strong problem\-solving skills.
* Proactive approach to identifying and addressing potential risks.
* Meticulous attention to detail to ensure accurate assessments and reporting.
* Understanding of relevant regulations and compliance standards.
* Experience with disaster recovery, data backup solutions, and virtualization platforms
* Good problem\-solving skills
* Customer \& product\-centric mindset

title: Director - Delivery Excellence
description:

 is dedicated to digitally enabling our vision of "Health for a Better World." The External Services team collaborates with peer health systems in the US to help them achieve their digital transformation goals while enhancing operational efficiency and predictability.

* Oversee delivery excellence across multiple clients and act as the escalation authority for systemic delivery issues impacting multiple accounts.

* Drive efficiencies continuously through account leadership and delivery teams

* Develop tools and guidance supporting effective delivery of services, such as service level management. Manage key vendor partner relationships as required in doing so.


 Leadership Characteristics
   

  

* Collaboration and Influence : The executive must be able to build strong and enduring relationships across the organization and facilitate collaborations, transparent communications, and alignment between diverse constituents. S/he must have the ability to move seamlessly between various stakeholders, gaining support for key initiatives.

Conscientiously builds a diverse talent pipeline of highly capable caregivers. Demonstrates the value of diversity and inclusion in leadership efforts.
* Thought Leader : Knowledgeable about current business and healthcare practices. Capable of critical operational and financial analytics. Leverages best business practices to solve problems. Leverages strategies that grow and develop the organization. Stays on top of emerging business and healthcare trends. Thinks innovatively and facilitates creativity in others. Is mentally agile; “thinks well on their feet.” Introduces break \- through thinking, enabling new mental models to emerge.

* 18\+ years of overall IT experience, with progressive leadership responsibility.

* Executive\-level stakeholder management and communication skills.

title: Full-Chip STA Signoff Engineer
description:
**This role is for one of Weekday's clients
   

  

 Salary range: Rs 1400000 \- Rs 3200000 (ie INR 14 \- 32 LPA)**
 Min Experience: 6\+ years
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad
   

  

 JobType: full\-time
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Full\-Chip STA Signoff Engineer** 
 with 6\-17 years of hands\-on experience in Static Timing Analysis and timing closure for complex SoC designs. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in
 **full\-chip STA signoff** 
 , timing analysis, constraint development, timing closure, and signoff methodologies across advanced semiconductor process nodes.
   

  

 You will work closely with RTL, synthesis, physical design, clock, and implementation teams to analyze timing, identify critical paths, resolve timing violations, and ensure the design meets all timing requirements before tapeout.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Own and execute full\-chip Static Timing Analysis (STA) signoff for complex SoC designs
* Perform timing analysis across multiple modes and corners (MMMC) and ensure complete timing coverage
* Analyze setup, hold, recovery, removal, minimum pulse width, clock gating, and other timing checks
* Develop, review, and maintain timing constraints including SDC, clocks, generated clocks, input/output delays, false paths, multicycle paths, and clock uncertainty
* Debug and resolve timing violations across functional and test modes
* Perform detailed analysis of critical timing paths, identify root causes, and work with implementation teams on timing closure
* Review timing reports and distinguish between real violations, constraint issues, and tool\-related exceptions
* Support timing closure through synthesis, place\-and\-route, ECO, and final signoff stages
* Validate timing constraints and ensure consistency between RTL, synthesis, STA, and physical implementation environments
* Analyze clock skew, latency, reconvergence, clock interactions, and clock\-domain timing relationships
* Work with physical design teams to resolve congestion, buffering, routing, transition, capacitance, and timing\-related issues
* Participate in timing signoff reviews and provide actionable recommendations for improving PPA and timing
* Perform timing correlation between different implementation and signoff stages
* Automate STA analysis, report generation, and debugging workflows using Tcl, Python, or Perl
* Ensure timing signoff quality and completeness before tapeout


 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

* Strong hands\-on expertise in STA Signoff
* 6\-17 years of experience in ASIC/SoC physical design or timing analysis
* Proven experience with full\-chip timing signoff for complex designs
* Strong understanding of Static Timing Analysis concepts and methodologies
* Excellent knowledge of MMMC timing analysis and timing closure
* Strong expertise in SDC constraints and timing exceptions
* Experience analyzing setup/hold violations, clock skew, uncertainty, latency, and critical paths
* Hands\-on experience with industry\-standard STA tools such as Synopsys PrimeTime
* Strong understanding of clock definitions, generated clocks, asynchronous clocks, false paths, and multicycle paths
* Good understanding of ASIC implementation, synthesis, place\-and\-route, CTS, ECOs, and physical effects on timing
* Strong scripting skills in Tcl and/or Python
* Experience working with large, hierarchical, multi\-million\-instance SoC designs


 Good\-to\-Have Skills
   

  

* Experience with advanced process nodes and complex SoC designs
* Knowledge of MCMM/OCV, AOCV, POCV, CPPR, and variation\-aware timing analysis
* Understanding of SI/crosstalk\-aware timing analysis
* Experience with low\-power designs, UPF, and multi\-voltage timing analysis
* Exposure to timing ECO implementation and signoff automation
* Familiarity with formal equivalence checking and physical verification flows
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving abilities


 Education
   

  

 Bachelor's or Master's degree in
 **Electrical Engineering, Electronics, VLSI, Microelectronics, or a related field** 
 .

**What You’ll Be Doing (position summary):** 




 The
 **Specialist, OTC Settlements** 
 is responsible for the timely, accurate, and controlled execution of settlement, reconciliation, and investigation activities supporting Precious Metals operations within Capital Markets and Treasury. The role ensures end\-to\-end operational integrity across settlement processing, inventory movements, invoice validation, and metal delivery tracking, while minimizing risk through effective controls, issue resolution, and stakeholder coordination.
 



 This role requires strong technical knowledge, sound judgment, and the ability to independently manage complex investigations, escalations, and day\-to\-day issue resolution in a high\-volume, deadline\-driven environment.
 



 At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on\-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.
 



  





**How You’ll Succeed (responsibilities):** 




**CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:** 



* Execute and oversee daily settlement activities related to Precious Metals transactions, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to internal controls and operating procedures
* Perform detailed reconciliations across inventory positions, cash movements, metal deliveries, invoices, and settlement records to identify and resolve discrepancies
* Independently investigate and resolve complex reconciliation breaks, unmatched items, settlement exceptions, and inventory discrepancies, including root cause analysis where applicable
* Review and validate invoices, delivery documentation, and settlement support records to ensure completeness, accuracy, and audit readiness

* Identify process gaps and recommend workflow, control, and efficiency improvements to strengthen settlement and reconciliation practices
* Partners closely with internal stakeholders including Front Office, Trade Control, Finance, Technology, Operations leadership, and other support teams to ensure accurate settlement processing, timely issue resolution, and effective escalation management
* Builds and maintains strong working relationships with external counterparties, and depositories to support Precious Metals settlement activities, resolve discrepancies, and ensure smooth operational execution.

 3\+ years of experience

* Supports end\-to\-end Precious Metals settlement and reconciliation activities across Capital Markets and Treasury, with responsibility for ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and control in a high\-volume, deadline\-driven environment
* Handles complex operational investigations related to settlement breaks, inventory discrepancies, invoice validation, metal delivery tracking, and exception management, requiring strong judgment, attention to detail, and effective coordination across multiple stakeholders
* Contributes to risk mitigation and operational excellence by maintaining strong documentation and audit trails, supporting escalations, identifying control gaps, and recommending process improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce operational risk

* Significant experience in settlements, reconciliations, or operations within a Capital Markets, Treasury, or Precious Metals environment
* Demonstrated experience in Precious Metals inventory management at depositories, invoice processing, and metal delivery tracking
* Proven ability to independently investigate and resolve complex operational breaks, discrepancies, and settlement issues
* Strong understanding of operational risk, controls, escalation practices, and exception management
* Continuous improvement mindset with the ability to identify opportunities to strengthen processes and controls

title: Creative Head
description:
We are hiring a Creative Head to lead and grow our in\-house creative team, and to actively raise the creative bar across everything we make, rather than simply keeping the production line running. You will manage every video editor and graphic designer across our brand portfolio, own the daily production system that turns Growth Manager briefs into finished ad creative at volume, and push our creative angles forward rather than only executing what is asked of the team. This is a player\-coach role. You need to be genuinely capable of picking up an edit or a design and doing it yourself, not just directing people who can.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Manage the entire Creative Production team, including all video editors and graphic designers, across our full brand portfolio and any brand we add going forward.
* Own creative strategy across all brands, proactively identifying new hooks, formats, and angles rather than only executing briefs handed down from Growth Managers.
* Run the team's daily production system, including task assignment, the points\-based workload model covering Scratch, Stock Scratch, Hard Swap, Easy Swap, and Hook Change edits, and throughput targets, while continuing to improve volume and efficiency without sacrificing quality.
* Partner directly with Growth Managers across all brands to align creative direction with what the performance data is actually showing, including ROAS, CPM, CTR, hook rate, and hold rate.
* Personally edit video and design graphics or product creative when needed, since this role requires real hands\-on ability rather than only review and approval.
* Build and maintain a searchable library of winning creative so that proven hooks, angles, and formats are reused rather than reinvented.
* Set and enforce quality standards and the review and revision process across the team.
* Close the performance feedback loop by making sure editors and designers actually see how their own work performed, rather than simply being told to produce more.
* Recruit, onboard, and develop video editors and graphic designers as the team scales.
* Evaluate and roll out new AI creative tools to increase speed without sacrificing hook quality or design standards.
* Own creative from day one for any new brand launch, establishing visual identity and initial ad creative direction.
* Report on team output, creative performance, and productivity against target to the Chief Growth Officer.



  





**Required Qualifications and Experience** 



* At least five years of hands\-on experience across both video editing and graphic or product design. This role requires genuine dual\-discipline skill, not proficiency in one area and familiarity with the other.
* Prior experience leading creative strategy for a direct\-to\-consumer or e\-commerce company, with a track record of creative decisions that measurably improved performance metrics such as ROAS, CTR, or hook rate, rather than only aesthetic output.
* Experience managing a team of editors or designers, including people leadership, coaching, and holding a team accountable to both quality and volume targets.
* Comfortable operating across multiple brands or categories at the same time without losing creative distinctiveness between them.
* Strong fluency in performance marketing metrics and how creative choices actually drive them. You should be as comfortable in a data review as in a creative review.
* Working knowledge of AI\-assisted creative tools for both video and design production.
* A bachelor's degree is preferred but not required.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience scaling a creative team from a small group to a larger production operation.
* Exposure to multiple consumer categories, such as health, wellness, supplements, beauty, or adjacent areas.
* Experience building the creative identity for a brand from launch, rather than only optimizing an existing one.
* Familiarity with production\-tracking or points\-based workflow systems.



  





**Where We Expect to Find This Person** 




 Strong candidates are likely to come from one of the following backgrounds.
 


* A Creative Director or Head of Creative at a consumer brand, managing an in\-house video and design team.
* A senior creative lead at a performance marketing agency, managing creative output across multiple client accounts.
* A senior video editor or designer who has grown into a creative leadership role and can demonstrate both the strategic and people\-management side of the work, not just the craft.



  





**Key Competencies** 



* You are genuinely capable in both disciplines, and can personally sit down and complete an edit or a design file yourself.
* You think strategically and tactically at once. You can set creative direction across several brands and still fix one specific cut that is not working.
* You are data\-literate, and can read a performance dashboard as fluently as a creative brief, letting the data change the direction when it should.
* You are a strong people leader who can coach a production team on speed and quality at the same time, without one coming at the cost of the other.
* You are systems\-minded and comfortable operating inside a structured production pipeline with targets, points, and throughput tracking.



  





**Compensation and Benefits** 



* Competitive fixed compensation, commensurate with experience, reflecting a senior leadership position.



  





**Success Metrics for the First Three to Six Months** 



* Team\-wide production targets for volume and efficiency are consistently met across the brand portfolio.
* A measurable creative\-driven performance improvement, such as in ROAS, CTR, or hook rate, on at least one brand, that can be attributed to a creative strategy change you introduced.
* A performance feedback loop is established, so editors and designers are regularly shown how their own work performed.
* Clean creative ownership of any new brand launch that falls within this window, from identity through the first ad sets.
* Revision cycles and first\-pass approval rates are trending in the right direction across the team.

* Experience in SQL, building dashboards, data collection/transformation, visualization/dashboards, or experience in a scripting/programming language (e.g. Python).
* Experience working with engineering and product teams to create tools, solutions, or automation to improve user safety.
* Experience working closely with policy teams.
* Ability to translate complex data analyses and emerging abuse trends into actionable business strategies for non\-technical stakeholders and leadership.


**About The Job**
 Trust \& Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know\-how, excellent problem\-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big\-picture thinker and strategic team\-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross\-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed \- with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.
   

  

 Our team has the critical mission of protecting and respecting Google's users, ensuring online safety in both core and emerging areas. We are at the center of the company\-wide charge to raise the bar on content, including coherent policies and scaled and effective enforcement. We have recently expanded beyond traditional product protections focusing on additional types of abuse: brand safety, controversial content, violent extremism, and political interference. We've advanced user protections, and demonstrated expertise across Google’s growing array of products and services.
   

  

 In this role, you’ll lead a team, be a thought leader, an excellent operator and will collaborate cross\-functionally. You will bring passion for abuse fighting, focus on putting the user first and lead a high performing team to deliver excellent business results. You will partner with key stakeholders to drive operational performance and lower abuse rates.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Architect the roadmap for global ads defense. Oversee the deployment of analytical frameworks and fraud\-detection methodologies to proactively identify and mitigate content that violates Google Ads policies, staying one step ahead of evolving adversarial tactics.
* Lead strategic cross\-functional initiatives by partnering with executive stakeholders across product, engineering, legal, Public Relation (PR), and public policy to influence long\-term technical roadmaps, roll out policy updates, and ensure safer\-by\-design product features.
* Forge and scale a team of subject matter experts. Advocate a culture of continuous learning and psychological safety, ensuring your team remains resilient and high\-performing while navigating the rapid pace and sensitive nature of global ads content and policies.
